Function glaExternalGLCode_Valid(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("glaExternalGLCode").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select glaGLChartID From GLAccounts Where glaExternalGLCode = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("glaExternalGLCode").Value)) & " And glaGLChartID <> " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("glaGLChartID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Call e.AddWarning("External account " + Trim(Fields("glaExternalGLCode").Value) + " has already been entered for chart " + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("glaGLChartID").Value)) End If End If End Function
Function glaInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("glaInactive").Value) = True Then Fields("glaInactiveDate").Value = Date Else Fields("glaInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function

Function MaterialIssueComponents_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True End If Exit Function End If End Function
Function MaterialIssueComponents_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If End Function
Function inkPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsParts
If CBool(Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("inkPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("inkPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("inkDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("inkUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End if
End Function
Function inkInvIssueQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("inkInvIssueQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError trim(Fields("inkInvIssueQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End if End Function
Function inkInvScrapQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("inkInvScrapQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError trim(Fields("inkInvScrapQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End if End Function
Function inkJobMatIssueQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("inkJobMatIssueQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError trim(Fields("inkJobMatIssueQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function inkJobMatScrapQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("inkJobMatScrapQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError trim(Fields("inkJobMatScrapQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End if End Function
Function inkJobMatReturnIssueQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("inkJobMatReturnIssueQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError trim(Fields("inkJobMatReturnIssueQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function inkJobMatReturnScrapQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("inkJobMatReturnScrapQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError trim(Fields("inkJobMatReturnScrapQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End if End Function
Function inkPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("inkPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("inkPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("inkPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("inkPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then if CInt(Fields("inkPosted").Value) = 0 And not Fields("inkMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value then if Fields("inkMaterialIssueLineID").Fields("injIssueType") = 2 or Fields("inkMaterialIssueLineID").Fields("injIssueType") = 1 then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cPartRevisionID + "', Warehouse ID '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin ID '" + cBin + "' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." end if else If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cPartRevisionID + "', Warehouse ID '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin ID '" + cBin + "' is inactive." end if end if End If End If End Function

Function PartCrossReferences_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText,rsTemp cText = "" If Trim(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("imxOrgPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select imxPartID,imxPartRevisionID,imxOrganizationID,imxLocationID,imxOrgPartID From PartCrossReferences Where imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value)) + " And imxLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imxLocationID").Value)) + " And imxOrgPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imxOrgPartID").Value)) + " And Not (imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartRevisionID").Value) + ")",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False cText = cText + "Org Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("imxOrgPartID").Value) + "' already exists for organization '" + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value) + "' location '" + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imxLocationID").Value) + "' on part '" + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imxPartID").Value) + "' rev '" + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imxPartRevisionID").Value) + "'" + Chr(13) rsTemp.MoveNext Loop End If rsTemp.Close End If e.AddError cText End Function
Function PartCrossReferences_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "Update PartRevisions Set " & _ "imrPreferredRefExists = 1, " & _ "imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) & ", " & _ "imrConversionFactor = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) & _ "Where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartID").Value) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartRevisionID").Value) & " And imrSupplierOrganizationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value) & " And imrPurchaseLocationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxLocationID").Value)
End Function
Function PartCrossReferences_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "Update PartRevisions Set " & _ "imrPreferredRefExists = 0 " & _ "Where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartID").Value) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartRevisionID").Value) & " And imrSupplierOrganizationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value) & " And imrPurchaseLocationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxLocationID").Value)
End Function
Function imxLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("imxLocationID").Value) <> "" Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT cmlLocationID FROM OrganizationLocations WHERE cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value) + " And cmlLocationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = True Then msgbox "'" + Fields("imxLocationID").Value + "' does not exist in the OrganizationLocations table", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Close") e.Cancel = True End if oRs.Close
Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select cmlQuoteLocation,cmlShipLocation,cmlPurchaseLocation from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value)) + " And cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsData.Fields("cmlQuoteLocation").Value) <> 0 Or CInt(rsData.Fields("cmlShipLocation").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("imxSold").Value = True End If If CInt(rsData.Fields("cmlPurchaseLocation").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("imxPurchased").Value = True End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function PartCrossReferences_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "SELECT * FROM PartOrgReferences WHERE imzPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartID").Value) + " And imzPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imzOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imxOrganizationID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Call App.CopyMatchingFields(rsData,Fields) Else MsgBox "not found" End If rsData.Close End Function

Function lmdEmploymentDeclarationOnFile_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("lmdEmploymentDeclarationOnFile").Value) = True Then Fields("lmdEmploymentDeclarationDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("lmdEmploymentDeclarationDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function lmdPayrollDefinitionID_Valid(sender, e) dim rsParent : Set rsParent = Record.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If IsNull(rsParent) = False Then dTerminationDate = rsParent.Fields("lmeTerminationDate").Value If CBool(Fields("lmdPayrollDefinitionID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("lmrInactive").Fields("lmrInactive").Value) And IsDate(dTerminationDate) = False Then e.AddError "This employee is linked to an inactive Payroll Definition." , True End If End If End Function
Function lmdWorkingHolidayMaker_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("lmdWorkingHolidayMaker").Value) = False then Fields("lmdHomeCountry").Value = "" end if End Function
Function lmdStateAus_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("lmdState").Value = Fields("lmdStateAus").Value End Function

Function dslPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData, bKitPart If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then bKitPart = False If Trim(Fields("dslPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select impPhantomOrKitPart from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then bKitPart = rsData.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value End If rsData.Close End If Fields("dslKitPart").Value = bKitPart End if
End Function
Function dslQuantityShipped_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If Cdbl(Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value) = 0 and Not Cbool(App.Props("ProductionProperties").Fields("xapSMDeleteZeroShipmentLines").Value) then e.AddError "You must enter at least one ship qty before continuing." + chr(13) end if
If CBool(App.Ax("DMRShipments").CheckSumOfShipQtyForDelivery(Record.Table.BindingSource)) = False then e.AddWarning "There are deliveries that are set up to be filled by multiple jobs on this shipment. This has caused the quantity shipped to be greater than the delivery quantity." + chr(13) end if End if
call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value, Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Caption, e) End Function
Function validateNegativeQuantities(quantity, fieldCaption, e) Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If cdbl(quantity) < 0 And CBool(parentBs.Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError trim(fieldCaption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function DMRShipmentLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim cOrigShipmentID, nOrigShipmentLineID
If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If Trim(Fields("dslDMRClaimID").Value) <> "" Then cOrigShipmentID = Trim(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").OriginalValue) nOrigShipmentLineID = CInt(Fields("dslDMRShipmentLineID").OriginalValue)
cUpdate = ""
If Trim(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Value) <> Trim(cOrigShipmentID) Or CInt(Fields("dslDMRShipmentLineID").Value) <> CInt(nOrigShipmentLineID) Then cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlDMRShipmentID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Value) cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlDMRShipmentLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("dslDMRShipmentLineID").Value)
'update TransferredToDMRShipment flag only when ShippedComplete is true If CBool(Fields("dslShippedComplete").Value)=True then cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlTransferredToDMRShipment = 1" else cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlTransferredToDMRShipment = 0" End if
End If If Trim(cUpdate) <> "" Then cUpdate = Mid(cUpdate, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE DMRClaimLines SET " & cUpdate & " WHERE dmlDMRClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimID").Value) & " AND dmlDMRClaimLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged("DMRClaimLines") End If End If Call RefreshOpenQty End if
End Function
Function DMRShipmentLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID").Value<>0) Then Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipmentLines Set dslReversed=1 Where dslDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value)+" And dslDMRShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipments Set dspReversed=1 Where dspDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipmentComponents Set dsoReversed=1 Where dsoDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value)+" And dsoDMRShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID").Value)
'to reset the DMR Claim after reversing a DMR Shipment to create a new DMR Shipment again. If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = True Then If CBool(Fields("dslPosted").Value) = True Then If Trim(Fields("dslDMRClaimID").Value) <> "" Then cUpdate = "" cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlDMRShipmentID = ''" cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlDMRShipmentLineID = 0" cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlTransferredToDMRShipment = 0"
If Trim(cUpdate) <> "" Then cUpdate = Mid(cUpdate, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE DMRClaimLines SET " & cUpdate & " WHERE dmlDMRClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimID").Value) & " AND dmlDMRClaimLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimLineID").Value) End If
End If End If End if
else Fields("dslReversed").Value=0 End If End Function
Function DMRShipmentLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim cOrigShipmentID, nOrigShipmentLineID
If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If Trim(Fields("dslDMRClaimID").Value) <> "" Then cUpdate = ""
cOrigShipmentID = Trim(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").OriginalValue) nOrigShipmentLineID = CInt(Fields("dslDMRShipmentLineID").OriginalValue)
If Trim(cOrigShipmentID) <> "" Or CInt(nOrigShipmentLineID) <> 0 Then cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlDMRShipmentID = ''" cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlDMRShipmentLineID = 0" 'need to ignore this line if doesn't need to set TransferredToDMRShipment flag to false when deleting the shipment cUpdate = cUpdate & ",dmlTransferredToDMRShipment = 0" End If If Trim(cUpdate) <> "" Then cUpdate = Mid(cUpdate, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE DMRClaimLines SET " & cUpdate & " WHERE dmlDMRClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimID").Value) & " AND dmlDMRClaimLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimLineID").Value) End If End If End if
If Trim(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID").Value<>0) Then Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipmentLines Set dslReversed=0 Where dslDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value)+" And dslDMRShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipments Set dspReversed=0 Where dspDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipmentComponents Set dsoReversed=0 Where dsoDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value)+" And dsoDMRShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID").Value) End If End Function
Function dslQuantityShipped_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nConvFactor If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("dslConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 And Trim(Fields("dslUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("dslInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value) / CDbl(nConvFactor), App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals) ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If Trim(Fields("dslJobID").Value) = "" Then If CInt(Fields("dslDMRClaimLineID").Value) <> 0 And CInt(Fields("dslInspectionLineID").Value) <> 0 Then If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dslReturnQuantityShipped").Value) Then Fields("dslInventoryQuantityShipped").Value = 0 Fields("dslReturnQuantityShipped").Value = nNewValue End If Else If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dslInventoryQuantityShipped").Value) Then Fields("dslReturnQuantityShipped").Value = 0 Fields("dslInventoryQuantityShipped").Value = nNewValue End If End If Else If CInt(Fields("dslJobMaterialID").Value) <> 0 Then If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dslJobMatQuantityShipped").Value) Then Fields("dslJobMatQuantityShipped").Value = nNewValue End If Else If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dslJobOprQuantityShipped").Value) Then Fields("dslJobOprQuantityShipped").Value = nNewValue End If End If End If End If End If End if
End Function
Function dslInventoryQuantityShipped_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call UpdateQuantityShipped End Function
Function dslJobMatQuantityShipped_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call UpdateQuantityShipped End Function
Function dslJobOprQuantityShipped_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call UpdateQuantityShipped End Function
Function dslConversionFactor_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call UpdateQuantityShipped End Function
Function dslReturnQuantityShipped_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call UpdateQuantityShipped End Function
Sub UpdateQuantityShipped Dim nConvFactor If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("dslInventoryQuantityShipped").Value) <> 0 Or CDbl(Fields("dslReturnQuantityShipped").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("dslConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 And Trim(Fields("dslUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("dslInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("dslInventoryQuantityShipped").Value) + CDbl(Fields("dslReturnQuantityShipped").Value)) * CDbl(nConvFactor), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value) Then Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value = nNewValue End If End If Else If CDbl(Fields("dslJobMatQuantityShipped").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("dslConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 And Trim(Fields("dslUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("dslInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("dslJobMatQuantityShipped").Value) * CDbl(nConvFactor), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value) Then Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value = nNewValue End If End If End If If CDbl(Fields("dslJobOprQuantityShipped").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("dslConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 And Trim(Fields("dslUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("dslInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("dslJobOprQuantityShipped").Value) * CDbl(nConvFactor), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value) Then Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value = nNewValue End If End If End If End If End if end sub
Sub RefreshOpenQty Dim rsClaims, nOpenQty, nClaimQty
If CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = 0 nDeliveryQty = 0 If CInt(Fields("dslDMRClaimLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsClaims = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsClaims.Open "select dmlQuantity,dmlQuantityShipped,dmlTransferredToDMRShipment from DMRClaimLines where dmlDMRClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimID").Value) & " and dmlDMRClaimLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("dslDMRClaimLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsClaims.EOF = False Then nClaimQty = CDbl(rsClaims.Fields("dmlQuantity").Value) If CBool(rsClaims.Fields("dmlTransferredToDMRShipment").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsClaims.Fields("dmlQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsClaims.Fields("dmlQuantityShipped").Value) End If If CDbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If rsClaims.Close End If Fields("dslDMROpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty Fields("dslDMRClaimQuantity").Value = nClaimQty
End if End Sub
Function dslDMRClaimLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RefreshOpenQty End Function
Function dslPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("dslPosted").Value = True or CBool(Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = True then Exit Function end if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("dslPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(Fields("dslPartID").Value, Fields("dslPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("dslPartWarehouseLocationID").Value, Fields("dslPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddError "Part ID '"+Fields("dslPartID").Value+"', Revision '"+Fields("dslPartRevisionID").Value+"', Warehouse '"+Fields("dslPartWarehouseLocationID").Value+"', Bin '"+Fields("dslPartBinID").Value+"' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." , True End If End If End Function

Function PartPrices_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText cText = "" If Trim(Fields("imiCustomerGroupID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("imiOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("imiPartGroupID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("imiPartID").Value) = "" Then cText = cText + "Part and Customer fields cannot both be empty" + Chr(13) End If If IsNull(Fields("imiStartDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("imiEndDate").Value) = False Then If Fields("imiStartDate").Value > Fields("imiEndDate").Value Then cText = cText + "Start date must be less than end date" + Chr(13) End If End If e.AddError cText End Function
Function PartPrices_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Dim cPartId,cPartRev cPartID = Trim(Fields("imiPartID").Value) cPartRev = Trim(Fields("imiPartRevisionID").Value) If cPartID <> "" And Trim(Fields("imiOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Call App.Ax("Part").CreatePartCrossRef(cPartID, cPartRev, "", Fields("imiOrganizationID").Value, Fields("imiLocationID").Value, "", "", 1, e.SqlTransaction) End If End Function
Function imiCustomerGroupID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imiCustomerGroupID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("imiOrganizationID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function imiPartGroupID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imiPartGroupID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("imiPartID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function imiPriceType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("imiPriceType").Value) = 2 Then Fields("imiInventoryPrice").Value = True ElseIf CInt(Fields("imiPriceType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("imiPartGroupID").Value = "" Fields("imiCustomerGroupID").Value = ""
Dim childBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartPriceBreaks") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False rsDetails.Fields("imjDiscount").Value = 0 rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End If End Function
Function imiPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim childBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartPriceBreaks") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False rsDetails.Fields("imjUnitPrice").Value = 0 rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function

Function wroSourceWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wroPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wroSourceWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Source warehouse does not exist for part " + Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value) End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function wroSourcePartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imbPartBinID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("wroPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wroSourceWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("wroSourcePartBinID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Source bin does not exist for part " + Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value) End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function wroDestinationWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wroPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wroDestinationWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Destination warehouse does not exist for part " + Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value) End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function wroDestinationPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPart, cPartRevision, cWarehouse, cBinDestination cPart = Trim(Fields("wroPartID").Value) cPartRevision = Trim(Fields("wroPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("wroDestinationWarehouseID").Value) cBinDestination = Trim(Fields("wroDestinationPartBinID").Value)
' quick exit 1: don't show error/warning for empty/non-existent part, Non-Stock/Kit part If cPart = "" then Exit Function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPart, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then Exit Function End if
' quick exit 2: don't show error/warning for posted and reversed receipt If CBool(Fields("wroPosted").Value) = true OR CBool(Fields("wroReversed").Value) = true Then Exit Function End If
If cBinDestination = "" then e.AddError "Destination bin is empty" Exit Function End if
If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsWarehouseBinValid(cWarehouse,cBinDestination, e.SqlTransaction)) = False Then e.AddError "Destination bin '" + cBinDestination + "' DOES NOT EXIST in Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "'." Exit Function End If
Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "select imbPartBinID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPart) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevision) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cWarehouse) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cBinDestination), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddWarning "Destination bin '" + cBinDestination + "' EXISTS in Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "', but is not assigned to this Part ID. It will be added to Part '" + cPart + "' Revision '" + cPartRevision + "' upon save." End If rsLookup.Close
If CBool(Fields("wroWarehouseReceiptID").Fields("wrpReversalEntry").Value) = False then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPart, cPartRevision, cWarehouse, cBinDestination, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPart + "', Revision '" + cPartRevision + "', Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin '" + cBinDestination + "' is inactive." End If End If
End Function
Function wroQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("wroQuantityReceived").Value, Fields("wroQuantityReceived").Caption, e) End Function
Function validateNegativeQuantities(quantity, fieldCaption, e) If cdbl(quantity) < 0 And CBool(Fields("wroWarehouseReceiptID").Fields("wrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError trim(fieldCaption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function

Fields("pawPeriod1").Value = rsData.Fields("paoPeriod1").Value Fields("pawPeriod2").Value = rsData.Fields("paoPeriod2").Value Fields("pawPeriod3").Value = rsData.Fields("paoPeriod3").Value Fields("pawPeriod4").Value = rsData.Fields("paoPeriod4").Value Fields("pawPeriod5").Value = rsData.Fields("paoPeriod5").Value Fields("pawPeriod6").Value = rsData.Fields("paoPeriod6").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function

Function refreshPriceBreaks() If Trim(Fields("qmmPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim nPriceID,rsTemp,rsDate,rsCurrency,nLoop,nConversion,nRate,cCurrency,bPrev
bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False
For nLoop = 1 To 9 Fields("qmmQuantityBreak" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = 0 Fields("qmmUnitCost" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = 0 Fields("qmmLeadTime" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = 0 Next Set rsCurrency = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsCurrency.open "Select cmlCurrencyRateID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmmPurchaseLocationID").Value), Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsCurrency.EOF = False Then cCurrency = rsCurrency.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value Else cCurrency = App.HomeCurrencyID End If rsCurrency.Close
Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("qmmPartID").Value,Fields("qmmPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("qmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value,Fields("qmmPurchaseLocationID").Value, 0, "Material", cCurrency, Nothing, 0) If IsNull(priceObj.PartPrice) = False Then Fields("qmmSourcePriceID").Value = priceObj.PartPrice.ID nPriceID = priceObj.PartPrice.ID End If Set priceObj = nothing
If nPriceID <> 0 Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsDate = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select PartPriceBreaks.*,imiInventoryPrice, imiCurrencyRateID From PartPriceBreaks Inner Join PartPrices On imjPartPriceID = imiPartPriceID Where imjPartPriceID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nPriceID) + " And imjUnitPrice <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText rsDate.open "Select qmpQuoteDate from Quotes where qmpQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmmQuoteID").value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If rsDate.EOF = false then nRate= App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(rsTemp.Fields("imiCurrencyRateID").value, rsDate.Fields("qmpQuoteDate").value) End If If nRate = 0 then nRate = 1 End If If CInt(rsTemp.Fields("imiInventoryPrice").Value) = 0 Then nConversion = CDbl(App.Ax("Part").GetConversionFactor(Fields("qmmPartID").Value,Fields("qmmPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("qmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value, Fields("qmmPurchaseLocationID").Value)) If nConversion <= 0 Then nConversion = 1 End If Else nConversion = 1 End If nLoop = 0 Do While rsTemp.EOF = False nLoop = nLoop + 1 If nLoop <= 9 Then 'Fields("qmmQuantityBreak" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = App.Round(CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("imjQuantity").Value) / nConversion,App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Fields("qmmQuantityBreak" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = App.Round(CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("imjQuantity").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)
If Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imiCurrencyRateID").value) <> "" And Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imiCurrencyRateID").value) <> Trim(App.HomeCurrencyID) Then Fields("qmmUnitCost" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = App.Round((CDbl(CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("imjUnitPrice").Value) * nConversion) / nRate), 5) Else Fields("qmmUnitCost" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = App.Round(CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("imjUnitPrice").Value) * nConversion,5) Fields("qmmLeadTime" + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nLoop)).Value = rsTemp.Fields("imjLeadTime").Value End If Else Exit Do End If rsTemp.MoveNext Loop End If rsTemp.Close End If App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End If End Function

Function qmmCostOverride_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("qmmCostOverride").Value) = False Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrAverageLaborCost+imrAverageOverheadCost+imrAverageMaterialCost+imrAverageSubcontractCost+imrAverageDutyCost+imrAverageFreightCost+imrAverageMiscCost As AvgCost,imrLastLaborCost+imrLastOverheadCost+imrLastMaterialCost+imrLastSubcontractCost+imrLastDutyCost+imrLastFreightCost+imrLastMiscCost As LastCost,imrStandardLaborCost+imrStandardOverheadCost+imrStandardMaterialCost+imrStandardSubcontractCost+imrStandardDutyCost+imrStandardFreightCost+imrStandardMiscCost As StdCost from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmmPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmmPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Select Case CInt(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMCostingMethod").Value) Case 1,4,5: ' Avg Fields("qmmEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("AvgCost").Value Case 2: ' Last Fields("qmmEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("LastCost").Value Case 3: ' Standard Fields("qmmEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("StdCost").Value End Select bCostOverride= false End If oRs.Close End IF End Function
Function qmmPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("qmmPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("qmmPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("qmmPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("qmmPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End If If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect" + Chr(13) End If End If End Function

Sub ValidateDuplicates(e) Dim currentBs, rsDetails, rows Set currentBs = Record.Table.BindingSource Set rows = currentBs.GetRecordset() If rows.recordcount > 0 Then rows.movefirst Do While rows.Eof = False If Trim(Fields("cmdOrganizationID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("cmdOrganizationID").Value) And _ Trim(Fields("cmdIndustryTypeID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("cmdIndustryTypeID").Value) And _ Fields("cmdIndustryTypeLinkID").Value <> Rows.Fields("cmdIndustryTypeLinkID").Value Then e.AddError "There is already a industry type defined for the Organization-" & Fields("cmdOrganizationID").Value & chr(13) Exit do End If rows.movenext Loop End If Set rows = Nothing Set rsDetails = Nothing End Sub

Function QuoteLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) ' Copy data in duplicate fields to QuoteAssemblies table Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT * FROM QuoteAssemblies WHERE qmaQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlQuoteID").Value) + " AND qmaQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmlQuoteLineID").Value) + " AND qmaQuoteAssemblyID = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Else oRs.AddNew App.BlankRecord oRs End If oRs.Fields("qmaClosed").Value = Fields("qmlClosed").Value oRs.Fields("qmaQuoteID").Value = Fields("qmlQuoteID").Value oRs.Fields("qmaQuoteLineID").Value = Fields("qmlQuoteLineID").Value oRs.Fields("qmaQuoteAssemblyID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("qmaLevel").Value = 1 oRs.Fields("qmaParentAssemblyID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("qmaPartID").Value = Fields("qmlPartID").Value oRs.Fields("qmaPartRevisionID").Value = Fields("qmlPartRevisionID").Value oRs.Fields("qmaUnitOfMeasure").Value = Fields("qmlUnitOfMeasure").Value oRs.Fields("qmaPartShortDescription").Value = Fields("qmlPartShortDescription").Value oRs.Fields("qmaPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = Fields("qmlPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value oRs.Fields("qmaPartLongDescriptionText").Value = Fields("qmlPartLongDescriptionText").Value oRs.Fields("qmaSourceMethodID").Value = Fields("qmlSourceMethodID").Value oRs.Fields("qmaProductionNotesRTF").Value = Fields("qmlProductionNotesRTF").Value oRs.Fields("qmaProductionNotesText").Value = Fields("qmlProductionNotesText").Value oRs.Fields("qmaDocuments").Value = Fields("qmlDocuments").Value oRs.Fields("qmaQuantityPerParent").Value = 1
oRs.UpdateBatch oRs.Close End Function
Function QuoteLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("qmlPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("qmlPartID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("qmlPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("qmlPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "Update QuoteOperations Set qmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlPartID").Value) + ", qmoPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlPartRevisionID").Value) + " Where qmoQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlQuoteID").Value) + " And qmoQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmlQuoteLineID").Value) + " And qmoQuoteAssemblyID = 0 And qmoOperationType = 2 And qmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlPartID").OriginalValue) End If
If Not IsEmpty(Fields("qmlLeadID").Value) And Trim(Fields("qmlLeadID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("qmlLeadID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE Followups SET cmfLeadID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("qmlLeadID").Value)) + " WHERE cmfQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlQuoteID").Value) End If End Function
Function QuoteLines_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE QuoteLines SET qmlTransferredToOrder = 0 WHERE " + aWhere(0) ' Create final assembly for new lines. Connection.Execute "Insert Into QuoteAssemblies (qmaQuoteID,qmaQuoteLineID,qmaQuoteAssemblyID,qmaLevel,qmaPartID,qmaPartRevisionID,qmaUnitOfMeasure,qmaPartShortDescription,qmaPartLongDescriptionRTF,qmaPartLongDescriptionText,qmaProductionNotesRTF,qmaProductionNotesText,qmaDocuments,qmaQuantityPerParent) Select qmlQuoteID,qmlQuoteLineID,0,1,qmlPartID,qmlPartRevisionID,qmlUnitOfMeasure,qmlPartShortDescription,qmlPartLongDescriptionRTF,qmlPartLongDescriptionText,qmlProductionNotesRTF,qmlProductionNotesText,qmlDocuments,1 From QuoteLines Where " + aWhere(0) + " And qmlQuoteID + Convert(char(10),qmlQuoteLineID) NOT IN (Select qmaQuoteID + Convert(char(10),qmaQuoteLineID) From QuoteAssemblies Inner Join QuoteLines on qmaQuoteID = qmlQuoteID And qmaQuoteLineID = qmlQuoteLineID Where qmaQuoteAssemblyID = 0 And " + aWhere(0) + ")"
Dim rsDest,rsSource Set rsDest = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsSource = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsDest.Open "SELECT qmlUniqueID FROM QuoteLines WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " Order By qmlQuoteID,qmlQuoteLineID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText rsSource.Open "SELECT qmlUniqueID FROM QuoteLines WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " Order By qmlQuoteID,qmlQuoteLineID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSource.RecordCount = rsDest.RecordCount And rsSource.EOF = False Then Do While rsSource.EOF = False Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").ConfiguratorSaveAs(rsSource.Fields("qmlUniqueID").Value,rsDest.Fields("qmlUniqueID").Value,"QuoteLines") rsSource.MoveNext rsDest.MoveNext Loop End If rsSource.Close rsDest.Close End Function
Function QuoteLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM FormInputValues WHERE xaiSourceUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlUniqueID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'QUOTELINES'" Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues FROM FormInputValues Inner Join QuoteAssemblies On qmaUniqueID = xaiSourceUniqueID WHERE qmaQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmlQuoteID").Value) + " And qmaQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmlQuoteLineID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'QUOTEASSEMBLIES'" End Function
Sub CheckPurchaseToOrder() If Trim(Fields("qmlPartID").Value) <> "" And Fields("qmlPurchaseToOrder").value = True Then Dim rsParent, dPriceDate, cCurrencyID, priceCalc Set rsParent = Fields("qmlQuoteID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("qmpQuoteDate,qmpCurrencyRateID") dPriceDate = rsParent.Fields("qmpQuoteDate").Value cCurrencyID = rsParent.Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value Set rsParent = Nothing
Set priceCalc = App.Ax("Part").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("qmlPartID").Value,Fields("qmlPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("qmlSupplierOrganizationID").Value,Fields("qmlPurchaseLocationID").Value,1,"MATERIAL", cCurrencyID, dPriceDate, 1) If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) >= 0 Then If priceCalc.IsForeignCurrency = True Then If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("qmlPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value) Then Fields("qmlPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value = priceCalc.FullPrice End If Else If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("qmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) Then Fields("qmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = priceCalc.FullPrice End If End If End If End If End Sub

Function qmlPartGroupID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oMarkups, childBs, rsDetails
Set oMarkups = App.Ax("Part").GetPartGroupMarkups(Fields("qmlPartGroupID").Value) ' Only refresh markups if there are part group specific markups. If oMarkups.MarkupOption = 1 Then Fields("qmlquotemarkuptype").Value = oMarkups.MarkupType Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("QuoteQuantities") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False rsDetails.Fields("qmqMaterialMarkupPercent").Value = oMarkups.MaterialMarkup rsDetails.Fields("qmqSubcontractMarkupPercent").Value = oMarkups.SubcontractMarkup rsDetails.Fields("qmqLaborMarkupPercent").Value = oMarkups.LaborMarkup rsDetails.Fields("qmqOverheadMarkupPercent").Value = oMarkups.OverheadMarkup rsDetails.Fields("qmqQuotingMarkupPercent").Value = oMarkups.QuoteMarkup rsDetails.Fields("qmqPurToOrderMarkupPercent").Value = oMarkups.PurchaseToOrderMarkup rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End If Call App.Ax("Quote").SetQuantities(Record.Table.BindingSource) End Function
Function QuoteLines_CurrentChanged(sender, e) If Fields("qmlMatrixCalculated").Value = False And Record.Table.ChildBindingSourceExists("QuoteQuantities") = True And Record.Table.BindingSource.AllowEdit = True Then Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("QuoteQuantities") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False Call App.Ax("QuoteQuantity").CalculateUsingCurrentQty(rsDetails.CurrentDataRow, e.SqlTransaction) rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing Fields("qmlMatrixCalculated").Value = True End If End Function

Function InspectionComponents_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim bPrevInspectionComplete
If Trim(UCase(Fields("qamSourceTableName").value)) <> "" Then Dim prefix prefix = "" Select case Trim(UCase(Fields("qamSourceTableName").value)) Case "RECEIPTCOMPONENTS": prefix = "rmo" Case "RMARECEIPTCOMPONENTS": prefix = "rro" End Select
If prefix <> "" Then Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select qamInspectionComplete From InspectionComponents Where qamInspectionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qamInspectionID").Value) & " and qamInspectionLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qamInspectionLineID").Value) & " and qamInspectionComponentID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qamInspectionComponentID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False then bPrevInspectionComplete = CBool(rsTemp.Fields("qamInspectionComplete").Value) Else bPrevInspectionComplete = False End if rsTemp.Close
cUpdate = ""
If CBool(Fields("qamInspectionComplete").Value) <> CBool(bPrevInspectionComplete) Then cUpdate = cUpdate & "," & prefix & "InspectionComplete = " & App.IIf(Fields("qamInspectionComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") End If If Trim(cUpdate) <> "" Then cUpdate = Mid(cUpdate, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE " + Trim(UCase(Fields("qamSourceTableName").Value)) + " SET " & cUpdate & " WHERE " + prefix + "UniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qamSourceTableUniqueID").value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(Fields("qamSourceTableName").Value) End If End If End If
Dim rsInspections, cInspectionID If CBool(Fields("qamPosted").Value) = False Then Exit Function End If
cInspectionID = Trim(Fields("qamInspectionID").Value) If cInspectionID = "" then Exit function End If Dim rsWarehouse, bNonNettable, nInvQtyAccepted, cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsPartRevisions, rsReceiptComponent bNonNettable = False Set rsWarehouse = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWarehouse.Open "Select imwWarehouseID, imwNonNettable, imwNonNettableType From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("qamPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)) + " And imwNonNettable <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsWarehouse.EOF = False Then bNonNettable = rsWarehouse.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouse.Close
nInvQtyAccepted = CDbl(Fields("qamInvQuantityAccepted").Value)
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("qamPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("qamPartRevisionID").Value)) If cPartID <> "" And Trim(Fields("qamJobID").Value) = "" And nInvQtyAccepted <> 0 Then Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' If this revision doesn't exist, check to see if we can find another ' one and use it instead. If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then Dim nTotalCurrentCost, nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand, nInventoryUnitCost ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCost = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If If Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) < 0 And nInvQtyAccepted > 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = nInvQtyAccepted Else nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) + nInvQtyAccepted End If If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. Set rsReceiptComponent = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsReceiptComponent.Open "Select rmoInventoryUnitCost From ReceiptComponents Where rmoUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("qamSourceTableUniqueID").Value)) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsReceiptComponent.EOF = False Then nInventoryUnitCost = rsReceiptComponent.Fields("rmoInventoryUnitCost").Value End If rsReceiptComponent.Close
If nInvQtyAccepted > 0 Then ' Set avg/last labor/burden to zero. rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = 0 ' Set Avg matl unit cost nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyAccepted)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) End If End If End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End If End If End Function

Function Timecards_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Select Case Record.EditMode Case adEditInProgress: ' Update detail records with empoyee and date info if chaned. If Trim(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE TimecardLines SET lmlEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value) + " WHERE lmlTimecardID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmpTimecardID").Value) ' Update labor cost field Dim oRs, oRsLines Set oRsLines= CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRsLines.Open "select lmlTimecardID,lmlTimecardLineID,lmlLaborCost,lmlLaborHours from TimecardLines where lmlTimecardID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmpTimecardID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If Not oRsLines.EOF Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select lmdLaborRate from EmployeePersonalData where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText Do While Not oRsLines.EOF If CDbl(oRsLines.Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) = 0 Then oRsLines.Fields("lmlLaborCost").Value = 0 Else If oRs.EOF = False Then oRsLines.Fields("lmlLaborCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(oRsLines.Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("lmdLaborRate").Value),2) Else oRsLines.Fields("lmlLaborCost").Value = 0 End If End If oRsLines.MoveNext Loop oRsLines.UpdateBatch End If End If If CDbl(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmpShiftID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE TimecardLines SET lmlShiftID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value) + " WHERE lmlTimecardID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmpTimecardID").Value) End If End Select End Function
Function lmpRoundedStartTime_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value) <> 0 And IsNull(Fields("lmpRoundedStartTime").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("lmpRoundedEndTime").Value) = False Then If CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapDCPayCalculationMethod").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("lmpPayrollHours").Value = App.Ax("TimecardFunctions").CalculateHours(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value,Fields("lmpRoundedStartTime").Value,Fields("lmpRoundedEndTime").Value) End If End If End Function
Function lmpTimecardDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("lmpPaidDate").Value = Fields("lmpTimecardDate").Value End Function
Function lmpRoundedEndTime_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value) <> 0 And IsNull(Fields("lmpRoundedStartTime").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("lmpRoundedEndTime").Value) = False Then If CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapDCPayCalculationMethod").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("lmpPayrollHours").Value = App.Ax("TimecardFunctions").CalculateHours(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value,Fields("lmpRoundedStartTime").Value,Fields("lmpRoundedEndTime").Value) End If End If End Function
Function lmpEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value) <> "" Then ' Check if the employee being changed to has an active timcard, and revert if they do If CBool(Fields("lmpActive").Value) = True Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select lmpActive from Timecards where lmpEmployeeID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value)) & " and lmpActive <> 0 and lmpTimecardID <> " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("lmpTimecardID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "Selected employee (" & Trim(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value) & ") has an active timecard, reverting to original employee" Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value = Fields("lmpEmployeeID").OriginalValue Exit Function End If End If
Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select lmeDefaultShiftID,lmePlantID from Employees where lmeEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("lmpShiftID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmeDefaultShiftID").Value Fields("lmpPlantID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmePlantID").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function lmpShiftID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value) <> 0 And IsNull(Fields("lmpRoundedStartTime").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("lmpRoundedEndTime").Value) = False Then If CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapDCPayCalculationMethod").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("lmpPayrollHours").Value = App.Ax("TimecardFunctions").CalculateHours(Fields("lmpShiftID").Value,Fields("lmpRoundedStartTime").Value,Fields("lmpRoundedEndTime").Value) End If End If End Function
Function Timecards_DeleteStarted(sender, e) ' Check if there is a un-posted material issue associated to the a job that belongs to the ' Timecard to be deleted Dim oPostedMaterialIssues Set oPostedMaterialIssues = createobject("adodb.recordset") oPostedMaterialIssues.Open "Select iniPosted, iniMaterialIssueID From MaterialIssues " & _ " Join TimecardLines On iniSourceTableUniqueID = lmlUniqueID " & _ " Join Timecards On lmlTimecardID = lmpTimecardID " & _ " Where lmpTimecardID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmpTimecardID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText_ Dim unpostedList Set unpostedList = CreateObject("System.Collections.ArrayList") Do While oPostedMaterialIssues.eof = false If CBool(oPostedMaterialIssues.fields("iniPosted").value) = False And Not unpostedList.Contains(oPostedMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value) Then unpostedList.Add oPostedMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value End If oPostedMaterialIssues.MoveNext() Loop oPostedMaterialIssues.Close If unpostedList.Count <> 0 Then Timecards_DeleteStarted = False Msgbox "This timecard cannot be deleted because it is linked to the following unposted material issues:" & _ vbCrLf & join(unpostedList.ToArray(), vbCrLf), vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm") e.Cancel = true Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) Exit Function End If End Function
Function lmiInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("lmiInactive").Value) = True Then Fields("lmiInactiveDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("lmiInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function

Sub ValidateDuplicates(e) Dim currentBs, rsDetails, rows Set currentBs = Record.Table.BindingSource Set rows = currentBs.GetRecordset() If rows.recordcount > 0 Then rows.movefirst Do While rows.Eof = False If Trim(Fields("CMRORGANIZATIONID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("CMRORGANIZATIONID").Value) And _ Trim(Fields("CMRLOCATIONID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("CMRLOCATIONID").Value) And _ Trim(Fields("CMRCONTACTID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("CMRCONTACTID").Value) And _ Trim(Fields("CMRCONTACTGROUPID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("CMRCONTACTGROUPID").Value) And _ Fields("cmrContactGroupLinkID").Value <> Rows.Fields("cmrContactGroupLinkID").Value Then e.AddError "There is already a contact group defined for the Organization-" & Fields("CMRORGANIZATIONID").Value & chr(13) & _ ", Location-" & Fields("CMRLOCATIONID").Value & chr(13) & ", Contact-" & Fields("CMRCONTACTID").Value & chr(13) Exit do End If rows.movenext Loop End If Set rows = Nothing Set rsDetails = Nothing End Sub
Function OrganizationContactGroupLinks_Valid(sender, e) Call ValidateDuplicates(e) End Function

0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsLookup.Fields("aptPaymentNumber").Value) = False Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE BankAccounts SET glnNextPaymentNumber = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(rsLookup.Fields("aptPaymentNumber").Value) + " Where glnBankAccountID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("apsBankAccountID").Value) End If End If And aptPaymentType <> 3 and aptManualPayment = 0 and aptEFTNumber <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsLookup.Fields("aptEFTNumber").Value) = False Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE BankAccounts SET glnNextEFTNumber = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(rsLookup.Fields("aptEFTNumber").Value) + " Where glnBankAccountID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("apsBankAccountID").Value) End If End If rsLookup.Close End If Connection.Execute "UPDATE APPaymentHeaders SET aptCompleted = 0 WHERE aptAPPaymentSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE APPaymentHeaders SET aptEFTNumber = 0 WHERE aptAPPaymentSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value) + " And aptPaymentType <> 3 And aptManualPayment = 0" Connection.Execute "UPDATE APPaymentHeaders SET aptPaymentNumber = 0 WHERE aptAPPaymentSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value) + " And aptPaymentType <> 3 And aptManualPayment = 0" Connection.Execute "UPDATE APPaymentLines SET apnCompleted = 0 WHERE apnAPPaymentSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If End Function

Function apsSessionType_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Dim rsPaymentSessionType Dim cAPPaymentSessionID Dim cApsSessionType Dim cFilterPaymentType
Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsPaymentSessionType = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") cAPPaymentSessionID = Fields("apsApPaymentSessionID").Value cApsSessionType = Fields("apsSessionType").Value cFilterPaymentType = " and (aptPaymentType = 5 Or aptPaymentType = 6 Or aptPaymentType = 3)"
If CInt(cApsSessionType) = 1 Then Fields("apsEFTReferenceNumber").Value = "" End If
If CInt(cApsSessionType) = 4 Then Fields("apsBankAccountID").Value = "" Fields("apsEFTReferenceNumber").Value = "" End If
rsPaymentSessionType.Open "Select apsSessionType From APPaymentSessions Where apsAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(cAPPaymentSessionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText
If rsPaymentSessionType.Fields("apsSessionType") <> 4 Then cFilterPaymentType = " and (aptPaymentType = 1 Or aptPaymentType = 2 Or aptPaymentType = 3 Or aptPaymentType = 4 Or aptPaymentType = 7)" End If
rsLookup.Open "Select * From APPaymentHeaders Where aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(cAPPaymentSessionID) & cFilterPaymentType, Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText
If rsLookup.EOF = False And rsPaymentSessionType.Fields("apsSessionType") <> cApsSessionType Then e.Cancel = true Msgbox("Unable to change session type, there are incompatbile headers with this session type") End If
rsLookup.Close rsPaymentSessionType.Close End Function

Function apsSessionType_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Dim rsCountInvalidPaymentTypes Dim cType Dim cCommonQuery Dim cQuery
Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsCountInvalidPaymentTypes = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If Fields("apsSessionType").Value = 4 Then cQuery = GetQueryFromPaymentHeaders(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value) cCommonQuery = "Select count(*) as Value From APPaymentHeaders Where (aptPaymentType <> 5 And aptPaymentType <> 6 And aptPaymentType <> 7) And" rsLookup.Open cCommonQuery & " (" & cQuery & ")", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText rsLookup.Open cCommonQuery & " aptPaymentType <> 3 AND aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value, Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText
If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If rsLookup.Fields("Value").Value <> 0 Or rsCountInvalidPaymentTypes.Fields("Value").Value <> 0 Then Call e.AddError("You cannot set the Session Type to Other because there are existing Payment Headers for the current Payment Session of the type - Invoice, Miscellaneous, Bank Transfer Or Void") End if End If
rsLookup.Close rsCountInvalidPaymentTypes.Close Else rsLookup.Open "Select aptPaymentType From APPaymentHeaders Where aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value) & " and (aptPaymentType = 5 Or aptPaymentType = 6)", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Select Case Fields("apsSessionType").Value Case 1: cType = "Cheque" Case 2: cType = "EFT" Case 3: cType = "Direct Debit" End Select Call e.AddError("You cannot set the Session Type to " & cType & " because there are exisiting Payment Headers for the current Payment Session of the type - Credit Memo or Adjustment") End If rsLookup.Close
' Check for Bank Transfer If Fields("apsSessionType").Value = 2 Then rsLookup.Open "Select aptPaymentType From APPaymentHeaders Where aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value) & " and aptPaymentType = 4", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Call e.AddError("You cannot set the Session Type to EFT because there are exisiting Payment Headers for the current Payment Session of the type Bank Transfer") End If rsLookup.Close End If End If End Function
Function GetQueryFromPaymentHeaders(apSessionID) Dim cPaymentHeadersId Dim rsAPSession Dim nPosition
Set rsAPSession = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsAPSession.Open "Select aptVoidAPPaymentSessionID From APPaymentHeaders Where aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(apSessionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText nPosition = 1 cPaymentHeadersId = ""
While rsAPSession.EOF = False cPaymentHeadersId = cPaymentHeadersId & "aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & rsAPSession.Fields("aptVoidAPPaymentSessionID") If rsAPSession.RecordCount <> nPosition Then cPaymentHeadersId = cPaymentHeadersId & " OR " End If nPosition = nPosition + 1 rsAPSession.MoveNext Wend
rsAPSession.Close
If Len(cPaymentHeadersId) = 0 then cPaymentHeadersId = cPaymentHeadersId & "1=0" End If
GetQueryFromPaymentHeaders = cPaymentHeadersId End Function
Function APPaymentSessions_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim rsAPPaymentHeaders Dim rsVoidAPPaymentHeaders
Set rsAPPaymentHeaders = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsAPPaymentHeaders.Open "Select aptPaymentType,aptVoidAPPaymentSessionID,aptVoidAPPaymentHeaderID from APPaymentHeaders where aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("apsAPPaymentSessionID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsAPPaymentHeaders.EOF = False Then Set rsVoidAPPaymentHeaders = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsAPPaymentHeaders.MoveFirst While rsAPPaymentHeaders.EOF = False If rsAPPaymentHeaders.Fields("aptPaymentType").Value = 3 Then rsVoidAPPaymentHeaders.Open "Select aptAPPaymentSessionID,aptAPPaymentHeaderID from APPaymentHeaders where aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsAPPaymentHeaders.Fields("aptVoidAPPaymentSessionID").Value) & " and aptAPPaymentHeaderID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsAPPaymentHeaders.Fields("aptVoidAPPaymentHeaderID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsVoidAPPaymentHeaders.EOF = False Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE APPaymentHeaders SET aptVoidedPayment = 0 WHERE aptAPPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsVoidAPPaymentHeaders.Fields("aptAPPaymentSessionID").Value) & " and aptAPPaymentHeaderID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsVoidAPPaymentHeaders.Fields("aptAPPaymentHeaderID").Value) End If rsVoidAPPaymentHeaders.Close End If rsAPPaymentHeaders.MoveNext Wend End If rsAPPaymentHeaders.Close End Function

Function InspectionLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim nCurrQtyAccepted, nCurrQtyScrap, nCurrQtyReturn, nTotal If CInt(Fields("qalInspectionType").Value) = 3 And CInt(Fields("qalJobType").Value) = 3 Then
ElseIf CInt(Fields("qalInspectionType").Value) = 2 Then If CInt(Fields("qalJobType").Value) = 1 then
Else If CInt(Fields("qalJobType").Value) = 2 then nCurrQtyAccepted = Cdbl(Fields("qalJobOprQuantityAccepted").Value) nCurrQtyScrap = Cdbl(Fields("qalJobOprQuantityToScrap").Value) nCurrQtyReturn = Cdbl(Fields("qalJobOprQuantityToReturn").Value) If CInt(Fields("qalJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then If (nCurrQtyAccepted + nCurrQtyScrap + nCurrQtyReturn) = CDbl(Fields("qalQuantityToInspect").Value) Then Connection.Execute "Update Joboperations set jmoInspectionStatus = 2 Where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("qalJobID").Value)) + " and jmoJobAssemblyid = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qalJobAssemblyID").Value) & " and jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qalJobOperationID").Value) Else Connection.Execute "Update Joboperations set jmoInspectionStatus = 1 Where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("qalJobID").Value)) + " and jmoJobAssemblyid = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qalJobAssemblyID").Value) & " and jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qalJobOperationID").Value) End If End If end if End If End If
Dim prefix, bPrevInspectionComplete prefix = "" Select case Trim(UCase(Fields("qalSourceTableName").value)) Case "RECEIPTLINES": prefix = "rml" Case "RMARECEIPTLINES": prefix = "rrl" Case "MFGRECEIPTS": prefix = "rmm" End Select If prefix <> "" Then Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select qalInspectionComplete From InspectionLines Where qalInspectionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qalInspectionID").Value) & " and qalInspectionLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qalInspectionLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False then bPrevInspectionComplete = CBool(rsTemp.Fields("qalInspectionComplete").Value) Else bPrevInspectionComplete = False End if rsTemp.Close
cUpdate = ""
If CBool(Fields("qalInspectionComplete").Value) <> CBool(bPrevInspectionComplete) Then cUpdate = cUpdate & "," & prefix & "InspectionComplete = " & App.IIf(Fields("qalInspectionComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") End If If Trim(cUpdate) <> "" Then cUpdate = Mid(cUpdate, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE " + Trim(UCase(Fields("qalSourceTableName").Value)) + " SET " & cUpdate & " WHERE " + prefix + "UniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qalSourceTableUniqueID").value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(Fields("qalSourceTableName").Value) End If End If
End Function

If CInt(Fields("qalInspectionType").Value) = 2 Then If CInt(Fields("qalJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "Update Joboperations set jmoInspectionStatus = 1 Where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("qalJobID").Value)) + " and jmoJobAssemblyid = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qalJobAssemblyID").Value) & " and jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qalJobOperationID").Value) End If ElseIf CInt(Fields("qalInspectionType").Value) = 3 And CInt(Fields("qalJobType").Value) = 3 Then
end if End Function
