Function qalInspectorEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("qalInspectorEmployeeID").Value) <> "" Then Dim bResult If Trim(App.Ax("Production").EmployeeID) <> Trim(Fields("qalInspectorEmployeeID").Value) then If Cbool(App.Ax("Inspection").InspectorApprovedCheck(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, Trim(App.Ax("Production").EmployeeID), Fields("qalInspectionComplete").Value)) = False then bResult = False ElseIf Cbool(App.Ax("Inspection").InspectorApprovedCheck(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, Trim(App.Ax("Production").EmployeeID), Fields("qalInspectionComplete").Value)) = True Or Cbool(App.Ax("Inspection").InspectorApprovedCheck(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, Fields("qalInspectorEmployeeID").Value, Fields("qalInspectionComplete").Value)) = True then bResult = True Else bResult = False End If Else bResult = False End If
If CBool(bResult) = True Then e.Cancel = "This inspector cannot be selected due to their quality approval status." & chr(13) Fields("qalInspectorEmployeeID").Value = Fields("qalInspectorEmployeeID").OriginalValue Else Fields("qalInspectionDate").Value = Now() Call ChangeApprovalStatus End If Else Fields("qalInspectionDate").Value = Null Fields("qalApprovalStatus").Value = 1 End If End Function
Function InspectionLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("qalSourceTableName").Value) = "" then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.open "Select qapProjectID from Inspections where qapInspectionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qalInspectionID").Value) , Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If not oRs.EOF then Fields("qalProjectID").Value = oRs.Fields("qapProjectID").Value end if oRs.Close Set oRs = nothing end if Call ChangeApprovalStatus End Function
Sub ChangeApprovalStatus If Fields("qalInspectionComplete").Value = True Or App.Ax("Approvals").IsApprovalRequired("InspectionLines", Record.Table.BindingSource) Then Fields("qalApprovalStatus").Value = 1 Else Fields("qalApprovalStatus").Value = 3 end if end sub
Function qalPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, bPosted, oRs, message cPartID = Trim(Fields("qalPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("qalPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("qalPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("qalPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" or cbool(Fields("qalInspectionID").Fields("qapPosted")) = True then Exit Function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then message = "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cPartRevisionID + "', Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin '" + cBin + "' is inactive." + Chr(13) select case CInt(Fields("qalInspectionType").Value) case 1: if CStr(Fields("qalSourceTableName").Value) <> "" then e.AddError message else e.AddWarning message end if case 3: e.AddError message case Else: ' do not show a message when Inspection Type is Job end select End If End If End function

Sub RefreshOpenQty Dim rsWR, nOpenQty, nShippedQty
nOpenQty = 0 nShippedQty = 0 If CInt(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsWT = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWT.Open "select mwlShippedComplete,mwlShipQuantity,mwlReceivedQuantity from WarehouseTransferLines where mwlWarehouseTransferID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) & " and mwlWarehouseTransferLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsWT.EOF = False Then nShippedQty = CDbl(rsWT.Fields("mwlShipQuantity").Value) If CBool(rsWT.Fields("mwlShippedComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsWT.Fields("mwlShipQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsWT.Fields("mwlReceivedQuantity").Value) End If If CDbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If rsWT.Close End If Fields("wrlWTOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty Fields("wrlWTShippedQuantity").Value = nShippedQty End Sub
Function wrlWarehouseTransferLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RefreshOpenQty End Function
Function WarehouseReceiptLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, cText, rsLookup, cPartID, cRevisionID, cBinID, bFound, nLoop, nCount
Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouseReceiptComponents") nCount = -1 If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsTemp = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.MoveFirst Do While rsTemp.EOF = False cPartID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("wroPartID").Value)) cRevisionID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("wroPartRevisionID").Value)) cBinID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("wroDestinationPartBinID").Value)) rsLookup.Open "select imbPartID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrlDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cBinID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then bFound = False For nLoop = 0 To nCount If aParts(nCount) = cPartID And aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID And aBins(nCount) = cBinID Then bFound = True Exit For End If Next If bFound = False Then nCount = nCount + 1 ReDim Preserve aParts(nCount) aParts(nCount) = cPartID cText = cText & ", " & cPartID & App.IIf(cRevisionID = "", "", "/" & cRevisionID) & "/" & cBinID ReDim Preserve aRevisions(nCount) aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID ReDim Preserve aBins(nCount) aBins(nCount) = cBinID End If End If rsLookup.Close rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Set rsTemp = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing
If CInt(nCount) > -1 Then cText = Trim(Mid(cText, 3)) For nLoop = 0 To nCount rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrlDestinationWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartWarehouseLocations (imlPartID,imlPartRevisionID,imlPartWarehouseID) VALUES (" + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrlDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + ")" End If rsLookup.Close Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartBins (imbPartID,imbPartRevisionID,imbWarehouseID,imbPartBinID,imbConversionFactor) SELECT imrPartID as imbPartID,imrPartRevisionID as imbPartRevisionID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrlDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " as imbWarehouseID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aBins(nLoop)) + " as imbPartBinID,1 as imbConversionFactor FROM PartRevisions WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) Next End If
Dim cUpdateWTL, cUpdateWT
If Trim(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) <> "" And CDbl(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value) <> 0 Then
cUpdateWTL = "" cUpdateWT = ""
If CBool(Fields("wrlReceivedComplete").Value) <> CBool(bPrevReceivedComplete) Then If CBool(Fields("wrlReceivedComplete").Value) = True Then nCount = 0 Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select Count(*) as reccount from WarehouseTransferLines Where mwlWarehouseTransferID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) + " And mwlReceivedComplete = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("reccount").Value) = False Then nCount = rsTemp.Fields("reccount").Value End If End If rsTemp.Close If CInt(nCount) = 0 Then cUpdateWTL = cUpdateWTL & ",mwlClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("wrlReceivedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") cUpdateWT = cUpdateWT & ",mwpClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("wrlReceivedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") & ", mwpClosedDate = " + App.Convert.DateTimeToSQL(Date) End If Else cUpdateWTL = cUpdateWTL & ",mwlClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("wrlReceivedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") cUpdateWT = cUpdateWT & ",mwpClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("wrlReceivedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") & ", mwpClosedDate = NULL" End If End If cUpdateWTL = cUpdateWTL & ",mwlReceivedDate = " + App.Convert.DateTimeToSQL(Fields("wrlWarehouseReceiptID").Fields("wrpReceiptDate").Value) If Trim(cUpdateWTL) <> "" Then cUpdateWTL = Mid(cUpdateWTL, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseTransferLines SET " + cUpdateWTL + " WHERE mwlWarehouseTransferID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) & " AND mwlWarehouseTransferLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged("WarehouseTransferLines") End If If Trim(cUpdateWT) <> "" Then cUpdateWT = Mid(cUpdateWT, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseTransfers SET " + cUpdateWT + " WHERE mwpWarehouseTransferID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged("WarehouseTransfers") End If End if Call RefreshOpenQty End Function
Function WarehouseReceiptLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Dim cUpdateWTL, cUpdateWT
If CBool(Fields("wrlWarehouseReceiptID").Fields("wrpReversalEntry").Value) = True Then
if Trim(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) <> "" Then
Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceipts Set wrpReversed=1 Where wrpWarehouseReceiptID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceiptLines Set wrlReversed=1 Where wrlWarehouseReceiptID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) & " and wrlWarehouseReceiptLineID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceiptComponents Set wroReversed=1 Where wroWarehouseReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) & " and wroWarehouseReceiptLineID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptLineID").Value)
'to reset the WHT after reversing a WHR to create new WHRs again. If Trim(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) <> "" And CDbl(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value) <> 0 Then
If CBool(Fields("wrlPosted").Value) = True Then cUpdateWTL = "" cUpdateWT = "" cUpdateWTL = cUpdateWTL & ",mwlClosed = 0" cUpdateWT = cUpdateWT & ",mwpClosed = 0, mwpClosedDate = NULL" cUpdateWTL = cUpdateWTL & ",mwlReceivedDate = NULL"
If Trim(cUpdateWTL) <> "" Then cUpdateWTL = Mid(cUpdateWTL, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseTransferLines SET " + cUpdateWTL + " WHERE mwlWarehouseTransferID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) & " AND mwlWarehouseTransferLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value) End If If Trim(cUpdateWT) <> "" Then cUpdateWT = Mid(cUpdateWT, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseTransfers SET " + cUpdateWT + " WHERE mwpWarehouseTransferID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) End If End If
End if
End if End if End Function
Function WarehouseReceiptLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim nPrevQuantityReceived, bPrevReceivedComplete, nReceivedQtyChanged, cUpdateWTL, cUpdateWT, rsTemp, nCount
If Trim(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) <> "" And CDbl(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value) <> 0 Then bPrevReceivedComplete = CDbl(Fields("wrlReceivedComplete").OriginalValue)
cUpdateWTL = "" cUpdateWT = ""
If CBool(bPrevReceivedComplete) = True Then cUpdateWTL = cUpdateWTL & ",mwlClosed = 0" cUpdateWT = cUpdateWT & ",mwpClosed = 0, mwpClosedDate = NULL" cUpdateWTL = cUpdateWTL & ",mwlReceivedDate = NULL" End If If Trim(cUpdateWTL) <> "" Then cUpdateWTL = Mid(cUpdateWTL, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseTransferLines SET " + cUpdateWTL + " WHERE mwlWarehouseTransferID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) & " AND mwlWarehouseTransferLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferLineID").Value) End If If Trim(cUpdateWT) <> "" Then cUpdateWT = Mid(cUpdateWT, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseTransfers SET " + cUpdateWT + " WHERE mwpWarehouseTransferID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlWarehouseTransferID").Value) End If End if
' if a reversal entry record is deleted update the reverted flag from the parent record if Trim(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceipts Set wrpReversed=0 Where wrpWarehouseReceiptID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceiptLines Set wrlReversed=0 Where wrlWarehouseReceiptID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) & " and wrlWarehouseReceiptLineID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceiptComponents Set wroReversed=0 Where wroWarehouseReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) & " and wroWarehouseReceiptLineID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptLineID").Value) End if
End Function
Function wrlSourceWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wrlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wrlSourceWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Source warehouse does not exist for part " + Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value) End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function wrlSourcePartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imbPartBinID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("wrlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrlSourceWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("wrlSourcePartBinID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Source bin does not exist for part " + Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value) End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function wrlDestinationWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wrlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wrlDestinationWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Destination warehouse does not exist for part " + Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value) End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function wrlDestinationPartBinID_Valid(sender, e)
Dim cPart, cPartRevision, cWarehouse, cBinDestination cPart = Trim(Fields("wrlPartID").Value) cPartRevision = Trim(Fields("wrlPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("wrlDestinationWarehouseID").Value) cBinDestination = Trim(Fields("wrlDestinationPartBinID").Value)
' quick exit 1: don't show error/warning for empty/non-existent part, Non-Stock/Kit part If cPart = "" then Exit Function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPart, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then Exit Function End if
' quick exit 2: don't show error/warning for posted and reversed receipt If CBool(Fields("wrlPosted").Value) = true OR CBool(Fields("wrlReversed").Value) = true Then Exit Function End If
If cBinDestination = "" then e.AddError "Destination bin is empty" Exit Function End if
If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsWarehouseBinValid(cWarehouse,cBinDestination, e.SqlTransaction)) = False Then e.AddError "Destination bin '" + cBinDestination + "' DOES NOT EXIST in Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "'." Exit Function End If
Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "select imbPartBinID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPart) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevision) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cWarehouse) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cBinDestination), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddWarning "Destination bin '" + cBinDestination + "' EXISTS in Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "', but is not assigned to this Part ID. It will be added to Part '" + cPart + "' Revision '" + cPartRevision + "' upon save." End If rsLookup.Close
if CBool(Fields("wrlWarehouseReceiptID").Fields("wrpReversalEntry").Value) = False then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPart, cPartRevision, cWarehouse, cBinDestination, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPart + "', Revision '" + cPartRevision + "', Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin '" + cBinDestination + "' is inactive." End If End If
End Function
Function wrlQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("wrlQuantityReceived").Value, Fields("wrlQuantityReceived").Caption, e) End Function
Function validateNegativeQuantities(quantity, fieldCaption, e) If cdbl(quantity) < 0 And CBool(Fields("wrlWarehouseReceiptID").Fields("wrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError trim(fieldCaption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function

Function dmpSupplierOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("dmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("dmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("dmpAPInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("dmpPurchaseLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("dmpPurchaseContactID").Value = "" Else Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID,cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("dmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID").Value Fields("dmpPurchaseLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID").Value Else Fields("dmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("dmpAPInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("dmpPurchaseLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("dmpPurchaseContactID").Value = "" End If rsData.Close End If End Function

Function dmpCurrencyRateID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value) = "" Then Fields("dmpCustomRate").Value = False Fields("dmpExchangeRate").Value = 1 Else Fields("dmpCustomRate").Value = False 'If CInt(Fields("dmpCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("dmpExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("dmpClaimDate").Value) 'End If End If End Function
Function dmpExchangeRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Dim bFixForeign bFixForeign = False
If Trim(Fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").OriginalValue) Or _ CInt(Fields("dmpCustomRate").Value) <> CInt(Fields("dmpCustomRate").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("dmpExchangeRate").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("dmpExchangeRate").OriginalValue) Or _ Fields("dmpClaimDate").Value <> Fields("dmpClaimDate").OriginalValue Then
Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select cmlCurrencyRateID From OrganizationLocations Where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " And cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If (Trim(rsTemp.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value) = Trim(Fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value)) And ((Trim(fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "") And (Trim(fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value) <> Trim(App.HomeCurrencyID))) Then bFixForeign = True End If End If rsTemp.Close App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").RefreshCurrencyForDetails "DMRCLAIMS",Fields,bFixForeign End If End Function
Function dmpCustomRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("dmpCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("dmpExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("dmpClaimDate").Value) End If End Function

Sub ValidateDuplicates(e, startDate, CurrencyRate) Dim currentBs, rsDetails, rows Set currentBs = Record.Table.BindingSource Set rows = currentBs.GetRecordset() If rows.recordcount > 0 Then rows.movefirst Do While rows.Eof = False If Trim(Fields("imhPartID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("imhPartID").Value) And _ Trim(Fields("imhPartRevisionID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("imhPartRevisionID").Value) And _ Trim(Fields("imhCurrencyRateID").Value) = Trim(Rows.Fields("imhCurrencyRateID").Value) And _ App.IIf(IsNull(Fields("imhStartDate").Value) = True, DateSerial(1900, 1, 1), Fields("imhStartDate").Value) = App.IIf(IsNull(rows.Fields("imhStartDate").Value) = True, DateSerial(1900, 1, 1), rows.Fields("imhStartDate").Value) And _ Trim(Fields("imhPartUnitSalePriceID").Value) <> Trim(Rows.Fields("imhPartUnitSalePriceID").Value) Then e.AddError "There is already a unit sale price defined for date " & App.IIf(IsNull(Fields("imhStartDate").Value) = True, DateSerial(1900, 1, 1), Fields("imhStartDate").Value) & chr(13) Exit do End If rows.movenext Loop End If Set rows = Nothing Set rsDetails = Nothing End Sub
Function PartUnitSalePrices_Valid(sender, e) Call ValidateDuplicates(e, Fields("imhStartDate").Value, Fields("imhCurrencyRateID").Value) End Function

Function RMAReceipts_DeleteStarted(sender, e) dim receiptId,receiptLineId If CBool(Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("rrpPosted").Value)=False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT rrlReverseRMAReceiptID, rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID FROM RMAReceiptLines WHERE rrlRMAReceiptID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrpRMAReceiptID").Value) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False receiptId=Trim(rsTemp.Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value) receiptLineId=rsTemp.Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID").Value If receiptId <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceiptLines Set rrlReversed=0 Where rrlRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId)+" And rrlRMAReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceiptComponents Set rroReversed=0 Where rroRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId)+" And rroRMAReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceipts Set rrpReversed=0 Where rrpRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId) End If rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Function GLDivisions_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Dim nCount nCount = 0 Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select count(*) as rec_count from GLJournalLines Inner Join GLAccounts on gllGLAccountID=glaGLAccountID where glaGLDivisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("glvGLDivisionID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("rec_count").Value) = False Then nCount = rsTemp.Fields("rec_count").Value End If End If rsTemp.Close If nCount > 0 Then GLDivisions_DeleteStarted = "Division " + Trim(Fields("glvGLDivisionID").Value) + " is referenced on " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(nCount)) + " GL Journal Lines" End If End Function

If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("smoDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("smoUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End If End Function

If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function

Function smoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("smoPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("smoPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("smoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("smoPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" or Fields("smoPostedToGL").Value = True or CBool(Fields("smoShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = True then Exit Function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = true and CDbl(Fields("smoQuantityShipped").Value) > 0 Then e.AddError "Part ID '"&cPartID&"', Revision '"&cPartRevisionID&"', Warehouse '"&cWarehouse&"', Bin '"&cBin&"' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect.", True End If End If End Function

Function lolQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call QuantityChange End Function
Sub QuantityChange Dim priceCalc Set priceCalc = App.Ax("Part").GetSellingPrice(Fields("lolPartID").Value, Fields("lolPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("lolPartGroupID").Value, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value , Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopLocationID").Value, CDbl(Fields("lolQuantity").Value), Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopCurrencyRateID").Value, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopLeadDate").Value) If IsNull(priceCalc) = false then If CDbl(priceCalc.DiscountedPrice) <> 0 then If Cbool(priceCalc.IsForeignCurrency) = true then Fields("lolUnitSalePriceForeign").value = CDbl(priceCalc.DiscountedPrice) Else Fields("lolUnitSalePriceBase").value = CDbl(priceCalc.DiscountedPrice) End If End If Else Fields("lolUnitSalePriceForeign").value = 0 End If Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("lolUnitSalePriceForeign").Value) * CDbl(Fields("lolQuantity").Value)), 2) end sub
Function lolUnitSalePriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("lolUnitSalePriceForeign").Value) * CDbl(Fields("lolQuantity").Value)), 2) End Function
Function lolPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) e.FocusField = "lolQuantity" End Function
Function lolPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim priceID Set priceID = App.Ax("Part").GetPrice(Fields("lolPartID").Value, Fields("lolPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("lolPartGroupID").Value, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value , Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopLocationID").Value, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopCurrencyRateID").Value, 2, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopLeadDate").Value) If IsNull(priceID) = false then Fields("lolPartPriceID").Value = priceID.ID Else Fields("lolPartPriceID").Value = 0 End If Call QuantityChange e.FocusField = "lolQuantity" End Function
Function lolPartGroupID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim priceID Set priceID = App.Ax("Part").GetPrice(Fields("lolPartID").Value, Fields("lolPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("lolPartGroupID").Value, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value , Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopLocationID").Value, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopCurrencyRateID").Value, 2, Fields("lolLeadID").Fields("lopLeadDate").Value) If IsNull(priceID) = false then Fields("lolPartPriceID").Value = priceID.ID Else Fields("lolPartPriceID").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function CalculateDiscountPercent() Dim nPrice nPrice = 0 If CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountAmountForeign").Value) / CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) nPrice = App.Round(nPrice * 100,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If End If CalculateDiscountPercent = nPrice End Function
Function lolRevenueForecastForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value),2) If CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountAmountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("lolDiscountAmountForeign").Value = nPrice End If Else If CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value) Then Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value = Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value End If End If If CDbl(Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("lolForecastDate").Value = Date() End If End Function
Function lolGrossAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountAmountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("lolDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function lolDiscountPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,nPercent nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If nPercent <> CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountPercent").Value) Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountPercent").Value) / 100),2) If CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountAmountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("lolDiscountAmountForeign").Value = nPrice End If End If End Function
Function lolDiscountAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountAmountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("lolRevenueForecastForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("lolGrossAmountForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("lolDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("lolDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function

Function inpStartDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("inpStartDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("inpEndDate").Value) = True Then Fields("inpEndDate").Value = DateAdd("d",-1,DateAdd("yyyy",1,Fields("inpStartDate").Value)) End If End Function

Function raoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsParts
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("raoPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("raoPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("raoDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("raoUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End Function
Function raoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("raoPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("raoPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("raoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("raoPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddWarning "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive" + Chr(13) End If End If End Function

Function SetMovementType() 'Auto-select the movement type, based on current status of tool If Trim(Fields("xtaToolID").Value) <> "" Then If Fields("xtaToolID").Fields("xttInactive").Value = False and Fields("xtaToolID").Fields("xttMovementType").Value <> "CheckOut" then Fields("xtaMovementType").Value = "CheckOut" ElseIf Fields("xtaToolID").Fields("xttMovementType").Value = "CheckOut" then Fields("xtaMovementType").Value = "CheckIn" End If End If End Function
Function ToolMovements_UpdateStarted(sender, e) 'Update Tools record with latest movement details Set rsTools = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTools.open "Select * from Tools where xttToolID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("xtaToolID").Value)), Connection, 3,3,1 If Not rsTools.EOF then rsTools.Fields("xttMovementType").Value = Fields("xtaMovementType").Value rsTools.Fields("xttMovementDate").Value = Fields("xtaMovementDate").Value rsTools.Fields("xttCheckedOutToEmployeeID").Value = Fields("xtaCheckedOutToEmployeeID").Value rsTools.Fields("xttPlannedReturnDate").Value = Fields("xtaPlannedReturnDate").Value rsTools.Fields("xttCheckoutReasonID").Value = Fields("xtaCheckoutReasonID").Value rsTools.UpdateBatch End If End Function
Function ToolMovements_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Call SetMovementType() End Function
Function xtaToolID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call SetMovementType() End Function

Function Calls_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsLookup,cType If Trim(Fields("kbpCallTypeID").Value) = "" Then cType = Trim(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapHDCallTypeID").Value) Else cType = Trim(Fields("kbpCallTypeID").Value) End IF If Trim(Fields("kbpLeadID").Value) <> "" Then cType = Trim(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapHDSalesCallTypeID").Value) Else Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "select TOP 1 lmeCallTypeID from Employees where lmeEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(App.Ax("Production").EmployeeID) + " and lmeTerminationDate IS NULL order by lmeEmployeeID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsLookup.Fields("lmeCallTypeID").Value) <> "" Then cType = Trim(rsLookup.Fields("lmeCallTypeID").Value) End If End If rsLookup.Close End If Fields("kbpCallTypeID").Value = cType End Function
Function Calls_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) ' Copy data in duplicate fields to details table Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "SELECT * FROM CallLines WHERE kblCallID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbpCallID").Value) + " AND kblCallLineID = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = True Then rsData.AddNew App.BlankRecord rsData End If rsData.Fields("kblCallID").Value = Fields("kbpCallID").Value rsData.Fields("kblCallLineID").Value = 0 rsData.Fields("kblShortDescription").Value = Fields("kbpShortDescription").Value rsData.Fields("kblLongDescriptionRTF").Value = Fields("kbpLongDescriptionRTF").Value rsData.Fields("kblLongDescriptionText").Value = Fields("kbpLongDescriptionText").Value rsData.Fields("kblContactMethodID").Value = Fields("kbpContactMethodID").Value rsData.Fields("kblBillable").Value = Fields("kbpBillable").Value rsData.Fields("kblInbound").Value = Fields("kbpInbound").Value rsData.Fields("kblInternalOnly").Value = Fields("kbpInternalOnly").Value rsData.Fields("kblTimeSpent").Value = Fields("kbpTimeSpent").Value rsData.Fields("kblExtraTime").Value = Fields("kbpExtraTime").Value rsData.Fields("kblTotalTime").Value = Fields("kbpTotalTime").Value rsData.Fields("kblAddedByEmployeeID").Value = Fields("kbpOpenedByEmployeeID").Value rsData.Fields("kblAddedDate").Value = Fields("kbpOpenedDate").Value rsData.UpdateBatch rsData.Close End Function
Function Calls_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsCall
Set rsCall= CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsCall.Open "SELECT kbpCallID,kbpCurrencyRateID FROM Calls WHERE " + aWhere(0),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText if rsCall.Eof = False Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE Calls SET kbpFieldServiceJobCreated = 0, kbpInvoicedComplete = 0, kbpOpenedDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Date()) + ", kbpExchangeRate = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(CDbl(App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(rsCall.Fields("kbpCurrencyRateID").Value,Date()))) +" WHERE " + aWhere(0) end if rsCall.Close End Function

Function kbpCallTypeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cType,rsTemp,bBillable,dOpened cType = Trim(Fields("kbpCallTypeID").Value) If cType <> "" Then bBillable = False Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select kbtCallStatus,kbtInboundCall,kbtInternalOnlyCall,kbtBillableCall,kbtFieldServiceCall from CallTypes Where kbtCallTypeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cType),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsTemp.Fields("kbtCallStatus").Value) <> "" Then Fields("kbpStatus").Value = rsTemp.Fields("kbtCallStatus").Value End If Fields("kbpInbound").Value = rsTemp.Fields("kbtInboundCall").Value Fields("kbpInternalOnly").Value = rsTemp.Fields("kbtInternalOnlyCall").Value Fields("kbpFieldServiceCall").Value = rsTemp.Fields("kbtFieldServiceCall").Value bBillable = CInt(rsTemp.Fields("kbtBillableCall").Value) End If rsTemp.Close
If Trim(Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then If CInt(bBillable) = True Then If IsNull(Fields("kbpOpenedDate").Value) = True Then dOpened = Date() Else dOpened = Fields("kbpOpenedDate").Value End If
rsTemp.Open "select kbsServiceContractID From ServiceContracts Where kbsOrganizationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value)) & " AND kbsStartDate <= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dOpened) + " AND kbsEndDate >= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dOpened), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = True Then bBillable = True Else bBillable = False End If rsTemp.Close End If Fields("kbpBillable").Value = bBillable End If End If End Function
Function kbpProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("kbpProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID,prpLocationID,prpContactID From Projects Where prpProjectID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbpProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value Fields("kbpLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpLocationID").Value Fields("kbpContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpContactID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function kbpRMAClaimID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("kbpRMAClaimID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select rapCustomerOrganizationID,rapProjectID From RMAClaims Where rapRMAClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbpRMAClaimID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("rapCustomerOrganizationID").Value End If Fields("kbpProjectID").Value = rsData.Fields("rapProjectID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function kbpDMRClaimID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("kbpDMRClaimID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select dmpSupplierOrganizationID, dmpProjectID From DMRClaims Where dmpDMRClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbpDMRClaimID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("dmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value End If Fields("kbpProjectID").Value = rsData.Fields("dmpProjectID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function kbpJobID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("kbpJobID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select jmpCustomerOrganizationID, jmpProjectID From Jobs Where jmpJobID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbpJobID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("kbpOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("jmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value End If Fields("kbpProjectID").Value = rsData.Fields("jmpProjectID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function kbpMethodPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("kbpMethodPartID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("kbpPartGroupID").Value = Fields("kbpMethodPartID").Fields("impPartGroupID").Value End If End Function

Function wqpShippingMethodID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("wqpShippingMethodID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select xasShippingPaymentTypeID from ShippingMethods Where xasShippingMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wqpShippingMethodID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("wqpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = rsData.Fields("xasShippingPaymentTypeID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function wqpClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("wqpClosed").Value) = True Then Fields("wqpClosedDate").Value = Date Else Fields("wqpClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function wqpDestinationWarehouseID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("wqpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select imwShippingMethodID From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wqpDestinationWarehouseID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("wqpShippingMethodID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("imwShippingMethodID").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function wqpSourceWarehouseID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim childBs, rsDetails Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouseRequisitionLines") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False rsDetails.Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value = Fields("wqpSourceWarehouseID").Value rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function
Function wqpSourceWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("wqpSourceWarehouseID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT imwInactive FROM Warehouses WHERE imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wqpSourceWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsTemp.Fields("imwInactive").Value) = True Then rsTemp.Open "SELECT COUNT(inbHasQOHQTI) AS inbHasQOHQTI FROM WarehouseBins WHERE inbHasQOHQTI = 1 AND inbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wqpSourceWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If rsTemp.Fields("inbHasQOHQTI").Value = 0 Then e.AddError("Source Warehouse '" + Fields("wqpSourceWarehouseID").Value + "' is inactive and has no bins with quantity on hand or quantity to inspect.") End If End If End If End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Function APInvoices_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE APInvoices SET appInvoiceBalanceBase = appInvoiceTotalBase,appInvoiceBalanceForeign = appInvoiceTotalForeign,appPostedToGL = 0,appPostedDate = NULL,appPaidComplete = 0,appPaidDate = NULL, appSupplierInvoiceNumber = '' WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function APInvoices_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("appOpenInvoiceLoad").Value) = True And CInt(Fields("appPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Fields("appPostedToGL").Value = True Fields("appPostedDate").Value = Date() If CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceBalanceBase").Value) = 0 Then Fields("appPaidComplete").Value = True Fields("appPaidDate").Value = Date() End If End If
Dim rsTemp Dim bFixForeign bFixForeign = False If Record.EditMode <> adEditAdd And CInt(Fields("appOpenInvoiceLoad").Value) = False Then If Trim(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").OriginalValue) Or _ CInt(Fields("appCustomRate").Value) <> CInt(Fields("appCustomRate").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("appExchangeRate").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("appExchangeRate").OriginalValue) Or _ Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value <> Fields("appInvoiceDate").OriginalValue Then
Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select cmlCurrencyRateID From OrganizationLocations Where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " And cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If (Trim(rsTemp.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value) = Trim(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value)) And ((Trim(fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "") And (Trim(fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value) <> Trim(App.HomeCurrencyID))) Then bFixForeign = True End If End If rsTemp.Close App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").RefreshCurrencyForDetails "APINVOICES",Fields,bFixForeign End If End If End Function
Function APInvoices_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("APFunctions").DeleteAPInvoiceEvent(Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value) ' Reset invoiced complete flag on all po lines that are referenced by this invoice. 'Connection.Execute "UPDATE PurchaseOrderLines SET pmlInvoicedComplete = 0 FROM PurchaseOrderLines INNER JOIN APInvoiceLines ON pmlPurchaseOrderID=aplPurchaseOrderID AND pmlPurchaseOrderLineID=aplPurchaseOrderLineID WHERE aplAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value) End Function
Function APInvoices_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText,rsTemp cText = "" If CInt(Fields("appPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select appPostedToGL From APInvoices Where appOpenInvoiceLoad = 0 And appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsTemp.Fields("appPostedToGL").Value) = True Then cText = cText + "Record cannot be saved because the invoice has been posted while editing the data" + Chr(13) End If End If rsTemp.Close End If
If CInt(Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 1 Then If CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTotalBase").Value) < 0 Then cText = cText + "Invoice total must be positive for an invoice" + Chr(13) End If Else If CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTotalBase").Value) > 0 Then cText = cText + "Invoice total must be negative for a credit" + Chr(13) End If End If e.AddError cText End Function
Function appInvoiceTotalBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("appInvoiceBalanceBase").Value = Fields("appInvoiceTotalBase").Value End Function
Function appFreightAmountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"BASE",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If
Dim dDate dDate = Fields("appInvoiceDate").value If CInt(Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If If IsNull(dDate) = True Then dDate = Date End If
Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value, dDate, 0, 4) Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value, dDate, Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value, 4)
Fields("appInvoiceTotalBase").Value = CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountBase").Value) End Function
Function appPlantDepartmentID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("APFunctions").SetAPInvoiceAccounts(Fields) End Function
Function appInvoiceType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("appCreditAPInvoiceID").Value = "" Fields("appCreditReasonID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function appSecondFreightTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim bPrev bPrev = App.UpdatingCost App.UpdatingCost = True
Dim dDate dDate = Fields("appInvoiceDate").value If CInt(Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If If IsNull(dDate) = True Then dDate = Date End If
Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value, dDate, Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value, 4) Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value, dDate, Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value, 4) App.UpdatingCost = bPrev End Function
Function appCustomRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("appCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("appExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value) End If End Function
Function appDiscountAmountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appDiscountAmountBase").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"BASE",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appDiscountAmountForeign").Value) Then Fields("appDiscountAmountForeign").Value = nPrice End If End Function
Function appInvoiceSubtotalBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalBase").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"BASE",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalForeign").Value) Then Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalForeign").Value = nPrice End If
Fields("appInvoiceTotalBase").Value = CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountBase").Value) End Function
Function appPaymentTermID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim dDueDate,dDiscountDate If App.Ax("Financial").CalculateDiscountAndDueDate(Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value,Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value,dDueDate,dDiscountDate) = True Then Fields("appDueDate").Value = dDueDate Fields("appDiscountDueDate").Value = dDiscountDate End If Fields("appDiscountAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("APFunctions").CalculateDiscountAmount(Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value,Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value, false,Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value,Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value,Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value) End Function
Function appRetentionTotalBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appRetentionTotalBase").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"BASE",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appRetentionTotalForeign").Value) Then Fields("appRetentionTotalForeign").Value = nPrice End If End Function
Function appRetentionTotalForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appRetentionTotalForeign").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"FOREIGN",4) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appRetentionTotalBase").Value) Then Fields("appRetentionTotalBase").Value = nPrice End If End Function
Function appExchangeRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("appPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Fields("appOriginalExchangeRate").Value = Fields("appExchangeRate").Value End If End Function
Function appDiscountAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appDiscountAmountForeign").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"FOREIGN",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appDiscountAmountBase").Value) Then Fields("appDiscountAmountBase").Value = nPrice End If End Function
Function appFreightAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"FOREIGN",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If
Dim dDate dDate = Fields("appInvoiceDate").value If CInt(Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If If IsNull(dDate) = True Then dDate = Date End If
Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value, dDate, 0, 4) Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value, dDate, Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value, 4)
Fields("appInvoiceTotalForeign").Value = CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign").Value) End Function
Function appInvoiceSubtotalForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalForeign").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"FOREIGN",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalBase").Value) Then Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalBase").Value = nPrice End If
Fields("appInvoiceTotalForeign").Value = CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign").Value) End Function
Function appFreightTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value) = "" Or CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value) = 0 Then Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value = 0 Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value = 0 Else Dim oRs,bPrev, rsAP, dDate Set rsAP = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsAP.Open "Select appInvoiceDate, appCreditDate, appInvoiceType From APInvoices Where appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value),Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsAP.EOF = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value If CInt(rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If End If rsAP.Close
If IsNull(dDate) = True then dDate = Date End If
Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select Top 1 IsNull(xabTaxRate,0) As xabTaxRate from TaxCodes Left Outer Join TaxCodeLines On xaxTaxCodeID = xabTaxCodeID where xaxTaxCodeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value) + " And IsNull(xabEffectiveDate,'19000101') <= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dDate) + " Order By xabEffectiveDate DESC",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.UpdatingCost App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xabTaxRate").Value) / 100,4) Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xabTaxRate").Value) / 100,4) App.UpdatingCost = bPrev End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function appSecondFreightTaxAmtForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtForeign").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"FOREIGN",4) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If
Dim nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign nTotalTaxBase = 0 nTotalTaxForeign = 0 Call App.Ax("APFunctions").CalcInvoiceTaxes(Fields,nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign) Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountBase").Value = nTotalTaxBase Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign").Value = nTotalTaxForeign End Function
Function appSupplierInvoiceNumber_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cInvoice,cSupplierID,rsLookup cInvoice = Fields("appSupplierInvoiceNumber").Value If Trim(cInvoice) <> "" Then Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") cSupplierID = Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value rsLookup.Open "select appAPInvoiceID from APInvoices where appSupplierInvoiceNumber = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cInvoice) + " and appSupplierOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cSupplierID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value) <> Trim(rsLookup.Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value) Then e.Cancel = "Invoice " + Trim(cInvoice) + " has already been entered for supplier " + Trim(cSupplierID) + " on invoice entry " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(rsLookup.Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value)) + "." End If End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function appInvoiceTaxAmountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("appInvoiceTotalBase").Value = CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountBase").Value) End Function
Function appSupplierOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData,cPrev If Trim(Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value = "" Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value = "" Else Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID,cmoSupplierTaxCodeID,cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID,cmoCurrencyRateID, cmoTaxReportable from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then ' If blank, don't need to set it again, as the related fields are blanked out automatically each time the customer is changed. If Trim(Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) <> Trim(rsData.Fields("cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) Then Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID").Value End If Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value = rsData.Fields("cmoCurrencyRateID").Value If CInt(App.Props("AP").Fields("xafAPTaxOnFreight").Value) = True Then Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value = rsData.Fields("cmoSupplierTaxCodeID").Value Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = rsData.Fields("cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID").Value Else Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" End If Fields("appTaxReportable").Value = rsData.Fields("cmoTaxReportable").Value Else Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value = "" Fields("appFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value = "" Fields("appTaxReportable").value = 0 End If rsData.Close ' Reset supplier invoice so validation runs again. If Trim(Fields("appSupplierInvoiceNumber").Value) <> "" Then cPrev = Fields("appSupplierInvoiceNumber").Value Fields("appSupplierInvoiceNumber").Value = "" Fields("appSupplierInvoiceNumber").Value = cPrev End If End If End Function
Function appInvoiceTotalForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("appInvoiceBalanceForeign").Value = Fields("appInvoiceTotalForeign").Value End Function
Function appProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("appProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID,prpLocationID,prpContactID From Projects Where prpProjectID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpLocationID").Value Fields("appAPInvoiceContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpContactID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function appFreightTaxAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"FOREIGN",4) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If

Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value, dDate, Fields("appFreightTaxAmountforeign").Value, 4)
Dim nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign nTotalTaxBase = 0 nTotalTaxForeign = 0 Call App.Ax("APFunctions").CalcInvoiceTaxes(Fields,nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign) Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountBase").Value = nTotalTaxBase Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign").Value = nTotalTaxForeign End Function
Function appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"BASE",4) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtForeign").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtForeign").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If
Dim nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign nTotalTaxBase = 0 nTotalTaxForeign = 0 Call App.Ax("APFunctions").CalcInvoiceTaxes(Fields,nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign) Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountBase").Value = nTotalTaxBase Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign").Value = nTotalTaxForeign
Fields("appDiscountAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("APFunctions").CalculateDiscountAmount(Fields("appAPInvoiceID").Value,Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value, false,Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value,Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value,Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value) End Function
Function appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("appInvoiceTotalForeign").Value = CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceSubtotalForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appFreightAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign").Value) End Function
Function appPlantID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("APFunctions").SetAPInvoiceAccounts(Fields) End Function
Function appCurrencyRateID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value) = "" Then Fields("appCustomRate").Value = False Fields("appExchangeRate").Value = 1 Else Fields("appCustomRate").Value = False 'If CInt(Fields("appCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("appExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value) 'End If End If
Call App.Ax("APFunctions").SetAPInvoiceAccounts(Fields) End Function
Function appAPInvoiceLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("appAPInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlAPInvoiceContactID,cmlSupplierPaymentTermID,cmlTaxReportable from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("appAPInvoiceContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlAPInvoiceContactID").Value Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlSupplierPaymentTermID").Value Fields("appTaxReportable").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlTaxReportable").Value Else Fields("appAPInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value = "" Fields("appTaxReportable").Value = 0 End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function appFreightTaxAmountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value),"APINVOICES",Fields,"BASE",4) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("appFreightTaxAmountForeign").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If
Dim dDate dDate = Fields("appInvoiceDate").value If CInt(Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If If IsNull(dDate) = True Then dDate = Date End If
Fields("appSecondFreightTaxAmtBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("appSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("appFreightAmountBase").Value, dDate, Fields("appFreightTaxAmountBase").Value, 4)
Dim nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign nTotalTaxBase = 0 nTotalTaxForeign = 0 Call App.Ax("APFunctions").CalcInvoiceTaxes(Fields,nTotalTaxBase,nTotalTaxForeign) Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountBase").Value = nTotalTaxBase Fields("appInvoiceTaxAmountForeign").Value = nTotalTaxForeign End Function
Function appInvoiceDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim dDueDate,dDiscountDate If App.Ax("Financial").CalculateDiscountAndDueDate(Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value,Fields("appPaymentTermID").Value,dDueDate,dDiscountDate) = True Then Fields("appDueDate").Value = dDueDate Fields("appDiscountDueDate").Value = dDiscountDate End If Dim nYear,nPeriod If IsNull(Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value) = False Then If App.Ax("GLFunctions").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value,"AP",nYear,nPeriod,False,True,Fields("appInvoiceDate")) = True Then Fields("appGLFiscalYearID").Value = nYear Fields("appGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value = nPeriod End If If CInt(Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("appCreditDate").Value = Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value End If End If
If Trim(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "" Then If CInt(Fields("appCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("appExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value) End If End If End Function

Function QuoteAssemblies_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Dim aValues,oRs If CLng(Fields("qmaParentAssemblyID").Value) = 0 Then Fields("qmaLevel").Value = 2 Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT qmaQuoteAssemblyID,qmaLevel FROM QuoteAssemblies WHERE qmaQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteID").Value) + " AND qmaQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteLineID").Value) + " AND qmaQuoteAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmaParentAssemblyID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qmaLevel").Value = CLng(oRs.Fields("qmaLevel").Value) + 1 Else MsgBox "Unable to find parent assembly - QUOTEASSEMBLIES AfterInsert Trigger" End If oRs.Close End If e.FocusField = "qmaPartID" End Function
Function QuoteAssemblies_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE QuoteLines SET qmlMatrixCalculated = 0 WHERE qmlQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteID").Value) + " And qmlQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteLineID").Value) If Trim(Fields("qmaPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("qmaPartID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("qmaPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("qmaPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "Update QuoteOperations Set qmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaPartID").Value) + ", qmoPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaPartRevisionID").Value) + " Where qmoQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteID").Value) + " And qmoQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteLineID").Value) + " And qmoQuoteAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteAssemblyID").Value) + " And qmoOperationType = 2 And qmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaPartID").OriginalValue) End If End Function
Function QuoteAssemblies_DeleteStarted(sender, e) ' Only need to call this when deleting an assembly. When the quote header or detail are deleted, all the ' assemblies will be deleted. Call App.Ax("Quote").DeleteQuoteAssembly(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("qmaQuoteID").Value,Fields("qmaQuoteLineID").Value,Fields("qmaQuoteAssemblyID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE QuoteLines SET qmlMatrixCalculated = 0 WHERE qmlQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteID").Value) + " And qmlQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmaQuoteLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End Function
Function QuoteAssemblies_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsDest,rsSource Set rsDest = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsSource = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
rsDest.Open "SELECT qmaUniqueID FROM QuoteAssemblies WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " Order By qmaQuoteID,qmaQuoteLineID,qmaQuoteAssemblyID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText rsSource.Open "SELECT qmaUniqueID FROM QuoteAssemblies WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " Order By qmaQuoteID,qmaQuoteLineID,qmaQuoteAssemblyID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSource.RecordCount = rsDest.RecordCount And rsSource.EOF = False Then Do While rsSource.EOF = False Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").ConfiguratorSaveAs(rsSource.Fields("qmaUniqueID").Value,rsDest.Fields("qmaUniqueID").Value,"QuoteAssemblies") rsSource.MoveNext rsDest.MoveNext Loop End If rsSource.Close rsDest.Close End Function
Function qmaOverlapOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("qmaOverlapOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("qmaOverlapType").Value = 1 Else Fields("qmaOverlapType").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function qmaPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("qmaPartID").Value) <> "" Then If Trim(Fields("qmaPartShortDescription").Value) <> "" Then e.FocusField = "qmaQuantityPerParent" End If End If End Function
Function qmaPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("qmaPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText, imrDocuments from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmaPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qmaUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("qmaPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("qmaPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("qmaPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value Fields("qmaDocuments").Value = oRs.Fields("imrDocuments").Value End If oRs.Close e.FocusField = "qmaQuantityPerParent" End If End Function
Function qmaAssemblyOverlap_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("qmaAssemblyOverlap").Value <> 0 then Fields("qmaOverlapOperationID").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function qmaOverlapSourceLink_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 And Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value Then Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value Else If Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 And Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> 0 Then Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function qmaOverlapDestinationLink_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 And Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value Then Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value Else If Fields("qmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 And Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value <> 0 Then Fields("qmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 End If End If End Function

Function WarehouseTransfers_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, cText, rsLookup, cPartID, cRevisionID, cWHID, bFound, nLoop, nCount Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouseTransferLines") nCount = -1 If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsTemp = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.MoveFirst Do While rsTemp.EOF = False cPartID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("mwlPartID").Value)) cRevisionID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value)) cWHID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("mwlDestinationWarehouseID").Value)) 'rsLookup.Open "select imbPartID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("mwpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cWHID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cWHID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then bFound = False For nLoop = 0 To nCount If aParts(nCount) = cPartID And aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID And aWH(nCount) = cWHID Then bFound = True Exit For End If Next If bFound = False Then nCount = nCount + 1 ReDim Preserve aParts(nCount) aParts(nCount) = cPartID cText = cText & ", " & cPartID & App.IIf(cRevisionID = "", "", "/" & cRevisionID) & "/" & cWHID ReDim Preserve aRevisions(nCount) aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID ReDim Preserve aWH(nCount) aWH(nCount) = cWHID End If End If rsLookup.Close rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Set rsTemp = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing
If CInt(nCount) > -1 Then cText = Trim(Mid(cText, 3)) For nLoop = 0 To nCount rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aWH(nLoop)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartWarehouseLocations (imlPartID,imlPartRevisionID,imlPartWarehouseID) VALUES (" + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aWH(nLoop)) + ")" End If rsLookup.Close 'Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartBins (imbPartID,imbPartRevisionID,imbWarehouseID,imbPartBinID,imbConversionFactor) SELECT imrPartID as imbPartID,imrPartRevisionID as imbPartRevisionID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("mwpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " as imbWarehouseID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aWH(nLoop)) + " as imbPartBinID,1 as imbConversionFactor FROM PartRevisions WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) Next End If End Function
Function mwpClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("mwpClosed").Value) = True Then Fields("mwpClosedDate").Value = Date Else Fields("mwpClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function mwpShippingMethodID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("mwpShippingMethodID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select xasShippingPaymentTypeID from ShippingMethods Where xasShippingMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwpShippingMethodID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("mwpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = rsData.Fields("xasShippingPaymentTypeID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function mwpSourceWarehouseID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim childBs, rsDetails Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouseTransferLines") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False rsDetails.Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value = Fields("mwpSourceWarehouseID").Value rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function
Function mwpDestinationWarehouseID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("mwpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select imwShippingMethodID From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwpDestinationWarehouseID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("mwpShippingMethodID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("imwShippingMethodID").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If
Dim childBs, rsDetails Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouseTransferLines") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False rsDetails.Fields("mwlDestinationWarehouseID").Value = Fields("mwpDestinationWarehouseID").Value rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function
Function mwpPosted_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("mwpPosted").Value Then Fields("mwpPostedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("mwpPostedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function WarehouseTransfers_DeleteStarted(sender, e) dim receiptId,receiptLineId If CBool(Fields("mwpReversalEntry").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("mwpPosted").Value)=False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT mwlReverseWHTransferID,mwlReverseWHTransferLineID FROM WarehouseTransferLines WHERE mwlWarehouseTransferID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwpWarehouseTransferID").Value) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False receiptId=Trim(rsTemp.Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value) receiptLineId=rsTemp.Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferLineID").Value If receiptId <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransferLines Set mwlReversed=0 Where mwlWarehouseTransferID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId)+" And mwlWarehouseTransferLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransferComponents Set mwoReversed=0 Where mwoWarehouseTransferID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId)+" And mwoWarehouseTransferLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransfers Set mwpReversed=0 Where mwpWarehouseTransferID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId) end if rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
