Function mwpSourceWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("mwpSourceWarehouseID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT imwInactive from Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwpSourceWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsTemp.fields("imwInactive").Value) = True and cbool(Fields("mwpPosted").Value) = false and cbool(Fields("mwpReversalEntry").Value) = false Then rsTemp.Open "SELECT COUNT(inbHasQOHQTI) AS inbHasQOHQTI FROM WarehouseBins WHERE inbHasQOHQTI = 1 AND inbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwpSourceWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If rsTemp.Fields("inbHasQOHQTI").Value = 0 Then e.AddError("Source Warehouse '" + Fields("mwpSourceWarehouseID").Value + "' is inactive and has no bins with quantity on hand or quantity to inspect.") End If End If end if end if rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Function pabInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("pabInactive").Value) = True Then Fields("pabInactiveDate").Value = Date Else Fields("pabInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function pabCalculationMethod_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("pabCalculationMethod").Value) <> 1 Then Fields("pabPercent").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("pabCalculationMethod").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("pabAmount").Value = 0 End If End Function

Function pftTotalPayments_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftTotalTaxableFUTA").Value = Fields("pftTotalPayments").Value - Fields("pftExemptSubtotal").Value End Function
Function pftExemptFromFUTA_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftExemptSubtotal").Value = Fields("pftExemptFromFUTA").Value + Fields("pftPaymentExcess").Value End Function
Function pftPaymentExcess_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftExemptSubtotal").Value = Fields("pftExemptFromFUTA").Value + Fields("pftPaymentExcess").Value End Function
Function pftExemptSubtotal_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftTotalTaxableFUTA").Value = Fields("pftTotalPayments").Value - Fields("pftExemptSubtotal").Value End Function
Function pftTotalTaxableFUTA_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftFUTABeforeAdjustments").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("pftTotalTaxableFUTA").Value) * 0.006, 2) End Function
Function pftFUTABeforeAdjustments_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value = Fields("pftFUTABeforeAdjustments").Value + Fields("pftAdjustAllExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustSomeExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustCreditReduction").Value End Function
Function pftAdjustAllExcludeState_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value = Fields("pftFUTABeforeAdjustments").Value + Fields("pftAdjustAllExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustSomeExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustCreditReduction").Value End Function
Function pftAdjustSomeExcludeState_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value = Fields("pftFUTABeforeAdjustments").Value + Fields("pftAdjustAllExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustSomeExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustCreditReduction").Value End Function
Function pftAdjustCreditReduction_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value = Fields("pftFUTABeforeAdjustments").Value + Fields("pftAdjustAllExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustSomeExcludeState").Value + Fields("pftAdjustCreditReduction").Value End Function
Function pftFUTAAfterAdjustments_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value > Fields("pftFUTADeposited").Value Then Fields("pftBalanceDue").Value = Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value - Fields("pftFUTADeposited").Value Else Fields("pftOverpayment").Value = Fields("pftFUTADeposited").Value - Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value End If End Function
Function pftFUTADeposited_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value > Fields("pftFUTADeposited").Value Then Fields("pftBalanceDue").Value = Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value - Fields("pftFUTADeposited").Value Else Fields("pftOverpayment").Value = Fields("pftFUTADeposited").Value - Fields("pftFUTAAfterAdjustments").Value End If End Function
Function pftFUTALiabilityQ1_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftTotalTaxLiability").Value = Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ1").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ2").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ3").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ4").Value End Function
Function pftFUTALiabilityQ2_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftTotalTaxLiability").Value = Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ1").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ2").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ3").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ4").Value End Function
Function pftFUTALiabilityQ3_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftTotalTaxLiability").Value = Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ1").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ2").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ3").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ4").Value End Function
Function pftFUTALiabilityQ4_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pftTotalTaxLiability").Value = Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ1").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ2").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ3").Value + Fields("pftFUTALiabilityQ4").Value End Function

Function IncomeTaxTableRevisions_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select Top 1 parCalculationMethod From IncomeTaxTableRevisions Where parIncomeTaxID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("parIncomeTaxID").Value) + " And parIncomeTaxTypeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("parIncomeTaxTypeID").Value) + " And parIncomeTaxTableID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("parIncomeTaxTableID").Value) + " Order By parStartDate Desc",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("parCalculationMethod").Value = rsData.Fields("parCalculationMethod").Value End If rsData.Close End Function
Function parCalculationMethod_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("parCalculationMethod").Value) <> 1 Then Fields("parPersonalExemptionAmount").Value = 0 Fields("parDependentExemptionAmount").Value = 0 Fields("parStandardAdjustmentAmount").Value = 0 Fields("parPersonalTaxCredit").Value = 0 Fields("parDependentTaxCredit").Value = 0 Fields("parSupplementalWagesTaxPercent").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("parCalculationMethod").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("parTaxPercent").Value = 0 Fields("parWageExcess").Value = 0 Fields("parWageLimit").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("parCalculationMethod").Value) <> 3 Then Fields("parTaxAmount").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("parCalculationMethod").Value) <> 4 Then Fields("parRelatedIncomeTaxID").Value = "" Fields("parRelatedIncomeTaxTypeID").Value = "" End If If CInt(Fields("parCalculationMethod").Value) <> 5 Then Fields("parTaxAmount").Value = 0 End If End Function

Function imtPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imtPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsNonStocked Set rsNonStocked = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsNonStocked.Open "Select impNonStockedItem From Parts Where impPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imtPartID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If Not rsNonStocked.EOF Then Fields("imtNonInventoryTransaction").Value = rsNonStocked.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value Else Fields("imtNonInventoryTransaction").Value = False End If rsNonStocked.Close End If End Function
Function imtJobID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,bPrev If CStr(Trim(Fields("imtJobID").Value)) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmpProjectID,jmpProjectAreaID FROM Jobs WHERE jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imtJobID").Value)),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("imtProjectID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmpProjectID").Value Fields("imtProjectAreaID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmpProjectAreaID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End If oRs.Close Else Fields("imtProjectID").Value = "" Fields("imtProjectAreaID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function imtIssueType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("imtIssueType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("imtReceiptType").Value = 1 ' Issues are always against materials Fields("imtJobType").Value = 1 Else Fields("imtReceiptType").Value = Fields("imtIssueType").Value End If End Function
Function imtPartWarehouseLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.RecordSet") oRs.Open "SELECT IsNull(imlNonNettable,0) As imlNonNettable FROM PartWarehouseLocations WHERE imlPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imtPartID").Value)) & " And imlPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imtPartRevisionID").Value)) & " And imlPartWarehouseID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imtPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If Not oRs.EOF Then Fields("imtNonNettable").Value = oRs.Fields("imlNonNettable").Value End If oRs.Close End Function
Function imtJobMaterialID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,bPrev If CLng(Fields("imtJobMaterialID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmmPartID,jmmPartRevisionID,jmmPartWarehouseLocationID,jmmPartBinID,jmmUnitOfMeasure,jmmSupplierOrganizationID,jmmPurchaseLocationID,jmmCalculatedUnitCost,jmmEstimatedQuantity,jmmScrapQuantity,jmmQuantityReceived FROM JobMaterials WHERE jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtJobID").Value) + " AND jmmJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtJobAssemblyID").Value) + " AND jmmJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtJobMaterialID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("imtPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartID").Value Fields("imtPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartRevisionID").Value Fields("imtPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartWarehouseLocationID").Value Fields("imtPartBinID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartBinID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev If Trim(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) = "" Then ' Don't update supplier if it was set by the po change event. Fields("imtSupplierOrganizationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value Fields("imtPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPurchaseLocationID").Value End If Fields("imtInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmmEstimatedQuantity").Value) - CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmmScrapQuantity").Value) - CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmmQuantityReceived").Value) Fields("imtInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imtUnitMaterialCost").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmCalculatedUnitCost").Value Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = 0 End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function imtJobAssemblyID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,bPrev If CLng(Fields("imtJobAssemblyID").Value) <> 0 And CInt(Fields("imtSource").Value) = 3 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmaPartID,jmaPartRevisionID,jmaPartWarehouseLocationID,jmaPartBinID,jmaUnitOfMeasure,jmaQuantityToPull,jmaQuantityIssued FROM JobAssemblies WHERE jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtJobID").Value) + " AND jmaJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtJobAssemblyID").Value) + " And jmaQuantityToPull > 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("imtPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartID").Value Fields("imtPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value Fields("imtPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartWarehouseLocationID").Value Fields("imtPartBinID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev Fields("imtInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityToPull").Value) - CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityIssued").Value) Fields("imtInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = 0 End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function imtReceiptType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("imtReceiptType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("imtJobType").Value = 1 Else Fields("imtJobID").Value = "" Fields("imtJobType").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function imtPurchaseQuantityReceived_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("imtPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) <> 0 Then Dim nConversionFactor nConversionFactor = 1 If Trim(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim oPurchaseOrderLines Set oPurchaseOrderLines = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oPurchaseOrderLines.Open "select pmlInventoryQuantity,pmlPurchaseQuantity,pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived from PurchaseOrderLines where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oPurchaseOrderLines.EOF = False Then If CDbl(Fields("imtPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 Then If Abs(CDbl(Fields("imtPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value)) > CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) Then Fields("imtPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value = -CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) End If End If If CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConversionFactor = App.Round(CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) / CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value),8) End If End If oPurchaseOrderLines.Close If nConversionFactor <> 0 Then Fields("imtInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("imtPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) / nConversionFactor,App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) End If End If End If End Function
Function imtJobType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("imtTransactionType").Value) <> 2 Then If CInt(Fields("imtJobType").Value) <> 1 Then Fields("imtJobMaterialID").Value = 0 Fields("imtUnitMaterialCost").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("imtJobType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("imtJobOperationID").Value = 0 Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = 0 End If Else If CInt(Fields("imtJobType").Value) <> 1 Then Fields("imtJobMaterialID").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("imtJobType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("imtJobOperationID").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function imtPurchaseOrderID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select pmpSupplierOrganizationID,pmpPurchaseLocationID from PurchaseOrders where pmpPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("imtSupplierOrganizationID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value Fields("imtPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value End If oRs.Close Else Fields("imtPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("imtPurchaseUnitCost").Value = 0 Fields("imtSetupCharge").Value = 0 Fields("imtPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = "" End If End Function
Function imtJobOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,bPrev If CLng(Fields("imtJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmoPartID,jmoPartRevisionID,jmoUnitOfMeasure,jmoSupplierOrganizationID,jmoPurchaseLocationID,jmoCalculatedUnitCost,jmoOperationQuantity FROM JobOperations WHERE jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtJobID").Value) + " AND jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtJobAssemblyID").Value) + " AND jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtJobOperationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("imtPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartID").Value Fields("imtPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartRevisionID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev If Trim(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) = "" Then ' Don't update supplier if it was set by the po change event. Fields("imtSupplierOrganizationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoSupplierOrganizationID").Value Fields("imtPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPurchaseLocationID").Value End If Fields("imtInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoOperationQuantity").Value Fields("imtInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imtUnitMaterialCost").Value = 0 Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoCalculatedUnitCost").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function imtPurchaseOrderLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select pmlJobID,pmlJobAssemblyID,pmlJobType,pmlJobMaterialID,pmlJobOperationID,pmlPartID,pmlPartRevisionID,pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure,pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase,pmlSetupChargeBase,pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived,pmlReceivedComplete from PurchaseOrderLines where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Trim(oRs.Fields("pmlJobID").Value) = "" Then Fields("imtReceiptType").Value = 2 Else Fields("imtReceiptType").Value = 1 End If Fields("imtJobID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlJobID").Value Fields("imtJobAssemblyID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value Fields("imtJobType").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlJobType").Value Fields("imtJobMaterialID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value Fields("imtJobOperationID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value Fields("imtPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlPartID").Value Fields("imtPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value Fields("imtPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imtInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imtPurchaseUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value If CDbl(oRs.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then Fields("imtSetupCharge").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlSetupChargeBase").Value End If Fields("imtPOLineReceivedComplete").Value = oRs.Fields("pmlReceivedComplete").Value Fields("imtReference").Value = "PO " + Trim(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) + "-" + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderLineID").Value)) End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function imtPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imtPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,(imrAverageMaterialCost+imrAverageDutyCost+imrAverageFreightCost+imrAverageMiscCost) As imrAverageMaterialCost,(imrLastMaterialCost+imrLastDutyCost+imrLastFreightCost+imrLastMiscCost) As imrLastMaterialCost,(imrStandardMaterialCost+imrStandardDutyCost+imrStandardFreightCost+imrStandardMiscCost) As imrStandardMaterialCost,imrAverageSubcontractCost,imrLastSubcontractCost,imrStandardSubcontractCost FROM PartRevisions WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("imtInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imtPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value Select Case CInt(App.Props("PM").Fields("xapPMCostingMethod").Value) Case 1: Fields("imtUnitMaterialCost").Value = oRs.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = oRs.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value Case 2: Fields("imtUnitMaterialCost").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLastSubcontractCost").Value Case 3: Fields("imtUnitMaterialCost").Value = oRs.Fields("imrStandardMaterialCost").Value Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = oRs.Fields("imrStandardSubcontractCost").Value End Select End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function imtPurchaseUnitCost_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("imtPurchaseUnitCost").Value) <> 0 Then Dim nConversionFactor nConversionFactor = 1 If Trim(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim oPurchaseOrderLines Set oPurchaseOrderLines = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oPurchaseOrderLines.Open "select pmlInventoryQuantity,pmlPurchaseQuantity from PurchaseOrderLines where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imtPurchaseOrderLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oPurchaseOrderLines.EOF = False Then If CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConversion = App.Round(CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) / CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value),8) End If End If oPurchaseOrderLines.Close If nConversion <> 0 Then If CInt(Fields("imtJobType").Value) = 2 Then Fields("imtUnitSubcontractCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("imtPurchaseUnitCost").Value) * nConversion,5) Else Fields("imtUnitMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("imtPurchaseUnitCost").Value) * nConversion,5) End If End If End If End If End Function

Function SalesOrderDeliveries_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("SalesOrder").DefaultDeliveryQuantity(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.Row) End Function
Function SalesOrderDeliveries_SetDefaultValues(sender, e)
' Default the ReleaseDate to the Requested Ship Date from the Order Header if this is the first release Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT ompRequestedShipDate FROM SalesOrders WHERE ompSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If IsNull(oRs.Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value) = False Then Fields("omdDeliveryDate").Value = oRs.Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value Else Fields("omdDeliveryDate").Value = Date End If Else Fields("omdDeliveryDate").Value = Date End If oRs.Close
End Function
Function SalesOrderDeliveries_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim nPrevDeliveryQuantity, bPrevFirm, dPrevDeliveryDate, nQtyChanged, cUpdateJob
nPrevDeliveryQuantity = CDbl(Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").OriginalValue) bPrevFirm = CBool(Fields("omdFirm").OriginalValue) dPrevDeliveryDate = cdate(Fields("omdDeliveryDate").OriginalValue)
nQtyChanged = CDbl(Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value) - CDbl(nPrevDeliveryQuantity)
cUpdateJob = ""
If CBool(Fields("omdFirm").Value) <> CBool(bPrevFirm) Then cUpdateJob = cUpdateJob & ",jmpFirm = " & App.IIf(Fields("omdFirm").Value = True, "1", "0") End If If CDate(Fields("omdDeliveryDate").Value) <> CDate(dPrevDeliveryDate) Then cUpdateJob = cUpdateJob & ",jmpProductionDueDate = " & App.Convert.DateToSql(Fields("omdDeliveryDate").Value) End If If Trim(cUpdateJob) <> "" Then cUpdateJob = cUpdateJob & ",jmpScheduleComplete = 0" cUpdateJob = Mid(cUpdateJob, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE Jobs SET " & cUpdateJob & " FROM Jobs INNER JOIN SalesOrderJobLinks ON jmpJobID = omjJobID WHERE omjSalesOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderID").Value) & " And omjSalesOrderLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderLineID").Value) & " And omjSalesOrderDeliveryID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) & " And omjLinkType = 1 And jmpProductionComplete = 0" Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged("Jobs") End If
If nQtyChanged <> 0 Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select jmpJobID,jmpOrderQuantity,jmpInventoryQuantity,jmpScrapQuantity,jmpProductionQuantity from Jobs INNER JOIN SalesOrderJobLinks ON jmpJobID = omjJobID where omjSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderID").Value) + " And omjSalesOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("omdSalesOrderLineID").Value) + " And omjSalesOrderDeliveryID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("omdSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) + " And omjLinkType = 1 And jmpProductionComplete = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText Do While rsData.EOF = False Connection.Execute "UPDATE Jobs SET jmpOrderQuantity = " + Trim(CDbl(Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value)) + ", jmpProductionQuantity = " + Trim(CDbl(Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value)) + " + jmpInventoryQuantity + jmpScrapQuantity WHERE jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(rsData.Fields("jmpJobID").Value)) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobAssemblies SET jmaProductionQuantity = jmpProductionQuantity, jmaOrderQuantity = jmpOrderQuantity, jmaQuantityToMake = jmpProductionQuantity FROM JobAssemblies INNER JOIN Jobs ON jmaJobID = jmpJobID WHERE jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(rsData.Fields("jmpJobID").Value)) + " And jmaJobAssemblyID = 0" App.Ax("Job").ChangeProductionQty e.SqlTransaction, rsData.Fields("jmpJobID").Value, 0, CDbl(Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value) + Cdbl(rsData.Fields("jmpInventoryQuantity").Value) + CDbl(rsData.Fields("jmpScrapQuantity").Value), rsData.Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value, False rsData.MoveNext Loop rsData.Close End If End Function
Function SalesOrderDeliveries_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsSalesOrders,dOldDate,dNewDate,nDiff,rsData dOldDate = Null dNewDate = Null Set rsSalesOrders = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSalesOrders.Open "SELECT ompOrderDate FROM SalesOrders INNER JOIN SalesOrderDeliveries ON omdSalesOrderID = ompSalesOrderID WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " GROUP BY ompOrderDate",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSalesOrders.EOF = False Then dOldDate = rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompOrderDate").Value End If rsSalesOrders.Close rsSalesOrders.Open "SELECT ompOrderDate FROM SalesOrders INNER JOIN SalesOrderDeliveries ON omdSalesOrderID = ompSalesOrderID WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " GROUP BY ompOrderDate",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSalesOrders.EOF = False Then dNewDate = rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompOrderDate").Value End If rsSalesOrders.Close
If IsNull(dOldDate) = False And IsNull(dNewDate) = False Then nDiff = DateDiff("d",dOldDate,dNewDate) Else nDiff = 0 End If Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderDeliveries SET omdDeliveryDate = DateAdd(dd," + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nDiff) + ", omdDeliveryDate) WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function omdShipLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("omdCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("omdShipLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("omdShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("omdShippingMethodID").Value = "" Else Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlShipContactID,cmlCustomerShippingMethodID,cmlNonTaxReasonID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdShipLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("omdShipContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlShipContactID").Value Fields("omdShippingMethodID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShippingMethodID").Value If App.Ax("Financial").AvalaraActivated = true then Fields("omdAvalaraNonTaxReasonID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlNonTaxReasonID").Value End If Else Fields("omdShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("omdShippingMethodID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function omdDifferentLocation_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("omdDifferentLocation").Value) = True Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select ompShipOrganizationID,ompShipLocationID,ompShipContactID from SalesOrders Where ompSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("omdCustomerOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("ompShipOrganizationID").Value Fields("omdShipLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value Fields("omdShipContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("ompShipContactID").Value Fields("omdShippingMethodID").Value = "" End If rsData.Close Else Fields("omdCustomerOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("omdShipLocationID").Value = "" Fields("omdShipContactID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function omdShippingMethodID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("omdShippingMethodID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select xasShippingPaymentTypeID from ShippingMethods Where xasShippingMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdShippingMethodID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("omdShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = rsData.Fields("xasShippingPaymentTypeID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function omdDeliveryType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) then If CBool(Fields("omdShippedComplete").Value) Or Cdbl(Fields("omdQuantityShipped").Value) <> 0 then e.cancel = "This delivery has already been shipped. The delivery type cannot be changed after it has been shipped, unless the shipment is reversed." Exit Function End If If CInt(Fields("omdDeliveryType").OriginalValue) = 1 Then ' If the original value is Make to Order Set rsJobLinks = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsJobLinks.Open "Select omjJobID From SalesOrderJobLinks Where omjSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderID").Value) + " And omjSalesOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderLineID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsJobLinks.EOF = False then e.cancel = "This make to order delivery has already been linked to job "+ rsJobLinks.Fields("omjJobID").Value +". The delivery type cannot be changed from Make To Order unless the job is unlinked from the delivery." Exit Function End If End If End If Dim rsData,po,poline Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select pmlPurchaseOrderID,pmlPurchaseOrderLineID from purchaseorderlines where pmlSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderID").Value) + " and pmlSalesOrderLineID="+App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderLineID").Value) + " and pmlSalesOrderDeliveryID="+App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If rsData.EOF = False Then po=rsData.Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value poline=rsData.Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value e.Cancel ="This purchase to order delivery has already been linked to purchase order line "+po+"-"+cstr(poline)+"."+Chr(13)+Chr(13)+ "The delivery type cannot be changed from Purchase To Order unless the purchase is unlinked from the delivery." else OnDeliveryTypeChanged() end if rsData.Close
End Function
Function omdPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs, bKitPart bKitPart = False nDeliveryType = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMDeliveryType").Value
Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select impPhantomOrKitPart,impDeliveryType,impNonStockedItem from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bKitPart = oRs.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").value
If CInt(oRs.Fields("impDeliveryType").Value) <> 0 Then nDeliveryType = oRs.Fields("impDeliveryType").Value ElseIf CInt(App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMDeliveryType").Value) <> 0 Then nDeliveryType = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMDeliveryType").Value ElseIf CInt(oRs.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = True Then nDeliveryType = 1 End If End If oRs.Close
Fields("omdKitPart").Value = bKitPart Fields("omdKitPart").RunFormatter e.Database, e.Row Fields("omdDeliveryType").Value = nDeliveryType
Fields("omdPartRevisionID").RunFormatter e.Database, e.Row call OnDeliveryTypeChanged()
End Function
Function omdDeliveryQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If cdbl(Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "You must enter a delivery quantity before continuing" + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function omdDeliveryDate_Valid(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("omdDeliveryDate").Value) = True Then e.AddError "You must enter a delivery date before continuing" + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function omdDeliveryType_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("omdDeliveryType").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "You must enter a delivery type before continuing" + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function omdDeliveryQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("SalesOrder").UpdatePurchaseUnitCost(Record.Table.BindingSource) End Function
Function omdPurchaseLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("SalesOrder").UpdatePurchaseUnitCost(Record.Table.BindingSource) End Function
Function omdKitPart_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("omdKitPart").RunFormatter e.Database, e.Row End Function
Function OnDeliveryTypeChanged() Dim oRs If CInt(Fields("omdDeliveryType").Value) <> 3 Then Fields("omdAmountToInvoice").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("omdDeliveryType").Value) = 5 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrSupplierOrganizationID, imrPurchaseLocationID from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdPartID").Value) + " and imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omdPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("omdSupplierOrganizationID").Value = oRs.Fields("imrSupplierOrganizationID").value Fields("omdPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("imrPurchaseLocationID").value End If oRs.Close Call App.Ax("SalesOrder").UpdatePurchaseUnitCost(Record.Table.BindingSource) Else Fields("omdSupplierOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("omdPurchaseLocationID").Value = "" Fields("omdPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = 0 End If End function
Function omdPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("omdPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("omdPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("omdPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("omdPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End If If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect" + Chr(13) End If End If end function

Function IncomeTaxTableLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) If Record.EntryMode = ".NET" Then Dim source Set source = Record.Table.BindingSource.GetRecordset() If source.RecordCount > 0 Then source.MoveLast Fields("palMultiplier").Value = source.Fields("palMultiplier").Value If Fields("palIncomeTaxID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("paxCountry").Fields("paxCountry").Value <> "AUS" Then Fields("palEarningsOver").Value = source.Fields("palEarningsNotOver").Value End If End if End If End Function
Function palEarningsNotOver_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("palEarningsNotOver").Value < Fields("palEarningsOver").Value Then e.AddError "Earnings Over cannot be greater than Earnings Not Over" End If End Function

Dim bInUpdate,bInExtCostUpdate
Function RMAReceiptLines_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) e.FocusField = "rrlPartID" End Function
Function rrlPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData, bKitPart bKitPart = False If Trim(Fields("rrlPartID").Value) <> "" Then If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,impPhantomOrKitPart from PartRevisions Inner Join Parts on imrPartID=impPartID where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("rrlDescription").Value = rsData.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("rrlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsData.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value
Dim objPartCosts, nValue Set objPartCosts = App.Ax("Part").GetPartCosts(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("rrlPartID").Value, Fields("rrlPartRevisionID").Value) if IsNull(objPartCosts) = False Then nValue = Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) + _ Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) End If Set objPartCosts = nothing
Fields("rrlUnitCost").Value = nValue
bKitPart = rsData.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value Else If Trim(Fields("rrlRMAClaimID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("rrlRMAClaimLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim rsRMAClaimLines Set rsRMAClaimLines = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsRMAClaimLines.Open "select ralPartShortDescription from RMACLaimLines where ralRMAClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringtoSQL(Fields("rrlRMAClaimID").Value) + " and ralRMAClaimLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rrlRMAClaimLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsRMAClaimLines.EOF = False Then Fields("rrlDescription").Value = rsRMAClaimLines.Fields("ralPartShortDescription").Value End If End If End If rsData.Close End If End If Fields("rrlKitPart").Value = bKitPart End Function
Function rrlInventoryQuantityReceived_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Call UpdateSalesQty bInExtCostUpdate=True End If End Function
Function rrlQuantityToInspect_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call UpdateSalesQty If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If Cdbl(Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value) <> 0 Then If Cbool(Fields("rrlRequiresInspection").Value) = False Then bInUpdate = True Fields("rrlRequiresInspection").Value = True bInUpdate = False End If End If bInExtCostUpdate=True End If End If End Function Sub UpdateSalesQty Dim nValue If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("rrlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nValue = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) + CDbl(Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value)) * CDbl(Fields("rrlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").SellQuantityDecimals) If nValue <> CDbl(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value) Then Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value = nValue End If End If End if End Sub
Function rrlSalesQuantityReceived_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Call UpdateInvQty End If End Function
Function rrlConversionFactor_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Call UpdateInvQty End If End Function
Sub UpdateInvQty If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("rrlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then bInUpdate = True If Cbool(Fields("rrlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rrlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Else Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rrlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) End If bInUpdate = False End If End If ' This won't work properly until the originalvalue issue is fixed If Cdbl(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value) <> 0 Then If Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value - Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").OriginalValue >= Fields("rrlRMAOpenQuantity").Value Then If Fields("rrlReceivedComplete").Value = False Then Fields("rrlReceivedComplete").Value = True End If End If End If end sub
Function rrlRequiresInspection_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If Cbool(Fields("rrlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then If CDbl(Fields("rrlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then bInUpdate = True Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rrlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = 0 bInUpdate = False End If Else Dim rsInspection Set rsInspection = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsInspection.Open "Select qalInspectionID, qalInspectionLineID From InspectionLines Where qalSourceTableUniqueID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("rrlUniqueID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsInspection.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "This RMA Receipt Line is currently in inspection on Inspection ID " & rsInspection.Fields("qalInspectionID").Value & " - " & rsInspection.Fields("qalInspectionLineID").Value & chr(13) bInUpdate = True Fields("rrlRequiresInspection").Value = True bInUpdate = False Else Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value = 0 End If Set rsInspection = nothing End If End if End If End Function
Function rrlRequiresInspection_Valid(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Value) <> "" Then If CBool(Fields("rrlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then If Cdbl(Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 then e.AddError "You must enter a quantity to inspect before continuing" + Chr(13) end if End If End If End Function
Function rrlReceivedComplete_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rrlReceivedComplete").Value) = True Then If CDbl(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value = Fields("rrlRMAOpenQuantity").Value End If End If End Function
Function rrlInventoryQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) If cdbl(Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 And _ cdbl(Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 And _ cdbl(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "You must enter at least one receipt qty before continuing" + Chr(13) end if call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value, Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Caption, e) End Function
Sub RefreshOpenQty Dim rsClaims, nOpenQty, nClaimQty
nOpenQty = 0 nDeliveryQty = 0 If CInt(Fields("rrlRMAClaimLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsClaims = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsClaims.Open "select ralQuantity,ralQuantityReceived,ralReceivedComplete from RMAClaimLines where ralRMAClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlRMAClaimID").Value) & " and ralRMAClaimLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rrlRMAClaimLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsClaims.EOF = False Then nClaimQty = CDbl(rsClaims.Fields("ralQuantity").Value) If CBool(rsClaims.Fields("ralReceivedComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsClaims.Fields("ralQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsClaims.Fields("ralQuantityReceived").Value) End If If CDbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If rsClaims.Close End If Fields("rrlRMAOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty Fields("rrlRMAClaimQuantity").Value = nClaimQty End Sub
Function rrlRMAClaimLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Call RefreshOpenQty End If End Function
Function RMAReceiptLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim nInvQtyChanged, cPartID, cPartRevisionID
If CBool(Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = True Then Exit function End If
If CBool(Fields("rrlPosted").Value) = False Then Exit Function Else If (Cbool(Fields("rrlPosted").Value) = Cbool(Fields("rrlPosted").OriginalValue)) then Exit Function End If End If
If CBool(Fields("rrlKitPart").Value) = True Then Exit Function end if
Dim parentBs Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row)
nInvQtyChanged = CDbl(Fields("rrlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) + CDbl(Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value)
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rrlPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rrlPartRevisionID").Value))
Dim rsWarehouse, bNonNettable bNonNettable = False Set rsWarehouse = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWarehouse.Open "Select imwWarehouseID, imwNonNettable, imwNonNettableType From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("rrlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)) + " And imwNonNettable <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsWarehouse.EOF = False Then bNonNettable = rsWarehouse.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouse.Close
If nInvQtyChanged <> 0 Then Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' If this revision doesn't exist, check to see if we can find another ' one and use it instead. If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then Dim nTotalCurrentCostLabor, nTotalCurrentCostOverHead, nTotalCurrentCostMaterial, nTotalCurrentCostSubContract, nTotalCurrentCostDuty, nTotalCurrentCostFreight, nTotalCurrentCostMisc Dim nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCostLabor = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostOverHead = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostMaterial = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostSubContract = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostDuty = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostFreight = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostMisc = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value)
If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If
If Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) < 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged) Else nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) + Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged) End If
If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. If Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged) > 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = GetMaxDate(parentBs.Fields("rrpReceiptDate").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value)
' Get costs either from linked shipment/order, or from the current costing method if not linked Dim objPartCosts, nValue Set objPartCosts = App.Ax("RMAReceipt").GetPartCostObjectForRmaReceipt(e.SqlTransaction, e.Row) if IsNull(objPartCosts) = True Then Exit Function End If
' Set new avg unit costs nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostLabor + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostOverHead + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostMaterial + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostSubContract + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostDuty + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostFreight + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostMisc + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
Set objPartCosts = nothing End If End If
End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End If End Function
Private Function GetMaxDate(dDate1, dDate2) Dim dReturn dReturn = Null If IsNull(dDate1) Then dReturn = dDate2 ElseIf IsNull(dDate2) Then dReturn = dDate1 Else If dDate1 > dDate2 Then dReturn = dDate1 Else dReturn = dDate2 End If End If GetMaxDate = dReturn End Function
Function RMAReceiptLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID").Value<>0) Then Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceiptLines Set rrlReversed=1 Where rrlRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value)+" And rrlRMAReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceipts Set rrpReversed=1 Where rrpRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceiptComponents Set rroReversed=1 Where rroRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value)+" And rroRMAReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID").Value) else Fields("rrlReversed").Value=0 End If End Function
Function RMAReceiptLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID").Value<>0) Then Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceiptLines Set rrlReversed=0 Where rrlRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value)+" And rrlRMAReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceipts Set rrpReversed=0 Where rrpRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update RMAReceiptComponents Set rroReversed=0 Where rroRMAReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptID").Value)+" And rroRMAReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rrlReverseRMAReceiptLineID").Value) End If End Function
Function rrlTotalComponentCosts_ValueChanged(sender, e) bInExtCostUpdate=True End Function
Function rrlUnitCost_ValueChanged(sender, e) bInExtCostUpdate=True End Function
Function RMAReceiptLines_CurrentChanged(sender, e) bInExtCostUpdate=True dim preVal If CInt(Fields("rrlKitPart"))=True And Cdbl(Fields("rrlUnitCost").Value)<>0 then 'this is to trigger the rrlUnitCost_Valid event from Currentchange. At present rrlUnitCost_Valid event fires before Currentchange. 'So, it does not run validate code because bInExtCostUpdate =false preVal=Fields("rrlUnitCost").Value Fields("rrlUnitCost").Value=preVal+1 Fields("rrlUnitCost").Value=preVal end if End Function
Function rrlUnitCost_Valid(sender, e) dim errorText If CBool(bInExtCostUpdate) = True And CInt(Fields("rrlKitPart"))=True And Cdbl(Fields("rrlExtendedCostForeign").Value)<>0 then dim totalCosts, lineCompCosts totalCosts = App.Ax("RMAReceipt").GetTotalComponentsCost(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.Row) lineCompCosts = cdbl(fields("rrlTotalComponentCosts").value) If App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("rrlExtendedCostForeign").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)<>App.Round(Cdbl(totalCosts),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) then errorText = "The total kit component costs do not equal the kit part extended cost. To make them equal, change the unit cost on the kit or on the components." bInExtCostUpdate = false If CInt(App.Props("GL").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals")) = True Then e.AddError errorText Else e.AddWarning errorText End if end if End if End Function Function rrlQuantityToInspect_Valid(sender, e) call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Value, Fields("rrlQuantityToInspect").Caption, e) End Function
Function rrlSalesQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("rrlRMAOpenQuantity").Value > 0 Then call validateFieldQuantities(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value, Fields("rrlRMAOpenQuantity").Value, Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Caption, Fields("rrlRMAOpenQuantity").Caption, e) End if call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Value, Fields("rrlSalesQuantityReceived").Caption, e) End Function
Function validateFieldQuantities(fieldValue1, fieldValue2, fieldCaption1, fieldCaption2, e) If fieldValue1 > fieldValue2 Then e.AddError trim(fieldCaption1) + " must not be greater than " + fieldCaption2 + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function validateNegativeQuantities(quantity, fieldCaption, e) Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If cdbl(quantity) < 0 And CBool(parentBs.Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError trim(fieldCaption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function RMAReceiptLines_RemoveStarted(sender, e) bInExtCostUpdate=True End Function
Function rrlPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("rrlPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("rrlPartID").Value, Fields("rrlPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("rrlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("rrlPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then if CInt(Fields("rrlPosted").Value) = 0 And not Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value then e.AddError "Part ID '" + Fields("rrlPartID").Value + "', Revision '" + Fields("rrlPartRevisionID").Value + "', Warehouse ID '" + Fields("rrlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value + "', Bin ID '" + Fields("rrlPartBinID").Value + "' is inactive." end if End If End If End Function

Function imlPartWarehouseID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsWarehouses If App.Props("DS").Fields("xadEnableNonNettable").Value = True Then Set rsWarehouses = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsWarehouses.Open "select isnull(imwNonNettable,0) as imwNonNettable from Warehouses where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imlPartWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsWarehouses.EOF = False Then Fields("imlNonNettable").Value = rsWarehouses.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouses.Close End If End Function
Function PartWarehouseLocations_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartWarehouseLocations SET imlQuantityInTransit = 0 WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function PartWarehouseLocations_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Fields("imlLastRunDatePurchasePlanner").Value = Date() End Function

Function incStructureID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("incStructureCode").Value = Trim(Fields("incStructureID").Value) End Function
Function ProductCategories_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) ' Copy data in duplicate fields to lines table Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "Select * From ProductCategoryLines Where insProductCategoryID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("incProductCategoryID").Value) + " And insProductCategoryLineID = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If oRs.EOF = True then oRs.AddNew App.BlankRecord oRs end if Call App.CopyMatchingFields(Fields, oRs, "inc,uinc")
oRs.Fields("insProductCategoryID").Value = Fields("incProductCategoryID").Value oRs.Fields("insProductCategoryLineID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("insParentLineID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("insLevel").Value = 1
oRs.Fields("insStructureID").Value = Fields("incStructureID").Value oRs.Fields("insStructureCode").Value = Fields("incStructureCode").Value oRs.Fields("insDescription").Value = Fields("incDescription").Value oRS.Fields("insImageFilePath").Value = Fields("incImageFilePath").Value
oRs.Fields("insInactive").Value = Fields("incInactive").Value oRs.Fields("insInactiveDate").Value = Fields("incInactiveDate").Value
oRs.UpdateBatch oRs.Close End Function

Function WarehouseTransferLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, cText, rsLookup, cPartID, cRevisionID, cWHID, bFound, nLoop, nCount
Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouseTransferComponents") nCount = -1 If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsTemp = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.MoveFirst Do While rsTemp.EOF = False cPartID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("mwoPartID").Value)) cRevisionID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value)) cWHID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("mwoDestinationWarehouseID").Value)) 'rsLookup.Open "select imbPartID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("mwlDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cBinID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cWHID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then bFound = False For nLoop = 0 To nCount If aParts(nCount) = cPartID And aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID And aWH(nCount) = cWHID Then bFound = True Exit For End If Next If bFound = False Then nCount = nCount + 1 ReDim Preserve aParts(nCount) aParts(nCount) = cPartID cText = cText & ", " & cPartID & App.IIf(cRevisionID = "", "", "/" & cRevisionID) & "/" & cWHID ReDim Preserve aRevisions(nCount) aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID ReDim Preserve aWH(nCount) aWH(nCount) = cWHID End If End If rsLookup.Close rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Set rsTemp = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing
If CInt(nCount) > -1 Then cText = Trim(Mid(cText, 3)) For nLoop = 0 To nCount rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aWH(nLoop)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartWarehouseLocations (imlPartID,imlPartRevisionID,imlPartWarehouseID) VALUES (" + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aWH(nLoop)) + ")" End If rsLookup.Close 'Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartBins (imbPartID,imbPartRevisionID,imbWarehouseID,imbPartBinID,imbConversionFactor) SELECT imrPartID as imbPartID,imrPartRevisionID as imbPartRevisionID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("mwpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " as imbWarehouseID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aWH(nLoop)) + " as imbPartBinID,1 as imbConversionFactor FROM PartRevisions WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) Next End If
Dim nPrevShipQuantity, bPrevShippedComplete, nShipQtyChanged, cUpdateWRL, cUpdateWR
If Trim(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) <> "" And CDbl(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionLineID").Value) <> 0 Then bPrevShippedComplete = CDbl(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").OriginalValue)
cUpdateWRL = "" cUpdateWR = ""
If CBool(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").Value) <> CBool(bPrevShippedComplete) Then If CBool(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").Value) = True Then nCount = 0 Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select Count(*) as reccount from WarehouseRequisitionLines Where wqlWarehouseRequisitionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) + " And wqlTransferredComplete = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("reccount").Value) = False Then nCount = rsTemp.Fields("reccount").Value End If End If rsTemp.Close If CInt(nCount) = 0 Then cUpdateWRL = cUpdateWRL & ",wqlClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") cUpdateWR = cUpdateWR & ",wqpClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") & ", wqpClosedDate = " + App.Convert.DateTimeToSQL(Date) End If Else cUpdateWRL = cUpdateWRL & ",wqlClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") cUpdateWR = cUpdateWR & ",wqpClosed = " & App.IIf(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").Value = True, "1", "0") & ", wqpClosedDate = NULL" End If End If If Trim(cUpdateWRL) <> "" Then cUpdateWRL = Mid(cUpdateWRL, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseRequisitionLines SET " + cUpdateWRL + " WHERE wqlWarehouseRequisitionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) & " AND wqlWarehouseRequisitionLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged("WarehouseRequisitionLines") End If If Trim(cUpdateWR) <> "" Then cUpdateWR = Mid(cUpdateWR, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseRequisitions SET " + cUpdateWR + " WHERE wqpWarehouseRequisitionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged("WarehouseRequisitions") End If End if Call RefreshOpenQty End Function

If Trim(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) <> "" And CDbl(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionLineID").Value) <> 0 Then bPrevShippedComplete = CDbl(Fields("mwlShippedComplete").OriginalValue)
cUpdateWRL = "" cUpdateWR = ""
If CBool(bPrevShippedComplete) = True Then cUpdateWRL = cUpdateWRL & ",wqlClosed = 0" cUpdateWR = cUpdateWR & ",wqpClosed = 0, wqpClosedDate = NULL" End If If Trim(cUpdateWRL) <> "" Then cUpdateWRL = Mid(cUpdateWRL, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseRequisitionLines SET " + cUpdateWRL + " WHERE wqlWarehouseRequisitionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) & " AND wqlWarehouseRequisitionLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionLineID").Value) End If If Trim(cUpdateWR) <> "" Then cUpdateWR = Mid(cUpdateWR, 2) Connection.Execute "UPDATE WarehouseRequisitions SET " + cUpdateWR + " WHERE wqpWarehouseRequisitionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) End If End if If Trim(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransfers Set mwpReversed=0 Where mwpWarehouseTransferID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransferLines Set mwlReversed=0 Where mwlWarehouseTransferID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value)+" And mwlWarehouseTransferLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransferComponents Set mwoReversed=0 Where mwoWarehouseTransferID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value)+" And mwoWarehouseTransferLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferLineID").Value) end if End Function
Function WarehouseTransferLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransfers Set mwpReversed=1 Where mwpWarehouseTransferID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransferLines Set mwlReversed=1 Where mwlWarehouseTransferID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value)+" And mwlWarehouseTransferLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseTransferComponents Set mwoReversed=1 Where mwoWarehouseTransferID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value)+" And mwoWarehouseTransferLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferLineID").Value) else Fields("mwlReversed").Value = 0 End If End Function
Sub RefreshOpenQty Dim rsWR, nOpenQty, nReqQty
nOpenQty = 0 nReqQty = 0 If CInt(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsWR = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWR.Open "select wqlTransferredComplete,wqlRequestedQuantity,wqlQuantityTransferred from WarehouseRequisitionLines where wqlWarehouseRequisitionId = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionID").Value) & " and wqlWarehouseRequisitionLineId = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("mwlWarehouseRequisitionLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsWR.EOF = False Then nReqQty = CDbl(rsWR.Fields("wqlRequestedQuantity").Value) If CBool(rsWR.Fields("wqlTransferredComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsWR.Fields("wqlRequestedQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsWR.Fields("wqlQuantityTransferred").Value) End If If CDbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If rsWR.Close End If Fields("mwlWROpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty Fields("mwlWRRequestedQuantity").Value = nReqQty End Sub

Function mwlSourceWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Source warehouse does not exist for part '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value) + "'" Else rsLookup.Open "SELECT imwInactive from Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsLookup.fields("imwInactive").Value) = True and cbool(Fields("mwlPosted").Value) = false And Trim(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value) = "" Then rsLookup.Open "SELECT impNonStockedItem, SUM(imbQuantityOnHand + imbQuantityToInspect) AS Quantity from PartBins INNER JOIN Parts ON imbPartID = impPartID Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value) + " group by impPhantomOrKitPart, impNonStockedItem", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsLookup.fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = False AND cdbl(rsLookup.fields("Quantity").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Warehouse '" + Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value + "' is assigned to this part revision, but is inactive and all bins have no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect. [Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value) + "']" End If End If End If End If End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function mwlSourcePartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imbPartBinID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlSourcePartBinID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then Dim warehouseBinID, parentPartId, parentPartRevisionId warehouseBinID = "" parentPartId = "" parentPartRevisionId = "" isFoundBinValid = App.Ax("Part").GetWarehouseBinForWarehouseTransferLine(Record.Table.BindingSource, Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value), warehouseBinID, parentPartId, parentPartRevisionId, e.SqlTransaction) If isFoundBinValid = False Then e.AddError "ALL Bins in the Source Warehouse for Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value) + "' are INACTIVE and have no quantity on hand." Else e.AddError "Source bin does not exist for part '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value) + "'" End If Else If cbool(Fields("mwlPosted").Value) = false And Trim(Fields("mwlReverseWHTransferID").Value) = "" then rsLookup.Open "SELECT impNonStockedItem, imbQuantityOnHand, imbQuantityToInspect FROM PartBins INNER JOIN Parts ON imbPartID = impPartID WHERE imbInactiveBin = 1 AND imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwlSourcePartBinID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsLookup.fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = False AND cdbl(rsLookup.fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) + cdbl(rsLookup.fields("imbQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Bin in the Source Warehouse for Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value) + "' is INACTIVE and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." End If End If end if End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function

Dim bCostSetByCode, bAddingSupplierReqLine
Function CalculatePrice(e) If Cbool(bCostSetByCode = False) Then If Fields("ppoPurchaseType").Value = 2 Then Dim cSupplierID,cType,cCurrencyID,dPriceDate,cLocID,priceCalc,bForeignAmount
cType = "MATERIAL" bForeignAmount = False cSupplierID = Trim(Fields("ppoSupplierOrganizationID").Value) cCurrencyID = Trim(Fields("ppoCurrencyRateID").Value) dPriceDate = cDate(Date()) cLocID = Trim(Fields("ppoPurchaseLocationID").Value)
Set priceCalc = App.Ax("Part").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("ppoPartID").Value,Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Value,cSupplierID,cLocID,Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value,cType,cCurrencyID,dPriceDate,Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) > 0 Then If priceCalc.IsForeignCurrency Then If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("ppoUnitCostForeign").Value) Then bCostSetByCode = True Fields("ppoUnitCostForeign").Value = priceCalc.FullPrice bCostSetByCode = False End If End If If not priceCalc.IsForeignCurrency Then If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("ppoUnitCostBase").Value) Then bCostSetByCode = True Fields("ppoUnitCostBase").Value = priceCalc.FullPrice bCostSetByCode = False End If End If End If
Fields("ppoLeadTime").Value = priceCalc.LeadTime Fields("ppoConversionFactor").Value = priceCalc.ConversionFactor
Set priceCalc = Nothing End If
bCostSetByCode = True Dim parentBs Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) 'Add the supplier requirement line if required
If CBool(bAddingSupplierReqLine) = False Then bAddingSupplierReqLine = True Call App.Ax("PurchasePlanner").AddSupplierRequirementsLine(Record.Table.BindingSource, parentBs.CurrentAsDataRow) bAddingSupplierReqLine = False End If bCostSetByCode = False End If End Function
Function ppoInventoryQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nConvFactor, nNewValue
' Calculate new purchase quantity to be used in GetPurchasePrice functions nConvFactor = 1 nNewValue = 0 If CDbl(Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = Fields("ppoConversionFactor").Value If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value) * CDbl(nConvFactor), App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals) End If ' New code from VB6 If CDbl(nNewValue) <> Cdbl(Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) Then If App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) / CDbl(nConvFactor), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) <> Cdbl(Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value) Then Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value = nNewValue End If End If End If
Call CalculatePrice(e)
End Function
Function ppoPurchaseQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nConvFactor,nNewValue nConvFactor = 1 nNewValue = 0 If CDbl(Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("ppoConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = CDbl(App.Round(CDbl(Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) / CDbl(nConvFactor),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) Else Exit Function End If End If ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If nNewValue <> CDbl(Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value) Then If CDbl(App.Round(CDbl(Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value) * CDbl(nConvFactor),App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals)) <> CDbl(Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) Then Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value = nNewValue End If End If End Function
Function ppoConversionFactor_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nConvFactor,nNewValue If CDbl(Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = 1 nNewValue = 0 nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("ppoConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = CDbl(App.Round(CDbl(Fields("ppoPurchaseQuantity").Value) / CDbl(nConvFactor),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If nNewValue <> CDbl(Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value) Then Fields("ppoInventoryQuantity").Value = nNewValue End If End If End If End Function
