Function ppoPurchaseLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call CalculatePrice(e) End Function
Function PurchasePlannerOrderDetails_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Fields("ppoPartID").Value = Fields("ppoLineID").Fields("pplPartID").Value Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Value = Fields("ppoLineID").Fields("pplPartRevisionID").Value Fields("ppoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = Fields("ppoLineID").Fields("pplWarehouseID").Value Fields("ppoPartWarehouseLocationID").RunFormatter e.Database, e.Row 'Needed to auto-set the Bin ID based on default rules
If Trim(Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) = "" Then Fields("ppoInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapomunitofmeasure").Value Else Fields("ppoInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If
If Trim(Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) = "" Then Fields("ppoPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapomunitofmeasure").Value Else Fields("ppoPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value End If End Function
Function ppoUnitCostBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice, nExchangeRate
' get the exchange rate from the rate ID and the date nExchangeRate = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("ppoCurrencyRateID").Value, Now()) if nExchangeRate = 0 then nExchangeRate = 1 end if
' get the new foreign price nPrice = Cdbl(App.Round(fields("ppoUnitCostBase").value * nExchangeRate, 5)) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("ppoUnitCostForeign").Value) Then bCostSetByCode = True Fields("ppoUnitCostForeign").Value = nPrice bCostSetByCode = False End If End Function
Function ppoUnitCostForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice, nExchangeRate
' get the exchange rate from the rate ID and the date nExchangeRate = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("ppoCurrencyRateID").Value, Now()) if nExchangeRate = 0 then nExchangeRate = 1 end if
' get the new base price nPrice = Cdbl(App.Round(fields("ppoUnitCostForeign").value / nExchangeRate, 5)) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("ppoUnitCostBase").Value) Then bCostSetByCode = True Fields("ppoUnitCostBase").Value = nPrice bCostSetByCode = False End If End Function
Function ppoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("ppoPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("ppoPartID").Value, Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("ppoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("ppoPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID '"&Fields("ppoPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("ppoPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse ID '"&Fields("ppoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin ID '"&Fields("ppoPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive." End If End If End Function

Function PartAssemblies_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Dim aValues,oRs ' If the number of key fields in the parent is 3, ' then the parent is PartAssemblies instead of PartRevisions. ' Set the parent assembly to the assembly of the parent If CLng(Fields("imaParentAssemblyID").Value) = 0 Then Fields("imaLevel").Value = 2 Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT imaMethodAssemblyID,imaLevel FROM PartAssemblies WHERE imaMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imaMethodID").Value) + " And imaMethodRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imaMethodRevisionID").Value) + " AND imaMethodAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imaParentAssemblyID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("imaLevel").Value = CLng(oRs.Fields("imaLevel").Value) + 1 Else MsgBox "Unable to find parent assembly - PARTASSEMBLIES AfterInsert Trigger" End If oRs.Close End If End Function

Fields("imaUseMethod").Value = False ElseIf Trim(Fields("imaPartID").Value) = Trim(Fields("imaMethodID").Value) And Trim(Fields("imaPartRevisionID").Value) = Trim(Fields("imaMethodRevisionID").Value) Then e.AddWarning "Use Method cannot be checked as the Part ID is the same as the Method ID." Function Organizations_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) ' Copy data in duplicate fields to locations table Dim childBs, oRs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("OrganizationLocations") If childBs.Count > 0 then Set oRs = childBs.GetRecordset(Record.Table.BindingSource.CurrentAsDataRow) oRs.Filter = "cmlOrganizationId = " & App.Convert.StringToLinq(Fields("cmoOrganizationID").Value) & " and cmlLocationID = ''" else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT * FROM OrganizationLocations WHERE cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmoOrganizationID").Value) + " AND cmlLocationID = '' ",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = True Then oRs.AddNew App.BlankRecord oRs End If end if
Call App.CopyMatchingFields(Fields,oRs,"cmo,ucmo") oRs.Fields("cmlOrganizationID").Value = Fields("cmoOrganizationID").Value oRs.Fields("cmlLocationID").Value = "" If CInt(Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 2 Then oRs.Fields("cmlQuoteLocation").Value = True Else oRs.Fields("cmlQuoteLocation").Value = False End If If CInt(Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 2 Then oRs.Fields("cmlShipLocation").Value = True Else oRs.Fields("cmlShipLocation").Value = False End If If CInt(Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 2 Then oRs.Fields("cmlARInvoiceLocation").Value = True Else oRs.Fields("cmlARInvoiceLocation").Value = False End If If CInt(Fields("cmoSupplierStatus").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("cmoSupplierStatus").Value) = 2 Then oRs.Fields("cmlPurchaseLocation").Value = True Else oRs.Fields("cmlPurchaseLocation").Value = False End If If CInt(Fields("cmoSupplierStatus").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("cmoSupplierStatus").Value) = 2 Then oRs.Fields("cmlAPInvoiceLocation").Value = True Else oRs.Fields("cmlAPInvoiceLocation").Value = False End If oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerPaymentTermID").Value = Fields("cmoCustomerPaymentTermsID").Value oRs.UpdateBatch oRs.Close
If CInt(Fields("cmoFinanceCompany").Value) = True Then Connection.Execute "Update OrganizationLocations Set cmlName = cmoName,cmlAddressLine1 = cmoAddressLine1,cmlAddressLine2 = cmoAddressLine2,cmlAddressLine3 = cmoAddressLine3,cmlCity = cmoCity,cmlCounty = cmoCounty,cmlState = cmoState,cmlPostCode = cmoPostCode,cmlCountry = cmoCountry,cmlPhoneNumber = cmoPhoneNumber,cmlAlternatePhoneNumber = cmoAlternatePhoneNumber,cmlFaxNumber = cmoFaxNumber,cmlEmailAddress = cmoEmailAddress From OrganizationLocations Inner Join Organizations On cmlFinanceOrganizationID = cmoOrganizationID And cmlFinanceOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmoOrganizationID").Value) End If End Function
Function Organizations_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartCrossReferences WHERE imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmoOrganizationID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartOrgReferences WHERE imzOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmoOrganizationID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM IntegrationCrossReferences WHERE icrIntegrationType = 'Financial' AND icrAPIType In ('Customer', 'Vendor') AND icrSourceTableUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmoUniqueID").Value)

Function smlQuantityShipped_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, bShippedComplete If CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If cdbl(Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If
bShippedComplete = False Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select omdShippedComplete From SalesOrderDeliveries Where omdSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderID").Value) + " and omdSalesOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderLineID").Value) + " and omdSalesOrderDeliveryID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText if rstemp.eof = false then bShippedComplete = cbool(rstemp.fields("omdShippedComplete").Value) end if rstemp.close
If cbool(Fields("smlShippedComplete").Value) = True Then If (cdbl(Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value) + cdbl(Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").Value)) < cdbl(Fields("smlSOOpenQuantity").Value) Then e.AddWarning "The shipment line is marked as shipped complete with a quantity shipped that is less than the quantity on the delivery." + Chr(13) End If end if
If CBool(App.Ax("Shipments").CheckSumOfShipQtyForDelivery(Record.Table.BindingSource)) = False then 'e.AddWarning "There are deliveries that are set up to be filled by multiple jobs on this shipment. This has caused the quantity shipped to be greater than the delivery quantity." + chr(13) e.AddWarning "The quantity shipped is greater than the open/remaining quantity for the sales order delivery." + chr(13) end if
If CBool(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) Then Set rsDeliveries = createobject("adodb.recordset") Dim nDeliveryType rsDeliveries.Open "select omdDeliveryType from SalesOrderDeliveries where omdSalesOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderID").Value) & " and omdSalesOrderLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderLineID").Value) & " and omdSalesOrderDeliveryID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsDeliveries.EOF = False Then If(rsDeliveries.Fields("omdDeliveryType").Value = 5) Then Dim message message = App.Ax("Shipments").QtyShippedExceedsQtyOnSalesOrder(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.Row) If(Len(message) > 0) then e.AddWarning message + Chr(13) End If End IF End If rsDeliveries.close End If End If End Function
Function smlQuantityShipped_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CBool(Fields("smlInvoicedComplete").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "The quantity for this line cannot be changed because it has been invoiced. You will need to delete the invoice in order to edit this line." & chr(13) 'Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value = Fields("smlQuantityShipped").OriginalValue End If
Dim nPrice If Trim(Fields("smlSalesOrderID").Value) = "" Then Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetSellingPrice(Fields("smlPartID").Value, Fields("smlPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("smlPartGroupID").Value,Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpCustomerOrganizationID").Value, Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpARInvoiceLocationID").Value,Cdbl(Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value),Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpShipDate").Value) nPrice = 0 nFullPrice = 0 bForeign = False If IsNull(priceObj) = False Then nFullPrice = priceObj.FullPrice nPrice = priceObj.DiscountedPrice bForeign = priceObj.IsForeignCurrency End If Set priceObj = nothing
If Cdbl(nPrice) <> -1 Then Fields("smlUnitPrice").Value = nPrice End If End If End If End Function
Function smlJobQuantityShipped_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("smlInvoicedComplete").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.Cancel = "The quantity for this line cannot be changed because it has been invoiced. You will need to delete the invoice in order to edit this line." & chr(13) Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").Value = Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").OriginalValue End If End Function
Function ShipmentLines_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapSMLineQuantityValidation").Value) = 1 And CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Dim rsLookup nQtyShipped = 0 If Trim(Fields("smlSalesOrderID").Value) <> "" Then set rsLookup = createobject("ADODB.RecordSet") rsLookup.Open "Select IsNull(Sum(smlJobQuantityShipped+smlQuantityShipped),0) As smlQuantityShipped From ShipmentLines Where smlSalesOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderID").Value) & " And smlSalesOrderLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderLineID").Value) & " And smlSalesOrderDeliveryID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) & " And smlShipmentID <> " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlShipmentID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then nQtyShipped = rsLookup.Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value End If rsLookup.Close
If cdbl(Fields("smlSODeliveryQuantity").Value) < (CDbl(nQtyShipped) + (CDbl(Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value)+CDbl(Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").Value))) Then e.AddWarning "The Delivery Quantity (" & Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSODeliveryQuantity").Value)) & ") for Part " & Trim(Fields("smlPartID").Value) & " Rev " & Trim(Fields("smlPartRevisionID").Value) & " is less than the Total Ship Quantity (" & Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value + Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").Value + CDbl(nQtyShipped))) & ") for the current delivery. " & Chr(13) End If End If End If End Function
Function smlPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("smlPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("smlPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("smlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("smlPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" or Fields("smlPostedToGL").Value = True or CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = True then Exit Function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = true and CDbl(Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value) > 0 Then e.AddError "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect" + Chr(13) End If End If End Function
Function ShipmentLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Call RefreshOpenQty End If End Function
Function smlJobID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("smlJobID").Value) = "" And CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = False then Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").Value = 0 end if End Function
Sub RefreshOpenQty Dim rsDeliveries, nOpenQty, nDeliveryQty
nOpenQty = 0 nDeliveryQty = 0 If CInt(Fields("smlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsDeliveries = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsDeliveries.Open "select omdShippedComplete,omdDeliveryQuantity,omdQuantityShipped from SalesOrderDeliveries where omdSalesOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderID").Value) & " and omdSalesOrderLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderLineID").Value) & " and omdSalesOrderDeliveryID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("smlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsDeliveries.EOF = False Then nDeliveryQty = CDbl(rsDeliveries.Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value) If CBool(rsDeliveries.Fields("omdShippedComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsDeliveries.Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsDeliveries.Fields("omdQuantityShipped").Value) End If If CDbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If rsDeliveries.Close End If Fields("smlSOOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty Fields("smlSODeliveryQuantity").Value = nDeliveryQty End Sub
Function smlSalesOrderDeliveryID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("smlShipmentID").Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Call RefreshOpenQty End If End Function
Function ShipmentLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("smlReverseShipmentLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update ShipmentLines Set smlReversed=1 Where smlShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value)+" And smlShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("smlReverseShipmentLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update Shipments Set smpReversed=1 Where smpShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update ShipmentComponents Set smoReversed=1 Where smoShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value)+" And smoShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("smlReverseShipmentLineID").Value) else Fields("smlReversed").Value = 0 End if End Function
Function ShipmentLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("smlReverseShipmentLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update ShipmentLines Set smlReversed=0 Where smlShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value)+" And smlShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("smlReverseShipmentLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update Shipments Set smpReversed=0 Where smpShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update ShipmentComponents Set smoReversed=0 Where smoShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value)+" And smoShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("smlReverseShipmentLineID").Value) End if End Function

Dim bInUpdate, bCompCostUpdate, dTempPartQtyOnHand Function ReceiptLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim parentBs, nInvQtyChanged, cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsPartRevisions, cPartIDKey If CBool(Fields("rmlReceiptID").Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = True Then Exit function End if
If CBool(Fields("rmlPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Exit Function Else If (Cbool(Fields("rmlPostedToGL").Value) = Cbool(Fields("rmlPostedToGL").OriginalValue)) then Exit Function End If End If Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) Dim rsWarehouse, bNonNettable bNonNettable = False Set rsWarehouse = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWarehouse.Open "Select imwWarehouseID, imwNonNettable, imwNonNettableType From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("rmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)) + " And imwNonNettable <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsWarehouse.EOF = False Then bNonNettable = rsWarehouse.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouse.Close
nInvQtyChanged = CDbl(Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value)
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmlPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value)) cPartIDKey = cPartID & App.IIf(cPartRevisionID = "", "", "/" & cPartRevisionID)
If cPartID <> "" And Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) = "" And (nInvQtyChanged <> 0 Or (CDbl(Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").OriginalValue))) Then Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' If this revision doesn't exist, check to see if we can find another ' one and use it instead. If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then Dim nTotalCurrentCost, nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand, nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) If dTempPartQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey) <> "" Then nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(dTempPartQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey)) Else nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) End If ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCost = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If
If nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand < 0 And nInvQtyChanged > 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = nInvQtyChanged Else nNewQtyOnHand = nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand + nInvQtyChanged End If
If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. If nInvQtyChanged > 0 Then ' Set avg/last labor/burden to zero. rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = 0
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = GetMaxDate(parentBs.Fields("rmpReceiptDate").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value) ' Set Avg matl unit cost nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged))
If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) + Cdbl(Fields("rmlSetupCharge").Value)) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value) + App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("rmlSetupCharge").Value) / nInvQtyChanged, 5) ' Add a key to the dictionary or replace if no exists If dTempPartQtyOnHand.Exists(cPartIDKey) Then dTempPartQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey) = nNewQtyOnHand Else dTempPartQtyOnHand.Add cPartIDKey, nNewQtyOnHand End If End If ' Landed cost stuff If Trim(parentBs.Fields("rmpLandedCostID").Value) <> "" Then ' Update duty cost nTotalCurrentCost = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If nTotalCurrentCost < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(Fields("rmlDutyUnitCost").Value) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastDutyCost").Value = Fields("rmlDutyUnitCost").Value If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = Fields("rmlDutyUnitCost").Value Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = App.Round(nNewTotalCost / nNewQtyOnHand, 5) End If
' Update freight cost nTotalCurrentCost = (Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value)) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If nTotalCurrentCost < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(Fields("rmlFreightUnitCost").Value) * (Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged))) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastFreightCost").Value = Fields("rmlFreightUnitCost").Value If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = Fields("rmlFreightUnitCost").Value Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = App.Round(nNewTotalCost / nNewQtyOnHand, 5) End If
' Update misc cost nTotalCurrentCost = (Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value)) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If nTotalCurrentCost < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(Fields("rmlMiscUnitCost").Value) * (Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged))) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMiscCost").Value = Fields("rmlMiscUnitCost").Value If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = Fields("rmlMiscUnitCost").Value Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = App.Round(nNewTotalCost / nNewQtyOnHand, 5) End If End If End If End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End If End If
If Trim(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" And CDbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then If nInvQtyChanged > 0 Then Call App.Ax("FixedAssets").CreateAssetFromReceiptLine(e.Row, parentBs.CurrentAsDataRow, e.SqlTransaction, nInvQtyChanged) End If End if Call RefreshJobQty Call RefreshPOInfo End Function
Function ReceiptLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update Receipts Set rmpReversed=1 Where rmpReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update ReceiptLines Set rmlReversed=1 Where rmlReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value)+" And rmlReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update ReceiptComponents Set rmoReversed=1 Where rmoReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value)+" And rmoReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptLineID").Value) else Fields("rmlReversed").Value = 0 End If
Set dTempPartQtyOnHand = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End Function
Function ReceiptLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim cReceiptID cReceiptID = Trim(Fields("rmlReceiptID").Value) If Trim(cReceiptID) = "" Then Exit Function End If
Dim parentBs
Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row)
If Trim(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update Receipts Set rmpReversed=0 Where rmpReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update ReceiptLines Set rmlReversed=0 Where rmlReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value)+" And rmlReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update ReceiptComponents Set rmoReversed=0 Where rmoReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value)+" And rmoReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmlReverseReceiptLineID").Value) End If
End Function
Function rmlPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim bKitPart, rsParts, nConv,rsRef,cPurUM,cInvUM bKitPart = False If Trim(Fields("rmlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsParts.Open "select imrConversionFactor, imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure, imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure, (imrLastMaterialCost+imrLastDutyCost+imrLastFreightCost+imrLastMiscCost) As imrLastMaterialCost, (imrAverageMaterialCost+imrAverageDutyCost+imrAverageFreightCost+imrAverageMiscCost) As imrAverageMaterialCost, (imrStandardMaterialCost+imrStandardDutyCost+imrStandardFreightCost+imrStandardMiscCost) As imrStandardMaterialCost, imrShortDescription from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("rmlPartID").Value))) + " and imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value))), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("rmlDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value nConv = rsParts.fields("imrConversionFactor").Value cPurUM = rsParts.Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value cInvUM = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value
Set rsRef = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsRef.Open "select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor from PartCrossReferences where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("rmlReceiptID").Fields("rmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value)) + " And imxLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("rmlReceiptID").Fields("rmpPurchaseLocationID").Value)),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRef.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nConv = CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) End If If Trim(rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) <> "" Then cPurUM = rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value End If Else rsRef.Close rsRef.Open "select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor from PartCrossReferences where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("rmlReceiptID").Fields("rmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value)) + " And imxLocationID = ''",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRef.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nConv = CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) End If If Trim(rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) <> "" Then cPurUM = rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value End If End If End If rsRef.Close Fields("rmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = cPurUM Fields("rmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = cInvUM If cdbl(nConv) = 0 Then nConv = 1 End If Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value = nConv
If cStr(App.Props("ProductionProperties").Fields("xapIMCostingMethod").Value) = "1" Then Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value ElseIf cStr(App.Props("ProductionProperties").Fields("xapIMCostingMethod").Value) = "2" Then Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value Else Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrStandardMaterialCost").Value End If End If rsParts.Close
Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsParts.Open "select impPhantomOrKitPart from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("rmlPartID").Value))), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then bKitPart = rsParts.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value End If rsParts.Close End If Fields("rmlKitPart").Value = bKitPart
End Function
Function rmlJobType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("rmlJobType").Value) <> 1 Then Fields("rmlJobMaterialID").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("rmlJobType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("rmlJobOperationID").Value = 0 End If call UpdateJobInvQty End Function
Function rmlJobMaterialID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, cPart, cRev, cWH, cBin, cDesc, bKit bKit = False Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "select jmmPartID,jmmPartRevisionID,jmmPartWarehouseLocationID,jmmPartBinID,jmmPartShortDescription,jmmKitPart from JobMaterials where jmmJobID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) & " and jmmJobAssemblyID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobAssemblyID").Value) & " and jmmJobMaterialID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobMaterialID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then cPart = rsTemp.Fields("jmmPartID").Value cRev = rsTemp.Fields("jmmPartRevisionID").Value cWH = rsTemp.Fields("jmmPartWarehouseLocationID").Value cBin = rsTemp.Fields("jmmPartBinID").Value cDesc = rsTemp.Fields("jmmPartShortDescription").Value bKit = rsTemp.Fields("jmmKitPart").Value end if Fields("rmlPartID").Value = cPart Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value = cRev Fields("rmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = cWH Fields("rmlPartBinID").Value = cBin Fields("rmlDescription").Value = cDesc Fields("rmlKitPart").Value = bKit Call RefreshJobQty End Function
Function rmlJobOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, cPart, cRev, cWH, cBin, cDesc, bKit bKit = False Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "select jmoPartID,jmoPartRevisionID from JobOperations where jmoJobID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) & " and jmoJobAssemblyID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobAssemblyID").Value) & " and jmoJobOperationID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobOperationID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then cPart = rsTemp.Fields("jmoPartID").Value cRev = rsTemp.Fields("jmoPartRevisionID").Value end if Fields("rmlPartID").Value = cPart Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value = cRev Call RefreshJobQty End Function
Sub RefreshJobQty Dim rsTemp, rsData, nOpenQty, nEstQty
nOpenQty = 0 nEstQty = 0 If CInt(Fields("rmlJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "select jmoOperationQuantity,jmoQuantityComplete,jmoProductionComplete from JobOperations where jmoJobID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) & " and jmoJobAssemblyID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobAssemblyID").Value) & " and jmoJobOperationID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobOperationID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then nEstQty = rsTemp.Fields("jmoOperationQuantity").Value If CBool(rsTemp.Fields("jmoProductionComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("jmoOperationQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("jmoQuantityComplete").Value) If nOpenQty < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If End If rsTemp.Close ElseIf CInt(Fields("rmlJobMaterialID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "select jmmPurchaseToJobQuantity,jmmQuantityReceived,jmmReceivedComplete,jmmPartShortDescription from JobMaterials where jmmJobID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) & " and jmmJobAssemblyID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobAssemblyID").Value) & " and jmmJobMaterialID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlJobMaterialID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then nEstQty = rsTemp.Fields("jmmPurchaseToJobQuantity").Value Fields("rmlDescription").Value = rsTemp.Fields("jmmPartShortDescription").Value If CBool(rsTemp.Fields("jmmReceivedComplete").Value = False) Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("jmmPurchaseToJobQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("jmmQuantityReceived").Value) If nOpenQty < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If End If rsTemp.Close End If Fields("rmlJobEstimatedQuantity").Value = nEstQty Fields("rmlJobOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty end sub
Function rmlPurchaseOrderLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RefreshPOInfo End Function
Sub RefreshPOInfo Dim rsPurchaseOrderlines, nOpenQty, nPurchaseQty, bLandedCost
nOpenQty = 0 nPurchaseQty = 0 bLandedCost = False If CInt(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsPurchaseOrderlines = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPurchaseOrderlines.Open "select pmpLandedCost,pmlReceivedComplete,pmlPurchaseQuantity,pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived,IsNull((Select Sum(rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived) From ReceiptLines Where rmlPurchaseOrderID = pmlPurchaseOrderID And rmlPurchaseOrderLineID = pmlPurchaseOrderLineID),0) As ReceivedQty from PurchaseOrderLines Inner Join PurchaseOrders On pmlPurchaseOrderID = pmpPurchaseOrderID where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) & " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsPurchaseOrderlines.EOF = False Then nPurchaseQty = CDbl(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) If CBool(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmpLandedCost").Value) = False Then If CBool(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmlReceivedComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) End If Else nOpenQty = CDbl(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) - CDbl(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("ReceivedQty").Value) End If If CDbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If rsPurchaseOrderlines.Close End If Fields("rmlPOPurchaseQuantity").Value = nPurchaseQty Fields("rmlPOOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty End Sub

Function rmlQuantityToInspect_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call UpdatePurchaseQty If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If Cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value) <> 0 Then If Cbool(Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value) = False Then bInUpdate = True Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value = True bInUpdate = False End If End If End If bCompCostUpdate = True End Function

Sub UpdatePurchaseQty Dim nValue If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nValue = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) + CDbl(Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value) + CDbl(Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value) + CDbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value)) * CDbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals) If nValue <> CDbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) Then Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value = nValue End If End If End if End Sub
Function rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived_ValueChanged(sender, e) call UpdateJobInvQty End Function
Function rmlConversionFactor_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value) = 0 Then Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value = 1 End if call UpdateJobInvQty End Function
Sub UpdateJobInvQty If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then bInUpdate = True If Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) <> "" Then If CInt(Fields("rmlJobType").Value) = 1 Then If Cbool(Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Else Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) End If Else If Cbool(Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Else Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value = 0 End If End If Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Else If Cbool(Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Else Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) End If End If bInUpdate = False End If End If
If Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value - Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").OriginalValue >= Fields("rmlPOOpenQuantity").Value Then If Fields("rmlPOReceivedComplete").Value = False Then Fields("rmlPOReceivedComplete").Value = True End If End If end sub
Function rmlPOReceivedComplete_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmlPOReceivedComplete").Value) = True Then If CDbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value = Fields("rmlPOOpenQuantity").Value End If End If End Function
Function rmlRequiresInspection_Valid(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("rmlReceiptID").Value) <> "" Then If CBool(Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then If Cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 then e.AddError "You must enter a quantity to inspect before continuing" + Chr(13) end if End If End If End Function
Function rmlJobMatQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) If cdbl(Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 And _ Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) <> "" And _ CInt(Fields("rmlJobType").Value) = 1 And _ cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 And _ cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then e.AddWarning "You have not entered a receipt quantity" + Chr(13) end if
Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If cdbl(Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 And CBool(parentBs.Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If
If cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("rmlJobType").Value) = 1 Then If (App.Round((cdbl(Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value) + cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value)), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) > App.Round((cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) / cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value)), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) And (cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) > 0) Then e.AddWarning "The receipt line has a greater job material quantity received than purchase quantity received." + Chr(13) End If End If End Function
Function rmlJobOprQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) If cdbl(Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 And _ Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) <> "" And _ CInt(Fields("rmlJobType").Value) = 2 And _ cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 And _ cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then e.AddWarning "You have not entered a receipt quantity" + Chr(13) end if
Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If cdbl(Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 And CBool(parentBs.Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If
If cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("rmlJobType").Value) = 2 Then If (App.Round((cdbl(Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value) + cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value)), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) > App.Round((cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) / cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value)), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) And (cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) > 0) Then e.AddWarning "The receipt line has a greater job operation quantity received than purchase quantity received." + Chr(13) End If End If End Function
Function rmlInventoryQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, bPORecComp If cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 And _ Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) = "" And _ cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 And _ cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then e.AddWarning "You have not entered a receipt quantity" + Chr(13) end if
Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 And CBool(parentBs.Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If
bPORecComp = False Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select pmlReceivedComplete From PurchaseOrderLines Where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText if rstemp.eof = false then bPORecComp = cbool(rstemp.fields("pmlReceivedComplete").Value) end if rstemp.close
If cbool(Fields("rmlPOReceivedComplete").Value) = True And cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) < cdbl(Fields("rmlPOOpenQuantity").Value) And CBool(parentBs.Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddWarning "The receipt line is marked as received complete with a quantity received that is less than the quantity on the order." + Chr(13) end if
If cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) = "" Then If (App.Round((CDbl(Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) + cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value)), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) > App.Round((cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) / cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value)), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) And (cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) > 0) Then e.AddWarning "The receipt line has a greater inventory quantity received than purchase quantity received." + Chr(13) End If End If End Function
