If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if If Trim(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" Then If cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 Then e.AddWarning "You have not entered a purchase quantity received" + Chr(13) end if End If End Function
Function rmlQuantityToInspect_Valid(sender, e) Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If cdbl(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value) < 0 And CBool(parentBs.Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function
Function rmlPurchaseOrderID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsPurchaseOrderlines, parentBs Set rsPurchaseOrderlines = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPurchaseOrderlines.Open "select pmpLandedCost From PurchaseOrders where pmpPurchaseOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsPurchaseOrderlines.EOF = False Then Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If CBool(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmpLandedCost").Value) <> CBool(parentBs.Fields("rmpLandedCost").Value) Then If CBool(rsPurchaseOrderlines.Fields("pmpLandedCost").Value) = True Then e.AddError "The purchase order you have selected is marked as a landed cost" + Chr(13) Else e.AddError "The purchase order you have selected is not marked as a landed cost" + Chr(13) end if end if end if rsPurchaseOrderlines.close End Function
Function rmlRequiresInspection_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If Cbool(Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then If CDbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then bInUpdate = True Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("rmlPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("rmlConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Fields("rmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlJobMatQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmlJobOprQuantityReceived").Value = 0 bInUpdate = False End If Else Dim rsInspection Set rsInspection = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsInspection.Open "Select qalInspectionID, qalInspectionLineID From InspectionLines Where qalSourceTableUniqueID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("rmlUniqueID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsInspection.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "This Receipt Line is currently in inspection on Inspection ID " & rsInspection.Fields("qalInspectionID").Value & " - " & rsInspection.Fields("qalInspectionLineID").Value & chr(13) bInUpdate = True Fields("rmlRequiresInspection").Value = True bInUpdate = False Else Fields("rmlQuantityToInspect").Value = 0 End If Set rsInspection = nothing End If End If End Function
Private Function GetMaxDate(dDate1, dDate2) Dim dReturn dReturn = Null If IsNull(dDate1) Then dReturn = dDate2 ElseIf IsNull(dDate2) Then dReturn = dDate1 Else If dDate1 > dDate2 Then dReturn = dDate1 Else dReturn = dDate2 End If End If GetMaxDate = dReturn End Function
Function rmlTotalComponentCosts_ValueChanged(sender, e) bCompCostUpdate = True End Function
Function rmlInventoryUnitCost_ValueChanged(sender, e) bCompCostUpdate = True End Function
Function rmlSetupCharge_ValueChanged(sender, e) bCompCostUpdate = True End Function
Function ReceiptLines_CurrentChanged(sender, e) bCompCostUpdate = True dim preVal, parentBs If CInt(Fields("rmlKitPart"))=True And Cdbl(Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value)<>0 then 'this is to trigger the UnitCost_Valid event from Currentchange. At present UnitCost_Valid event fires before Currentchange. 'So, it does not run validate code because bInExtCostUpdate =false preVal=Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If Not IsCreatingReceiptFromPO(parentBs) Then Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value=preVal+1 End If Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value=preVal end if End Function
Function rmlInventoryUnitCost_Valid(sender, e) Dim msgError If CBool(bCompCostUpdate) = True And Cbool(Fields("rmlKitPart")) = True And Cdbl(Fields("rmlExtendedCostForeign").Value) <> 0 then dim totalCosts, lineCompCosts totalCosts = App.Ax("Receipt").GetTotalComponentsCost(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.Row) lineCompCosts = cdbl(fields("rmlTotalComponentCosts").value) If App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("rmlExtendedCostForeign").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) <> App.Round(Cdbl(totalCosts), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) then msgError = "The total kit component costs do not equal the kit part extended cost. To make them equal, change the unit cost on the kit or on the components." bCompCostUpdate = false If cbool(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) = True Then e.AddError msgError Else e.AddWarning msgError End if End if End if End Function
Function ReceiptLines_RemoveStarted(sender, e) bCompCostUpdate = True End Function
Function rmlPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("rmlPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("rmlPartID").Value, Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("rmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("rmlPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then Dim parentBs, poLinetype Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) poLinetype = App.Ax("PO").GetPurchaseOrderLineType(Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderID").Value, Fields("rmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value, e.SqlTransaction) if Trim(Fields("rmlJobID").Value) = "" and poLinetype <> 4 and CInt(Fields("rmlPostedToGL").Value) = 0 And not parentBs.Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value then e.AddError "Part ID '"&Fields("rmlPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("rmlPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse ID '"&Fields("rmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin ID '"&Fields("rmlPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive." end if End If End If End Function
Private Function IsCreatingReceiptFromPO(parentBs) IsCreatingReceiptFromPO = False If Trim(Fields("rmlReference").Value) <> "" And parentBs.Fields("rmpLandedCost").Value And Trim(parentBs.Fields("rmpLandedCostID").Value) = "" Then IsCreatingReceiptFromPO = True End if End Function

Function PartOrgReferences_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText,rsTemp cText = "" If Trim(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("imzOrgPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select imzPartID,imzPartRevisionID,imzOrganizationID,imzOrgPartID From PartOrgReferences Where imzOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value)) + " And imzOrgPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imzOrgPartID").Value)) + " And Not (imzPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartID").Value) + " And imzPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value) + ")",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False cText = cText + "Org Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("imzOrgPartID").Value) + "' already exists for organization '" + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value) + "' on part '" + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imzPartID").Value) + "' rev '" + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value) + "'" + Chr(13) rsTemp.MoveNext Loop End If rsTemp.Close End If e.AddError cText End Function
Function PartOrgReferences_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) ' Copy data in duplicate fields to PartCrossReferences table Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT * FROM PartCrossReferences WHERE imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value) + " AND imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value) + " And imxLocationID = ''",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then 'msgbox "Updating" Else 'msgbox "Adding" oRs.AddNew App.BlankRecord oRs End If Call App.CopyMatchingFields(Fields,oRs) oRs.Fields("imxLocationID").Value = "" oRs.UpdateBatch oRs.Close
Connection.Execute "Update PartRevisions Set " & _ "imrPreferredRefExists = 1, " & _ "imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) & ", " & _ "imrConversionFactor = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imzConversionFactor").Value) & _ "Where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartID").Value) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value) & " And imrSupplierOrganizationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value) & " And imrPurchaseLocationID = '' " End Function
Function PartOrgReferences_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE PartPriceBreaks FROM PartPriceBreaks Inner Join PartPrices On imiPartPriceID = imjPartPriceID WHERE imiPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartID").Value) + " And imiPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imiOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartPrices WHERE imiPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartID").Value) + " And imiPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imiOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value)
Connection.Execute "Update PartRevisions Set " & _ "imrPreferredRefExists = 0 " & _ "Where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartID").Value) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value) & " And imrSupplierOrganizationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value) & " And imrPurchaseLocationID = '' " End Function
Function imzOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT cmoOrganizationID FROM Organizations WHERE cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = True Then msgbox "'" + Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value + "' does not exist in the Organizations table", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Close") e.Cancel = True End if oRs.Close
Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select cmoCustomerStatus,cmoSupplierStatus from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imzOrganizationID").Value)),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsData.Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 1 Or CInt(rsData.Fields("cmoCustomerStatus").Value) = 2 Then Fields("imzSold").Value = True End If If CInt(rsData.Fields("cmoSupplierStatus").Value) = 1 Or CInt(rsData.Fields("cmoSupplierStatus").Value) = 2 Then Fields("imzPurchased").Value = True End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function PartOrgReferences_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "SELECT imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imrConversionFactor FROM PartRevisions WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imzPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("imzPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsData.Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imzConversionFactor").Value = rsData.Fields("imrConversionFactor").Value Else MsgBox "not found" End If rsData.Close End Function

Function GLDepartments_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Dim nCount nCount = 0 Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select count(*) as rec_count from GLJournalLines Inner Join GLAccounts on gllGLAccountID=glaGLAccountID where glaGLDepartmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("gldGLDepartmentID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("rec_count").Value) = False Then nCount = rsTemp.Fields("rec_count").Value End If End If rsTemp.Close If nCount > 0 Then GLDepartments_DeleteStarted = "Department " + Trim(Fields("gldGLDepartmentID").Value) + " is referenced on " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(nCount)) + " GL Journal Lines" End If End Function
Function gldGLDepartmentID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("gldGLDepartmentID").Value) <> "" And Len(Trim(Fields("gldGLDepartmentID").Value)) <> 3 Then Fields("gldGLDepartmentID").Value = Right("000" + Trim(Fields("gldGLDepartmentID").Value),3) End If End Function

Function STPSessions_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE PayrollSessions SET pasTransferredToSTP = 0, pasSTPSessionID = 0 Where pasTransferredToSTP <> 0 And pasSTPSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("stpSessionID").Value) End Function
Function STPLinesCount() Dim childBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("STPLines") If childBs.Count > 0 Then STPLinesCount = true Else STPLinesCount = false End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function
Function stpPayerDeclaration_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("stpPayerDeclaration").Value) = True Then Fields("stpDeclarationDate").Value = Fields("stpPayUpdateDate").Value Else Fields("stpDeclarationDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function stpTaxYear_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim stpTaxYear, actualDate, payUpdateDate, isDateBetweenSessionDates
stpTaxYear = CInt(Fields("stpTaxYear").Value)
If stpTaxYear <> "" AND stpTaxYear <> 0 Then actualDate = Now() payUpdateDate = App.Ax("Payroll").GetMaxStpSessionDate(stpTaxYear)
isDateBetweenSessionDates = App.Ax("Payroll").IsDateBetweenStpSessionDates(stpTaxYear, actualDate)
If isDateBetweenSessionDates = True Then payUpdateDate = actualDate End If
Fields("stpPayUpdateDate").Value = payUpdateDate End If End Function
Function IsLastSessionSubmitted(currentSessionID) Dim recordSet, isSessionSubmitted, lastSessionSubmittedQuery
isSessionSubmitted = false lastSessionSubmittedQuery = "SELECT TOP 1 stpSessionID FROM STPSessions WHERE stpSTPSubmitted = 1 ORDER BY stpSTPSubmittedDate DESC"
Set recordSet = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") recordSet.Open lastSessionSubmittedQuery,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If recordSet.EOF = false Then Dim lastSessionId
lastSessionId = recordSet.Fields("stpSessionID").Value
If lastSessionId = currentSessionID Then isSessionSubmitted = true End If End If
recordSet.Close
IsLastSessionSubmitted = isSessionSubmitted End Function
Function hcpTestScenario_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("hcpTestScenario").Value) = False Then Fields("hcpTestScenario").Value = 0 End If End Function

Function QuantityAdjustments_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) e.FocusField = "inqPartID" End Function
Function inqPosted_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("inqPosted").Value Then Fields("inqPostedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("inqPostedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Sub RefreshQuantities Dim nCounted, cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, cDestBin Dim dDateCounted, rsTrans, rsTemp, cWhere, nQOH, bFound
Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") cPartID = Trim(Fields("inqPartID").Value) cRevisionID = Trim(Fields("inqPartRevisionID").Value) cWareHouse = Trim(Fields("inqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("inqPartBinID").Value) cDestBin = Trim(Fields("inqDestinationPartBinID").Value) dDateCounted = Fields("inqAdjustmentDate").Value nQOH = 0 nCounted = 0 nQtySinceDate = 0
If cPartID <> "" Then rsTemp.Open "select imbQuantityOnHand,imbQuantityToInspect,imbQuantityToReturn from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " And imbWarehouseID = " & App.Convert.StringToSQL(cWareHouse) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cBin), Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Select Case CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) Case 1,2 nQOH = rsTemp.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value End Select bFound = True End If rsTemp.Close If CBool(bFound) = False And cBin = "" Then rsTemp.Open "select imrQuantityOnHand,imrQuantityToInspect,imrQuantityToReturn from PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID), Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Select Case CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) Case 1,2 nQOH = rsTemp.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value End Select End If rsTemp.Close End If End If
If CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 1 Then If cPartID <> "" And IsNull(dDateCounted) = False Then cWhere = "imtPartID=" + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) cWhere = cWhere + " And imtPartRevisionID=" + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) cWhere = cWhere + " And imtPartWarehouseLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cWareHouse) cWhere = cWhere + " And imtPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cBin) cWhere = cWhere + " And imtTransactionDate > " + App.Convert.DateTimeToSQL(dDateCounted) cWhere = cWhere + " And imtNonInventoryTransaction = 0"
Set rsTrans = createobject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTrans.Open "select count(*) as TransCount, sum(imtInventoryQuantityReceived) as InvTrans From PartTransactions where " + cWhere, Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTrans.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTrans.Fields("TransCount").Value) = False Then nCounted = rsTrans.Fields("TransCount").Value End If If IsNull(rsTrans.Fields("InvTrans").Value) = False Then nQtySinceDate = rsTrans.Fields("InvTrans").Value End If End If rsTrans.Close Set rsTrans = Nothing End If
Fields("inqDestinationWarehouseID").Value = Fields("inqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value Fields("inqDestinationPartBinID").Value = Fields("inqPartBinID").Value Fields("inqBinQuantityTransferred").Value = 0 Else If CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 2 Then Fields("inqCountedQuantity").Value = 0 End If End If
Fields("inqCurrentQuantity").Value = nQOH Fields("inqQuantitySince").Value = nQtySinceDate Fields("inqTransactionsSince").Value = nCounted Call UpdateChangeQuantity(cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, dDateCounted) End sub
Sub UpdateChangeQuantity(cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, dDateCounted) Dim rsTemp, nQtyChangeAmount, nQtyCounted, nCurrentBinQty
If CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 1 Then Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") ' Determines the quantity change amount rsTemp.Open "SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN imtSource = 7 THEN imtInventoryQuantityReceived ELSE imtPreviousQuantityOnHand END AS imtPreviousQuantityOnHand FROM PartTransactions " _ & " WHERE imtPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " AND imtPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " AND imtPartWarehouseLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cWareHouse) + " AND imtPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cBin) + " AND imtTransactionDate > " + App.Convert.DateTimeToSQL(dDateCounted) _ & " ORDER BY imtTransactionDate ASC", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText
If rsTemp.EOF = False Then nCurrentBinQty = Cdbl(rsTemp.Fields("imtPreviousQuantityOnHand").Value) Else nCurrentBinQty = Cdbl(Fields("inqCurrentQuantity").Value) End If rsTemp.Close Set rsTemp = Nothing Fields("inqChangeQuantity").Value = Cdbl(Fields("inqCountedQuantity").Value) - Cdbl(nCurrentBinQty) Else Fields("inqChangeQuantity").Value = 0 End If End sub
Function inqCountedQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RefreshQuantities End Function
Function inqAdjustmentType_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RefreshQuantities End Function
Function inqAdjustmentDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RefreshQuantities End Function
Function inqPartBinID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RefreshQuantities End Function
Function inqDestinationPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 2 and Cbool(Fields("inqPosted").Value) = False Then Dim cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, cDestWareHouse, cDestBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("inqPartID").Value) cRevisionID = Trim(Fields("inqPartRevisionID").Value) cWareHouse = Trim(Fields("inqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cDestWareHouse = Trim(Fields("inqDestinationWarehouseID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("inqPartBinID").Value) cDestBin = Trim(Fields("inqDestinationPartBinID").Value) If cPartID <> "" And cDestBin <> "" then If cWareHouse = cDestWareHouse And cBin = cDestBin then e.AddError "The source wh/bin and destination wh/bin cannot be the same." End If If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinValid(cPartID, cRevisionID, cDestWareHouse, cDestBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = False Then e.AddError "The selected destination bin is invalid for Part/Rev." End If IF CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cRevisionID, cDestWareHouse, cDestBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cRevisionID + "', Destination Warehouse '" + cDestWareHouse + "', Destination Bin '" + cDestBin + "' is inactive." End If End If End If End Function
Function inqBinQuantityTransferred_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inqPosted").Value) = False And CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 2 Then If Cdbl(Fields("inqBinQuantityTransferred").Value) < 0 then e.AddError "Bin quantity transferred cannot be less than 0." End If End If End Function
Function inqCountedQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inqPosted").Value) = False And CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 1 Then Dim allowNegativeQtyOnHand, lot, serial, cPartID allowNegativeQtyOnHand = CBool(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand")) If Cdbl(Fields("inqCountedQuantity").Value) < 0 Then If allowNegativeQtyOnHand = True Then cPartID = Trim(Fields("inqPartID").Value) lot=CBool(App.Ax("LotNumbers").IsLotTracked(cPartID)) serial=CBool(App.Ax("SerialNumbers").IsSerialTracked(cPartID)) If serial Or lot Then e.AddError "Qty Counted CAN NOT be negative for a Serial/Lot Tracked Part." End If Else e.AddError "Qty Counted CAN NOT be negative." End If End If End If End Function
Function inqNewQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inqPosted").Value) = False And CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 1 Then Dim allowNegativeQtyOnHand allowNegativeQtyOnHand = CBool(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand")) If allowNegativeQtyOnHand = False And Cdbl(Fields("inqNewQuantity").Value) < 0 then e.AddError "New quantity cannot be less than 0 as this would result in negative quantity on hand." End If End If End Function
Function inqPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inqPosted").Value) = True Then Exit Function End If Dim cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("inqPartID").Value) cRevisionID = Trim(Fields("inqPartRevisionID").Value) cWareHouse = Trim(Fields("inqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("inqPartBinID").Value) If cPartID <> "" And CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinValid(cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = False Then e.AddError "The selected source bin is invalid for Part/Rev." End If ' Qty Adjustment If CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 1 Then If CBool(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand")) And Cdbl(Fields("inqCountedQuantity").Value) < 0 Then IF CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Quantity Counted cannot be negative when the bin location is inactive." End If End If End If ' Bin Transfer If CInt(Fields("inqAdjustmentType").Value) = 2 Then IF CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cRevisionID, cWareHouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cRevisionID + "', Source Warehouse '" + cWareHouse + "', Source Bin '" + cBin + "' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." End If End If End Function
Function inqPartWarehouseLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp set rstemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select imwPlantID From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("inqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText if rsTemp.EOF = false Then Fields("inqPlantID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("imwPlantID").Value else If Trim(Fields("inqPlantID").Value) <> "" then Fields("inqPlantID").Value = "" End If End If End Function
Function QuantityAdjustments_CurrentChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inqPosted").Value) = false And Trim(Fields("inqQuantityAdjustmentID").Value) <> "" then Call RefreshQuantities End If End Function
Function inqAdjustmentDate_Valid(sender, e) If DateAdd("n", -5, Fields("inqAdjustmentDate").Value) > Now Then e.AddError "Adjustment date cannot be greater than today's date." End If End Function
Function inqPartID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID cPartID = Trim(Fields("inqPartID").Value) set rsPart = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPart.Open "select impNonStockedItem from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPart.EOF = false then If cbool(rsPart.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = True Then e.AddError "This part is marked as a non-stocked item, therefore cannot have its quantity changed." End If End If End Function

Dim inUpdate
Function xafDisableMultiplePlants_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("xafDisableMultiplePlants").Value) = True And CInt(Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) = True Then Fields("xafCOGSUseAccounts").value = 1 End If End Function
Function xafCOGSUseAccounts_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("xafCOGSUseAccounts").Value) = 2 Or CInt(Fields("xafCOGSUseAccounts").Value) = 3 Then If CInt(Fields("xafDisableMultiplePlants").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "You cannot select this option when Multi-Plant is set to disabled." Fields("xafCOGSUseAccounts").value = 1 End If End If End Function
Function xafGLCreateStockJournals_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(inUpdate) = True Then Exit Function End if
If CBool(Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) = True then If CBool(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand").Value) = True Then Call msgbox("COGS Journals CAN NOT be enabled when Negative Quantity on Hand is enabled for Inventory.", vbExclamation + vbokonly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm")) inUpdate = True Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value = Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").OriginalValue inUpdate = False Exit function End if If msgbox("This will enable COGS and create production journals upon posting of inventory transactions. Do you want to continue?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm")) = vbNo Then inUpdate = True Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value = Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").OriginalValue inUpdate = False Exit function End if Else If msgbox("This will disable COGS and no future production journals will be created. Do you want to continue?", vbExclamation + vbYesNo, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm")) = vbNo Then inUpdate = True Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value = Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").OriginalValue inUpdate = False Exit function End if End if
If CInt(Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) = False Then Fields("xafCOGSUseAccounts").value = 0 Else Fields("xafAPIncludeTaxInExpAmt").Value = 0 Fields("xafPartsMustExist").value = True End If
' Record the history of enable/disable for 'create stock journals' Set tableRecordSet = Record.Table.BindingSource.GetRecordset() originalValue = IIf(CBool(Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").OriginalValue) = True, "Enabled", "Disabled") newValue = IIf(CBool(Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) = True, "Enabled", "Disabled") updateRecord = "" If tableRecordSet.RecordCount = 1 Then updateRecord = now & "," & app.UserID & "," & originalValue & "," & newValue Fields("xafCOGSStatusHistory").Value = Fields("xafCOGSStatusHistory").Value & chr(13) & updateRecord End If End Function
Function xafAvalaraDisableAddrValidate_ValueChanged(sender, e) if CInt(Fields("xafAvalaraDisableAddrValidate").Value) = true then Fields("xafAvalaraForceAddressValidate").Value = false end if End Function
Function IIf(blnExpression, vTrueResult, vFalseResult) If blnExpression Then IIf = vTrueResult Else IIf = vFalseResult End If End Function

Function arsDepositAmount_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice Dim nRate If App.UpdatingCost = False Then 'nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("arsDepositAmount").Value),"ARPaymentSessions",Fields("arsARPaymentSessionID").Value,"BASE",2) nRate = CDbl(Fields("arsExchangeRate").Value) If nRate = 0 Then nRate = 1 End If nPrice = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("arsDepositAmount").Value) * CDbl(nRate)),2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("arsDepositAmountForeign").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("arsDepositAmountForeign").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If End Function
Function arsReceiptDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("arsReceiptDate").Value) = False Then Dim nYear,nPeriod If App.Ax("GLFunctions").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("arsReceiptDate").Value,"AR",nYear,nPeriod,False,True,Fields("arsReceiptDate")) = True Then Fields("arsGLFiscalYearID").Value = nYear Fields("arsGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value = nPeriod End If End If End Function
Function arsPlantDepartmentID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("ARFunctions").SetARPaymentAccounts(Fields,True) End Function
Function arsBankAccountID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If App.UpdatingCost = False Then If Trim(Fields("arsPlantID").Value) <> "" Then Call App.Ax("ARFunctions").SetARPaymentAccounts(Fields, True, True) Else Call App.Ax("ARFunctions").SetARPaymentAccounts(Fields, False, True) End If End If End Function
Function arsDepositAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice Dim nRate If App.UpdatingCost = False Then 'nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("arsDepositAmountForeign").Value),"ARPaymentSessions",Fields("arsARPaymentSessionID").Value,"FOREIGN",2) nRate = CDbl(Fields("arsExchangeRate").Value) If nRate = 0 Then nRate = 1 End If nPrice = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("arsDepositAmountForeign").Value) / CDbl(nRate)),2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("arsDepositAmount").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("arsDepositAmount").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If End Function
Function arsCustomRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("arsCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("arsExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("arsCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("arsReceiptDate").Value) End If End Function
Function arsCurrencyRateID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("arsCurrencyRateID").Value) = "" Then Fields("arsCustomRate").Value = False Fields("arsExchangeRate").Value = 1 Else Fields("arsCustomRate").Value = False Fields("arsExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("arsCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("arsReceiptDate").Value) End If Call App.Ax("ARFunctions").SetARPaymentAccounts(Fields, False, False, True) End Function
Function arsPlantID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("ARFunctions").SetARPaymentAccounts(Fields,True) End Function
Function arsBankAccountID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup If Trim(Fields("arsBankAccountID").Value) = "" Then Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select Count(*) as HeaderCount From ARPaymentHeaders Where artARPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("arsARPaymentSessionID").Value) & " And (artReceiptType = 1 Or artReceiptType = 4 Or artReceiptType = 6) ", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If rsLookup.Fields("HeaderCount").Value > 0 Then Call e.AddError("Bank Account cannot be set to none when there are payment headers with receipt type of Payment, Miscellaneous or AP Invoice Offset.") End If End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function ARPaymentSessions_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim rsARPaymentHeaders Dim rsVoidARPaymentHeaders
Set rsARPaymentHeaders = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsVoidARPaymentHeaders = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsARPaymentHeaders.Open "Select artReceiptType,artVoidARPaymentSessionID,artVoidARPaymentHeaderID from ARPaymentHeaders where artARPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("arsARPaymentSessionID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsARPaymentHeaders.EOF = False Then rsARPaymentHeaders.MoveFirst While rsARPaymentHeaders.EOF = False If CInt(rsARPaymentHeaders.Fields("artReceiptType").Value) = 5 Then rsVoidARPaymentHeaders.Open "Select artARPaymentSessionID,artARPaymentHeaderID from ARPaymentHeaders where artARPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsARPaymentHeaders.Fields("artVoidARPaymentSessionID").Value) & " and artARPaymentHeaderID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsARPaymentHeaders.Fields("artVoidARPaymentHeaderID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsVoidARPaymentHeaders.EOF = False Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE ARPaymentHeaders SET artVoidedPayment = 0 WHERE artARPaymentSessionID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsVoidARPaymentHeaders.Fields("artARPaymentSessionID").Value) & " and artARPaymentHeaderID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsVoidARPaymentHeaders.Fields("artARPaymentHeaderID").Value) End If rsVoidARPaymentHeaders.Close End If rsARPaymentHeaders.MoveNext Wend End If rsARPaymentHeaders.Close End Function

Function OrganizationLocSalesPeople_RemoveStarted(sender, e) call ValidateSalesPeoplePercent End Function
Function OrganizationLocSalesPeople_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) call ValidateSalesPeoplePercent End Function
sub ValidateSalesPeoplePercent() Dim tableRecordSet percentTotal = 0 Set tableRecordSet = Record.Table.BindingSource.GetRecordset() If tableRecordSet.RecordCount = 1 Then percentTotal = 100 tableRecordSet.Fields("cmkPercent").Value = percentTotal End If tableRecordSet.Close End sub

Function StateUITaxYears_GetNextID(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, nLastYearID nLastYearID = 0 Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT TOP 1 puyStateUITaxYearID FROM StateUITaxYears ORDER BY puyStateUITaxYearID DESC", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("puyStateUITaxYearID").Value) = False Then nLastYearID = rsTemp.Fields("puyStateUITaxYearID").Value End If End If rsTemp.Close
If CInt(nLastYearID) = 0 Then nLastYearID = Year(Date) End If
If CBool(App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("MP")) = True Then If msgbox("Do you want to increment to the next State UI Year to " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nLastYearID + 1)) + "? ", vbExclamation + vbYesNo, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Close")) = vbNo Then e.Value = nLastYearID Else e.Value = nLastYearID + 1 End If Else e.Value = nLastYearID + 1 End If End Function

Function Parts_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If (CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) <> CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").OriginalValue)) Or (CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").Value) <> CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").OriginalValue)) Then If (CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) = -1) Or (CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").Value) = -1) Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartMaterials Set immBackflush = 0, immRelatedPartOperationID = 0 WHERE immBackflush = 1 AND immPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE QuoteMaterials Set qmmBackflush = 0, qmmRelatedQuoteOperationID = 0 WHERE qmmBackflush = 1 AND qmmPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobMaterials Set jmmBackflush = 0, jmmRelatedJobOperationID = 0 WHERE jmmBackflush = 1 AND jmmPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) End If End If End Function
Function Parts_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartWarehouseLocations WHERE imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartBins WHERE imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartTransactionCosts WHERE intPartTransactionID In (Select imtPartTransactionID From PartTransactions Where imtPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) + ")" Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartTransactions WHERE imtPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartUnitSalePrices WHERE imhPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value)
Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartAlternates WHERE imePartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartAlternates WHERE imeAlternatePartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value)
Connection.Execute "DELETE PartPriceBreaks FROM PartPriceBreaks Inner Join PartPrices On imiPartPriceID = imjPartPriceID WHERE imiPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartPrices WHERE imiPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value)
Connection.Execute "DELETE FormDefinitions FROM FormDefinitions INNER JOIN PartRevisions On xaoFormID = imrFormID WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues FROM FormInputValues INNER JOIN PartRevisions On xaiFormID = imrFormID WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) End Function
Function impTrackLotNumbers_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").Value) = True And Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").OriginalValue) <> True Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) + " And imrQuantityOnHand <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "The track lot numbers option may not be selected because " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " revision(s) currently have a quantity on hand" End If rsData.Close End If If CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").Value) = False And Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").OriginalValue) <> False Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) + " And imrQuantityOnHand <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "The track lot numbers option may not be unselected because " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " revision(s) currently have a quantity on hand" End If rsData.Close End If If CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").Value) = True And Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").OriginalValue) <> True Then If CBool(Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "The track lot numbers option may not be selected because the part is marked as a phantom or kit part" End If End If End Function
Function impNonStockedItem_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = True Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value)) + " And imrQuantityOnHand <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "The non-stocked flag may not be checked because " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " revision(s) currently have a quantity on hand" End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function impPhantomOrKitPart_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value) = True Then If CBool(Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").Value) = True Or CBool(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "The phantom or kit part option may not be selected because the part is marked as lot/serial tracked" Else Fields("impDeliveryType").Value = 4 If Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value)) + " And imrQuantityOnHand <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = True Then Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value = True End If rsData.Close Else Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value = True End If End If End If End Function
Function impInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("impInactive").Value) = True Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) + " And imrQuantityOnHand <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "The inactive flag may not be checked because " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " revision(s) currently have a quantity on hand" Else Fields("impInactiveDate").Value = Date End If rsData.Close Else Fields("impInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function impTrackSerialNumbers_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) = True And Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").OriginalValue) <> True Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) + " And imrQuantityOnHand <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "The track serial numbers option may not be selected because " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " revision(s) currently have a quantity on hand" End If rsData.Close End If If CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) = False And Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").OriginalValue) <> False Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("impPartID").Value) + " And imrQuantityOnHand <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "The track serial numbers option may not be unselected because " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " revision(s) currently have a quantity on hand" End If rsData.Close End If If CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) = True And Trim(Fields("impPartID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").OriginalValue) <> True Then If CBool(Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "The track serial numbers option may not be selected because the part is marked as a phantom or kit part" End If End If End Function Function impPartClassID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) = True Then Dim rsTemp, cPartID cPartID = Trim(Fields("impPartID")) set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " and imlQuantityInTransit > 0 ", connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = false then e.Cancel = "You cannot change the part class while there is in-transit quantity for this part" end if rsTemp.close set rsTemp = nothing End if End Function

Function PartClasses_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open"SELECT wgwWebConfigPriceRule, wgwWebConfigMode FROM WebGearProperties",connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then fields("imcWebConfigPriceRule").value = oRs.Fields("wgwWebConfigPriceRule").value fields("imcWebConfigMode").value = oRs.Fields("wgwWebConfigMode").value End If oRs.close End Function
Function PartClasses_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT * FROM PartClassPlants WHERE imfPartClassID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imcPartClassID").Value) + " And imfPartClassPlantID = '' ", Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = True Then oRs.AddNew App.BlankRecord oRs End If Call App.CopyMatchingFields(Fields,oRs) oRs.Fields("imfPartClassID").Value = Fields("imcPartClassID").Value oRs.Fields("imfPartClassPlantID").Value = "" oRs.UpdateBatch oRs.Close End Function

Function cmaARInvoiceID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("cmaARInvoiceID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select arpCustomerOrganizationID,arpARInvoiceLocationID,arpARInvoiceContactID,arpProjectID From ARInvoices Where arpARInvoiceID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmaARInvoiceID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("cmaOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value Fields("cmaLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value Fields("cmaContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("arpARInvoiceContactID").Value Call CheckProject(rsData.Fields("arpProjectID").Value) End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Sub CheckProject(projectID) If Trim(projectID) <> "" Then Fields("cmaProjectID").Value = projectID End If End Sub
Function cmaFileLocation_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("cmaFileLocation").Value) = "" Then Fields("cmaFilename").Value = "" Else Dim nPos,cFile,cLocation cFile = "" cLocation = Trim(Fields("cmaFileLocation").Value) nPos = InstrRev(cLocation,"\") If nPos > 0 Then cFile = Mid(cLocation,nPos+1) End If Fields("cmaFilename").Value = cFile
'Dim fso 'Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") 'If fso.FileExists(cLocation) = False And fso.FolderExists(cLocation) = False Then ' e.Cancel = "File " + cLocation + " does not exist." 'End If End If End Function

Function paxTaxAuthority_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("paxTaxAuthority").Value) = 1 Then Fields("paxState").Value = "" End If End Function

Function Warehouses_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsTemp,cText If CInt(Fields("imwDefaultWarehouse").Value) = True Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select imwWarehouseID From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID <> " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value) + " And imwPlantID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imwPlantID").Value)) + " And imwPlantDepartmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imwPlantDepartmentID").Value)) + " And imwDefaultWarehouse = 1",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value) + " cannot be marked as default because warehouse " + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value) + " is marked as default" & chr(13) End If rsTemp.Close End If ' Check to see if any quantity in warehouses before unchecking If CInt(Fields("imwNonNettable").Value) <> CInt(Fields("imwNonNettable").OriginalValue) Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If CInt(Fields("imwNonNettable").Value) = 0 Then rsTemp.Open "Select Isnull(sum(imbQuantityOnHand),0) As imbQuantityOnHand From PartBins Inner Join PartWarehouseLocations On imbPartID=imlPartID And imbPartRevisionID=imlPartRevisionID And imbWarehouseID=imlPartWarehouseID Where imbWarehouseID= " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value)) & " And imlNonNettable = 1",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If Not rsTemp.EOF Then If CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) <> 0 Then e.AddError Warehouses_Valid & Trim(Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value) + " cannot be unmarked as non-nettable as it has parts with non-zero quantity on hand" & chr(13) End If End If rsTemp.Close Else rsTemp.Open "Select Isnull(sum(imbQuantityOnHand),0) As imbQuantityOnHand From PartBins Inner Join PartWarehouseLocations On imbPartID=imlPartID And imbPartRevisionID=imlPartRevisionID And imbWarehouseID=imlPartWarehouseID Where imbWarehouseID= " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value)) & " And imlNonNettable = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If Not rsTemp.EOF Then If CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) <> 0 Then e.AddError Warehouses_Valid & Trim(Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value) + " cannot be marked as non-nettable as it has parts with non-zero quantity on hand" & chr(13) End If End If rsTemp.Close End If End If End Function
Function Warehouses_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If App.Props("DS").Fields("xadEnableNonNettable").Value = True Then If CInt(Fields("imwNonNettable").Value) <> CInt(Fields("imwNonNettable").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartWarehouseLocations SET imlNonNettable = " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(CInt(Fields("imwNonNettable").Value))) + " WHERE imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imwWarehouseID").Value)) End If End If End Function
Function imwInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("imwInactive").Value) = True Then Fields("imwInactiveDate").Value = Date Fields("imwDefaultWarehouse").Value = False Call App.Ax("Warehouses").InactivateWarehouseBins(Record.Table.BindingSource) Else Fields("imwInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function imwNonNettable_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("imwNonNettable").Value) = False Then Fields("imwNonNettableType").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function imwDefaultBinCount_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("imwInactive").Value) = False Then If CInt(Fields("imwDefaultBinCount").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Default bin should be selected" & chr(13) End If End If End Function

Function ARInvoices_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("arpPostedToGL").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("AR").ARInvoicePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If End Function
Function ARInvoices_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("arpPostedToGL").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("AR").ARInvoicePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If
Connection.Execute "UPDATE RMAClaimLines SET ralInvoicedComplete = 0 FROM RMAClaimLines INNER JOIN ARInvoiceLines ON ralRMAClaimID = arlRMAClaimID AND ralRMAClaimLineID = arlRMAClaimLineID WHERE arlARInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value) + " AND arlRMAClaimID <> '' AND arlRMAClaimLineID <> ''" Connection.Execute "UPDATE ShipmentLines SET smlInvoicedComplete = 0 FROM ShipmentLines INNER JOIN ARInvoiceLines On smlShipmentID = arlShipmentID And smlShipmentLineID = arlShipmentLineID WHERE arlARInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value) + " AND arlShipmentID <> '' And ((arlInvoiceQuantity < 0 And (smlQuantityShipped+smlJobQuantityShipped) < 0) Or (arlInvoiceQuantity >= 0 And (smlQuantityShipped+smlJobQuantityShipped) >= 0))" Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderLines SET omlDepositCreated = 0 FROM SalesOrderLines INNER JOIN ARInvoiceLines ON omlSalesOrderID = arlSalesOrderID and omlSalesOrderLineID = arlSalesOrderLineID INNER JOIN ARInvoices ON arlARInvoiceID = arpARInvoiceID WHERE arlARInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value) + " AND arpInvoiceType = 3" Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderLines SET omlDepositCredited = 0, omlDepositCreated = 1 FROM SalesOrderLines INNER JOIN ARInvoiceLines ON omlSalesOrderID = arlSalesOrderID and omlSalesOrderLineID = arlSalesOrderLineID INNER Join ARInvoices ON arlArInvoiceID = arpARInvoiceID WHERE arlARInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value) + " And arpInvoiceType = 2 and arlSalesOrderDeliveryID = 0"
' Cancel Tax For Avalara Dim cReturnMsg cReturnMsg = "" If App.Ax("Financial").AvalaraActivated Then cReturnMsg = Trim(App.Ax("AvalaraTax").CancelTax(Record.Table.BindingSource, "ARInvoices", Fields("arpARInvoiceID").Value)) end if if cReturnMsg <> "" then e.AddError cReturnMsg end if
End Function
Function RecalculateSalesCommissionAmounts() Dim childBs, rsSales, row Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("ARInvoiceSalespeople") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsSales = childBs.GetRecordset() rsSales.MoveFirst Do While rsSales.EOF = False rsSales.Fields("arjAmount").Value = App.Round((App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arpTotalForSalesCommission").Value) * (CDbl(rsSales.Fields("arjRate").Value) / 100), 2) + CDbl(Fields("arpLineCommissionTotal").Value)) * (CDbl(rsSales.Fields("arjPercent").Value) / 100),2) rsSales.MoveNext Loop End If End Function
Function arpResellerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select cmoResellerCommissionRate From Organizations Where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpResellerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("arpResellerCommissionRate").Value = rsTemp.Fields("cmoResellerCommissionRate").Value Else Fields("arpResellerCommissionRate").Value = 0 end if End Function
Function arpShipLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("arpShipOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("arpShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("arpShippingMethodID").Value = "" Fields("arpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = "" Fields("arpFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arpSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arpCurrencyRateID").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlShipContactID,cmlCustomerShippingMethodID,cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID,cmlCustomerTaxCodeID,cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID,cmlCurrencyRateID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpShipOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("arpShipContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlShipContactID").Value If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARTaxOnFreight").Value) = True Then Fields("arpFreightTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arpSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID").Value Else Fields("arpFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arpSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" End If Fields("arpShippingMethodID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShippingMethodID").Value If Trim(oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID").Value End If Fields("arpCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value Else Fields("arpShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("arpShippingMethodID").Value = "" Fields("arpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = "" Fields("arpFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arpSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arpCurrencyRateID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 3 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("arpShipOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value)) End If End Function
Function arpInvoiceType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("arpInvoiceType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("arpCreditARInvoiceID").Value = "" Fields("arpCreditReasonID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function arpInvoiceDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim dDueDate,dDiscountDate If App.Ax("Financial").CalculateDiscountAndDueDate(Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value,Fields("arpPaymentTermID").Value,dDueDate,dDiscountDate) = True Then Fields("arpDueDate").Value = dDueDate Fields("arpDiscountDueDate").Value = dDiscountDate End If Dim info If IsNull(Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value) = False Then Set info = App.Ax("Financial").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value,"AR",False) If info.Success Then Fields("arpGLFiscalYearID").Value = info.Year Fields("arpGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value = info.Period Else 'Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value = Null End If If CInt(Fields("arpInvoiceType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("arpCreditDate").Value = Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value End If End If End Function
Function arpInvoiceDate_Valid(sender, e) Dim info If Fields("arpPostedToGL").Value = False Then If IsNull(Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value) = False Then Set info = App.Ax("Financial").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value,"AR",False) If info.Success = False Then Call e.AddError(info.Message) End If End If End If End Function
Function arpPlantDepartmentID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("AR").SetARInvoiceAccounts(e.Row) End Function
Function arpProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("arpProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID,prpLocationID,prpContactID From Projects Where prpProjectID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpLocationID").Value Fields("arpARInvoiceContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpContactID").Value End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function arpPaymentTermID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim dDueDate,dDiscountDate If App.Ax("Financial").CalculateDiscountAndDueDate(Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value,Fields("arpPaymentTermID").Value,dDueDate,dDiscountDate) = True Then Fields("arpDueDate").Value = dDueDate Fields("arpDiscountDueDate").Value = dDiscountDate End If End Function
Function arpCustomerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oCustRs Dim oShipToRs Fields("arpShipOrganizationID").Value = Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("arpARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("arpShipContactID").Value = "" Else Set oCustRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oCustRs.Open "select cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID,cmoDefaultShipLocationID,cmoResellerOrganizationID,cmoResellerLocationID,cmoResellerContactID,cmoIncludeFreightInPrice,cmoARIncludeTaxInRetention from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oCustRs.EOF = False Then ' If blank, don't need to set it again, as the related fields are blanked out automatically each time the customer is changed. If Trim(Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value) Then Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value) Then Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value End If Fields("arpResellerOrganizationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("arpResellerOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arpResellerLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerLocationID").Value Fields("arpResellerContactID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerContactID").Value End If Fields("arpIncludeFreightInPrice").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoIncludeFreightInPrice").Value Fields("arpIncludeTaxInRetention").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoARIncludeTaxInRetention").Value Else Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("arpARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("arpShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("arpIncludeTaxInRetention").Value = False End If oCustRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 1 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value), "") End If End Function
Function arpCurrencyRateID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("AR").SetARInvoiceAccounts(e.Row) End Function
Function arpTotalForSalesCommission_ValueChanged(sender, e) RecalculateSalesCommissionAmounts End Function
Function arpShippingMethodID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("arpShippingMethodID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select xasShippingPaymentTypeID, xasTaxStatus, xasTaxCodeID, xasSecondTaxCodeID from ShippingMethods Where xasShippingMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpShippingMethodID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("arpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = rsData.Fields("xasShippingPaymentTypeID").Value If Trim(CStr(rsData.Fields("xasTaxStatus").Value)) = "1" Then Fields("arpFreightTaxCodeID").Value = rsData.Fields("xasTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arpSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = rsData.Fields("xasSecondTaxCodeID").Value ElseIF Trim(CStr(rsData.Fields("xasTaxStatus").Value)) = "2" Then Fields("arpFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arpSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" End If End If rsData.Close End If If App.Ax("Financial").AvalaraActivated = true and Fields("arpShippingMethodID").value <> Fields("arpShippingMethodID").OriginalValue then Fields("arpAvalaraTaxCalculated").Value = false end if End Function
Function arpARInvoiceLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,rsLookup If Trim(Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("arpARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("arpPaymentTermID").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlARInvoiceContactID,cmlCustomerPaymentTermID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("arpARInvoiceContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlARInvoiceContactID").Value Fields("arpPaymentTermID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerPaymentTermID").Value Else Fields("arpARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("arpPaymentTermID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 2 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value)) End If End Function
Function arpLineCommissionTotal_ValueChanged(sender, e) RecalculateSalesCommissionAmounts End Function
Function arpRetentionBalanceForeign_Valid(sender, e) If Abs(CDbl(Fields("arpRetentionBalanceForeign").Value)) > Abs(CDbl(Fields("arpInvoiceBalanceForeign").Value)) Then Call e.AddError("The Retention Balance cannot be greater than the current Invoice Balance") End If End Function
Function arpExchangeRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("arpPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Fields("arpOriginalExchangeRate").Value = Fields("arpExchangeRate").Value End If End Function
Function arpSplitPercentTotal_Valid(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("arpSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 0 And CDbl(Fields("arpSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 100 Then Call e.AddError("The percentages for the salespeople listed do not total 100%") End If End Function
Function arpInvoiceBalanceForeign_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("arpInvoiceType").Value) = 1 Then If CDbl(Fields("arpInvoiceBalanceBase").Value) < 0 Then Call e.AddError("Invoice balance must be positive for an invoice") End If ElseIf CInt(Fields("arpInvoiceType").Value) = 3 Then If CDbl(Fields("arpInvoiceBalanceBase").Value) < 0 Then Call e.AddError("Invoice balance must be positive for a deposit invoice") End If Else If CDbl(Fields("arpInvoiceBalanceBase").Value) > 0 Then Call e.AddError("Invoice balance must be negative for a credit") End If End If End Function
Function arpPlantID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("AR").SetARInvoiceAccounts(e.Row) End Function
Function SetSalesPeople(orgID, locationID) Dim childBs, rsSales, row Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("ARInvoiceSalespeople") childBs.SetRowCount(0) Set rsSales = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSales.Open "select cmkSalesEmployeeID,cmkPercent from OrganizationLocSalespeople where cmkOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(orgID) + " And cmkLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(locationID) + " Order By cmkSequenceID", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsSales.EOF = False Then Do While rsSales.EOF = False Set row = childBs.AddNewAsRs() row.Fields("arjSalesEmployeeID").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkSalesEmployeeID").Value row.Fields("arjPercent").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkPercent").Value rsSales.MoveNext Loop End If rsSales.Close End Function
