Function Quotes_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "select TOP 1 lmeEmployeeID from Employees where lmeQuoterEmployee = 1 and lmeUserID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(App.UserID) + " and lmeTerminationDate IS NULL order by lmeEmployeeID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Fields("qmpQuoterEmployeeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("lmeEmployeeID").Value End If rsLookup.Close End Function
Function Quotes_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If App.Ax("FollowUps").TransferQuoteToFollowup(Fields,Record.Table.BindingSource, e.SqlTransaction) Then Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If End Function
Function Quotes_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim dQuote,dExpiry,dFollowUp Dim rsQuote, rsRefresh, bFixForeign, cCurrency
dQuote = Date() dExpiry = Null dFollowUp = Null If CInt(App.Props("QM").Fields("xapQMExpirationDays").Value) <> 0 Then dExpiry = DateAdd("d", App.Props("QM").Fields("xapQMExpirationDays").Value, dQuote) End If ' If CInt(App.Props("QM").Fields("xapQMFollowUpDays").Value) <> 0 Then ' dFollowUp = DateAdd("d", App.Props("QM").Fields("xapQMFollowUpDays").Value, dQuote) ' End If
Set rsQuote= CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsQuote.Open "SELECT qmpQuoteID,qmpCurrencyRateID,qmpCustomerOrganizationID,qmpARInvoiceLocationID FROM Quotes WHERE " + aWhere(0),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
Connection.Execute "UPDATE Quotes SET qmpClosedDate = NULL, qmpQuoteDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dQuote) + ", qmpDueDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Date) + ", qmpExpirationDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dExpiry) + ", qmpExchangeRate = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(CDbl(App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(rsQuote.Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value,Date()))) + " WHERE " + aWhere(0)
Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT qmpQuoteID FROM Quotes WHERE " + aWhere(0),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText Do While rsTemp.EOF = False If App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("MC") = True Then
bFixForeign = False Set rsRefresh = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsRefresh.Open "Select cmlCurrencyRateID From OrganizationLocations Where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsQuote.Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " And cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsQuote.Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsRefresh.EOF = False Then If (Trim(rsRefresh.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value) = Trim(rsQuote.Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value)) And ((Trim(rsQuote.Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "") And (Trim(rsQuote.Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value) <> Trim(App.HomeCurrencyID))) Then bFixForeign = True End If End If rsRefresh.Close
App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").RefreshCurrencyForDetails "QUOTES",rsTemp.Fields("qmpQuoteID").Value,bFixForeign End If Call App.Ax("FollowUps").TransferQuoteToFollowup(rsTemp.Fields("qmpQuoteID").Value, Null, Null) rsTemp.MoveNext Loop rsTemp.Close rsQuote.Close End Function
Function Quotes_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues FROM FormInputValues Inner Join QuoteLines On qmlUniqueID = xaiSourceUniqueID WHERE qmlQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpQuoteID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'QUOTELINES'" Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues FROM FormInputValues Inner Join QuoteAssemblies On qmaUniqueID = xaiSourceUniqueID WHERE qmaQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpQuoteID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'QUOTEASSEMBLIES'" End Function
Function qmpProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("qmpProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID,prpLocationID,prpContactID From Projects Where prpProjectID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value Fields("qmpQuoteLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpLocationID").Value Fields("qmpQuoteContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpContactID").Value End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function qmpCustomRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("qmpCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("qmpExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("qmpQuoteDate").Value) End If End Function
Function qmpQuoteDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(App.Props("QM").Fields("xapQMExpirationDays").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("qmpExpirationDate").Value = Fields("qmpQuoteDate").Value + CInt(App.Props("QM").Fields("xapQMExpirationDays").Value) End If
If Trim(Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "" Then If CInt(Fields("qmpCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("qmpExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("qmpQuoteDate").Value) End If End If End Function
Function qmpClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("qmpClosed").Value) = True Then Fields("qmpClosedDate").Value = Date Else Fields("qmpClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function qmpARInvoiceLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("qmpARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("qmpPaymentTermID").Value = ""
Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlARInvoiceContactID, cmlCustomerPaymentTermID, cmlCurrencyRateID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qmpARInvoiceContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlARInvoiceContactID").Value Fields("qmpPaymentTermID").value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerPaymentTermID").Value Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value Else Fields("qmpARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("qmpPaymentTermID").Value = "" Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 2 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value)) End If End Function
Function qmpQuoteLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("qmpQuoteLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("qmpQuoteContactID").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlQuoteContactID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpQuoteLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qmpQuoteContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlQuoteContactID").Value Else Fields("qmpQuoteContactID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function qmpCustomerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oCustRs Fields("qmpShipOrganizationID").Value = Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("qmpARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("qmpQuoteLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("qmpQuoteContactID").Value = "" Fields("qmpShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("qmpShipContactID").Value = "" Else Set oCustRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oCustRs.Open "select cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID, cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID, cmoDefaultShipLocationID, cmoCustomerPaymentTermsID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oCustRs.EOF = False Then ' If blank, don't need to set it again, as the related fields are blanked out automatically each time the customer is changed. If Trim(Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value) Then Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("qmpQuoteLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID").Value) Then Fields("qmpQuoteLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID").Value End If if Trim(Fields("qmpPaymentTermID").value) <> Trim(oCustRs.fields("cmoCustomerPaymentTermsID").value) Then Fields("qmpPaymentTermID").value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoCustomerPaymentTermsID").value end if If Trim(Fields("qmpShipLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value) Then Fields("qmpShipLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value End If Else Fields("qmpARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("qmpQuoteLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("qmpQuoteContactID").Value = "" Fields("qmpShipLocationID").Value = "" End If oCustRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 1 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("qmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value), "") End If End Function
Function qmpCurrencyRateID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value) = "" Then Fields("qmpCustomRate").Value = False Fields("qmpExchangeRate").Value = 1 Else Fields("qmpCustomRate").Value = False 'If CInt(Fields("qmpCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("qmpExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("qmpQuoteDate").Value) 'End If End If End Function
Function qmpShipLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("qmpShipOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("qmpShipLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("qmpShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value = "" Fields("qmpShippingMethodID").Value = "" Fields("qmpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = "" Fields("qmpFreeOnBoardDescription").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlShipContactID,cmlCustomerShippingMethodID,cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID,cmlCurrencyRateID,cmlFreeOnBoardDescription from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpShipOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmpShipLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qmpShipContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlShipContactID").Value 'Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.FIelds("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value Fields("qmpShippingMethodID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShippingMethodID").Value 'If Trim(oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("qmpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID").Value 'End If 'If Trim(oRs.Fields("cmlFreeOnBoardDescription").Value) <> "" Then Fields("qmpFreeOnBoardDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlFreeOnBoardDescription").Value 'End If Else Fields("qmpShipContactID").Value = "" 'Fields("qmpCurrencyRateID").Value = "" Fields("qmpShippingMethodID").Value = "" Fields("qmpShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = "" Fields("qmpFreeOnBoardDescription").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 3 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("qmpShipOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("qmpShipLocationID").Value)) End If End Function
Function qmpSplitPercentTotal_Valid(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("qmpSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 0 And CDbl(Fields("qmpSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 100 Then Call e.AddError("The percentages for the salespeople listed do not total 100%") End If End Function
Function SetSalesPeople(orgID, locationID) Dim childBs, rsSales, row Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("QuoteSalespeople") childBs.SetRowCount(0) Set rsSales = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSales.Open "select cmkSalesEmployeeID,cmkPercent from OrganizationLocSalespeople where cmkOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(orgID) + " And cmkLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(locationID) + " Order By cmkSequenceID", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsSales.EOF = False Then Do While rsSales.EOF = False Set row = childBs.AddNewAsRs() row.Fields("qmjSalesEmployeeID").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkSalesEmployeeID").Value row.Fields("qmjPercent").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkPercent").Value rsSales.MoveNext Loop End If rsSales.Close end function

Function wqlPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value = "" Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value = Fields("wqlWarehouseRequisitionID").Fields("wqpSourceWarehouseID").Value
Dim bKitPart, rsParts bKitPart = False If Trim(Fields("wqlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsParts.Open "select impPhantomOrKitPart from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("wqlPartID").Value))), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then bKitPart = rsParts.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value End If rsParts.Close End If Fields("wqlKitPart").Value = bKitPart Fields("wqlKitPart").RunFormatter e.Database, e.Row End Function
Function wqlSourceWarehouseID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim childBs, rsDetails Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouserequisitionComponents") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False rsDetails.Fields("wqoSourceWarehouseID").Value = Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function
Function wqlSourceWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("wqlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim warehouseBinID, parentPartId, parentPartRevisionId warehouseBinID = "" parentPartId = "" parentPartRevisionId = "" rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wqlPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wqlPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Source warehouse does not exist for part '" + Trim(Fields("wqlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("wqlPartRevisionID").Value) + "'" else isFoundBinValid = App.Ax("Part").GetWarehouseBinForWarehouseTransferLine(Record.Table.BindingSource, Trim(Fields("wqlPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("wqlPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value), warehouseBinID, parentPartId, parentPartRevisionId, e.SqlTransaction) If isFoundBinValid = False Then e.AddWarning "ALL Bins in the Source Warehouse '" + Trim(Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value) + "' for Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("wqlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("wqlPartRevisionID").Value) + "' are INACTIVE and have no quantity on hand." End If End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function WarehouseRequisitionLines_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Fields("wqlSourceWarehouseID").Value = Fields("wqlWarehouseRequisitionID").Fields("wqpSourceWarehouseID").Value End Function

Function injJobMaterialID_ValueChanged(sender, e)
Dim oJobMaterials, oJobAsm, nOpenQty, nEstQty, bRecd, cPart, cRev, cWH, cBin, bPrev, bKitPart, bStockAsm
If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = 0 nEstQty = 0 nInvQty = 0 bRecd = False bKitPart = False bStockAsm = False If CInt(Fields("injJobMaterialID").Value) <> 0 And CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 1 Then Set oJobMaterials = createobject("adodb.recordset") oJobMaterials.Open "select jmmPartID,jmmPartRevisionID,jmmPartWarehouseLocationID,jmmPartBinID,jmmPullFromStockQuantity,jmmQuantityReceived,jmmReceivedComplete,jmmKitPart from JobMaterials where jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("injJobID").Value) + " and jmmJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("injJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and jmmJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("injJobMaterialID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If oJobMaterials.EOF = False Then cPart = Trim(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmPartID").Value) cRev = Trim(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmPartRevisionID").Value) cWH = Trim(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmPartBinID").Value) nEstQty = Cdbl(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmPullFromStockQuantity").Value) bRecd = Cbool(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmReceivedComplete").Value) bKitPart = Cbool(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmKitPart").Value) If Cbool(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmReceivedComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = cdbl(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmPullFromStockQuantity").Value) - cdbl(oJobMaterials.Fields("jmmQuantityReceived").Value) If cdbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If End If oJobMaterials.Close Else If CInt(Fields("injJobAssemblyID").Value) <> 0 And CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 3 Then Set oJobAsm = createobject("adodb.recordset") oJobAsm.Open "SELECT jmaPartID,jmaPartRevisionID,jmaPartWarehouseLocationID,jmaPartBinID,jmaQuantityToMake,jmaQuantityToPull,jmaIssuedComplete,jmaQuantityIssued FROM JobAssemblies WHERE jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("injJobID").Value) + " and jmaJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("injJobAssemblyID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If oJobAsm.EOF = False Then cPart = Trim(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaPartID").Value) cRev = Trim(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value) cWH = Trim(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value) nEstQty = Cdbl(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaQuantityToPull").Value) bRecd = Cbool(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaIssuedComplete").Value) bStockAsm = False If Cbool(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaIssuedComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = cdbl(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaQuantityToPull").Value) - cdbl(oJobAsm.Fields("jmaQuantityIssued").Value) If cdbl(nOpenQty) < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If End If oJobAsm.Close End If End If
Fields("injPartID").Value = cPart Fields("injPartRevisionID").Value = cRev Fields("injPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = cWH Fields("injPartBinID").Value = cBin Fields("injKitPart").Value = bKitPart
If Cbool(bStockAsm) = True then ' Do asm label here end if
Fields("injJobOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty Fields("injEstimatedQuantity").Value = nEstQty Fields("injIssueComplete").Value = bRecd End If End Function
Function injPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim bKitPart, rsParts If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then bKitPart = False If Trim(Fields("injPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsParts.Open "select impPhantomOrKitPart from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injPartID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then bKitPart = rsParts.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value End If rsParts.Close End If Fields("injKitPart").Value = bKitPart End if End Function
Function injIssueType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Fields("injJobID").Value = "" Fields("injPartID").Value = "" If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 3 then Fields("injJobType").Value = 1 Else Fields("injJobType").Value = 0 end if End if End Function
Function injCreateJobSeq_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CBool(Fields("injCreateJobSeq").Value) = True Then Fields("injJobMaterialID").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function MaterialIssueLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True End If Exit Function End If
If CBool(Fields("injCreateJobSeq").Value) = True Then Dim jobSeq If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then jobSeq = App.Ax("Job").CreateJobSequenceFromMaterialIssue(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.SqlTransaction, e.Row) If CInt(jobSeq) <> 0 then If CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 3 Then Fields("injJobMaterialID").Value = jobSeq End If Fields("injCreateJobSeq").Value = False Else Exit function End If End If End If End Function
Function MaterialIssueLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If
If Trim(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssues Set iniReversed=0 Where iniMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssueLines Set injReversed=0 Where injMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value)+" And injMaterialIssueLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssueComponents Set inkReversed=0 Where inkMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value)+" And inkMaterialIssueLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueLineID").Value) End if End Function
Function injJobType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Fields("injJobAssemblyID").Value = 0 Fields("injJobMaterialID").Value = 0 Fields("injCreateJobSeq").Value = False Fields("injInvIssueQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injInvScrapQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobMatIssueQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobMatScrapQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobAsmIssueQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobAsmScrapQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobMatReturnIssueQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobMatReturnScrapQuantity").Value = 0 End IF End Function
Function MaterialIssueLines_Valid(sender, e)
If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 2 then ' Miscellaneous Issue - Check GL Account on Reason/ReasonPlants if COGS Dim cMiscIssueGLAccount, rsTemp If CBool(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value) = True Then If Trim(Fields("injMiscIssueReasonID").Value) <> "" Then cMiscIssueGLAccount = "" Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Select Case CInt(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafCOGSUseAccounts").Value) Case 1: rsTemp.Open "Select xarReasonGLAccountID From Reasons Where xarReasonID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injMiscIssueReasonID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then cMiscIssueGLAccount = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("xarReasonGLAccountID").Value) End If rsTemp.Close Case 2, 3: rsTemp.Open "Select xajReasonGLAccountID From ReasonPlants Where xajReasonID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injMiscIssueReasonID").Value) + " And xajReasonPlantID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injPlantID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then cMiscIssueGLAccount = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("xajReasonGLAccountID").Value) End If rsTemp.Close End Select If Trim(cMiscIssueGLAccount) = "" Then ' Blank Reason GL Account e.AddError "GL Account is required to be set up in Reason Maintenance for Miscellaneous Issues." + Chr(13) End If End If End If End If End If End Function
Function injInvIssueQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 2 Then If Cdbl(Fields("injInvIssueQuantity").Value) = 0 And Cdbl(Fields("injInvScrapQuantity").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Please enter an inventory issue or scrap quantity" + Chr(13) End If End If
If cdbl(Fields("injInvIssueQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("injInvIssueQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End IF End Function
Function injJobMatIssueQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 1 And CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 1 Then If Cdbl(Fields("injJobMatIssueQuantity").Value) = 0 And Cdbl(Fields("injJobMatScrapQuantity").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Please enter a job material issue or scrap quantity" + Chr(13) End If End If
If cdbl(Fields("injJobMatIssueQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("injJobMatIssueQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End If End Function
Function injJobMatReturnIssueQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 3 And CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 1 Then If Cdbl(Fields("injJobMatReturnIssueQuantity").Value) = 0 And Cdbl(Fields("injJobMatReturnScrapQuantity").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Please enter a job material reverse issue or scrap quantity" + Chr(13) End If End If
If cdbl(Fields("injJobMatReturnIssueQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("injJobMatReturnIssueQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End If End Function
Function injJobAsmIssueQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 1 And CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 3 Then If Cdbl(Fields("injJobAsmIssueQuantity").Value) = 0 And Cdbl(Fields("injJobAsmScrapQuantity").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Please enter a job assembly issue or scrap quantity" + Chr(13) End If End If
If cdbl(Fields("injJobAsmIssueQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("injJobAsmIssueQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End If End Function
Function injIssueComplete_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then Call UpdateQuantities End if End Function
Sub UpdateQuantities If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 1 Then If CBool(Fields("injIssueComplete").Value) = True Then If CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("injJobMatIssueQuantity").Value = Cdbl(Fields("injJobOpenQuantity").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("injJobMatScrapQuantity").Value) ElseIf CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 3 Then Fields("injJobAsmIssueQuantity").Value = Cdbl(Fields("injJobOpenQuantity").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("injJobAsmScrapQuantity").Value) End If Else Fields("injJobMatIssueQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobMatScrapQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobAsmIssueQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("injJobAsmScrapQuantity").Value = 0 End If End If end sub
Function injJobMaterialID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CInt(Fields("injJobMaterialID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim rsOpenPO Set rsOpenPO = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsOpenPO.Open "Select IsNull(Count(*),0) As OpenPOCount From PurchaseOrderLines Where pmlJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injJobID").Value) + " And pmlJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("injJobAssemblyID").Value) + " And pmlJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("injJobMaterialID").Value) + " And pmlReceivedComplete = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsOpenPO.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsOpenPO.Fields("OpenPOCount").Value) > 0 Then Dim warningText warningText = "There are outstanding purchase orders for part " + Trim(Fields("injPartID").Value) If Trim(Fields("injPartRevisionID").Value) <> "" then warningText = warningText + " - " + Trim(Fields("injPartRevisionID").Value) end if e.AddWarning warningText + Chr(13) end if end if rsOpenPO.Close End If End If End Function
Function injJobAssemblyID_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("injIssueType").Value) = 1 And CInt(Fields("injJobType").Value) = 3 And CInt(Fields("injJobAssemblyID").Value) = 0 then e.AddError "Job Assembly ID is required" + Chr(13) End If End Function
Function injJobID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cProject, cProjectAreaID, cPlant cProject = "" cProjectAreaID = "" cPlant = ""
If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If Trim(Fields("injJobID").Value) <> "" Then Set oJobs = createobject("adodb.recordset") oJobs.Open "select jmpProjectID,jmpProjectAreaID,jmpPlantID from Jobs where jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("injJobID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If oJobs.EOF = False Then cProject = Trim(oJobs.Fields("jmpProjectID").Value) cProjectAreaID = Trim(oJobs.Fields("jmpProjectAreaID").Value) cPlant = Trim(oJobs.Fields("jmpPlantID").Value) End If oJobs.Close Set oJobs = Nothing End If
Fields("injProjectID").Value = cProject Fields("injProjectAreaID").Value = cProjectAreaID Fields("injPlantID").Value = cPlant End if End Function
Function injInvScrapQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("injInvScrapQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("injInvScrapQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function

If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function
Function injJobMatScrapQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("injJobMatScrapQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("injJobMatScrapQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function
Function injJobMatReturnScrapQuantity_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("injJobMatReturnScrapQuantity").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("injJobMatReturnScrapQuantity").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function
Function MaterialIssueLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueLineID").Value <> 0) Then Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssues Set iniReversed=1 Where iniMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssueLines Set injReversed=1 Where injMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value)+" And injMaterialIssueLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueLineID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssueComponents Set inkReversed=1 Where inkMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value)+" And inkMaterialIssueLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueLineID").Value) Else Fields("injReversed").Value = 0 End if End Function
Function injPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, rsTemp cPartID = Trim(Fields("injPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("injPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("injPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("injPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End if Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select (IsNull(impNonStockedItem,0) | IsNull(impPhantomOrKitPart,0)) AS isNonStock From Parts Where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CBool(rsTemp.Fields("isNonStock").Value) = false Then if CInt(Fields("injPosted").Value) = 0 And not Fields("injMaterialIssueID").Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value then if Fields("injIssueType") = 2 or Fields("injIssueType") = 1 then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID,cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cPartRevisionID + "', Warehouse ID '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin ID '" + cBin + "' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." end if else If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cPartRevisionID + "', Warehouse ID '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin ID '" + cBin + "' is inactive." end if end if End If End If End If rsTemp.Close End Function

Function APInvoiceExpenseAccounts_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Call ValidateExpenseAccountPercent End Function
Function APInvoiceExpenseAccounts_RemoveStarted(sender, e) Call ValidateExpenseAccountPercent End Function
sub ValidateExpenseAccountPercent() Dim tableRecordSet Set tableRecordSet = Record.Table.BindingSource.GetRecordset() If tableRecordSet.RecordCount = 1 Then tableRecordSet.Fields("apxPercent").Value = 100 End If tableRecordSet.Close End sub

Function pmoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsParts
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("pmoPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("pmoPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("pmoDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("pmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End Function
Function PurchaseOrderComponents_Valid(sender, e) Dim oRs If App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value = True Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "Select impNonStockedItem From Parts Where impPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmoPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Cbool(oRs.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = True Then Dim childBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PurchaseOrderAccounts") If childBs.Count < 1 Then e.AddError "At least 1 expense account is required when Component Part is a Non-Stocked Item." + Chr(13) end if Set childBs = nothing End If End if oRs.Close End If End Function
Function pmoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim purchaseType Dim rsParent : Set rsParent = Record.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) purchaseType=CInt(rsParent.Fields("pmlPurchaseType").Value) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("pmoPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("pmoPartID").Value, Fields("pmoPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("pmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("pmoPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then if purchaseType=2 or purchaseType=3 or purchaseType=5 then e.AddWarning "Part ID '"&Fields("pmoPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("pmoPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse ID '"&Fields("pmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin ID '"&Fields("pmoPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive." end if End If End If End Function

Function WarehouseReceipts_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, cText, rsLookup, cPartID, cRevisionID, cBinID, bFound, nLoop, nCount Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("WarehouseReceiptLines") nCount = -1 If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsTemp = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.MoveFirst Do While rsTemp.EOF = False cPartID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("wrlPartID").Value)) cRevisionID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("wrlPartRevisionID").Value)) cBinID = UCase(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("wrlDestinationPartBinID").Value)) rsLookup.Open "select imbPartID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cRevisionID) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cBinID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then bFound = False For nLoop = 0 To nCount If aParts(nCount) = cPartID And aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID And aBins(nCount) = cBinID Then bFound = True Exit For End If Next If bFound = False Then nCount = nCount + 1 ReDim Preserve aParts(nCount) aParts(nCount) = cPartID cText = cText & ", " & cPartID & App.IIf(cRevisionID = "", "", "/" & cRevisionID) & "/" & cBinID ReDim Preserve aRevisions(nCount) aRevisions(nCount) = cRevisionID ReDim Preserve aBins(nCount) aBins(nCount) = cBinID End If End If rsLookup.Close rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Set rsTemp = Nothing End If
If CInt(nCount) > -1 Then cText = Trim(Mid(cText, 3)) For nLoop = 0 To nCount rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrpDestinationWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartWarehouseLocations (imlPartID,imlPartRevisionID,imlPartWarehouseID) VALUES (" + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) + "," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + ")" End If rsLookup.Close Connection.Execute "INSERT INTO PartBins (imbPartID,imbPartRevisionID,imbWarehouseID,imbPartBinID,imbConversionFactor) SELECT imrPartID as imbPartID,imrPartRevisionID as imbPartRevisionID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("wrpDestinationWarehouseID").Value) + " as imbWarehouseID," + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aBins(nLoop)) + " as imbPartBinID,1 as imbConversionFactor FROM PartRevisions WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aParts(nLoop)) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(aRevisions(nLoop)) Next End If End Function
Function wrpClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("wrpClosed").Value) = True Then Fields("wrpClosedDate").Value = Date Else Fields("wrpClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function wrpPosted_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("wrpPosted").Value Then Fields("wrpPostedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("wrpPostedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function WarehouseReceipts_DeleteStarted(sender, e) dim receiptId,receiptLineId If CBool(Fields("wrpReversalEntry").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("wrpPosted").Value)=False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT wrlReverseWHReceiptID,wrlReverseWHReceiptLineID FROM WarehouseReceiptLines WHERE wrlWarehouseReceiptID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("wrpWarehouseReceiptID").Value) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False receiptId=Trim(rsTemp.Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptID").Value) receiptLineId=rsTemp.Fields("wrlReverseWHReceiptLineID").Value If receiptId <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceiptLines Set wrlReversed=0 Where wrlWarehouseReceiptID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId) & " and wrlWarehouseReceiptLineID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceiptComponents Set wroReversed=0 Where wroWarehouseReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId) & " and wroWarehouseReceiptLineID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update WarehouseReceipts Set wrpReversed=0 Where wrpWarehouseReceiptID=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId) End if rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Function SalesOrders_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If Record.EditMode <> adEditAdd Then If Trim(Fields("ompShipOrganizationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("ompShipOrganizationID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderDeliveries SET omdDifferentLocation = 0, omdCustomerOrganizationID = '', omdShipLocationID = '', omdShipContactID = '' WHERE omdSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value) + " And (omdDifferentLocation <> 0 Or omdCustomerOrganizationID <> '')" End If If (Trim(Fields("ompShipOrganizationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("ompShipOrganizationID").OriginalValue)) Or (Trim(Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("ompShipLocationID").OriginalValue)) Then Connection.Execute "Update Jobs Set jmpShipOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompShipOrganizationID").Value) + " , jmpShipLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value) + " From Jobs Inner Join SalesOrderJobLinks On jmpJobID = omjJobID Where omjSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value) + " And omjLinkType = 1 And jmpCustomerOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").OriginalValue)) End If If Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "Update Jobs Set jmpCustomerOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " From Jobs Inner Join SalesOrderJobLinks On jmpJobID = omjJobID Where omjSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value) + " And omjLinkType = 1 And jmpCustomerOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").OriginalValue)) End If End If If IsNull(Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").OriginalValue) = False Then If Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value <> Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").OriginalValue Then ' Update date on releases and jobs that have the same date as the header. Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderDeliveries SET omdDeliveryDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value) + " WHERE omdSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value) + " AND omdDeliveryDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").OriginalValue) Connection.Execute "UPDATE Jobs SET jmpProductionDueDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value) + " FROM Jobs INNER JOIN SalesOrderJobLinks ON jmpJobID = omjJobID WHERE jmpJobID = omjJobID AND jmpClosed = 0 AND omjSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value) + " AND jmpProductionDueDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").OriginalValue) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If End If End Function
Function SalesOrders_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues FROM FormInputValues Inner Join SalesOrderLines On omlUniqueID = xaiSourceUniqueID WHERE omlSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'SALESORDERLINES'" End Function
Function SalesOrders_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsSalesOrders,dNewDate,nDiff dNewDate = Null Set rsSalesOrders = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSalesOrders.Open "SELECT ompSalesOrderID,ompOrderDate,ompRequestedShipDate,ompCurrencyRateID,ompCustomerOrganizationID,ompARInvoiceLocationID FROM SalesOrders WHERE " + aWhere(1),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSalesOrders.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompOrderDate").Value) = False And IsNull(rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value) = False Then ' Get the number of days difference and apply that amount to the dates on the new order. nDiff = DateDiff("d",rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompOrderDate").Value,rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompRequestedShipDate").Value) dNewDate = DateAdd("d",nDiff,Date()) End If End If Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrders SET ompRequestedShipDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dNewDate) + " WHERE " + aWhere(0)
If App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("MC") = True Then Dim rsTemp Dim bFixForeign
Do While rsSalesOrders.EOF = False
bFixForeign = False Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select cmlCurrencyRateID From OrganizationLocations Where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " And cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False then If (Trim(rsTemp.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value) = Trim(rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompCurrencyRateID").Value)) And ((Trim(rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "") And (Trim(rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompCurrencyRateID").Value) <> Trim(App.HomeCurrencyID))) Then bFixForeign = True End If End If rsTemp.Close
App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").RefreshCurrencyForDetails "SalesOrders",rsSalesOrders.Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value,bFixForeign rsSalesOrders.MoveNext Loop End If rsSalesOrders.Close End Function
Function SalesOrders_SaveDataCompleted(sender, e) Call UpdateEasyOrderInformation() End Function
Function ompCustomerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oCustRs Dim oShipToRs Fields("ompShipOrganizationID").Value = Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("ompARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("ompQuoteLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("ompQuoteContactID").Value = "" Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("ompShipContactID").Value = "" Else Set oCustRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oCustRs.Open "select cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID, cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID, cmoDefaultShipLocationID, cmoResellerOrganizationID, cmoResellerLocationID, cmoResellerContactID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oCustRs.EOF = False Then ' If blank, don't need to set it again, as the related fields are blanked out automatically each time the customer is changed. If Trim(Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value) Then Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("ompQuoteLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID").Value) Then Fields("ompQuoteLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value) Then Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value End If Fields("ompResellerOrganizationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("ompResellerOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("ompResellerLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerLocationID").Value Fields("ompResellerContactID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerContactID").Value End If Else Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("ompARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("ompQuoteLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("ompQuoteContactID").Value = "" Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("ompShipContactID").Value = "" End If oCustRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 1 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value), "") End If End Function
Function ompProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("ompProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID,prpLocationID,prpContactID From Projects Where prpProjectID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value Fields("ompShipLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpLocationID").Value Fields("ompShipContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpContactID").Value End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function ompShippingMethodID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("ompShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasShippingPaymentTypeID").Value If Trim(CStr(Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasTaxStatus").Value)) = "1" Then Fields("ompFreightTaxCodeID").Value = Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasTaxCodeID").Value Fields("ompSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasSecondTaxCodeID").Value ElseIF Trim(CStr(Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasTaxStatus").Value)) = "2" Then Fields("ompFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("ompSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" End If
Dim carrier, cBillingOption carrier = Trim(Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasCarrier").Value)
If carrier = "FEDEX" Or carrier = "FDXE" Or carrier = "FDXG" Then Fields("ompUPSBillingOption").Value = "" Fields("ompFedEx3rdPartyOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("ompFedEx3rdPartyLocationID").Value = "" Fields("ompFedExAccountNumber").Value = "" cBillingOption = Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasFedExBillingOption").Value Fields("ompFedExBillingOption").Value = cBillingOption if Trim(Fields("ompFedExBillingOption").Value) = "SENDER" then Fields("ompFedExAccountNumber").Value = App.Props("SM").Fields("xsmFdxAccountNumber").Value end if ElseIf carrier = "UPS" Then Fields("ompFedExBillingOption").Value="" Fields("ompUPS3rdPartyOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("ompUPS3rdPartyLocationID").Value = "" Fields("ompUPSAccountNumber").Value = "" cBillingOption = Fields("ompShippingMethodID").Fields("xasUPSBillingOptionDefault").Value Fields("ompUPSBillingOption").Value = cBillingOption if Trim(Fields("ompUPSBillingOption").Value) = "1" then Fields("ompUPSAccountNumber").Value = App.Props("SM").Fields("xsmUPSAccountNo").Value end if Else Fields("ompUPSBillingOption").Value = "" Fields("ompUPS3rdPartyOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("ompUPS3rdPartyLocationID").Value = "" Fields("ompUPSAccountNumber").Value = "" Fields("ompFedExBillingOption").Value = "" Fields("ompFedEx3rdPartyOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("ompFedEx3rdPartyLocationID").Value = "" Fields("ompFedExAccountNumber").Value = "" End If End If
If App.Ax("Financial").AvalaraActivated = true and Fields("ompShippingMethodID").value <> Fields("ompShippingMethodID").OriginalValue then Fields("ompAvalaraTaxCalculated").Value = false end if End Function
Function ompOrderDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("ompCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "" Then If CInt(Fields("ompCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("ompExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("ompCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("ompOrderDate").Value) End If End If End Function

Function ompARInvoiceLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("ompARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("ompPaymentTermID").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlARInvoiceContactID,cmlCustomerPaymentTermID, cmlCurrencyRateID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("ompARInvoiceContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlARInvoiceContactID").Value Fields("ompPaymentTermID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerPaymentTermID").Value Fields("ompCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value Else Fields("ompARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("ompPaymentTermID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 2 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value)) End If End Function
Function ompARInvoiceLocationID_ForeignKeyValid(sender, e) Dim offsetTotal offsetTotal = 0 If Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value = Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").OriginalValue And Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value <> Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").OriginalValue Then If CBool(Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Fields("cmlCreditCheckForLocation").Value) = True Then offsetTotal = Fields("ompOrderSubtotalBase").Value Else offsetTotal = Fields("ompOrderSubtotalBase").Value - Fields("ompOrderSubtotalBase").OriginalValue End if ElseIf Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value <> Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").OriginalValue Then offsetTotal = Fields("ompOrderSubtotalBase").Value Else offsetTotal = Fields("ompOrderSubtotalBase").Value - Fields("ompOrderSubtotalBase").OriginalValue End If If IsNull(offsetTotal) = True Then offsetTotal = 0 end if Call App.Ax("Organizations").CustomerCreditCheck(Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value,Fields("ompARInvoiceLocationID").Value, App.Props("PN").Fields("xapCMOrderCreditMessage").Value, App.Props("PN").Fields("xapCMOrderHoldMessage").Value, offsetTotal, 0, 0, e.ValidationInfo) End Function

Function ompCustomerPO_Valid(sender, e) Dim cOrder,cCustomerID,rsLookup,cText cOrder= Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value cText = "" If Trim(cOrder) <> "" Then Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") cCustomerID= Fields("ompCustomerOrganizationID").Value rsLookup.Open "select ompSalesOrderID from SalesOrders where ompCustomerPO = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cOrder) + " and ompCustomerOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cCustomerID) + " And ompSalesOrderID <> " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then cText = "Customer PO " + Trim(cOrder) + " has already been entered for customer " + Trim(cCustomerID) + " on Sales Order " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(rsLookup.Fields("ompSalesOrderID").Value)) + "." End If rsLookup.Close If Trim(cText) <> "" Then Call e.AddWarning(ctext) End If End If End Function

Function ompSplitPercentTotal_Valid(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("ompSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 0 And CDbl(Fields("ompSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 100 Then Call e.AddError("The percentages for the salespeople listed do not total 100%") End If End Function
Function SetSalesPeople(orgID, locationID) Dim childBs, rsSales, row Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("SalesOrderSalespeople") childBs.SetRowCount(0) Set rsSales = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSales.Open "select cmkSalesEmployeeID,cmkPercent from OrganizationLocSalespeople where cmkOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(orgID) + " And cmkLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(locationID) + " Order By cmkSequenceID", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsSales.EOF = False Then Do While rsSales.EOF = False Set row = childBs.AddNewAsRs() row.Fields("omiSalesEmployeeID").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkSalesEmployeeID").Value row.Fields("omiPercent").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkPercent").Value rsSales.MoveNext Loop End If rsSales.Close End Function

Function ompEasyOrderEnabled_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsSalesOrderLines, nLines, nInvoiced, nDelivered, nBackorder, nConfirmed
If Not CBool(Fields("ompEasyOrderEnabled").Value) Then Fields("ompEasyOrderStatus").Value = 0 Exit Function End If
If CBool(Fields("ompEasyOrderEnabled").Value) And Fields("ompEasyOrderStatus").Value = 0 then Fields("ompEasyOrderStatus").Value = 1 End If
Set rsSalesOrderLines = Record.GetChildBindingSource("SalesOrderLines").Recordset.Select("True") nLines = rsSalesOrderLines.RecordCount
If Not rsSalesOrderLines.EOF Then rsSalesOrderLines.Filter = "omlEasyOrderExternalStatus = 'INV'" nInvoiced = rsSalesOrderLines.RecordCount
rsSalesOrderLines.Filter = "omlEasyOrderExternalStatus = 'DLV'" nDelivered = rsSalesOrderLines.RecordCount
rsSalesOrderLines.Filter = "omlEasyOrderExternalStatus = 'BCK'" nBackorder = rsSalesOrderLines.RecordCount
Fields("ompEasyOrderExternalStatus").Value = "CON"
If nLines = nInvoiced then Fields("ompEasyOrderExternalStatus").Value = "INV" End If
If nLines = nDelivered then Fields("ompEasyOrderExternalStatus").Value = "DLV" End If
If nBackorder > 0 then Fields("ompEasyOrderExternalStatus").Value = "BCK" End If Else Fields("ompEasyOrderExternalStatus").Value = "CON" End If
rsSalesOrderLines.Close End Function

Function tprTaxYear_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Dim nYear nYear = Fields("tprTaxYear").Value If nYear <> 0 Then Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select glzStartDate,glzEndDate from GLFiscalYears where glzGLFiscalYearID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nYear),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly If rsLookup.EOF = False then Fields("tprStartDate").Value = rsLookup.Fields("glzStartDate").Value Fields("tprEndDate").Value = rsLookup.Fields("glzEndDate").Value End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function tprTaxYear_Valid(sender, e) Dim nTaxablePaymentID Dim nYear Dim cPlant Dim rsLookup Dim cWhere
nTaxablePaymentID = Fields("tprAPTaxablePaymentID").Value nYear = Fields("tprTaxYear").Value cPlant = Fields("tprPlantID").Value
cWhere = "" If App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("MP") = True Then cWhere = " And tprPlantID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPlant) End If Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select tprAPTaxablePaymentID From APTaxablePayments Where tprTaxYear = " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nYear) & cWhere & " And tprAPTaxablePaymentID <> " & App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nTaxablePaymentID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then ' There is already a record for same year/plant e.AddError "A record already exists for selected year and plant." End If rsLookup.Close End Function

Function OrganizationLocations_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartCrossReferences WHERE imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmlOrganizationID").Value) + " And imxLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmlLocationID").Value) Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select cmcWebUserID from OrganizationContacts Where cmcOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmlOrganizationID").Value) + " And cmcLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("cmlLocationID").Value) + " And cmcWebUserID <> '' And cmcWebLoginEnabled <> 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText Do While rsData.EOF = False If App.WebGearDeleteUser(rsData.Fields("cmcWebUserID").Value) = False Then OrganizationLocations_DeleteStarted = "Unable to delete WebGear user" Exit Function End If rsData.MoveNext Loop rsData.Close End Function
