Function Jobs_UpdateStarted(sender, e) ' First check if the part/rev/wh/bin has changed, if so, direct to change rework qty to 0 first If Trim(Fields("jmpPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpPartID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpPartBinID").OriginalValue) Then If (CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) > 0 Or CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) > 0) And _ CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) > 0 Then Msgbox "The part/revision/warehouse/bin cannot be changed due to the Rework Quantity." & _ vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Please reduce Rework Quantity from [" & Cstr(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) & "] to 0 for:" & _ vbcrlf & "[Part: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmpPartID").OriginalValue) & "', Revision: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) & "', Warehouse: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").OriginalValue) & "' ,Bin: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmpPartBinID").OriginalValue) & "'].", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXREWORKQTYCHANGEPART", "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit function End If End If
' Check QOH for the part/rev/wh/bin Dim allowNegativeQtyOnHand allowNegativeQtyOnHand = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand") If allowNegativeQtyOnHand = False Then If CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmpReworkDate").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpReworkDate").OriginalValue) Then Dim partBinQtyRs Set partBinQtyRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") partBinQtyRs.Open "select isnull(imbQuantityOnHand,imrQuantityOnHand) As imbQuantityOnHand From PartRevisions " & _ "Left Outer Join PartBins On imbPartID = imrPartID And imbPartRevisionID = imrPartRevisionID " & _ "And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) + " AND imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value) + " " & _ "WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If partBinQtyRs.EOF = False Then Dim nQtyChange nQtyChange = CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) - CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) If Cdbl(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) < nQtyChange Then Msgbox "There is insufficient quantity on hand to save this record due to the rework quantity entered." & _ vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Rework Quantity [" & Cstr(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is greater than Quantity On Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "].", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXINSUFFICIENTQOH", "Confirm") Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value = Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").OriginalValue e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If partBinQtyRs.Close End If End If
' Copy data in duplicate fields to JobAssemblies table Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT * FROM JobAssemblies WHERE jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " AND jmaJobAssemblyID = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then 'msgbox "Updating Assembly" Else 'msgbox "Adding empty assembly" oRs.AddNew App.BlankRecord oRs End If oRs.Fields("jmaClosed").Value = Fields("jmpClosed").Value oRs.Fields("jmaJobID").Value = Fields("jmpJobID").Value oRs.Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("jmaLevel").Value = 1 oRs.Fields("jmaParentAssemblyID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("jmaPartID").Value = Fields("jmpPartID").Value oRs.Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value = Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value oRs.Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").Value = Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").Value oRs.Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value = Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value oRs.Fields("jmaUnitOfMeasure").Value = Fields("jmpUnitOfMeasure").Value oRs.Fields("jmaPartShortDescription").Value = Fields("jmpPartShortDescription").Value oRs.Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = Fields("jmpPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value oRs.Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionText").Value = Fields("jmpPartLongDescriptionText").Value oRs.Fields("jmaSourceMethodID").Value = Fields("jmpSourceMethodID").Value oRs.Fields("jmaProductionNotesRTF").Value = Fields("jmpProductionNotesRTF").Value oRs.Fields("jmaProductionNotesText").Value = Fields("jmpProductionNotesText").Value oRs.Fields("jmaDocuments").Value = Fields("jmpDocuments").Value oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityPerParent").Value = 1
oRs.Fields("jmaOrderQuantity").Value = Fields("jmpOrderQuantity").Value oRs.Fields("jmaInventoryQuantity").Value = Fields("jmpInventoryQuantity").Value oRs.Fields("jmaScrapQuantity").Value = Fields("jmpScrapQuantity").Value oRs.Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value = Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory").Value = Fields("jmpQuantityReceivedToInventory").Value oRs.Fields("jmaReceivedComplete").Value = Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value = Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityToPull").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("jmaProductionQuantity").Value = Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value oRs.Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value = Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityCompleted").Value = Fields("jmpQuantityCompleted").Value oRs.Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value = Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value oRs.Fields("jmaCreatedBy").Value = App.UserID oRs.Fields("jmaCreatedDate").Value = Now
oRs.UpdateBatch oRs.Close
Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3)
End Function
Function Jobs_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").OriginalValue) Then ' Do this before JobAssemblies is updated below. App.Ax("Job").ChangeProductionQty e.SqlTransaction, Fields("jmpJobID").Value,0,Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value,0,False Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If
Dim prodCompleteChanged, qtyCompleteChanged, completeDateChanged prodCompleteChanged = False qtyCompleteChanged = False completeDateChanged = False If CBool(Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value) <> CBool(Fields("jmpProductionComplete").OriginalValue) Then prodCompleteChanged = True End If If CDbl(Fields("jmpQuantityCompleted").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmpQuantityCompleted").OriginalValue) Then qtyCompleteChanged = True End If If IsNull(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").OriginalValue) = False Then If CDate(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value) <> CDate(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").OriginalValue) Then completeDateChanged = True End If Else If IsNull(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").OriginalValue) = True Or IsNull(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value) = True And IsNull(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").OriginalValue) = False Then completeDateChanged = True End If End If If CBool(prodCompleteChanged) = True Or CBool(qtyCompleteChanged) = True Or CBool(completeDateChanged) = True Then App.Ax("Job").CompleteJob Fields("jmpJobID").Value,Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value,False,Fields("jmpQuantityCompleted").Value,0,Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value,prodCompleteChanged,qtyCompleteChanged,completeDateChanged, e.SqlTransaction Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If
If CBool(prodCompleteChanged) = True Then If CBool(Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value) =True Then App.Ax("Job").UpdateOperationCompleteFlagsForJob Fields("jmpJobID").Value, e.SqlTransaction End If End If
If CInt(Fields("jmpClosed").Value) <> CInt(Fields("jmpClosed").OriginalValue) And CInt(Fields("jmpClosed").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE TimecardLines SET lmlSuspended = 0 WHERE lmlSuspended = 1 AND lmlJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) Call RefreshPartAllocationsForJob() 'Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions", e.SqlTransaction) 'not compatible when Part Entry View is open End If If Trim(Fields("jmpPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpPartID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "Update JobOperations Set jmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartID").Value) + ", jmoPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value) + " Where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " And jmoJobAssemblyID = 0 And jmoOperationType = 2 And jmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartID").OriginalValue) End If End Function
Function RefreshPartAllocationsForJob() Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmaPartID,jmaPartRevisionID FROM JobAssemblies WHERE jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Do While oRs.EOF = false Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, oRs.Fields("jmaPartID").Value, oRs.Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value) oRs.MoveNext() loop end if oRs.Close oRs.Open "SELECT jmmPartID,jmmPartRevisionID FROM JobMaterials WHERE jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Connection.Execute "Update JobMaterials Set jmmQuantityAllocated = 0 Where jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) Do While oRs.EOF = false Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, oRs.Fields("jmmPartID").Value, oRs.Fields("jmmPartRevisionID").Value) oRs.MoveNext() loop end if oRs.Close oRs.Open "SELECT jmtPartID,jmtPartRevisionID FROM JobMaterialComponents WHERE jmtJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Connection.Execute "Update JobMaterialComponents Set jmtQuantityAllocated = 0 Where jmtJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) Do While oRs.EOF = false Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, oRs.Fields("jmtPartID").Value, oRs.Fields("jmtPartRevisionID").Value) oRs.MoveNext() loop end if oRs.Close End Function
Function Jobs_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim rsCalls Set rsCalls = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues WHERE xaiSourceUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpUniqueID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'JOBS'" Call App.Ax("Job").DeleteJobAssembly(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("jmpJobID").Value,0) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM SalesOrderJobLinks WHERE omjJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) rsCalls.Open "Select jmpJobID, jmpCallID from Jobs where jmpCallID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpCallID").value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If rsCalls.RecordCount = 1 and rsCalls.Fields("jmpJobID").value = Fields("jmpJobID").value Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE Calls SET kbpFieldServiceJobCreated = 0 WHERE kbpCallID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpCallID").value) End If
Call App.Ax("Job").UnscheduleJob(Fields("jmpJobID").Value, e.SqlTransaction) End Function
Function Jobs_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE Jobs SET jmpClosedDate = NULL, jmpProductionComplete = 0, jmpCompletedDate = NULL, jmpProductionDueDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Date) + ", jmpOrderQuantity = 0, jmpInventoryQuantity = 0, jmpScrapQuantity = 0, jmpReworkQuantity = 0 , jmpProductionQuantity = 0, jmpQuantityCompleted = 0, jmpQuantityShipped = 0, jmpQuantityReceivedToInventory = 0, jmpPlanningComplete = 0, jmpScheduleComplete = 0, jmpReleasedToFloor = 0, jmpReadyToPrint = 1, jmpScheduledStartDate = NULL, jmpScheduledDueDate = NULL WHERE " + aWhere(0)
Dim rsDest,rsSource Set rsDest = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsSource = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsDest.Open "SELECT jmpUniqueID FROM Jobs WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " Order By jmpJobID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText rsSource.Open "SELECT jmpUniqueID FROM Jobs WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " Order By jmpJobID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSource.RecordCount = rsDest.RecordCount And rsSource.EOF = False Then Do While rsSource.EOF = False Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").ConfiguratorSaveAs(rsSource.Fields("jmpUniqueID").Value,rsDest.Fields("jmpUniqueID").Value,"Jobs") rsSource.MoveNext rsDest.MoveNext Loop End If rsSource.Close rsDest.Close End Function
Function jmpCustomerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("jmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select cmoJobPriorityID From Organizations Where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("jmpJobPriorityID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("cmoJobPriorityID").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function jmpPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("jmpPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText,imrDocuments from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("jmpUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("jmpPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("jmpPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("jmpPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value Fields("jmpDocuments").Value = oRs.Fields("imrDocuments").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function jmpProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("jmpProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("jmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID From Projects Where prpProjectID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("jmpCustomerOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function jmpProductionComplete_ValueChanged(sender, e) if CInt(Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value) = True And _ CDbl(Fields("jmpQuantityCompleted").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value) then If Msgbox("Qty Complete does not match Production Qty. Are you sure?",vbExclamation+vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbNo Then Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value = False End If end if
If CInt(Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value) = True Then Dim oRs,cText cText = "" Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If Trim(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) <> "" Then oRs.Open "Select Count(*) as rec_count From PurchaseOrderLines Where pmlJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " And pmlClosed = 0 And pmlReceivedComplete = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If IsNull(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) = False Then If CLng(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) > 0 Then cText = cText + "Job " + Trim(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " has " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value)) + " open purchase order lines referencing it." + Chr(13) End If End If End If oRs.Close
oRs.Open "Select Count(*) as rec_count From TimecardLines Where lmlJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " And (lmlActive = 1 Or lmlSuspended = 1)",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If IsNull(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) = False Then If CLng(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) > 0 Then cText = cText + "Job " + Trim(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " has " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value)) + " active or suspended timecard lines referencing it." + Chr(13) End If End If End If oRs.Close
If Trim(cText) <> "" Then If Msgbox(cText + " Do you still want to complete the job?",vbExclamation+vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbNo Then Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value = False End If End If End If End If
If CInt(Fields("jmpProductionComplete").Value) = True Then If IsNull(Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value) Then Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value = Date End If Else Fields("jmpCompletedDate").Value = null End If End Function
Function jmpPlanningComplete_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("jmpPlanningComplete").Value) = True Then Fields("jmpScheduleLocked").Value = False End If End Function
Function jmpClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("jmpClosed").Value) = True Then Dim oRs,cText cText = "" Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If Trim(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) <> "" Then oRs.Open "Select Count(*) as rec_count From PurchaseOrderLines Where pmlJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " And pmlClosed = 0 And pmlReceivedComplete = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If IsNull(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) = False Then If CLng(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) > 0 Then cText = cText + "Job " + Trim(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " has " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value)) + " open purchase order lines referencing it." + Chr(13) End If End If End If oRs.Close
oRs.Open "Select Count(*) as rec_count From TimecardLines Where lmlJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " And (lmlActive = 1 Or lmlSuspended = 1)",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If IsNull(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) = False Then If CLng(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value) > 0 Then cText = cText + "Job " + Trim(Fields("jmpJobID").Value) + " has " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(oRs.Fields("rec_count").Value)) + " active or suspended timecard lines referencing it." + Chr(13) End If End If End If oRs.Close End If
If Trim(cText) <> "" Then e.Cancel = "This job cannot be closed for the following reasons:" + Chr(13) + cText Fields("jmpClosed").Value = False Else Fields("jmpClosedDate").Value = Date End If Else Fields("jmpClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function jmpReworkQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value = 0 Then Fields("jmpReworkDate").Value = Empty Else If IsEmpty(Fields("jmpReworkDate").Value) = True Or IsNull(Fields("jmpReworkDate").Value) = True Then Fields("jmpReworkDate").Value = Now End If End If End Function
Function jmpReworkQuantity_Valid(sender, e) Dim partBinQtyRs Set partBinQtyRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") partBinQtyRs.Open "select isnull(imbQuantityOnHand,imrQuantityOnHand) As imbQuantityOnHand From PartRevisions " & _ "Left Outer Join PartBins On imbPartID = imrPartID And imbPartRevisionID = imrPartRevisionID " & _ "And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) + " AND imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value) + " " & _ "WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText ' Check QOH for the part/rev/wh/bin If CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmpReworkDate").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmpReworkDate").OriginalValue) Then If partBinQtyRs.EOF = False Then Dim nQtyChange nQtyChange = CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) - CDbl(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) If Cdbl(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) < nQtyChange Then Dim rsPart, allowNegativeQtyOnHand, enableWarningWhenNegative Set rsPart = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") allowNegativeQtyOnHand = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand") enableWarningWhenNegative = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMEnableWarningWhenNegative") rsPart.Open "Select impNonStockedItem, impPhantomOrKitPart From Parts Where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmpPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If rsPart.EOF = False Then If allowNegativeQtyOnHand And rsPart.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value = False And rsPart.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(Trim(Fields("jmpPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").Value), Trim(Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value), e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddError "This entry CAN NOT be saved because Rework Qty [" & Cstr(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is GREATER THAN Quantity on Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "] and WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand for an INACTIVE bin." Else If enableWarningWhenNegative Then e.AddWarning "Saving this record WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand for the Part Revision due to the rework quantity entered. Rework Quantity [" & Cstr(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is greater than Quantity on Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "]." End If End If Else If rsPart.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value Or rsPart.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value Then e.AddError "Rework Qty cannot be entered for Kit Parts or Non-Stock Parts" Else e.AddError "There is insufficient quantity on hand to save this record due to the rework quantity entered." & _ vbcrlf & "Rework Quantity [" & Cstr(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is greater than Quantity On Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "]." End If End If End If rsPart.Close End If End If End If If partBinQtyRs.EOF = False And Int(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) > 0 Then e.AddWarning "The Rework Qty [" & Cstr(Fields("jmpReworkQuantity").Value) & "] entered will be automatically reduced from Quantity on Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "] for Warehouse '" + Trim(Fields("jmpPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) + "', Bin '" + Trim(Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value) + "'" end if partBinQtyRs.Close End Function
Function jmpPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("jmpPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("jmpPartID").Value, Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("jmpPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID '"&Fields("jmpPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("jmpPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse ID '"&Fields("jmpPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin ID '"&Fields("jmpPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive." End If End If End Function
Function omaStatus_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("omaStatus").Value) < 1 Then Fields("omaStatusDate").Value = Null Else Fields("omaStatusDate").Value = Now End If End Function

Dim bPriceSetByCode, bDontExecuteDepositCode
Function SalesOrderLines_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) If CInt(App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMAutoCreateDelivery").Value) = True Then Dim rsDetails, childBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("SalesOrderDeliveries") Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst If rsDetails.RecordCount = 0 Then Call App.Ax("SalesOrder").AddDeliveryLine(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.SqlTransaction) end if rsDetails.Close childBs = null End If e.FocusField = "omlPartID" End Function
Function SalesOrderLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) ' Default Taxable and Non-Tax Reason to the customer specified on the order header If Trim(Fields("omlSalesOrderID").Value) <> "" Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT ompProjectID,cmlCustomerTaxable,cmlCustomerTaxCodeID,cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID,cmlNonTaxReasonID FROM SalesOrders,OrganizationLocations WHERE ompSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omlSalesOrderID").Value) + " AND ompShipOrganizationID = cmlOrganizationID AND ompShipLocationID = cmlLocationID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If CInt(oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxable").Value) = True Then Fields("omlTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxCodeID").Value Fields("omlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID").Value End If Fields("omlNonTaxReasonID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlNonTaxReasonID").Value Fields("omlProjectID").value = ors.Fields("ompProjectID").value Else ' msgbox "Unable to retrieve customer info for taxable defaults" End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function SalesOrderLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("omlQuoteID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("omlQuoteLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "Update QuoteLines Set qmlFirm = 1 WHERE qmlQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omlQuoteID").Value) + " AND qmlQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("omlQuoteLineID").Value) If Trim(Fields("omlQuoteID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("omlQuoteID").OriginalValue) Or CLng(Fields("omlQuoteLineID").Value) <> CLng(Fields("omlQuoteLineID").OriginalValue) Then Call App.Ax("Quote").CloseRelatedFollowups(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("omlQuoteID").Value, Fields("omlSalesOrderID").Value) End If End If End Function
Function SalesOrderLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues WHERE xaiSourceUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omlUniqueID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'SALESORDERLINES'" End Function
Function SalesOrderLines_DeleteCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("omlQuoteID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("omlQuoteLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("Quotes") Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("QuoteLines") End If End Function
Function SalesOrderLines_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsSalesOrderLines Set rsSalesOrderLines = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
Dim rsDest,rsSource Set rsDest = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsSource = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsDest.Open "SELECT omlUniqueID FROM SalesOrderLines WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " Order By omlSalesOrderID,omlSalesOrderLineID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText rsSource.Open "SELECT omlUniqueID FROM SalesOrderLines WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " Order By omlSalesOrderID,omlSalesOrderLineID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSource.RecordCount = rsDest.RecordCount And rsSource.EOF = False Then Do While rsSource.EOF = False Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").ConfiguratorSaveAs(rsSource.Fields("omlUniqueID").Value,rsDest.Fields("omlUniqueID").Value,"SALESORDERLINES") rsSource.MoveNext rsDest.MoveNext Loop End If rsSource.Close rsDest.Close
End Function
Function omlOrderQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim childBs, rsDetails
If CBool(Fields("omlPriceOverride").Value) = 0 Then bPriceSetByCode = True Call App.Ax("OrderFunctions").CheckSalePrice(Fields) bPriceSetByCode = False End If

Function omlPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs, nDeliveryType If Trim(Fields("omlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select impPartGroupID,impTaxCodeID,impSecondTaxCodeID,impAlwaysNonTaxable,impNonTaxReasonID from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("omlPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("omlPartGroupID").Value = oRs.Fields("impPartGroupID").Value If CInt(oRs.Fields("impAlwaysNonTaxable").Value) = True Then Fields("omlTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value Fields("omlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value Else If Trim(oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("omlTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("omlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value End If End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("impNonTaxReasonID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("omlNonTaxReasonID").Value = oRs.Fields("impNonTaxReasonID").Value End If End If oRs.Close If Trim(Fields("omlPartShortDescription").Value) <> "" Then e.FocusField = "omlOrderQuantity" End If End If Fields("omlConfigured").Value = False End Function

Function omlDepositPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nDeposit, nAmount, nBaseAmt, bPrev, bForAmt If CInt(App.InUserChangeEvent) = True Then If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) > 100 Then e.Cancel = "Deposit Percent cannot be greater than 100." Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value = 100 End If
nAmount = 0 nBaseAmt = CDbl(Fields("omlExtendedPriceBase").Value) If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeTaxInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + CDbl(Fields("omlTaxAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("omlSecondTaxAmountBase").Value) End If If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeFrgtInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + Cdbl(Fields("omlFreightAmountBase").Value) End If nDeposit = App.Round((CDbl(nBaseAmt) * (CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) / 100)), 2)
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositAmountBase").Value) <> nDeposit Then bPrev = App.UpdatingCost App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("omlDepositAmountBase").Value = nDeposit App.UpdatingCost = bPrev End If
nAmount = 0 bForAmt= CDbl(Fields("omlExtendedPriceForeign").Value) If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeTaxInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then bForAmt = CDbl(bForAmt) + CDbl(Fields("omlTaxAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("omlSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value) End If If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeFrgtInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then bForAmt = CDbl(bForAmt) + Cdbl(Fields("omlFreightAmountForeign").Value) End If nDeposit = App.Round((CDbl(bForAmt) * (CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) / 100)), 2)
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositAmountForeign").Value) <> nDeposit Then bPrev = App.UpdatingCost App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("omlDepositAmountForeign").Value = nDeposit App.UpdatingCost = bPrev End If
End If End Function

Function omlTaxAmountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,bPrev Dim nDeposit, nBaseAmt
If Cbool(bDontExecuteDepositCode) = False Then If CInt(Fields("omlDepositCreated").Value) = False Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(Fields("omlExtendedPriceBase").Value) If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeTaxInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + CDbl(Fields("omlTaxAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("omlSecondTaxAmountBase").Value) End If If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeFrgtInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + Cdbl(Fields("omlFreightAmountBase").Value) End If nDeposit = App.Round(CDbl(nBaseAmt) * (CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) / 100),2)
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositAmountBase").Value) <> nDeposit Then bDontExecuteDepositCode = True Fields("omlDepositAmountBase").Value = nDeposit bDontExecuteDepositCode = False End If Else Dim nAmount
nAmount = 0 nBaseAmt = CDbl(Fields("omlExtendedPriceBase").Value) If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeTaxInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + CDbl(Fields("omlTaxAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("omlSecondTaxAmountBase").Value) End If If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeFrgtInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + Cdbl(Fields("omlFreightAmountBase").Value) End If nAmount = App.Round(CDbl(nBaseAmt),2)
If CDbl(nAmount) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("omlDepositAmountBase").Value) / CDbl(nAmount) nPrice = nPrice * 100 nPrice = App.Round(nPrice,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If ' Added an extra check here due to rounding if the percent will be 100.01 to force it to 100 If nPrice = 100.01 then nPrice = 100 End If
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) <> nPrice Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False bDontExecuteDepositCode = True Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value = nPrice App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev bDontExecuteDepositCode = False End If End If End If End If End Function

Function omlTaxAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,bPrev Dim nDeposit, nBaseAmt If Cbool(bDontExecuteDepositCode) = False Then If CInt(Fields("omlDepositCreated").Value) = False Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(Fields("omlExtendedPriceForeign").Value) If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeTaxInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + CDbl(Fields("omlTaxAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("omlSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value) End If If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeFrgtInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + Cdbl(Fields("omlFreightAmountForeign").Value) End If nDeposit = App.Round(CDbl(nBaseAmt) * (CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) / 100),2)
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositAmountForeign").Value) <> nDeposit Then bDontExecuteDepositCode = True Fields("omlDepositAmountForeign").Value = nDeposit bDontExecuteDepositCode = False End If Else Dim nAmount
nAmount = 0 nBaseAmt = CDbl(Fields("omlExtendedPriceForeign").Value) If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeTaxInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + CDbl(Fields("omlTaxAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("omlSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value) End If If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeFrgtInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + Cdbl(Fields("omlFreightAmountForeign").Value) End If nAmount = App.Round(CDbl(nBaseAmt),2)
If CDbl(nAmount) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("omlDepositAmountForeign").Value) / CDbl(nAmount) nPrice = nPrice * 100 nPrice = App.Round(nPrice,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If ' Added an extra check here due to rounding if the percent will be 100.01 to force it to 100 If nPrice >= 100.01 And nPrice <= 100.05 then nPrice = 100 End If
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) <> nPrice Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False bDontExecuteDepositCode = True Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value = nPrice App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev bDontExecuteDepositCode = False End If End If End If End If End Function
Function omlDepositAmountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice, nBaseAmt, bPrev If CInt(App.UpdatingCost) = False And Cbool(bDontExecuteDepositCode) = False Then nAmount = 0 nBaseAmt = CDbl(Fields("omlExtendedPriceBase").Value) If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeTaxInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + CDbl(Fields("omlTaxAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("omlSecondTaxAmountBase").Value) End If If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARIncludeFrgtInDepositCalc").Value) = True Then nBaseAmt = CDbl(nBaseAmt) + Cdbl(Fields("omlFreightAmountBase").Value) End If nAmount = App.Round(CDbl(nBaseAmt),2)
If CDbl(nAmount) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("omlDepositAmountBase").Value) / CDbl(nAmount) nPrice = nPrice * 100 nPrice = App.Round(nPrice,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If ' Added an extra check here due to rounding if the percent will be 100.01 to force it to 100 If nPrice = 100.01 then nPrice = 100 End If
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) <> nPrice Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False bDontExecuteDepositCode = True Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value = nPrice App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev bDontExecuteDepositCode = False End If
If CDbl(Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value) > 100 Then e.Cancel = "Deposit Percent cannot be greater than 100." Fields("omlDepositPercent").Value = 100 End If
End If End If End Function
Function omlDeliveryQuantityTotal_Valid(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("omlOrderQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("omlDeliveryQuantityTotal").Value) Then If CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapOMLineQuantityValidation").Value) = 1 Then e.AddWarning "Line order quantity does not equal the sum of the deliveries" + Chr(13) Else If CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapOMLineQuantityValidation").Value) = 2 Then e.AddError "Line order quantity does not equal the sum of the deliveries" + Chr(13) End If End If end if End Function
Function CalculateDiscountPercent() Dim nPrice nPrice = 0 If CDbl(Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> 0 and CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) / CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) nPrice = App.Round(nPrice * 100,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If End If CalculateDiscountPercent = nPrice End Function
Function omlUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 And App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMEnableDiscountFields").Value Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If Else If CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value) Then bPriceSetByCode = True Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value = Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value bPriceSetByCode = False End If End If End Function
Function omlFullUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("omlDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("omlDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If If CBool(bPriceSetByCode) = False Then Fields("omlPriceOverride").Value = True End If End Function
Function omlDiscountPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,nPercent
nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If nPercent <> CDbl(Fields("omlDiscountPercent").Value) Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("omlDiscountPercent").Value) / 100),5) If CDbl(Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If End If End Function
Function omlUnitDiscountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice 'nPrice = CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) 'If CDbl(Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then ' Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice 'End If If CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then
nPrice = CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("omlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("omlUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If
nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent()
If CDbl(Fields("omlDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("omlDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function omlFullUnitPriceBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("omlUnitDiscountBase").Value=App.Round(CDbl(Fields("omlFullUnitPriceBase").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("omlDiscountPercent").Value) / 100),5) End Function

Function SetJobAndStockQuantities(source) Dim rsParts If source = "PART" Then If Trim(Fields("jmmPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") 'rsParts.Open "select impBuyForInventory from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("jmmPartID").Value))), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText rsParts.Open "select top 1 * from ((select isnull(impBuyForInventory,0) as impBuyForInventory, isnull((case when isnull(impReorderMethod,0) = 0 then (case when isnull(imcReorderMethod,0) = 0 then 0 else imcReorderMethod end) else impReorderMethod end),0) as ReorderMethod, (select top 1 xapJMJobMaterialSource from ProductionProperties) as xapJMJobMaterialSource from parts left outer join PartClasses on impPartClassID = imcPartClassID where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("jmmPartID").Value))) + ") union all (select null, null, (select top 1 xapJMJobMaterialSource from ProductionProperties))) as query order by impBuyForInventory desc", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then 'If CInt(rsParts.Fields("impBuyForInventory").Value) = True Then If ( CInt(rsParts.Fields("impBuyForInventory").Value) = True or CInt(rsParts.Fields("ReorderMethod").Value) = 2 ) or ( CInt(rsParts.Fields("xapJMJobMaterialSource").Value) = 1 ) Then 'Buy for Inventory or Reorder Method Dynamic (or Job Material Source is PFS) Call PutToStockQuantity() Else Call PutToJobQuantity() End If End If rsParts.Close End If ElseIf source = "PULLALLFROMSTOCK" Then If CDbl(Fields("jmmPullAllFromStock").Value) <> 0 then Call PutToStockQuantity() Else Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsParts.Open "select isnull((case when isnull(impReorderMethod,0) = 0 then (case when isnull(imcReorderMethod,0) = 0 then 0 else imcReorderMethod end) else impReorderMethod end),0) as ReorderMethod from parts left outer join PartClasses on impPartClassID = imcPartClassID where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("jmmPartID").Value))), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsParts.Fields("ReorderMethod").Value) = 2 Then 'Reorder Method Dynamic and Purchase To Job not really compatible msgbox "This part has a reorder method of Dynamic. Dynamic parts are intended to be pulled from inventory, not purchased to a job. The Purchase Planner will not generate a purchase order for this material. If a job purchase order is required, it will need to be raised manually.",vbExclamation,"Purchase To Job not compatible with Dynamic parts" End If End If Call PutToJobQuantity() End If End If End Function

If bFound = False And nPackageID <> 0 Then ' Need to check details in box rsDetails.open "Select distinct spdShipmentLineID From ShipmentPackageDetails Where spdShipmentID =" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("spdShipmentID").Value)) & " And spdShipmentPackageID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(nPackageID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText Do While rsDetails.EOF = False cLines = cLines & "," & cstr(rsDetails.Fields("spdShipmentLineID").Value) rsDetails.MoveNext Loop
If cLines <> "" Then cLines = Mid(cLines, 2) End If If Trim(cLines) <> "" Then rsCustomerPO.Open "Select distinct ompCustomerPO from ShipmentLines Inner Join SalesOrders On smlSalesOrderID = ompSalesOrderID Where smlShipmentID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("spdShipmentID").Value)) & " And smlShipmentLineID In (" & Trim(cLines) & ") And ompCustomerPO <> '' Order By ompCustomerPO", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsCustomerPO.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsCustomerPO.Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value) = False Then cCustomerPO = Trim(rsCustomerPO.Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value) End If End If rsCustomerPO.Close End If
End If
GetCustomerPOForPackage = cCustomerPO
end function
function GetTotalBoxQuantityInPackageDetails(ByVal shipmentLineID) Dim currentBs, rows,spdBoxedQty
Set currentBs = Record.Table.BindingSource Set rows = currentBs.GetRecordset() spdBoxedQty=0
If rows.recordcount > 0 Then rows.movefirst Do While rows.Eof = False If Trim(Fields("spdShipmentID").Value)<>"" and Fields("spdShipmentLineID").Value=shipmentLineID then spdBoxedQty=spdBoxedQty+CDbl(rows.Fields("spdQuantity").Value) End If rows.movenext Loop End If Set rows = Nothing
GetTotalBoxQuantityInPackageDetails= spdBoxedQty end function

Function ARPaymentHeaders_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText,rsTemp cText = ""

If CDbl(Fields("artSecondTaxAmount").Value) <> 0 Then If Trim(Fields("artSecondTaxCodeID").Value) = "" Then cText = cText + "Second Tax ID is required when Second Tax Amount is non-zero" + Chr(13) End If End If

Function inbDefaultBin_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inbDefaultBin").Value) = True then If CBool(Fields("inbInactive").Value) = True then e.Cancel = "Cannot set an inactive bin to default" end if
If e.IsCurrentRow then Dim currentBs, rows Set currentBs = Record.Table.BindingSource Set rows = currentBs.GetRecordset()
If rows.recordcount > 0 Then rows.movefirst Do While rows.Eof = False if StrComp(rows.Fields("inbWarehouseBinID").Value,Fields("inbWarehouseBinID").Value) <> 0 then rows.Fields("inbDefaultBin").Value=False end if rows.movenext Loop End If end if end if End Function
Function inbInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inbDefaultBin").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("inbInactive").Value) = True then Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) set rsWarehouse = parentBs.Recordset.Select("imwWarehouseID = '" & Fields("inbWarehouseID").Value & "'") If rsWarehouse.RecordCount = 1 then If CBool(rsWarehouse.Fields("imwInactive").Value) = False then e.Cancel = "A different bin must be set as the default and the record SAVED before this bin can be set to inactive." End if End if end if End Function
Function WarehouseBins_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("inbInactive").Value) <> CBool(Fields("inbInactive").OriginalValue) And CBool(Fields("inbInactive").Value) = True Then ''set inactive warehouse bins for part revisions Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartBins SET imbDefaultBin = 0, imbInactiveBin = 1, imbInactiveBinDate = GETDATE() from PartBins inner join WarehouseBins on inbWarehouseID=imbWarehouseID and inbWarehouseBinID=imbPartBinID WHERE imbWarehouseID = "&App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("inbWarehouseID").Value)&" AND inbInactive = 1 AND imbInactiveBin = 0" Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions") Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartBins") else If CBool(Fields("inbDefaultBin").Value) <> CBool(Fields("inbDefaultBin").OriginalValue) And CBool(Fields("inbDefaultBin").Value) = True Then Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions") Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartBins") end if end if
End Function

Function GetAmount(e) Dim parentBs, nAmount Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) nAmount = App.Round(parentBs.Fields("arpTotalForSalesCommission").Value * (Fields("arjRate").Value / 100),2) + parentBs.Fields("arpLineCommissionTotal").Value GetAmount = CDbl(App.Round(nAmount * (Fields("arjPercent").Value / 100),2)) End Function
Sub CalculateAmount(e) Dim nAmount nAmount = GetAmount(e) If nAmount <> CDbl(Fields("arjAmount").Value) Then Fields("arjAmount").Value = nAmount End If End Sub
Function arjRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call CalculateAmount(e) End Function
Function arjSalesEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = Fields("arjSalesEmployeeID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("lmeCommissionRate") If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("arjRate").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmeCommissionRate").Value Else Fields("arjRate").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function arjAmount_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim parentBs, nLineAmount, nEnteredAmount, nAmountForSales, nNewRate If GetAmount(e) <> CDbl(Fields("arjAmount").Value) then Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) nLineAmount = CDbl(App.Round(parentBs.Fields("arpLineCommissionTotal").Value * (Fields("arjPercent").Value / 100),2)) nEnteredAmount = CDbl(Fields("arjAmount").Value) - nLineAmount nAmountForSales = App.Round(parentBs.Fields("arpTotalForSalesCommission").Value * (Fields("arjPercent").Value / 100),2) If Cdbl(nAmountForSales) = 0 Then Fields("arjAmount").Value = 0 Else nNewRate = App.Round((nEnteredAmount / nAmountForSales) * 100,2) If nNewRate <> CDbl(Fields("arjRate").Value) Then Fields("arjRate").Value = nNewRate End If End If End If End Function
Function arjPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call CalculateAmount(e) End Function

Function RFQSuppliers_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsRFQs Set rsRFQs= CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsRFQs.Open "select rqpDueDate from RFQs where rqpRFQID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rqsRFQID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRFQs.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsRFQs.Fields("rqpDueDate").Value) = False Then Fields("rqsDueDate").Value = rsRFQs.Fields("rqpDueDate").Value End If End If rsRFQs.Close End Function
Function RFQSuppliers_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsTemp,dOldDate,dNewDate,nDiff dOldDate = Null dNewDate = Null Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT rqpRFQDate FROM RFQs INNER JOIN RFQSuppliers ON rqpRFQID = rqsRFQID WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " GROUP BY rqpRFQDate",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then dOldDate = rsTemp.Fields("rqpRFQDate").Value End If rsTemp.Close rsTemp.Open "SELECT rqpRFQDate FROM RFQs INNER JOIN RFQSuppliers ON rqpRFQID = rqsRFQID WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " GROUP BY rqpRFQDate",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then dNewDate = rsTemp.Fields("rqpRFQDate").Value End If rsTemp.Close
If IsNull(dOldDate) = False And IsNull(dNewDate) = False Then nDiff = DateDiff("d",dOldDate,dNewDate) Else nDiff = 0 End If Connection.Execute "UPDATE RFQSuppliers SET rqsDueDate = DateAdd(dd," + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nDiff) + ", rqsDueDate) WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function rqsPurchaseLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("rqsSupplierOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlPurchaseContactID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rqsSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rqsPurchaseLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("rqsPurchaseContactID").Value) <> Trim(oRs.Fields("cmlPurchaseContactID").Value) Then Fields("rqsPurchaseContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlPurchaseContactID").Value End If End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function rqsSupplierOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("rqsSupplierOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmoPurchaseContactID,cmoCurrencyRateID, cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rqsSupplierOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("rqsPurchaseContactID").Value) <> Trim(oRs.Fields("cmoPurchaseContactID").Value) Then Fields("rqsPurchaseContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoPurchaseContactID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("rqsPurchaseLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oRs.Fields("cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID").Value) Then Fields("rqsPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID").Value End If Fields("rqsCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoCurrencyRateID").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function

Function glkGLAccountID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("glkGLAccountID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("glkGLFiscalYearID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select glkBudgetHeaderID from GLFiscalYearBudgetHeaders where glkGLFiscalYearID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("glkGLFiscalYearID").Value) & " and glkGLAccountID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("glkGLAccountID").Value) & " And glkBudgetHeaderID <> " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("glkBudgetHeaderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "Account " & Trim(Fields("glkGLAccountID").Value) & " already has a budget for year " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("glkGLFiscalYearID").Value) & "." End If End If End Function

Function DMRClaimLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE InspectionLines Set qalTransferredToDmr = 0 WHERE qalInspectionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlInspectionID").Value) + " And qalInspectionLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("dmlInspectionLineID").Value) End Function
Function dmlPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData,rsClaim,nValue, nConv,rsRef,cPurUM,cInvUM,cCurrency,dClaimDate Dim cSupplier,cLocation,bKitPart bKitPart = False If Trim(Fields("dmlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrConversionFactor,imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,impPhantomOrKitPart from PartRevisions Inner Join Parts on imrPartID=impPartID where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("dmlPartShortDescription").Value = rsData.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("dmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").value = rsData.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value nConv = rsData.fields("imrConversionFactor").Value cPurUM = rsData.Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value cInvUM = rsData.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMEasure").Value bKitPart = rsData.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value
Set rsClaim = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsClaim.Open "SELECT dmpSupplierOrganizationID,dmpPurchaseLocationID,dmpCurrencyRateID,dmpClaimDate FROM DMRClaims WHERE dmpDMRClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlDMRClaimID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsClaim.EOF = False Then cSupplier = rsClaim.Fields("dmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value cLocation = rsClaim.fields("dmpPurchaseLocationID").Value cCurrency = rsClaim.fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value dClaimDate = rsClaim.fields("dmpClaimDate").Value Else cSupplier = "" cLocation = "" cCurrency = "" Set dClaimDate = Nothing End If
Set rsRef = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsRef.Open "select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor from PartCrossReferences where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cSupplier ) + " And imxLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cLocation ),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRef.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nConv = CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) End If If Trim(rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) <> "" Then cPurUM = rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value End If Else rsRef.Close rsRef.Open "select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor from PartCrossReferences where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cSupplier ) + " And imxLocationID = ''",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRef.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nConv = CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) End If If Trim(rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) <> "" Then cPurUM = rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value End If End If End If rsRef.Close Fields("dmlUnitOfMeasure").Value = cPurUM Fields("dmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = cInvUM If cdbl(nConv) = 0 Then nConv = 1 End If Fields("dmlConversionFactor").Value = nConv If rsClaim.EOF = False Then Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("dmlPartID").Value,Fields("dmlPartRevisionID").Value,cSupplier ,cLocation ,Fields("dmlInventoryQuantity").Value,"MATERIAL",cCurrency,dClaimDate,Fields("dmlQuantity").Value) nValue = 0 If IsNull(priceObj) = False Then nValue = priceObj.FullPrice End If Set priceObj = nothing
If Cdbl(nValue) > 0 Then If CDbl(nValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dmlUnitCost").Value) Then Fields("dmlUnitCost").Value = nValue End If End If End If rsClaim.Close Else Fields("dmlConversionFactor").Value = 1 End If rsData.Close End If Fields("dmlKitPart").Value = bKitPart End Function
Function dmlQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData,rsClaim,nValue,nConvFactor,nNewValue If Trim(Fields("dmlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsClaim = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsClaim.Open "SELECT dmpSupplierOrganizationID,dmpPurchaseLocationID,dmpCurrencyRateID,dmpClaimDate FROM DMRClaims WHERE dmpDMRClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dmlDMRClaimID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsClaim.EOF = False Then Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("dmlPartID").Value,Fields("dmlPartRevisionID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("dmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("dmpPurchaseLocationID").Value,Fields("dmlInventoryQuantity").Value,"MATERIAL",rsClaim.Fields("dmpCurrencyRateID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("dmpClaimDate").Value,Fields("dmlQuantity").Value) nValue = 0 If IsNull(priceObj) = False Then nValue = priceObj.FullPrice End If Set priceObj = nothing
If Cdbl(nValue) > 0 Then If CDbl(nValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dmlUnitCost").Value) Then Fields("dmlUnitCost").Value = nValue If Record.EntryMode <> ".NET" Then Fields("dmlExtendedCost").value = nValue * cdbl(Fields("dmlQuantity").value) End If End If End If End If rsClaim.Close End If If CDbl(Fields("dmlQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("dmlConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 And Trim(Fields("dmlUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("dmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConfFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("dmlQuantity").Value) / CDbl(nConvFactor), App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals) ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If CDbl(nNewValue) <> CDbl(Fields("dmlInventoryQuantity").Value) Then Fields("dmlInventoryQuantity").Value = nNewValue End If End If End If End Function
Function dmlPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Trim(Fields("dmlPartID").Value), e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(Trim(Fields("dmlPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("dmlPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("dmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value), Trim(Fields("dmlPartBinID").Value), e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("dmlPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("dmlPartRevisionID").Value) + "', Warehouse '" + Trim(Fields("dmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) + "', Bin '" + Trim(Fields("dmlPartBinID").Value) + "' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." End If End If End Function

Function RFQs_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("rqpDueDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("rqpDueDate").OriginalValue) = False Then If Fields("rqpDueDate").Value <> Fields("rqpDueDate").OriginalValue Then ' Update date on details that have the same date as the header. Connection.Execute "UPDATE RFQSuppliers SET rqsDueDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Fields("rqpDueDate").Value) + " WHERE rqsRFQID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rqpRFQID").Value) + " AND rqsDueDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Fields("rqpDueDate").OriginalValue) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If End If End Function
Function RFQs_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE RFQs SET rqpDueDate = DateAdd(dd,DateDiff(dd,rqpRFQDate,rqpDueDate),{fn curdate()}) WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function rqpClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("rqpClosed").Value) = True Then Fields("rqpClosedDate").Value = Date Fields("rqpReadyToPrint").Value = False Else Fields("rqpClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function

Function lmrPayFrequency_ValueChanged(sender, e) Select Case CInt(Fields("lmrPayFrequency").Value) Case 1: Fields("lmrStandardHours").Value = 8 Case 2: Fields("lmrStandardHours").Value = 40 End Select End Function
Function lmrCalculationType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("lmrCalculationType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("lmrStartDayOfWeek").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("lmrCalculationType").Value) = 2 Or CInt(Fields("lmrCalculationType").Value) = 3 Then Fields("lmrCalcBeforeShift").Value = 0 End If If Record.EntryMode = ".NET" Then Dim childBs Dim childRs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PayrollOvertimeWeeks") If CInt(Fields("lmrCalculationType").Value = 1) Or CInt(Fields("lmrCalculationType").Value) = 4 Then childBs.SetRowCount(7) Set childRs = childBs.GetRecordset() If childRs.RecordCount > 0 Then childRs.MoveFirst() Dim nCount nCount = 0 Do While childRs.EOF = False nCount = nCount + 1 childRs.Fields("lmwDayOfWeek").Value = nCount childRs.MoveNext Loop End If Else childBs.SetRowCount(1) Set childRs = childBs.GetRecordset() If childRs.RecordCount > 0 Then childRs.MoveFirst() childRs.Fields("lmwDayOfWeek").Value = 0 End If End If End If End Function
Function lmrTotalHours_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("lmrTotalHours").Value = 0 Then e.AddError "Total Standard/Overtime hours cannot be zero in the Overtime Info table" End If End Function
Function lmrInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("lmrInactive").Value) = True Then Dim cErrorMessage Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select distinct patPayrollSessionID, pasPostedToGL From PayrollHeaders inner join PayrollSessions on patPayrollSessionID = pasPayrollSessionID Where pasPostedToGL = 0 and patPayrollDefinitionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmrPayrollDefinitionID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If Not rsData.EOF Then cErrorMessage = "This payroll definition is used in " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " unposted Payroll Session(s)" + chr(13) + "" End If rsData.Open "Select lmeTerminationDate, lmeEmployeeID From Employees inner join EmployeePersonalData on lmeEmployeeID = lmdEmployeeID Where lmeTerminationDate IS NULL and lmdPayrollDefinitionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmrPayrollDefinitionID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If Not rsData.EOF Then cErrorMessage = cErrorMessage + "This payroll definition is used in " + Trim(CStr(rsData.RecordCount)) + " current Employee(s)" End If rsData.Close If cErrorMessage <> "" then e.Cancel = cErrorMessage Exit Function End If Fields("lmrInactiveDate").Value = Date Else Fields("lmrInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function

Function Form940Years_GetNextID(sender, e) Dim rsTemp, nLastYearID nLastYearID = 0 Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT TOP 1 pfyForm940YearID FROM Form940Years ORDER BY pfyForm940YearID DESC", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("pfyForm940YearID").Value) = False Then nLastYearID = rsTemp.Fields("pfyForm940YearID").Value End If End If rsTemp.Close
If CInt(nLastYearID) = 0 Then nLastYearID = Year(Date) End If
If CBool(App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("MP")) = True Then If msgbox("Do you want to increment to the next Form 940 Year to " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSQL(nLastYearID + 1)) + "? ", vbExclamation + vbYesNo, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm Close")) = vbNo Then e.Value = nLastYearID Else e.Value = nLastYearID + 1 End If Else e.Value = nLastYearID + 1 End If
End Function

Function pamIncomeTaxTableID_Valid(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("pamIncomeTaxTableID").Value) <> "" And CBool(Fields("pamInactive")) = False Then Dim rsTaxRevision Dim rsEmployeeIncomeTax Dim cRelatedTaxID Dim cRelatedTaxTypeID
Set rsTaxRevision = createobject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTaxRevision.Open "Select Top 1 parRelatedIncomeTaxID, parRelatedIncomeTaxTypeID, parCalculationMethod From IncomeTaxTableRevisions Where parIncomeTaxID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxID").Value) + " And parIncomeTaxTypeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxTypeID").Value) + " And parIncomeTaxTableID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxTableID").Value) + " And parCalculationMethod = 4 Order By parStartDate Desc", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTaxRevision.EOF = False Then ' Current changed income tax is percent of tax. cRelatedTaxID = Trim(rsTaxRevision.Fields("parRelatedIncomeTaxID").Value) cRelatedTaxTypeID = Trim(rsTaxRevision.Fields("parRelatedIncomeTaxTypeID").Value) Set rsEmployeeIncomeTax = createobject("ADODB.Recordset") rsEmployeeIncomeTax.Open "Select pamEmployeeIncomeTaxID From EmployeeIncomeTaxes Where pamEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("pamEmployeeID").Value)) + " And pamIncomeTaxID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cRelatedTaxID) + " And pamIncomeTaxTypeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cRelatedTaxTypeID) + " and pamInactive = 0 ", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsEmployeeIncomeTax.EOF = True Then 'EOF = True = related tax not in employee file Call e.AddError("Related Tax of " + cRelatedTaxID + " Type " + cRelatedTaxTypeID + " needs to be added before adding current income tax because it is a related tax.") End If rsEmployeeIncomeTax.Close End If rsTaxRevision.Close End If End Function
Function pamIncomeTaxTypeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("pamExpenseGLAccountID").Value = "" If Trim(Fields("pamIncomeTaxTypeID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select pafExpenseGLAccountID From IncomeTaxTypes Where pafIncomeTaxID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxID").Value) + " And pafIncomeTaxTypeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxTypeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("pamExpenseGLAccountID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("pafExpenseGLAccountID").Value End If rsTemp.Close
rsTemp.Open "Select pazIncomeTaxTableID From IncomeTaxTables Where pazIncomeTaxID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxID").Value) + " And pazIncomeTaxTypeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxTypeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.RecordCount = 1 Then Fields("pamIncomeTaxTableID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("pazIncomeTaxTableID").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function pamInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("pamInactive").Value) = True Then Fields("pamInactiveDate").Value = Date Else Fields("pamInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function pamInactive_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("pamInactive")) then Dim rsTaxRevision Dim cIncomeTax Dim cIncomeTaxType Dim cIncomeTaxTable
Set rsTaxRevision = createobject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTaxRevision.Open "Select pamIncomeTaxID, pamIncomeTaxTypeID, pamIncomeTaxTableID From EmployeeIncomeTaxes inner join IncomeTaxTableRevisions on pamIncomeTaxID = parIncomeTaxID and pamIncomeTaxTypeID = parIncomeTaxTypeID and pamIncomeTaxTableID = parIncomeTaxTableID Where pamEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamEmployeeID").Value) + " And parRelatedIncomeTaxID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxID").Value) + " And parRelatedIncomeTaxTypeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pamIncomeTaxTypeID").Value) + " And parCalculationMethod = 4 And pamInactive = 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTaxRevision.EOF = False Then cIncomeTax = Trim(rsTaxRevision.Fields("pamIncomeTaxID").Value) cIncomeTaxType = Trim(rsTaxRevision.Fields("pamIncomeTaxTypeID").Value) cIncomeTaxTable = Trim(rsTaxRevision.Fields("pamIncomeTaxTableID").Value) Call e.AddError("The current Income Tax is used as a related tax for Tax " + cIncomeTax + " Type " + cIncomeTaxType + " Table " + cIncomeTaxTable + ". It cannot be set to inactive.") End If rsTaxRevision.Close End If End Function
Function pamWithholdingCalculationType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("pamWithholdingCalculationType").Value) = 2 then Fields("pamPersonalExemptions").Value = 0 Fields("pamDependentExemptions").Value = 0 Fields("pamAdditionalTaxAmount").Value = 0 Else Fields("pamDependentAmount").Value = 0 Fields("pamOtherIncomeAmount").Value = 0 Fields("pamOtherDeductionsAmount").Value = 0 Fields("pamExtraWithholdingAmount").Value = 0 end if End Function

Function pajLeaveType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("pajLeaveType").Value) <> "L" then Fields("pajIncludeUnpaidTimeOffInCalc").Value = False end if End Function

If rsContractData.EOF = False Then Fields("KbnContractLength").Value = rsContractData.Fields("impContractLength").Value Fields("kbnContractLengthType").Value = rsContractData.Fields("impContractLengthType").Value End If End If End Function
Function kbnPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("kbnPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select imrShortDescription from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbnPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbnPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("kbnPartShortDescription").Value = rsData.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function kbnSerialNumberID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData,bPrev,cSerial If Trim(Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value) <> "" Then cSerial = Trim(Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value) Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If Trim(Fields("kbnPartID").Value) = "" Then rsData.Open "select imsPartID, imsPartRevisionID From SerialNumbers Where imsSerialNumberID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value) + " Order By imsStatus",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("kbnPartID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartID").Value Fields("kbnPartRevisionID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartRevisionID").Value Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value = cSerial App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev Else e.Cancel = "Serial Number " + Trim(Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value) + " does not exist in the SerialNumbers table" End If rsData.Close Else rsData.Open "select imsPartID, imsPartRevisionID From SerialNumbers Where imsSerialNumberID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value) + " And imsPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbnPartID").Value) + " And imsPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbnPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = True Then rsData.Close rsData.Open "select imsPartID, imsPartRevisionID From SerialNumbers Where imsSerialNumberID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value) + " Order By imsStatus",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("kbnPartID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartID").Value Fields("kbnPartRevisionID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartRevisionID").Value Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value = cSerial App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev Else e.Cancel = "Serial Number " + Trim(Fields("kbnSerialNumberID").Value) + " does not exist in the SerialNumbers table" End If End If rsData.Close End If End If End Function

Function kbnContractLengthType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("kbnContractLength").Value) > 0 Then If Trim(Fields("kbnContractLengthType").Value) <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("kbnStartDate").Value) = False Then Fields("kbnEndDate").Value = App.DateAddByContractType(Fields("kbnStartDate").Value,Fields("kbnContractLength").Value,Fields("kbnContractLengthType").Value) End If End If End If End Function

Function xalFileName_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("xalFileName").Value) <> "" Then Dim nPos,cFile,cLocation,oFS cFile = "" cLocation = Trim(Fields("xalFileName").Value)
Set oFS = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") If oFS.FileExists(cLocation) = False Then e.Cancel = "File " + cLocation + " not found" Else cFile = oFS.GetFileName(cLocation) nPos = InstrRev(cFile,".") If nPos > 0 Then cFile = Mid(cFile,1,nPos-1) End If Fields("xalDescription").Value = cFile End If Set oFS = Nothing End If End Function

Function PartRevisions_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select impShortDescription,impLongDescriptionRTF,impLongDescriptionText from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("imrShortDescription").Value = rsTemp.Fields("impShortDescription").Value Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value = rsTemp.Fields("impLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value = rsTemp.Fields("impLongDescriptionText").Value End If rsTemp.Close End Function
Function PartRevisions_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").PartRevisionQuantitiesConcurrencyCheck(Record.Table.BindingSource)) = false then Call MsgBox("Record cannot be saved as there is a discrepancy between the part revision quantities in the database and those currently displayed.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = true Exit Function End If
If IsPartRevCostUpdated() = True then Call App.Ax("Part").AddCostsUpdatesTransaction(Record.Table.BindingSource, Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction) If CInt(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value)=True And Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value <> 0 Then Call App.Ax("Part").CreatePartCostsJournals(Record.Table.BindingSource,Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction) End IF End If If Trim(Fields("imrShortDescription").Value) <> Trim(Fields("imrShortDescription").OriginalValue) Or _ App.TrimNull(Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value) <> App.TrimNull(Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").OriginalValue) Or _ App.TrimNull(Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value) <> App.TrimNull(Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").OriginalValue) Or _ App.TrimNull(Fields("imrProductionNotesRTF").Value) <> App.TrimNull(Fields("imrProductionNotesRTF").OriginalValue) Or _ App.TrimNull(Fields("imrProductionNotesText").Value) <> App.TrimNull(Fields("imrProductionNotesText").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) <> Trim(Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("imrDocuments").Value) <> Trim(Fields("imrDocuments").OriginalValue) Then
Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartAssemblies SET imaPartShortDescription=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imrShortDescription").Value)) & ", imaPartLongDescriptionRTF=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value) & ", imaPartLongDescriptionText=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value) & ", imaProductionNotesRTF=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrProductionNotesRTF").Value) & ", imaProductionNotesText=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrProductionNotesText").Value) & ", imaDocuments=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrDocuments").Value) & ", imaUnitOfMeasure=" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value)) & " WHERE imaPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imrPartID").Value)) & " AND imaPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value)) & " AND imaMethodAssemblyID <> 0 AND imaUseMethod = 1" End If End Function
Function PartRevisions_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) ' Copy data in duplicate fields to PartAssemblies table Dim oRs Dim cWarehouse Dim bNettable Dim cBin Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT * FROM PartAssemblies WHERE imaMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartID").Value) + " AND imaMethodRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) + " AND imaMethodAssemblyID = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then 'msgbox "Updating Assembly" Else 'msgbox "Adding empty assembly" oRs.AddNew App.BlankRecord oRs End If oRs.Fields("imaMethodID").Value = Fields("imrPartID").Value oRs.Fields("imaMethodRevisionID").Value = Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value oRs.Fields("imaMethodAssemblyID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("imaLevel").Value = 1 oRs.Fields("imaParentAssemblyID").Value = 0 oRs.Fields("imaPartID").Value = Fields("imrPartID").Value oRs.Fields("imaPartRevisionID").Value = Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value oRs.Fields("imaUnitOfMeasure").Value = Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value oRs.Fields("imaPartShortDescription").Value = Fields("imrShortDescription").Value oRs.Fields("imaPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value oRs.Fields("imaPartLongDescriptionText").Value = Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value oRs.Fields("imaProductionNotesRTF").Value = Fields("imrProductionNotesRTF").Value oRs.Fields("imaProductionNotesText").Value = Fields("imrProductionNotesText").Value oRs.Fields("imaDocuments").Value = Fields("imrDocuments").Value oRs.Fields("imaQuantityPerParent").Value = 1
oRs.UpdateBatch oRs.Close If Not ISNull(e) And e.UpdateType = 1 Then ' Insert Call CreateDefaultPartBinRecords(sender, e) Call CreateDefaultPartWarehouseLocationRecords(sender, e)
' Refresh allocations and on-order for new parts created that may have existing allocations/orders Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, Fields("imrPartID").Value, Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshOnOrderQuantitesPurchases(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, Fields("imrPartID").Value, Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshOnOrderQuantitesSales(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, Fields("imrPartID").Value, Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(1) End If
' Delete Part Warehouse locations not binding to Part Bins Dim rsBins Dim sValidWarehouses, sNotInWarehouseList
Set strValidWarehouses = CreateObject("System.Collections.ArrayList") Set rsBins = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartBins").Recordset.Select("") Do While rsBins.EOF = false strValidWarehouses.Add "Fields(" & chr(34) & "imlPartWarehouseID" & chr(34) & ") <> " & chr(34) & rsBins.Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value & chr(34) rsBins.MoveNext() Loop rsBins.Close
If strValidWarehouses.Count > 0 Then sNotInWarehouseList = join(strValidWarehouses.ToArray(), " And ") Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartWarehouseLocations").RemoveWhere(sNotInWarehouseList) End If End Function
Function PartRevisions_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartWarehouseLocations WHERE imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartID").Value) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value)

Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartAlternates WHERE imePartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartID").Value) + " And imePartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PartAlternates WHERE imeAlternatePartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartID").Value) + " And imeAlternatePartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value)
