Function PartRevisions_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsTemp,cNewFormID Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT imrFormID,imrPartID,imrPartRevisionID FROM PartRevisions WHERE " + aWhere(0),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText Do While rsTemp.EOF = False If Trim(rsTemp.Fields("imrFormID").Value) <> "" Then cNewFormID = App.Ax("PartFunctions").GenerateFormIDForPart(rsTemp.Fields("imrPartID").Value,rsTemp.Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").CopyFormDefinitions(rsTemp.Fields("imrFormID").Value,cNewFormID) Connection.Execute "Update PartRevisions Set imrFormID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cNewFormID) + " Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsTemp.Fields("imrPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsTemp.Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) End If rsTemp.MoveNext Loop rsTemp.Close
Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartRevisions SET imrQuantityOnHand = 0, imrQuantityAllocated = 0, imrQuantityToInspect = 0, imrQuantityToReturn = 0, imrQuantityToReturnJob = 0, imrLastReceiptDate = Null, imrUniversalProductCode = '',imrQuantityOnOrderSales = 0, imrQuantityOnOrderPurchases = 0 WHERE " + aWhere(0) Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartAssemblies SET imaPartID = imrPartID, imaPartRevisionID = imrPartRevisionID From PartAssemblies Inner Join PartRevisions On imaMethodID = imrPartID And imaMethodRevisionID = imrPartRevisionID WHERE imaMethodAssemblyID = 0 And " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function imrPurchaseLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim bExists bExists = False If Trim(Fields("imrSupplierOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor From PartCrossReferences Where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " And imxLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imrPurchaseLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsData.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("imrConversionFactor").Value = rsData.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value bExists = True End If rsData.Close End If Fields("imrPreferredRefExists").Value = bExists End Function
Function PartRevisions_Valid(sender, e) If Record.EditMode = adEditAdd Then If App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("AB") = False Then If Record.Table.GetChildRowCountForParent() > 1 Then Call e.AddError("This record may not be created unless the ABOM module is purchased") End If End If End If
If Record.Table.ChildBindingSourceExists("PartBins") = True Then Set binrs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartBins").Recordset.Select("") If binrs.recordcount = 0 Then If Cbool(App.Props("ProductionProperties").Fields("xapIMAutoCreateRevision").Value) = False Then e.AddError "Part bin data must be entered - Click Add in the Warehouse Info section" End If End If Set binrs = Nothing End If End Function
Function imrExpenseSplitPercentTotal_Valid(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("imrExpenseSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 0 And CDbl(Fields("imrExpenseSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 100 Then Call e.AddError("The percentages for the expense accounts listed do not total 100%") End If End Function
Function CreateDefaultPartWarehouseLocationRecords(sender, e) Dim cWarehouseId,cPartId,cPartRevisionId Dim WHBs, binBs
cPartId = Fields("imrPartID").Value cPartRevisionId = Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value cWarehouseId = ""
Set binBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartBins").Recordset.Select("") If binBs.RecordCount = 1 Then cWarehouseId = binBs.Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value End If
If cWarehouseId <> "" then Set WHBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartWarehouseLocations") If WHBs.Count = 0 Then Set row = WHBs.AddNewAsRs() row.Fields("imlPartID").Value = Fields("imrPartID").Value row.Fields("imlPartRevisionID").Value = Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value row.Fields("imlPartWarehouseID").Value = cWarehouseId row.Fields("imlLastRunDatePurchasePlanner").Value = Date() row.Fields("imlCreatedBy").Value = App.UserID row.Fields("imlCreatedDate").Value = Now End If End If End Function
Function CreateDefaultPartBinRecords(sender, e) Dim cWarehouseId,cBinId,cPartId,cPartRevisionId Dim PBBs
cPartId = Fields("imrPartID").Value cPartRevisionId = Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value cWarehouseId = Trim(App.Ax("Part").GetDefaultWarehouse(App.Ax("Production").PlantID, Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction)) cBinId=Trim(App.Ax("Part").GetDefaultWarehouseBin(cWarehouseId,Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction))
If cWarehouseId <> "" And cBinId <> "" then Set PBBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartBins").Recordset.Select("") If PBBs.RecordCount = 0 Then set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PartBins") Set row = childBs.AddNewAsRs() row.Fields("imbPartID").Value = cPartId row.Fields("imbPartRevisionID").Value = cPartRevisionId row.Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value = cWarehouseId row.Fields("imbPartBinID").Value = cBinId row.Fields("imbConversionFactor").Value = 1 row.Fields("imbCreatedBy").Value = App.UserID row.Fields("imbCreatedDate").Value = Now End If Set PBBs = Nothing end if End Function
Function imrPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imrPartID").Value) <> "" Then Call CreateDefaultPartBinRecords(sender, e) Call CreateDefaultPartWarehouseLocationRecords(sender, e) End If End Function

Fields("imrStandardOverheadCost").OriginalValue Or _ Fields("imrStandardMaterialCost").Value <> Fields("imrStandardMaterialCost").OriginalValue Or _ Fields("imrStandardSubcontractCost").Value <> If Trim(Fields("payPayType").Value) = "O" Or Trim(Fields("payPayType").Value) = "B" Or Trim(Fields("payPayType").Value) = "R" Then Fields("payAccrueRDO").Value = False End If
If Trim(Fields("payPayType").Value) = "S" Or Trim(Fields("payPayType").Value) = "O" Or Trim(Fields("payPayType").Value) = "B" Or Trim(Fields("payPayType").Value) = "D" Then Fields("payLeaveType").Value = "" End If End Function

Function dsoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsParts
If CBool(Fields("dsoDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("dsoPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("dsoPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("dsoDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("dsoUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End if End Function
Function dsoInvQuantityShipped_Valid(sender, e) call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("dsoInvQuantityShipped").Value, Fields("dsoInvQuantityShipped").Caption, e) End Function
Function dsoReturnQuantityShipped_Valid(sender, e) call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("dsoReturnQuantityShipped").Value, Fields("dsoReturnQuantityShipped").Caption, e) End Function
Function dsoJobMatQuantityShipped_Valid(sender, e) call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("dsoJobMatQuantityShipped").Value, Fields("dsoJobMatQuantityShipped").Caption, e) End Function
Function validateNegativeQuantities(quantity, fieldCaption, e) If cdbl(quantity) < 0 And CBool(Fields("dsoDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError trim(fieldCaption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function dsoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("dsoPosted").Value = True or CBool(Fields("dsoDMRShipmentID").Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = True then Exit Function end if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("dsoPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(Fields("dsoPartID").Value, Fields("dsoPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("dsoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value, Fields("dsoPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddError "Part ID '"&Fields("dsoPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("dsoPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse '"&Fields("dsoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin '"&Fields("dsoPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." , True End If End If End Function

Function GLJournals_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("glpPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("GL").GLJournalPostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("glpGLJournalID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True End If Exit Function End If End Function
Function GLJournals_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("glpPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("GL").GLJournalPostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("glpGLJournalID").Value)) = True Then e.Cancel = True Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If Exit Function End If End Function
Function GLJournals_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim nYear,nPeriod nYear = 0 nPeriod = 0 If App.Ax("GLFunctions").GetYearAndPeriod(Date(),"GL",nYear,nPeriod) = True Then End If Connection.Execute "UPDATE GLJournals SET glpGLFiscalYearID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nYear) + ", glpGLFiscalYearPeriodID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nPeriod) + " WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function GLJournals_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText,rsTemp cText = "" If CDbl(Fields("glpTotalDebits").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("glpTotalCredits").Value) Then cText = cText + "Journal is out of balance" + Chr(13) End If e.AddError cText End Function
Function glpTransactionDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim info If IsNull(Fields("glpTransactionDate").Value) = False Then Set info = App.Ax("Financial").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("glpTransactionDate").Value,"GL",False) If info.Success Then Fields("glpGLFiscalYearID").Value = info.Year Fields("glpGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value = info.Period Else 'Fields("glpTransactionDate").Value = Null End If End If End Function
Function glpDescription_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim parentBs Dim rsLines Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("GLJournalLines") If parentBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsLines = parentBs.GetRecordset()
rsLines.MoveFirst While Not rsLines.EOF If Trim(rsLines.Fields("gllDescription").Value) = Trim(e.PreviousValue) Then rsLines.Fields("gllDescription").Value = Fields("glpDescription").Value End If rslines.MoveNext() wend
End If End Function
Function glpReference_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim parentBs Dim rsLines Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("GLJournalLines") If parentBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsLines = parentBs.GetRecordset()
rsLines.MoveFirst While Not rsLines.EOF If Trim(rsLines.Fields("gllReference").Value) = Trim(e.PreviousValue) Then rsLines.Fields("gllReference").Value = Fields("glpReference").Value End If rslines.MoveNext() wend
End If End Function
Function glpTransactionDate_Valid(sender, e) Dim info If fields("glpPosted").Value = False Then If IsNull(Fields("glpTransactionDate").Value) = False Then Set info = App.Ax("Financial").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("glpTransactionDate").Value,"GL",False) If info.Success = False Then Call e.AddError(info.Message) End If End If End If End Function

Function kbsStartDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("kbsContractLength").Value) > 0 Then If Trim(Fields("kbsContractLengthType").Value) <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("kbsStartDate").Value) = False Then Fields("kbsEndDate").Value = App.DateAddByContractType(Fields("kbsStartDate").Value,Fields("kbsContractLength").Value,Fields("kbsContractLengthType").Value) End If End If End If End Function
Function kbsOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("kbsOrganizationID").Value) <> "" And Record.EditMode = adEditAdd Then ' Get previous contract for this org. Dim rsData,nDays Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select top 1 kbsDescription,kbsStartDate,kbsEndDate,kbsContractAmount from ServiceContracts Where kbsOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsOrganizationID").Value) + " Order By kbsEndDate Desc",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("kbsDescription").Value) = "" Then Fields("kbsDescription").Value = rsData.Fields("kbsDescription").Value End If If CDbl(Fields("kbsContractAmount").Value) = 0 Then Fields("kbsContractAmount").Value = rsData.Fields("kbsContractAmount").Value End If If IsNull(Fields("kbsStartDate").Value) = True And IsNull(rsData.Fields("kbsEndDate").Value) = False Then ' Set the start date to the previous end date plus 1. Fields("kbsStartDate").Value = DateAdd("d",1,rsData.Fields("kbsEndDate").Value) If IsNull(rsData.Fields("kbsStartDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("kbsEndDate").Value) = True Then ' Set the end date to the start date plus the number of days of the previous contract. nDays = DateDiff("d",rsData.Fields("kbsStartDate").Value,rsData.Fields("kbsEndDate").Value) ' This is to handle leap years. If nDays = 364 Or nDays = 365 Then Fields("kbsEndDate").Value = DateAdd("d",-1,DateAdd("yyyy",1,Fields("kbsStartDate").Value)) Else Fields("kbsEndDate").Value = DateAdd("d",nDays,Fields("kbsStartDate").Value) End If End If End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function kbsSerialNumberID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData,bPrev,cSerial If Trim(Fields("kbsSerialNumberID").Value) <> "" Then cSerial = Trim(Fields("kbsSerialNumberID").Value) Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If Trim(Fields("kbsPartID").Value) = "" Then rsData.Open "select imsPartID, imsPartRevisionID From SerialNumbers Where imsSerialNumberID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsSerialNumberID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("kbsPartID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartID").Value Fields("kbsPartRevisionID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartRevisionID").Value Fields("kbsSerialNumberID").Value = cSerial App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End If rsData.Close Else rsData.Open "select imsPartID, imsPartRevisionID From SerialNumbers Where imsSerialNumberID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsSerialNumberID").Value) + " And imsPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsPartID").Value) + " And imsPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = True Then rsData.Close rsData.Open "select imsPartID, imsPartRevisionID From SerialNumbers Where imsSerialNumberID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsSerialNumberID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("kbsPartID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartID").Value Fields("kbsPartRevisionID").Value = rsData.Fields("imsPartRevisionID").Value Fields("kbsSerialNumberID").Value = cSerial App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End If End If rsData.Close End If End If End Function
Function kbsPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("kbsPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select imrShortDescription from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("kbsPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("kbsPartShortDescription").Value = rsData.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function kbsContractLength_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("kbsContractLength").Value) > 0 Then If Trim(Fields("kbsContractLengthType").Value) <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("kbsStartDate").Value) = False Then Fields("kbsEndDate").Value = App.DateAddByContractType(Fields("kbsStartDate").Value,Fields("kbsContractLength").Value,Fields("kbsContractLengthType").Value) End If End If End If End Function
Function kbsContractLengthType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("kbsContractLength").Value) > 0 Then If Trim(Fields("kbsContractLengthType").Value) <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("kbsStartDate").Value) = False Then Fields("kbsEndDate").Value = App.DateAddByContractType(Fields("kbsStartDate").Value,Fields("kbsContractLength").Value,Fields("kbsContractLengthType").Value) End If End If End If End Function

Function PartOperations_SaveAs(aWhere) ' Change matching outside op part ids. Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartOperations SET PartOperations.imoPartID = PartOperations.imoMethodID, PartOperations.imoPartRevisionID = PartOperations.imoMethodRevisionID FROM PartOperations Inner Join (Select Top 1 imoPartID From PartOperations Where " + aWhere(1) + " And imoMethodID = imoPartID) As Test On PartOperations.imoPartID = test.imoPartID WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function imoMachineType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("imoMachineType").Value) <> 3 Then Fields("imoWorkCenterMachineID").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function imoOperationType_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,bPrev If CInt(Fields("imoOperationType").Value) = 2 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imaPartID,imaPartRevisionID from PartAssemblies where imaMethodID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imoMethodID").Value) + " and imaMethodAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("imoMethodAssemblyID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InRelFieldChangeEvent App.InRelFieldChangeEvent = True Fields("imoPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("imaPartID").Value App.InRelFieldChangeEvent = bPrev Fields("imoPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("imaPartRevisionID").Value End If oRs.Close Fields("imoStandardFactor").Value = "TD" Else Fields("imoPartID").Value = "" Fields("imoPartRevisionID").Value = "" Fields("imoUnitOfMeasure").Value = "" Fields("imoStandardFactor").Value = App.Props("JM").Fields("xapJMStandardFactor").Value Fields("imoEstimatedUnitCost").Value = 0 Fields("imoMinimumCharge").Value = 0 Fields("imoSupplierOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("imoPurchaseLocationID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function imoWorkCenterID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawWorkCenterID,xawProcessID,xawSetupHours,xawStandardFactor,xawProductionStandard,xawQueueTime,xawMoveTime from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imoWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("imoQueueTime").Value = oRs.Fields("xawQueueTime").Value Fields("imoMoveTime").Value = oRs.Fields("xawMoveTime").Value
Call SetFields(true, true, true, oRs)
If Trim(oRs.Fields("xawProcessID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("imoProcessID").Value = oRs.Fields("xawProcessID").Value Else Fields("imoProcessID").Value = "" Fields("imoProcessShortDescription").Value = "" End If End If oRs.Close End Function
Function imoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("imoPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imoPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imoPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("imoUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function imoProcessID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,rsTemp,cPrev,bCopyDesc Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xacProcessID,xacShortDescription,xacLongDescriptionRTF,xacLongDescriptionText,xacSetupHours,xacStandardFactor,xacProductionStandard from Processes where xacProcessID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imoProcessID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Record.EntryMode = ".NET" Then cPrev = e.PreviousValue Else cPrev = Record.PreviousValue End If Fields("imoProcessShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("xacShortDescription").Value bCopyDesc = False Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select xacLongDescriptionRTF from Processes where xacProcessID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPrev),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If App.TrimNull(Fields("imoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value) = App.TrimNull(rsTemp.Fields("xacLongDescriptionRTF").Value) Then bCopyDesc = True Else If App.TrimNull(Fields("imoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value) = "" Then bCopyDesc = True Else replaceTxt = MsgBox("Do you want to replace the long description to match your new selection?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Replace Text?") If replaceTxt = vbYes Then bCopyDesc = True Else bCopyDesc = False End If End If End If Else If App.TrimNull(Fields("imoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value) = "" Then bCopyDesc = True Else bCopyDesc = False End If End If rsTemp.Close If bCopyDesc = True Then ' Only refresh the extended description info if it doesn't match the previous operations extended description or it hasn't been entered yet. Fields("imoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("xacLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("imoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("xacLongDescriptionText").Value End If
Dim bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard
bUpdateSetupHours = false bUpdateStandardFactor = false bUpdateProductionStandard = false
If CDbl(oRs.Fields("xacSetupHours").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("imoSetupHours").Value = oRs.Fields("xacSetupHours").Value Else bUpdateSetupHours = true End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("xacStandardFactor").Value) <> "" Then Fields("imoStandardFactor").Value = oRs.Fields("xacStandardFactor").Value Else bUpdateStandardFactor = true End If If CDbl(oRs.Fields("xacProductionStandard").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("imoProductionStandard").Value = oRs.Fields("xacProductionStandard").Value Else bUpdateProductionStandard = true End If
Call SetWorkCenterInformation(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard)
End If oRs.Close End Function
Private Function SetWorkCenterInformation(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawSetupHours,xawStandardFactor,xawProductionStandard from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imoWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If oRs.EOF = False Then Call SetFields(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard, oRs) End If oRs.Close End Function
Private Function SetFields(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard, oRecordSet) If bUpdateSetupHours Then If CDbl(oRecordSet.Fields("xawSetupHours").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("imoSetupHours").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawSetupHours").Value Else Fields("imoSetupHours").Value = 0 End If End If
If bUpdateStandardFactor Then If oRecordSet.Fields("xawStandardFactor").Value <> "" Then Fields("imoStandardFactor").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawStandardFactor").Value Else Fields("imoStandardFactor").Value = App.Props("JM").Fields("xapjmstandardfactor").Value End If End If
If bUpdateProductionStandard Then If CDbl(oRecordSet.Fields("xawProductionStandard").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("imoProductionStandard").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawProductionStandard").Value Else Fields("imoProductionStandard").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function imoPlantID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawWorkCenterID from WorkCenters where xawPlantID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imoPlantID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Trim(oRs.Fields("xawWorkCenterID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("imoWorkCenterID").Value = oRs.Fields("xawWorkCenterID").Value End If Else Fields("imoWorkCenterID").Value = "" Fields("imoProcessID").Value = "" Fields("imoProcessShortDescription").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End Function

Function hctEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("hctEmployeeID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select lmdEmployeeID, lmdTaxFileNumber, lmdEmployeeFirstName, lmdEmployeeMiddleName, lmdEmployeeLastName, lmdAddressLine1, lmdAddressLine2,lmdCity, lmdState, lmdPostCode, lmdCountry From EmployeePersonalData Where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("hctEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("hctEmployeeSSN").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdTaxFileNumber").Value Fields("hctEmployeeFirstName").Value = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeFirstName").Value) Fields("hctEmployeeMiddleName").Value = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeMiddleName").Value) Fields("hctEmployeeLastName").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeLastName").Value Fields("hctEmployeeAddressLine1").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdAddressLine1").Value Fields("hctEmployeeAddressLine2").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdAddressLine2").Value Fields("hctEmployeeCity").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdCity").Value Fields("hctEmployeeState").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdState").Value Fields("hctEmployeePostCode").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdPostCode").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Function lmeUserID_Valid(sender, e) Dim recordSet if Trim(Fields("LmeUserID").Value) <> "" Then Set recordSet = CreateObject("ADODB.RecordSet") queryEmployee = "Select top 1 lmeEmployeeID FROM Employees where lmeEmployeeID <> "& App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmeEmployeeID").Value) & " AND lmeUserID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("LmeUserID").Value) recordSet.Open queryEmployee, Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If recordSet.EOF = False AND recordSet.RecordCount >= 1 Then e.AddError("This User ID has already been linked with another employee. Please select another User ID") End If recordSet.Close End if End Function

Dim dTempPartComponentQtyOnHand Function rmoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsParts
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmoPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmoPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("rmoDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("rmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End Function
Function ReceiptComponents_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim rsReceipts, cReceiptID, cPartIDKey
If CBool(Fields("rmoPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Exit Function Else If (Cbool(Fields("rmoPostedToGL").Value) = Cbool(Fields("rmoPostedToGL").OriginalValue)) then Exit Function End If End If
cReceiptID = Trim(Fields("rmoReceiptID").Value) If cReceiptID = "" then Exit function End If
Dim rsWarehouse, bNonNettable, nInvQtyChanged, cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsPartRevisions bNonNettable = False Set rsWarehouse = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWarehouse.Open "Select imwWarehouseID, imwNonNettable, imwNonNettableType From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("rmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)) + " And imwNonNettable <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsWarehouse.EOF = False Then bNonNettable = rsWarehouse.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouse.Close
nInvQtyChanged = CDbl(Fields("rmoInvQuantityReceived").Value)
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmoPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmoPartRevisionID").Value)) cPartIDKey = cPartID & App.IIf(cPartRevisionID = "", "", "/" & cPartRevisionID)
If cPartID <> "" And Trim(Fields("rmoJobID").Value) = "" And (nInvQtyChanged <> 0) Then Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' If this revision doesn't exist, check to see if we can find another ' one and use it instead. If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then Dim nTotalCurrentCost, nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand, nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) If dTempPartComponentQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey) <> "" Then nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(dTempPartComponentQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey)) Else nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) End If ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCost = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If
If nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand < 0 And nInvQtyChanged > 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = nInvQtyChanged Else nNewQtyOnHand = nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand + nInvQtyChanged End If
If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. If nInvQtyChanged > 0 Then ' Set avg/last labor/burden to zero. rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = 0
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = GetMaxDate(Fields("rmoReceiptID").Fields("rmpReceiptDate").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value)
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmoInventoryUnitCost").Value) ' Set Avg matl unit cost nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(Fields("rmoInventoryUnitCost").Value) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmoInventoryUnitCost").Value) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) ' Add a key to the dictionary or replace if no exists If dTempPartComponentQtyOnHand.Exists(cPartIDKey) Then dTempPartComponentQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey) = nNewQtyOnHand Else dTempPartComponentQtyOnHand.Add cPartIDKey, nNewQtyOnHand End If End If End If End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch
End If End If
End Function
Function ReceiptComponents_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) ' Temporary dictionary to store part components and calculate costs correctly when there are lines with the same part component Set dTempPartComponentQtyOnHand = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End Function
Private Function GetMaxDate(dDate1, dDate2) Dim dReturn dReturn = Null If IsNull(dDate1) Then dReturn = dDate2 ElseIf IsNull(dDate2) Then dReturn = dDate1 Else If dDate1 > dDate2 Then dReturn = dDate1 Else dReturn = dDate2 End If End If GetMaxDate = dReturn End Function

If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function rmoJobQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) If cdbl(Fields("rmoJobQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 And CBool(Fields("rmoReceiptID").Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("rmoJobQuantityReceived").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function rmoQuantityToInspect_Valid(sender, e) If cdbl(Fields("rmoQuantityToInspect").Value) < 0 And CBool(Fields("rmoReceiptID").Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("rmoQuantityToInspect").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function CalculatePurchaseUnitCost(nInventoryUnitCost, nConversionFactor) If nConversionFactor = 0 Then CalculatePurchaseUnitCost = 0 Else CalculatePurchaseUnitCost = App.Round(nInventoryUnitCost / nConversionFactor, 5) End If End Function
Function rmoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("rmoPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("rmoPartID").Value, Fields("rmoPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("rmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("rmoPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then Dim parentBs, poLinetype Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) Set parentBs = parentBs.PrimaryTable.GetParentBindingSource(parentBs.CurrentAsDataRow) poLinetype = App.Ax("PO").GetPurchaseOrderLineType(Fields("rmoPurchaseOrderID").Value, Fields("rmoPurchaseOrderLineID").Value, e.SqlTransaction) if Trim(Fields("rmoJobID").Value) = "" and poLinetype <> 4 and CInt(Fields("rmoPostedToGL").Value) = 0 And not parentBs.Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value then e.AddError "Part ID '"&Fields("rmoPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("rmoPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse ID '"&Fields("rmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin ID '"&Fields("rmoPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive." end if End If End If End Function

Function imsPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("imsPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsParts Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsParts.Open "select impTrackSerialNumbers from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("imsPartID").Value))), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then If CBool(rsParts.Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) = False Then imsPartID = "Cannot select part as it is not marked as Serial Number Tracked in Part Entry." Fields("imsPartID").Value = "" End If End If rsParts.Close End If End Function

Function RMAReceiptComponents_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim nInvQtyChanged, cPartID, cPartRevisionID
If CBool(Fields("rroPosted").Value) = False Then Exit Function Else If (Cbool(Fields("rroPosted").Value) = Cbool(Fields("rroPosted").OriginalValue)) then Exit Function End If End If
Dim parentBs Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row)
nInvQtyChanged = CDbl(Fields("rroQuantityReceived").Value) + CDbl(Fields("rroQuantityToInspect").Value)
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rroPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rroPartRevisionID").Value))
Dim rsWarehouse, bNonNettable bNonNettable = False Set rsWarehouse = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWarehouse.Open "Select imwWarehouseID, imwNonNettable, imwNonNettableType From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("rroPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)) + " And imwNonNettable <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsWarehouse.EOF = False Then bNonNettable = rsWarehouse.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouse.Close
If nInvQtyChanged <> 0 Then Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' If this revision doesn't exist, check to see if we can find another ' one and use it instead. If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then Dim nTotalCurrentCostLabor, nTotalCurrentCostOverHead, nTotalCurrentCostMaterial, nTotalCurrentCostSubContract, nTotalCurrentCostDuty, nTotalCurrentCostFreight, nTotalCurrentCostMisc Dim nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCostLabor = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostOverHead = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostMaterial = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostSubContract = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostDuty = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostFreight = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nTotalCurrentCostMisc = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value)
If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If
If Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) < 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged) Else nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) + Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged) End If
If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. If Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged) > 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = GetMaxDate(Fields("rroRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReceiptDate").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value)
' Get costs either from linked shipment/order, or from the current costing method if not linked Dim objPartCosts, nValue Set objPartCosts = App.Ax("RMAReceipt").GetPartCostObjectForRmaReceipt(e.SqlTransaction, e.Row) if IsNull(objPartCosts) = True Then Exit Function End If
' Set new avg unit costs nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostLabor + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostOverHead + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostMaterial + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostSubContract + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostDuty + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostFreight + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCostMisc + (Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyChanged)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
Set objPartCosts = nothing End If End If
End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End If End Function
Private Function GetMaxDate(dDate1, dDate2) Dim dReturn dReturn = Null If IsNull(dDate1) Then dReturn = dDate2 ElseIf IsNull(dDate2) Then dReturn = dDate1 Else If dDate1 > dDate2 Then dReturn = dDate1 Else dReturn = dDate2 End If End If GetMaxDate = dReturn End Function

cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rroPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rroPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")

If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function rroPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("rroPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("rroPartID").Value, Fields("rroPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("rroPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("rroPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then if CInt(Fields("rroPosted").Value) = 0 And not Fields("rroRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrlRMAReceiptID").Fields("rrpReversalEntry").Value then e.AddError "Part ID '" + Fields("rroPartID").Value + "', Revision '" + Fields("rroPartRevisionID").Value + "', Warehouse ID '" + Fields("rroPartWarehouseLocationID").Value + "', Bin ID '" + Fields("rroPartBinID").Value + "' is inactive." end if End If End If End Function

Function PayrollHeaders_DeleteStarted(sender, e)
Dim cText, rsTemp cText = ""
Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select pasPostedToGL From PayrollSessions Where pasPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("patPayrollSessionID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText
If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsTemp.Fields("pasPostedToGL").Value) = True Then cText = cText + "Record cannot be deleted because the payroll session has been posted while editing the data" + Chr(13)
End If End If
rsTemp.Close
PayrollHeaders_DeleteStarted = cText
If Trim(cText) = "" Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE Timecards SET lmpTransferredToPayroll = 0, lmpTransferredDate = Null FROM Timecards Inner Join PayrollHeaderTotalLines On lmpTimecardID = paiTimecardID Inner Join PayrollHeaders On paiPayrollSessionID = patPayrollSessionID And paiPayrollHeaderID = patPayrollHeaderID WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollSessionID").Value) + " And paiPayrollHeaderID = " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollHeaderID").Value)) + " And patVoidedPayment = 0"
Connection.Execute "UPDATE TimecardLines SET lmlTransferredToPayroll = 0 FROM TimecardLines Inner Join PayrollHeaderTotalLines On lmlTimecardID = paiTimecardID Inner Join PayrollHeaders On paiPayrollSessionID = patPayrollSessionID And paiPayrollHeaderID = patPayrollHeaderID WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollSessionID").Value) + " And paiPayrollHeaderID = " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollHeaderID").Value)) + " And patVoidedPayment = 0"
If CLng(Fields("patVoidedPayrollSessionID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE PayrollHeaders SET patVoidedPayment = 0 WHERE patPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patVoidedPayrollSessionID").Value) + " And patPayrollHeaderID = " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patVoidedPayrollHeaderID").Value)) + " And patVoidedPayment <> 0" End If
Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM Timecards WHERE lmpCreatedFromPayrollSession = 1 AND lmpTimecardID IN (SELECT paiTimecardID FROM PayrollHeaderTotalLines WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollSessionID").Value) + " AND paiPayrollHeaderID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollHeaderID").Value) + ")"
Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM TimecardLines WHERE lmlCreatedFromPayrollSession = 1 AND lmlTimecardID IN (SELECT paiTimecardID FROM PayrollHeaderTotalLines WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollSessionID").Value) + " AND paiPayrollHeaderID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollHeaderID").Value) + ")"
Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PayrollHeaderLeaveAccruals WHERE lmfPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollSessionID").Value) + " And lmfPayrollHeaderID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("patPayrollHeaderID").Value) End If
End Function

Function PurchaseOrderLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmoOrganizationID,cmoSupplierTaxable,cmoSupplierTaxCodeID,cmoForm1099Box,cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID,cmoRequiresInspection from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("pmlTaxable").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoSupplierTaxable").Value Fields("pmlTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoSupplierTaxCodeID").Value Fields("pmlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID").Value Fields("pmlRequiresInspection").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoRequiresInspection").Value Fields("pmlForm1099Box").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoForm1099Box").Value End If oRs.Close

Function PurchaseOrderLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobMaterials SET jmmPurchaseOrderID = '' WHERE jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " And jmmJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " And jmmJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobOperations SET jmoPurchaseOrderID = '' WHERE jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " And jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " And jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value) End Function
Function PurchaseOrderLines_Valid(sender, e) Dim oRs If App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value = True Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "Select impNonStockedItem From Parts Where impPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Cbool(oRs.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = True Then Dim childBs, compBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PurchaseOrderAccounts") Set compBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("PurchaseOrderComponents") If childBs.Count < 1 And compBs.Count < 1 Then e.AddError "At least 1 expense account is required when Part is a Non-Stocked Item." + Chr(13) end if Set childBs = nothing set compBs = nothing End If End if oRs.Close End If End Function
Function PurchaseOrderLines_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsPurchaseOrders,dOldDate,dNewDate,nDiff,rsTemp dOldDate = Null dNewDate = Null Set rsPurchaseOrders = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsPurchaseOrders.Open "SELECT pmpOrderDate FROM PurchaseOrders INNER JOIN PurchaseOrderLines ON pmlPurchaseOrderID=pmpPurchaseOrderID WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " GROUP BY pmpOrderDate",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsPurchaseOrders.EOF = False Then dOldDate = rsPurchaseOrders.Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value End If rsPurchaseOrders.Close rsPurchaseOrders.Open "SELECT pmpOrderDate FROM PurchaseOrders INNER JOIN PurchaseOrderLines ON pmlPurchaseOrderID = pmpPurchaseOrderID WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " GROUP BY pmpOrderDate",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsPurchaseOrders.EOF = False Then dNewDate = rsPurchaseOrders.Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value End If rsPurchaseOrders.Close
If IsNull(dOldDate) = False And IsNull(dNewDate) = False Then nDiff = DateDiff("d",dOldDate,dNewDate) Else nDiff = 0 End If Connection.Execute "UPDATE PurchaseOrderLines SET pmlDueDate = DateAdd(dd," + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nDiff) + ", pmlDueDate) WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function PurchaseOrderLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim oPurchaseOrders, poID, supplierID, purLocationID, dueDate
If CInt(Fields("pmlPurchaseType").Value) = 1 Then ' supplierID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) ' purLocationID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) Set rsPO = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsPO.Open "Select pmpSupplierOrganizationID, pmpPurchaseLocationID From PurchaseOrders Where pmpPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsPO.EOF = False Then supplierID = rsPO.Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value purLocationID = rsPO.Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value End If rsPO.close
poID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) dueDate = Fields("pmlDueDate").Value
If CBool(Fields("pmlCreateJobSeq").Value) = True Then Dim jobSeq jobSeq = App.Ax("Job").CreateJobSequenceFromPOLine(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.SqlTransaction, e.Row) If CInt(jobSeq) <> 0 then If CInt(Fields("pmlJobType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value = jobSeq ElseIf CInt(Fields("pmlJobType").Value) = 2 Then Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value = jobSeq End If Fields("pmlCreateJobSeq").Value = False End If Else If Not IsEmpty(Fields("pmlJobID").OriginalValue) Then If CInt(Fields("pmlJobType").OriginalValue) = 1 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobMaterials SET jmmPurchaseOrderID = '', jmmSupplierOrganizationID = '', jmmPurchaseLocationID = '', jmmDueInDate = NULL WHERE jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").OriginalValue) + " And jmmJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").OriginalValue) + " And jmmJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").OriginalValue) Else Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobOperations SET jmoPurchaseOrderID = '', jmoSupplierOrganizationID = '', jmoPurchaseLocationID = '' WHERE jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").OriginalValue) + " And jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").OriginalValue) + " And jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").OriginalValue) End If End If
If CInt(Fields("pmlJobType").Value) = 1 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobMaterials SET jmmPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(poID) + ", jmmSupplierOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(supplierID) + ", jmmPurchaseLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(purLocationID) + ", jmmDueInDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dueDate) + " WHERE jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " And jmmJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " And jmmJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value) Else Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobOperations SET jmoPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(poID) + ", jmoSupplierOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(supplierID) + ", jmoPurchaseLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(purLocationID) + " WHERE jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " And jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " And jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value) End If End If End If End Function
Function pmlTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("pmlTaxCodeID").Value) = "" Or CDbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) = 0 Then Fields("pmlTaxAmountBase").Value = 0 Fields("pmlTaxAmountForeign").Value = 0 Else Dim oRs,bPrev, rsPO, dOrderDate Set rsPO = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsPO.Open "Select pmpOrderDate From PurchaseOrders Where pmpPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsPO.EOF = False Then dOrderDate = rsPO.Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value End If rsPO.close
If IsNull(dOrderDate) = True Then dOrderDate = Date End If
Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select Top 1 IsNull(xabTaxRate,0) As xabTaxRate from TaxCodes Left Outer Join TaxCodeLines on xaxTaxCodeID = xabTaxCodeiD where xaxTaxCodeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlTaxCodeID").Value) + " And IsNull(xabEffectiveDate,'19000101') <= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dOrderDate) + " Order By xabEffectiveDate DESC",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.UpdatingCost App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("pmlTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xabTaxRate").Value) / 100,4) Fields("pmlTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostForeign").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xabTaxRate").Value) / 100,4)
Fields("pmlTotalExtendedCostBase").Value = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("pmlTaxAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("pmlSecondTaxAmountBase").Value)), 2) Fields("pmlTotalExtendedCostForeign").Value = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("pmlTaxAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("pmlSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value)), 2)
App.UpdatingCost = bPrev End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function pmlPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,rsRef Dim nConv,cSupplierID,cLocationID,cLeadTime,cPurUM,nValue,cType,cCurrencyID,dPriceDate,priceCalc,bKitPart
bKitPart = False bForeignAmount = False cCurrencyID = "" cSupplierID = "" cLocationID = "" cSupplierID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) cLocationID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) cCurrencyID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpCurrencyRateID").Value) dPriceDate = cDate(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value)
If Trim(Fields("pmlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText,imrLeadTime,(imrAverageMaterialCost+imrAverageDutyCost+imrAverageFreightCost+imrAverageMiscCost) As imrAverageMaterialCost,(imrLastMaterialCost+imrLastDutyCost+imrLastFreightCost+imrLastMiscCost) As imrLastMaterialCost,(imrStandardMaterialCost+imrStandardDutyCost+imrStandardFreightCost+imrStandardMiscCost) As imrStandardMaterialCost,imrConversionFactor,imrDocuments,imrRequiresInspection,Isnull(imcRequiresInspection,0) as imcRequiresInspection, impPhantomOrKitPart from PartRevisions Inner Join Parts On impPartID = imrPartID Left Outer Join PartClasses On impPartClassID = imcPartClassId where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("pmlPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("pmlDocuments").Value = oRs.Fields("imrDocuments").Value bKitPart = oRs.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value cPurUM = oRs.Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value nConv = CDbl(oRs.Fields("imrConversionFactor").Value)
' First check if part revision marked as required inspection, if so set If Cdbl(oRs.Fields("imrRequiresInspection").value) = 1 Then Fields("pmlRequiresInspection").value = True ' set false if marked as not required ElseIf Cdbl(oRs.Fields("imrRequiresInspection").Value) = 2 Then Fields("pmlRequiresInspection").value = False Else ' otherwise check part class, if marked as true, set to true If CBool(oRs.Fields("imcRequiresInspection").Value) = True Then Fields("pmlRequiresInspection").value = True ElseIf Cdbl(oRs.Fields("imrRequiresInspection").Value) = 0 Then ' if revision is 'none', go back and re-check the org Dim orgCheck Set orgCheck = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") orgCheck.Open "select cmoRequiresInspection from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If orgCheck.EOF = False Then Fields("pmlRequiresInspection").Value = orgCheck.Fields("cmoRequiresInspection").Value End If orgCheck.Close End If End IF
Set rsRef = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsRef.Open "select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor from PartCrossReferences where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cSupplierID) + " And imxLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cLocationID),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRef.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nConv = CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) End If If Trim(rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) <> "" Then cPurUM = rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value End If Else rsRef.Close rsRef.Open "select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor from PartCrossReferences where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPartID").Value) + " And imxPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cSupplierID) + " And imxLocationID = ''",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRef.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nConv = CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) End If If Trim(rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) <> "" Then cPurUM = rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value End If End If End If rsRef.Close
Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = cPurUM
If nConv = 0 And Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConv = 1 End If Fields("pmlConversionFactor").Value = nConv
If CLng(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then cType = "SUBCONTRACT" Else cType = "MATERIAL" End If
' Default purchase quantity to 1 If Cdbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) = 0 Then Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value = 1 End If
Set priceCalc = App.Ax("Part").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("pmlPartID").Value,Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value,cSupplierID,cLocationID,Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value,cType,cCurrencyID,dPriceDate,Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) > 0 Then If priceCalc.IsForeignCurrency = True Then If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value) Then bCostSetByCode = True Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value = priceCalc.FullPrice bCostSetByCode = False End If Else If CDbl(priceCalc.FullPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) Then bCostSetByCode = True Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = priceCalc.FullPrice bCostSetByCode = False End If End If End If Fields("pmlLeadTime").Value = priceCalc.LeadTime Set priceCalc = Nothing
Else If CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseType").Value) = 2 Then Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMUnitOfMeasure").Value End If End If oRs.Close ' Refresh purchase qty so calculations run Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value = Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value
End If If (Trim(Fields("pmlPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("pmlPartID").OriginalValue)) Or (Trim(Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").OriginalValue)) Then Call App.Ax("PurchaseAccounts").RefreshPurchaseOrderLineAccounts(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.Row) End If Fields("pmlKitPart").Value = bKitPart
If Cbool(bInCodeChange) = False Then e.FocusField = "pmlPurchaseQuantity" End If End Function
Function pmlJobOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,nConv,bPrev,nOpenQty nOpenQty = 0 If CDbl(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") 'oRs.Open "select jmoPartID,jmoPartRevisionID,jmoProcessShortDescription,jmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF,jmoProcessLongDescriptionText,jmoUnitOfMeasure,jmoCalculatedUnitCost,jmoSetupCharge,jmoOperationQuantity,jmoQuantityComplete,jmoProductionComplete,jmoDocuments from JobOperations where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " and jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText oRs.Open "select JobOperations.*, Processes.xacInspectionType from JobOperations inner join Processes on jmoProcessID = xacProcessID where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " and jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then ' If the part is the same, then do not update it. This is primarily for when the create job seq checkbox is marked. If Record.SaveInProgress = False And CBool(Fields("pmlCreateJobSeq").Value) = False Then 'If Fields("pmlPartID").Value <> oRs.Fields("jmoPartID").Value Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False bInCodeChange = true Fields("pmlPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartRevisionID").Value Fields("pmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value Fields("pmlPartBinID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartBinID").Value bInCodeChange = false If Trim(Fields("pmlPartShortDescription").Value) = "" Then Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoUnitOfMeasure").Value End If Fields("pmlPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoProcessShortDescription").Value Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value Fields("pmlDocuments").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoDocuments").Value nConv = CDbl(Fields("pmlConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConv) = 0 And Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConv = 1 End If
If CInt(oRs.Fields("jmoProductionComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmoOperationQuantity").Value) - CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmoQuantityComplete").Value) If nOpenQty < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If

Dim cSupplierID,cLocationID cSupplierID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) cLocationID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) If CStr(Trim(oRs.Fields("jmoSupplierOrganizationID").Value)) <> "" And (CStr(Trim(oRs.Fields("jmoSupplierOrganizationID").Value)) <> CStr(Trim(cSupplierID)) Or CStr(Trim(oRs.Fields("jmoPurchaseLocationID").Value)) <> CStr(Trim(cLocationID))) Then Call msgbox("The supplier listed on the job operation sequence is different to that on the purchase order header.", VbOKOnly+VbExclamation,"Validation") End If

bCostSetByCode = True Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = nValue bCostSetByCode = False End If 'End If Fields("pmlSetupChargeBase").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoSetupCharge").Value End If End If oRs.Close Fields("pmlCreateJobSeq").Value = False End If Fields("pmlJobOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty End Function

Function pmlPurchaseQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nConvFactor,nNewValue nConvFactor = 1 nNewValue = 0 If CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConvFactor = CDbl(Fields("pmlConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConvFactor) = 0 And Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConvFactor = 1 End If If CDbl(nConvFactor) <> 0 Then nNewValue = CDbl(App.Round(CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) / CDbl(nConvFactor),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) Else Exit Function End If
End If ' Check for same value so we don't get in a recursive loop. If nNewValue <> CDbl(Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) Then If CDbl(App.Round(CDbl(Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) * CDbl(nConvFactor),App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals)) <> CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) Then Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value = nNewValue End If bShouldUpdateUnitCost=true End If End Function
Function pmlPurchaseQuantity_Valid(sender, e) Dim oRs, nLotSize, nMinPurQty, nQty, cText, cStartMsg Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.RecordSet") oRs.Open "select imxMinimumPurchaseQuantity,imxLotSize from PurchaseOrders Inner Join PartCrossReferences on pmpSupplierOrganizationID=imxOrganizationID and pmpPurchaseLocationID=imxLocationID Where pmpPurchaseOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value)) & " and imxPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("pmlPartID").Value)) & " and imxPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value)) & " and imxPurchased = 1 and imxInactive = 0",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If Not oRs.EOF Then nMinPurQty = oRs.Fields("imxMinimumPurchaseQuantity").Value nLotSize = oRs.Fields("imxLotSize").Value nQty = Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value
If CDbl(nQty) > 0 Then cStartMsg = "The quantity entered is " If CDbl(nMinPurQty) > CDbl(nQty) Then cText = "smaller than the min purchase qty of " & nMinPurQty End If If CDbl(nLotSize) > 0 Then If Int(CDbl(nQty) / CDbl(nLotSize)) <> CDbl(nQty) / CDbl(nLotSize) Then If trim(cText) <> "" then cText = cText & " and " End If cText = cText & "not in line with the lot size of " & nLotSize End If End If If Trim(cText) <> "" Then e.AddWarning cStartMsg & cText End If End If End If End Function

rsTemp.Fields("jmmUnitCost9").Value) End If End If rsTemp.Close Else rsTemp.Open "select * from JobOperations Where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " And App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then nValue = App.Ax("Job").CalculateJobOperationCalculatedCost(Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value, rsTemp.Fields("jmoEstimatedUnitCost").Value, rsTemp.Fields("jmoMinimumCharge").Value, rsTemp.Fields("jmoSetupCharge").Value, rsTemp.Fields("jmoQuantityBreak1").Value, rsTemp.Fields("jmoUnitCost1").Value, rsTemp.Fields("jmoQuantityBreak2").Value, rsTemp.Fields("jmoUnitCost2").Value, Function pmlJobMaterialID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,nConv,nOpenQty,bPrev,priceCalc,nValue nOpenQty = 0 If CDbl(Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select * from JobMaterials where jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " and jmmJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and jmmJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then ' If the part is the same, then do not update it. This is primarily for when the create job seq checkbox is marked. If Record.SaveInProgress = False And CBool(Fields("pmlCreateJobSeq").Value) = False Then 'If Fields("pmlPartID").Value <> oRs.Fields("jmmPartID").Value Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False bInCodeChange = true Fields("pmlPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartRevisionID").Value bInCodeChange = false If Trim(Fields("pmlPartShortDescription").Value) = "" Then Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmUnitOfMeasure").Value End If Fields("pmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartWarehouseLocationID").Value Fields("pmlPartBinID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartBinID").Value Fields("pmlKitPart").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmKitPart").Value Fields("pmlKitPart").RunFormatter e.Database, e.Row Fields("pmlPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartShortDescription").Value Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartLongDescriptionText").Value Fields("pmlDocuments").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmDocuments").Value Fields("pmlLeadTime").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmLeadTime").Value Fields("pmlDueDate").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmRequiredDate").Value nConv = CDbl(Fields("pmlConversionFactor").Value) If CDbl(nConv) = 0 And Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConv = 1 End If
If CInt(oRs.Fields("jmmReceivedComplete").Value) = False Then nOpenQty = CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmmPurchaseToJobQuantity").Value) - CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmmQuantityReceived").Value) If nOpenQty < 0 Then nOpenQty = 0 End If End If
If Record.EditMode = adEditAdd Then Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value = App.Round(nOpenQty * nConv,App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals) End If
Dim cSupplierID,cLocationID,cCurrencyID,dPriceDate cSupplierID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) cLocationID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) cCurrencyID = Trim(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpCurrencyRateID").Value) dPriceDate = cDate(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value) If CStr(Trim(oRs.Fields("jmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value)) <> "" And (CStr(Trim(oRs.Fields("jmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value)) <> CStr(Trim(cSupplierID)) Or CStr(Trim(oRs.Fields("jmmPurchaseLocationID").Value)) <> CStr(Trim(cLocationID))) Then If msgbox("The supplier listed on the job material sequence is different to that on the purchase order header. Do you wish to refresh the price breaks on the material with the new supplier?",VbYesNo+VbQuestion,"Confirm") = VbYes Then oRs.Fields("jmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value = cSupplierID oRs.Fields("jmmPurchaseLocationID").Value = cLocationID Call App.Ax("Job").RefreshMaterialPriceBreaks(e.SqlTransaction, oRs) oRs.UpdateBatch nValue = CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmmCalculatedUnitCost").Value) Else Set priceCalc = App.Ax("Part").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("pmlPartID").Value,Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value,cSupplierID,cLocationID,Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value,"MATERIAL",cCurrencyID,dPriceDate,Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) nValue = priceCalc.FullPrice Set priceCalc = Nothing End If Else nValue = CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmmCalculatedUnitCost").Value) End If
If CDbl(nValue) <> 0 Then If nConv <> 0 Then ' This assumes the job est unit cost is in inventory unit of measure Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = App.Round(CDbl(nValue) / nConv,5) End If End If End If If Cbool(bInCodeChange) = False Then e.FocusField = "pmlPurchaseQuantity" End If End If oRs.Close Fields("pmlCreateJobSeq").Value = False End If Fields("pmlJobOpenQuantity").Value = nOpenQty End Function
Function pmlJobType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("pmlJobType").Value) <> 1 Then Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("pmlJobType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value = 0 End If Fields("pmlCreateJobSeq").Value = False Call App.Ax("PurchaseAccounts").RefreshPurchaseOrderLineAccounts(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.Row) End Function
