Function pmlTotalExtendedCostBase_ValueChanged(sender, e)
Dim nValue,dOrderDate
If ((App.UpdatingUnitCost = false and bUpdatingTax = false)) Then
App.UpdatingUnitCost = True
dOrderDate = Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value If IsNull(dOrderDate) = True Then dOrderDate = Date End If
Fields("pmlTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnTotal(Fields("pmlTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("pmlTotalExtendedCostBase").Value, dOrderDate, Fields("pmlSecondTaxCodeID").Value, 4) Fields("pmlSecondTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnTotal(Fields("pmlSecondTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("pmlTotalExtendedCostBase").Value, dOrderDate, Fields("pmlTaxCodeID").Value, 4) Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value = App.Round((Fields("pmlTotalExtendedCostBase").Value - Fields("pmlTaxAmountBase").Value - Fields("pmlSecondTaxAmountBase").Value), 2)
If CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nValue = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("pmlSetupChargeBase").Value)) / CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value),5) End If
if (CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) = 0) then bShouldUpdateUnitCost=true end if
if (CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) = 0 and CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value)=0) then Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value = 1 Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("pmlSetupChargeBase").Value)) / CDbl(Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value),5) bShouldUpdateUnitCost=false end if
If (bShouldUpdateUnitCost=true) Then bCostSetByCode = True Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = nValue bCostSetByCode = False End If
App.UpdatingUnitCost = false End If bShouldUpdateUnitCost=true End Function
Function pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase_Valid(sender, e) dim errorText If CInt(Fields("pmlKitPart"))=True And Cdbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) <> 0 then dim totalCosts, lineCompCosts totalCosts = App.Ax("PO").GetTotalComponentsCost(Record.Table.BindingSource, e.Row) lineCompCosts = cdbl(fields("pmlTotalComponentCosts").value) If App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) <> App.Round(Cdbl(totalCosts),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) then errorText = "The total kit component costs do not equal the kit part extended cost. To make them equal, change the unit cost on the kit or on the components." If CInt(App.Props("GL").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals")) = True Then e.AddError errorText Else e.AddWarning errorText End if end if End if End Function
Function pmlInventoryQuantity_Valid(sender, e) 'Warn if current PO quantity (+ other PO quantity) will exceed estimated quantity on job material (jpb purchase) or sales order delivery (sales order purchase) Dim rsTemp, otherPurchasesText otherPurchasesText = "" If App.Props("FN").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals").Value = True Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If Fields("pmlPurchaseType").Value = 1 and Fields("pmlJobType").Value = 1 and Fields("pmlJobID").Value <> "" and Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value <> 0 then rsTemp.Open "select pmlJobID, pmlJobAssemblyID, pmlJobMaterialID, sum(case when pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) + " then 0 else pmlInventoryQuantity end) as OtherPOQuantity, (select IsNull(jmmEstimatedQuantity,0) from JobMaterials Where PMLJOBID = JMMJOBID and PMLJOBASSEMBLYID = JMMJOBASSEMBLYID and PMLJOBMATERIALID = JMMJOBMATERIALID) as jmmEstimatedQuantity from PurchaseOrderLines Where pmljobid = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " and pmlJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and pmlJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value) + " group by pmlJobID, pmlJobAssemblyID, pmlJobMaterialID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("OtherPOQuantity").Value) + CDbl(Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) > CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("jmmEstimatedQuantity").Value) Then If CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("OtherPOQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then otherPurchasesText = ", plus the quantity for all other purchases for this job material (" + CStr(App.Round(Cdbl(rsTemp.Fields("OtherPOQuantity").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) + ")," End If e.AddWarning "Warning: the inventory quantity (" + CStr(App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) + ")" + otherPurchasesText + " exceeds the material Estimated Quantity (" + CStr(App.Round(Cdbl(rsTemp.Fields("jmmEstimatedQuantity").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) + ") for job: " + Trim(Fields("pmlJobID").Value) + " asm: " + CStr(Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " material seq: " + CStr(Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value) + "." End If End If rsTemp.Close ElseIf Fields("pmlPurchaseType").Value = 3 and Fields("pmlSalesOrderID").Value <> "" and Fields("pmlSalesOrderLineID").Value <> 0 and Fields("pmlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value <> 0 then rsTemp.Open "select pmlSalesOrderID, pmlSalesOrderLineID, pmlSalesOrderDeliveryID, sum(case when pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) + " then 0 else pmlInventoryQuantity end) as OtherPOQuantity, (select IsNull(omdDeliveryQuantity,0) from SalesOrderDeliveries Where PMLSALESORDERID = OMDSALESORDERID and PMLSALESORDERLINEID = OMDSALESORDERLINEID and PMLSALESORDERDELIVERYID = OMDSALESORDERDELIVERYID) as omdDeliveryQuantity from PurchaseOrderLines Where pmlSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmlSalesOrderID").Value) + " and pmlSalesOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlSalesOrderLineID").Value) + " and pmlSalesOrderDeliveryID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pmlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) + " group by pmlSalesOrderID, pmlSalesOrderLineID, pmlSalesOrderDeliveryID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("OtherPOQuantity").Value) + CDbl(Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) > CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value) Then If CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("OtherPOQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then otherPurchasesText = ", plus the quantity for all other purchases for this sales order delivery (" + CStr(App.Round(Cdbl(rsTemp.Fields("OtherPOQuantity").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) + ")," End If e.AddWarning "Warning: the inventory quantity (" + CStr(App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) + ")" + otherPurchasesText + " exceeds the order delivery quantity (" + CStr(App.Round(Cdbl(rsTemp.Fields("omdDeliveryQuantity").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals)) + ") for order: " + Trim(Fields("pmlSalesOrderID").Value) + " line: " + CStr(Fields("pmlSalesOrderLineID").Value) + " delivery: " + CStr(Fields("pmlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) + "." End If End If rsTemp.Close End If End If End function
Function PurchaseOrderLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("PO").RefreshTaxSubtotal(Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row), e.SqlTransaction) End Function
Function pmlPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim purchaseType Dim rsParent : Set rsParent = Record.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) purchaseType=CInt(Fields("pmlPurchaseType").Value) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("pmlPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("pmlPartID").Value, Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("pmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("pmlPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then if purchaseType=2 or purchaseType=3 or purchaseType=5 then e.AddWarning "Part ID '"&Fields("pmlPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse ID '"&Fields("pmlPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin ID '"&Fields("pmlPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive." end if End If End If End Function

Sub CheckSellPrice(e) Dim parentBs,nPrice,nFullPrice,bForeignAmount If Trim(Fields("arlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) bForeignAmount = False nFullPrice = 0 nPrice = 0
Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetSellingPrice(Fields("arlPartID").Value,Fields("arlPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("arlPartGroupID").Value,parentBs.Fields("arpCustomerOrganizationID").Value,parentBs.Fields("arpARInvoiceLocationID").Value,Fields("arlOrderQuantity").Value,parentBs.Fields("arpCurrencyRateID").Value,parentBs.Fields("arpInvoiceDate").Value) If IsNull(priceObj) = False Then nFullPrice = priceObj.FullPrice nPrice = priceObj.DiscountedPrice bForeignAmount = priceObj.IsForeignCurrency End If Set priceObj = nothing
If Cdbl(nPrice) <> -1 Then If Not App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMEnableDiscountFields").Value Then nFullPrice = nPrice End If If bForeignAmount = True Then Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value = nFullPrice Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice Else Fields("arlFullUnitPriceBase").Value = nFullPrice Fields("arlUnitPriceBase").Value = nPrice End If End If Set parentBs = Nothing End If End Sub
Function ARInvoiceLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("arlPostedToGL").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("AR").ARInvoicePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If
If Trim(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) <> "" Then If CDbl(Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").Value) < 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE ShipmentLines SET smlInvoicedComplete = 0 WHERE smlShipmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) & " And smlShipmentLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlShipmentLineID").Value) + " And (smlQuantityShipped+smlJobQuantityShipped) < 0" Else Connection.Execute "UPDATE ShipmentLines SET smlInvoicedComplete = 0 WHERE smlShipmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) & " And smlShipmentLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlShipmentLineID").Value) + " And (smlQuantityShipped+smlJobQuantityShipped) >= 0" End If Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("Shipments") End If
If Trim(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("arlSalesOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 And CInt(Fields("arlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) = 0 And Trim(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) = "" Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderLines SET omlDepositCreated = 0 FROM SalesOrderLines INNER JOIN ARInvoiceLines ON omlSalesOrderID = arlSalesOrderID and omlSalesOrderLineID = arlSalesOrderLineID INNER JOIN ARInvoices ON arlARInvoiceID = arpARInvoiceID WHERE arlARInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Value) + " AND arpInvoiceType = 3" Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderLines SET omlDepositCredited = 0, omlDepositCreated = 1 FROM SalesOrderLines INNER JOIN ARInvoiceLines ON omlSalesOrderID = arlSalesOrderID and omlSalesOrderLineID = arlSalesOrderLineID INNER JOIN ARInvoices ON arlARInvoiceID = arpARInvoiceID WHERE arlARInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Value) + " AND arpInvoiceType = 2" Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("SalesOrders") Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("SalesOrderLines") End If
If Trim(Fields("arlRMAClaimID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("arlRMAClaimLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE RMAClaimLines SET ralInvoicedComplete = 0 WHERE ralRMAClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlRMAClaimID").Value) + " AND ralRMAClaimLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlRMAClaimLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("RMAClaimLines") End If End Function
Function ARInvoiceLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) ' Default Taxable and Non-Tax Reason to the customer specified on the invoice header Dim rsLookup Dim rsParent Set rsParent = Fields("arlARInvoiceID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("arpProjectID,arpShipOrganizationID,arpShipLocationID") Fields("arlProjectID").Value = rsParent.Fields("arpProjectID").Value Set rsLookup = CreateObject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "SELECT cmlCustomerTaxable,cmlCustomerTaxCodeID,cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID,cmlNonTaxReasonID FROM OrganizationLocations WHERE cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsParent.Fields("arpShipOrganizationID").Value) + " AND cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsParent.Fields("arpShipLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If CBool(rsLookup.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxable").Value) = True Then Fields("arlTaxCodeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID").Value End If Fields("arlNonTaxReasonID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("cmlNonTaxReasonID").Value End If rsLookup.Close Set rsParent = Nothing End Function
Function ARInvoiceLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("arlPostedToGL").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("AR").ARInvoicePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If
If Trim(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) <> "" Then If (CDbl(Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").OriginalValue)) Or (CDbl(Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").Value) = 0 And CDbl(Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").OriginalValue) = 0) Then Dim rsTemp, nQuantity, bContinue, parentBs bContinue = True
Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If CInt(parentBs.Fields("arpInvoiceType").Value) = 2 And Trim(parentBs.Fields("arpCreditARInvoiceID").Value) <> "" Then bContinue = False End If Set parentBs = Nothing If bContinue = True Then nQuantity = CDbl(Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").Value) Set rsTemp = CreateObject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select IsNull(Sum(arlInvoiceQuantity),0) As arlInvoiceQuantity From ARInvoiceLines Where arlShipmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) + " And arlShipmentLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlShipmentLineID").Value) + " And Not (arlARInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Value) + " And arlARInvoiceLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlARInvoiceLineID").Value) + ")", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then nQuantity = nQuantity + CDbl(rsTemp.Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").Value) End If rsTemp.Close
Connection.Execute "UPDATE ShipmentLines SET smlInvoicedComplete = Case When (smlQuantityShipped+smlJobQuantityShipped) < 0 Then Case When (smlQuantityShipped+smlJobQuantityShipped) < " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nQuantity) + " Then 0 Else 1 End Else Case When (smlQuantityShipped+smlJobQuantityShipped) <= " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nQuantity) + " Then 1 Else 0 End End WHERE smlShipmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) & " And smlShipmentLineID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlShipmentLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("Shipments") End If End If End If
If Trim(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("arlSalesOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 And CInt(Fields("arlSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value) = 0 And Trim(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) = "" Then If CInt(Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Fields("arpInvoiceType").Value) = 3 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderLines SET omlDepositCreated = 1, omlDepositCredited = 0 Where omlSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value) + " and omlSalesOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlSalesOrderLineID").Value) End If If CInt(Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Fields("arpInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE SalesOrderLines SET omlDepositCreated = 0, omlDepositCredited = 1 Where omlSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value) + " and omlSalesOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlSalesOrderLineID").Value) End If End If
If Trim(Fields("arlRMAClaimID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("arlRMAClaimLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim cValue
If CInt(Fields("arlDeliveryInvoicedComplete").Value) = True Then cValue = "1" Else cValue = "0" End If
Connection.Execute "UPDATE RMAClaimLines SET ralInvoicedComplete = " + cValue + " WHERE ralRMAClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlRMAClaimID").Value) + " AND ralRMAClaimLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlRMAClaimLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("RMAClaimLines") End If End Function
Function arlPartGroupID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Dim nRate nRate = 0 If Trim(Fields("arlPartGroupID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsTemp = Fields("arlPartGroupID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("imuCommissionType,imuCommissionRate") If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsTemp.Fields("imuCommissionType").Value) = 2 Then nRate = Cdbl(rsTemp.Fields("imuCommissionRate").Value) End If End If End If Fields("arlCommissionRate").Value = nRate End Function
Function arlTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("arlNonTaxReasonID").Value = "" End Function
Function CalculateDiscountPercent() Dim nPrice nPrice = 0 If CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) / CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) nPrice = App.Round(nPrice * 100,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If End If CalculateDiscountPercent = nPrice End Function
Function arlUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 And App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMEnableDiscountFields").Value Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("arlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arlUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If Else If CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value) Then Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value = Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value End If End If End Function
Function arlFullUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("arlDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("arlDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function arlDiscountPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,nPercent nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If nPercent <> CDbl(Fields("arlDiscountPercent").Value) Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("arlDiscountPercent").Value) / 100),5) If CDbl(Fields("arlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arlUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If End If End Function
Function arlUnitDiscountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arlUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arlUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("arlFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("arlDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("arlDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function arlPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Dim parentBs If Trim(Fields("arlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select impPartGroupID,impTaxCodeID,impSecondTaxCodeID,impAlwaysNonTaxable,impNonTaxReasonID from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("arlPartGroupID").Value = oRs.Fields("impPartGroupID").Value If CInt(oRs.Fields("impAlwaysNonTaxable").Value) = True Then Fields("arlTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value Else If Trim(oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arlTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value End If End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("impNonTaxReasonID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arlNonTaxReasonID").Value = oRs.Fields("impNonTaxReasonID").Value End If End If oRs.Close
If Trim(Fields("arlPartShortDescription").Value) <> "" Then e.FocusField = "arlOrderQuantity" End If End If End Function
Function arlOrderQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("arlShipmentID").Value) = "" Then Fields("arlInvoiceQuantity").Value = Fields("arlOrderQuantity").Value End If Call CheckSellPrice(e) End Function
Function arlPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("arlPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("arlPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("arlUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("arlPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("arlPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value Call CheckSellPrice(e) End If oRs.Close e.FocusField = "arlOrderQuantity" End If End Function
Function arlJobID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("arlJobID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select jmpProjectID,jmpProjectAreaID From Jobs Where jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlJobID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsData.Fields("jmpProjectID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arlProjectID").Value = rsData.fields("jmpProjectID").value Fields("arlProjectAreaID").Value = rsData.fields("jmpProjectAreaID").value End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function arlSalesOrderLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsLookup If Trim(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("arlSalesOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Set rsLookup = CreateObject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "SELECT omlTaxCodeID,omlSecondTaxCodeID,omlNonTaxReasonID,omlPayCommission FROM SalesOrderLines WHERE omlSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value) + " AND omlSalesOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("arlSalesOrderLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsLookup.Fields("omlTaxCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arlTaxCodeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("omlTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arlSecondTaxCodeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("omlSecondTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arlNonTaxReasonID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("omlNonTaxReasonID").Value End If Fields("arlPayCommission").Value = rsLookup.Fields("omlPayCommission").Value End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function arlSalesOrderID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsLookup If Trim(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsLookup = CreateObject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "SELECT ompCustomerPO FROM SalesOrders WHERE ompSalesOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arlSalesOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Fields("arlCustomerPO").Value = rsLookup.Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function ARInvoiceLines_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) e.FocusField = "arlPartID" End Function
Function ARInvoiceLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("AR").RefreshTaxSubtotal(Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row), e.SqlTransaction) End Function
Function CalculateRetentionPercent() Dim nPrice nPrice = 0 If CDbl(Fields("arlFullExtendedPriceForeign").Value)<> 0 Then If CBool(Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Fields("arpIncludeTaxInRetention").Value) = False Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arlRetentionAmountForeign").Value) / CDbl(Fields("arlFullExtendedPriceForeign").Value) Else nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arlRetentionAmountForeign").Value) / (CDbl(Fields("arlFullExtendedPriceForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("arlTaxAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("arlSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value)) End If nPrice = App.Round(nPrice * 100,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If End If CalculateRetentionPercent = nPrice End Function
Function arlRetentionPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPercent nPercent = CalculateRetentionPercent() If nPercent <> CDbl(Fields("arlRetentionPercent").Value) Then if CBool(Fields("arlARInvoiceID").Fields("arpIncludeTaxInRetention").Value) then nPrice = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("arlFullExtendedPriceForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("arlTaxAmountForeign").Value) + CDbl(Fields("arlSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value)) * CDbl(Fields("arlRetentionPercent").Value) / 100,2) Else nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arlFullExtendedPriceForeign").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("arlRetentionPercent").Value) / 100),2) end if If CDbl(Fields("arlRetentionAmountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arlRetentionAmountForeign").Value = nPrice End If End If End Function
Function arlRetentionAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call SetRetentionPercent End Function
Function arlTaxAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call SetRetentionPercent End Function
Function arlSecondTaxAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call SetRetentionPercent End Function
Function arlFullExtendedPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call SetRetentionPercent End Function
Sub SetRetentionPercent() Dim rPercent rPercent = CalculateRetentionPercent() If CDbl(Fields("arlRetentionPercent").Value) <> rPercent Then Fields("arlRetentionPercent").Value = rPercent End If End Sub

Function BankAccounts_Valid(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("glnCashGLAccountID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT glnBankAccountID FROM BankAccounts WHERE glnCashGLAccountID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("glnCashGLAccountID").Value) + " And glnBankAccountID <> " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("glnBankAccountID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then e.AddError "Cash Account " + Trim(Fields("glnCashGLAccountID").Value) + " is already used on bank account " + Trim(rsTemp.Fields("glnBankAccountID").Value) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Function lmtBreak1StartTime_Valid(sender, e) e.AddError App.Ax("Production").IsValidTime(Fields("lmtBreak1StartTime").Value, Fields("lmtDay").GetValueListText(Fields("lmtDay").Value) & " break 1 start") If Fields("lmtStartTime").Value <> 0 Or Fields("lmtEndTime").Value <> 0 Then If Fields("lmtBreak1StartTime").Value <> Fields("lmtBreak1EndTime").Value Then If Fields("lmtEndTime").Value > Fields("lmtStartTime").Value Then If Fields("lmtBreak1StartTime").Value > Fields("lmtEndTime").Value Or Fields("lmtBreak1StartTime").Value < Fields("lmtStartTime").Value Then e.AddError Fields("lmtDay").GetValueListText(Fields("lmtDay").Value) & " break 1 start must be between the shift start and shift end" End If Else If Fields("lmtBreak1StartTime").Value > Fields("lmtEndTime").Value And Fields("lmtBreak1StartTime").Value < Fields("lmtStartTime").Value Then e.AddError Fields("lmtDay").GetValueListText(Fields("lmtDay").Value) & " break 1 start must be between the shift start and shift end" End If End If End If End If End Function

Function QuoteOperations_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select qmpPlantID From Quotes Where qmpQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("qmoPlantID").Value = rsData.Fields("qmpPlantID").Value End If rsData.Close End Function
Function QuoteOperations_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE QuoteLines SET qmlMatrixCalculated = 0 WHERE qmlQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteID").Value) + " And qmlQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteLineID").Value) End Function
Function QuoteOperations_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE QuoteLines SET qmlMatrixCalculated = 0 WHERE qmlQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteID").Value) + " And qmlQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteLineID").Value) End Function
Function qmoMachineType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("qmoMachineType").Value) <> 3 Then Fields("qmoWorkCenterMachineID").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function qmoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("qmoPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function qmoProcessID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsProcesses,rsTemp,cPrev,bCopyDesc Set rsProcesses = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsProcesses.Open "select xacProcessID,xacShortDescription,xacLongDescriptionRTF,xacLongDescriptionText,xacProjectedSetupRate,xacProjectedProductionRate,xacSetupHours,xacStandardFactor,xacProductionStandard from Processes where xacProcessID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoProcessID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsProcesses.EOF = False Then If Record.EntryMode = ".NET" Then cPrev = e.PreviousValue Else cPrev = Record.PreviousValue End If Fields("qmoProcessShortDescription").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacShortDescription").Value bCopyDesc = False Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select xacLongDescriptionRTF from Processes where xacProcessID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPrev),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If App.TrimNull(Fields("qmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value) = App.TrimNull(rsTemp.Fields("xacLongDescriptionRTF").Value) Then bCopyDesc = True Else If App.TrimNull(Fields("qmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value) = "" Then bCopyDesc = True Else replaceTxt = MsgBox("Do you want to replace the long description to match your new selection?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Replace Text?") If replaceTxt = vbYes Then bCopyDesc = True Else bCopyDesc = False End If End If End If Else If App.TrimNull(Fields("qmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value) = "" Then bCopyDesc = True Else bCopyDesc = False End If End If rsTemp.Close If bCopyDesc = True Then ' Only refresh the extended description info if it doesn't match the previous operations extended description or it hasn't been entered yet. Fields("qmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("qmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacLongDescriptionText").Value End If Fields("qmoSetupRate").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacProjectedSetupRate").Value Fields("qmoProductionRate").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacProjectedProductionRate").Value
Dim bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard
bUpdateSetupHours = false bUpdateStandardFactor = false bUpdateProductionStandard = false
If CDbl(rsProcesses.Fields("xacSetupHours").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("qmoSetupHours").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacSetupHours").Value Else bUpdateSetupHours = true End If
If Trim(rsProcesses.Fields("xacStandardFactor").Value) <> "" Then Fields("qmoStandardFactor").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacStandardFactor").Value Else bUpdateStandardFactor = true End If
If CDbl(rsProcesses.Fields("xacProductionStandard").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("qmoProductionStandard").Value = rsProcesses.Fields("xacProductionStandard").Value Else bUpdateProductionStandard = true End If
Call SetWorkCenterInformation(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard)
End If rsProcesses.Close End Function
Function qmoOperationType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("qmoOperationType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("qmoPartID").Value = "" Fields("qmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = "" Fields("qmoPartRevisionID").Value = "" Fields("qmoEstimatedUnitCost").Value = 0 Fields("qmoMinimumCharge").Value = 0 Fields("qmoSupplierOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("qmoPurchaseLocationID").Value = ""
Fields("qmoQuantityBreak1").Value = 0 Fields("qmoUnitCost1").Value = 0 Fields("qmoQuantityBreak2").Value = 0 Fields("qmoUnitCost2").Value = 0 Fields("qmoQuantityBreak3").Value = 0 Fields("qmoUnitCost3").Value = 0 Fields("qmoQuantityBreak4").Value = 0 Fields("qmoUnitCost4").Value = 0
Fields("qmoStandardFactor").Value = App.Props("JM").Fields("xapJMStandardFactor").Value Else Fields("qmoAdditionalSetupHours").Value = 0 Fields("qmoAdditionalSetupQuantity").Value = 0 'Fields("qmoProductionStandard").Value = 0
Dim oRs, bPrev Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select qmaPartID,qmaPartRevisionID from QuoteAssemblies where qmaQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteID").Value) + " And qmaQuoteLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteLineID").Value) + " And qmaQuoteAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("qmoQuoteAssemblyID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText if oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InRelFieldChangeEvent App.InRelFieldChangeEvent = True Fields("qmoPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("qmaPartID").Value App.InRelFieldChangeEvent = bPrev Fields("qmoPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("qmaPartRevisionID").Value End If oRs.Close Fields("qmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("qmoStandardFactor").Value = "TD" End If End Function
Function qmoWorkCenterID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsWorkCenters Set rsWorkCenters = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsWorkCenters.Open "select xawWorkCenterID,xawProcessID,xawOverheadRate,xawQuotingRate,xawSetupHours,xawStandardFactor,xawProductionStandard,xawQueueTime,xawMoveTime from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsWorkCenters.EOF = False Then Fields("qmoQuotingRate").Value = rsWorkCenters.Fields("xawQuotingRate").Value Fields("qmoOverheadRate").Value = rsWorkCenters.Fields("xawOverheadRate").Value Fields("qmoQueueTime").Value = rsWorkCenters.Fields("xawQueueTime").Value Fields("qmoMoveTime").Value = rsWorkCenters.Fields("xawMoveTime").Value
Call SetFields(true, true, true, rsWorkCenters)
If Trim(rsWorkCenters.Fields("xawProcessID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("qmoProcessID").Value = rsWorkCenters.Fields("xawProcessID").Value End If End If rsWorkCenters.Close End Function
Private Function SetWorkCenterInformation(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawSetupHours,xawStandardFactor,xawProductionStandard from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmoWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If oRs.EOF = False Then Call SetFields(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard, oRs) End If oRs.Close End Function
Private Function SetFields(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard, oRecordSet) If bUpdateSetupHours Then If CDbl(oRecordSet.Fields("xawSetupHours").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("qmoSetupHours").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawSetupHours").Value Else Fields("qmoSetupHours").Value = 0 End If End If
If bUpdateStandardFactor Then If oRecordSet.Fields("xawStandardFactor").Value <> "" Then Fields("qmoStandardFactor").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawStandardFactor").Value Else Fields("qmoStandardFactor").Value = App.Props("JM").Fields("xapjmstandardfactor").Value End If End If
If bUpdateProductionStandard Then If CDbl(oRecordSet.Fields("xawProductionStandard").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("qmoProductionStandard").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawProductionStandard").Value Else Fields("qmoProductionStandard").Value = 0 End If End If End Function

Function EmployeeTaxCreditReturns_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "Select Top 1 parPersonalExemptionAmount From EmployeeIncomeTaxes Inner Join IncomeTaxTableRevisions On pamIncomeTaxID = parIncomeTaxID And pamIncomeTaxTypeID = parIncomeTaxTypeID And pamIncomeTaxTableID = parIncomeTaxTableID Where pamEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lncEmployeeID").Value) + " And pamEmployeeIncomeTaxID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lncEmployeeIncomeTaxID").Value) + " And parStartDate <= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(Date()) + " Order By parStartDate DESC", Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If IsNull(oRs.Fields("parPersonalExemptionAmount").Value) = False Then Fields("lncBasicPersonalAmount").Value = CDbl(oRs.Fields("parPersonalExemptionAmount").Value) End If End If oRs.Close End Function

Function CalculatePayRateFromFrequencyAmount(nStandardHours) If CDbl(nStandardHours) <> 0 Then CalculatePayRateFromFrequencyAmount = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lnrPayFrequencyAmount").Value) / CDbl(nStandardHours), 4) Else CalculatePayRateFromFrequencyAmount = 0 End If End Function
Sub RecalculatePayRateFromAward() Dim nAwardRate Dim nAddRate Dim nAddPercent Dim nPayRate If Trim(Fields("lnrAwardID").Value) <> "" Then nAwardRate = CDbl(Fields("lnrAwardRate").Value) nAddRate = CDbl(Fields("lnrAdditionalRate").Value) nAddPercent = CDbl(Fields("lnrAdditionalPercent").Value)
nPayRate = nAwardRate + nAddRate
If nAddPercent <> 0 Then nPayRate = nPayRate * (1 + (nAddPercent / 100)) End If
If CDbl(Fields("lnrPayRate").Value) <> nPayRate Then Fields("lnrPayRate").Value = App.Round(nPayRate, 4) End If End If End Sub
Sub GetAwardInfo() Dim rsTemp Dim cAwardID Dim dStartDate
cAwardID = UCase(Trim(Fields("lnrAwardID").Value)) If cAwardID <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("lnrStartDate").Value) Then dStartDate = Date Else dStartDate = Fields("lnrStartDate").Value End If Set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "select IsNull((Select Top 1 lnnPayRate From EmployeeAwardLines Where lnnEmployeeAwardID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cAwardID) + " and lnnStartDate <= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dStartDate) + " Order By lnnStartDate Desc),0) as lnnPayRate,IsNull((Select Top 1 lnnEmployeeAwardLineID From EmployeeAwardLines Where lnnEmployeeAwardID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cAwardID) + " and lnnStartDate <= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dStartDate) + " Order By lnnStartDate Desc),0) as lnnEmployeeAwardLineID From EmployeeAwards Where lnaEmployeeAwardID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cAwardID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("lnrAwardLineID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lnnEmployeeAwardLineID").Value Fields("lnrAwardRate").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lnnPayRate").Value Else Fields("lnrAwardLineID").Value = 0 Fields("lnrAwardRate").Value = 0 End If rsTemp.Close Else Fields("lnrAwardRate").Value = 0 Fields("lnrAdditionalRate").Value = 0 Fields("lnrAdditionalPercent").Value = 0 End If End Sub
Function lnrAwardID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call GetAwardInfo() End Function
Function lnrAwardRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RecalculatePayRateFromAward End Function
Function lnrPayFrequencyAmount_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Dim nPayRate Dim nSalaryAmount Dim nYearFactor
nPayRate = 0 nSalaryAmount = 0 Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select lmrPayFrequency,lmrStandardHours From PayrollDefinitions Inner Join EmployeePersonalData On lmrPayrollDefinitionID = lmdPayrollDefinitionID Where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lnrEmployeeID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then nYearFactor = App.Ax("PayrollFunctions").GetYearFactorFromFrequency(rsLookup.Fields("lmrPayFrequency").Value) nPayRate = CalculatePayRateFromFrequencyAmount(rsLookup.Fields("lmrStandardHours").Value) nSalaryAmount = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lnrPayFrequencyAmount").Value) * nYearFactor, 2) End If rsLookup.Close
If Trim(Fields("lnrAwardID").Value) = "" Then If CDbl(Fields("lnrPayRate").Value) <> nPayRate Then Fields("lnrPayRate").Value = nPayRate End If End If If CDbl(Fields("lnrSalaryAmount").Value) <> nSalaryAmount Then Fields("lnrSalaryAmount").Value = nSalaryAmount End If End Function
Function lnrAdditionalPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RecalculatePayRateFromAward End Function
Function lnrAdditionalRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call RecalculatePayRateFromAward End Function
Function lnrSalaryAmount_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Dim nFrequencyAmount Dim nYearFactor Dim nTempSalaryAmount
nFrequencyAmount = 0 nTempSalaryAmount = 0 Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select lmrPayFrequency,lmrStandardHours From PayrollDefinitions Inner Join EmployeePersonalData On lmrPayrollDefinitionID = lmdPayrollDefinitionID Where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lnrEmployeeID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then nYearFactor = App.Ax("PayrollFunctions").GetYearFactorFromFrequency(rsLookup.Fields("lmrPayFrequency").Value) nTempSalaryAmount = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lnrPayFrequencyAmount").Value) * nYearFactor, 2) nFrequencyAmount = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lnrSalaryAmount").Value) / nYearFactor, 2) End If rsLookup.Close
If Fields("lnrPayFrequencyAmount").Value <> nFrequencyAmount Then ' If this is called from the change of the pay frequency amount (salary hasn't changed) ' then don't update frequency, as we will get into an infinite loop because of rounding problems. If CDbl(Fields("lnrSalaryAmount").Value) <> nTempSalaryAmount Then Fields("lnrPayFrequencyAmount").Value = nFrequencyAmount End If End If End Function
Function lnrStartDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call GetAwardInfo() End Function
Function lnrPayRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Dim nFrequencyAmount Dim nTempPayRate
nFrequencyAmount = 0 nTempPayRate = 0 Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select lmrPayFrequency,lmrStandardHours From PayrollDefinitions Inner Join EmployeePersonalData On lmrPayrollDefinitionID = lmdPayrollDefinitionID Where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lnrEmployeeID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then nFrequencyAmount = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lnrPayRate").Value) * CDbl(rsLookup.Fields("lmrStandardHours").Value), 2) nTempPayRate = CalculatePayRateFromFrequencyAmount(rsLookup.Fields("lmrStandardHours").Value) End If rsLookup.Close
If CDbl(Fields("lnrPayFrequencyAmount").Value) <> nFrequencyAmount Then ' If this is called from the change of the pay frequency amount (pay rate hasn't changed) ' then don't update frequency, as we will get into an infinite loop because of rounding problems. If CDbl(Fields("lnrPayRate").Value) <> nTempPayRate Then Fields("lnrPayFrequencyAmount").Value = nFrequencyAmount End If End If End Function

Function padUSBox14A_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("padUSBox14A").Value) = True Then If CInt(Fields("padUSBox14B").Value) = True Or CInt(Fields("padUSBox14C").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "Multiple selections cannot be made." Else Dim rsValidate Set rsValidate = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsValidate.Open "Select 'D' As RecordType, RTrim(padDeductionID) As RecordID From Deductions Where padDeductionID <> " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("padDeductionID").Value) + " And padUSBox14A <> 0 Union All Select 'T' As RecordType, RTrim(pafIncomeTaxID)+' - '+RTrim(pafIncomeTaxTypeID) As RecordID From IncomeTaxTypes Where pafUSBox14A <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsValidate.EOF = False Then If rsValidate.Fields("RecordType").Value = "D" Then e.Cancel = "Item 1 has already been selected on Deduction " + Trim(rsValidate.Fields("RecordID").Value) Else e.Cancel = "Item 1 has already been selected on Income Tax Type " + Trim(rsValidate.Fields("RecordID").Value) End If End If rsValidate.Close End If End If End Function
Function padUSBox14B_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("padUSBox14B").Value) = True Then If CInt(Fields("padUSBox14A").Value) = True Or CInt(Fields("padUSBox14C").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "Multiple selections cannot be made." Else Dim rsValidate Set rsValidate = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsValidate.Open "Select 'D' As RecordType, RTrim(padDeductionID) As RecordID From Deductions Where padDeductionID <> " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("padDeductionID").Value) + " And padUSBox14B <> 0 Union All Select 'T' As RecordType, RTrim(pafIncomeTaxID)+' - '+RTrim(pafIncomeTaxTypeID) As RecordID From IncomeTaxTypes Where pafUSBox14B <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsValidate.EOF = False Then If rsValidate.Fields("RecordType").Value = "D" Then e.Cancel = "Item 2 has already been selected on Deduction " + Trim(rsValidate.Fields("RecordID").Value) Else e.Cancel = "Item 2 has already been selected on Income Tax Type " + Trim(rsValidate.Fields("RecordID").Value) End If End If rsValidate.Close End If End If End Function
Function padUSBox14C_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("padUSBox14C").Value) = True Then If CInt(Fields("padUSBox14B").Value) = True Or CInt(Fields("padUSBox14A").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "Multiple selections cannot be made." Else Dim rsValidate Set rsValidate = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsValidate.Open "Select 'D' As RecordType, RTrim(padDeductionID) As RecordID From Deductions Where padDeductionID <> " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("padDeductionID").Value) + " And padUSBox14C <> 0 Union All Select 'T' As RecordType, RTrim(pafIncomeTaxID)+' - '+RTrim(pafIncomeTaxTypeID) As RecordID From IncomeTaxTypes Where pafUSBox14C <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsValidate.EOF = False Then If rsValidate.Fields("RecordType").Value = "D" Then e.Cancel = "Item 3 has already been selected on Deduction " + Trim(rsValidate.Fields("RecordID").Value) Else e.Cancel = "Item 3 has already been selected on Income Tax Type " + Trim(rsValidate.Fields("RecordID").Value) End If End If rsValidate.Close End If End If End Function

Function GLCharts_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Dim nCount nCount = 0 Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select count(*) as rec_count from GLJournalLines Inner Join GLAccounts on gllGLAccountID=glaGLAccountID where glaGLChartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("glcGLChartID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("rec_count").Value) = False Then nCount = rsTemp.Fields("rec_count").Value End If End If rsTemp.Close If nCount > 0 Then Msgbox "Chart " + Trim(Fields("glcGLChartID").Value) + " is referenced on " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(nCount)) + " GL Journal Lines and cannot be deleted", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm") e.Cancel = true End If End Function
Function glcGLChartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("glcGLChartID").Value) <> "" And Len(Trim(Fields("glcGLChartID").Value)) <> 5 Then Fields("glcGLChartID").Value = Right("00000" + Trim(Fields("glcGLChartID").Value),5) End If End Function
Function glcParentAccount_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("glcParentAccount").Value) = True Then Fields("glcParentGLChartID").Value = "" Fields("glcParentDescription").Value = Trim(Fields("glcDescription").Value) Else Fields("glcParentDescription").Value = "" End If End Function
Function glcParentGLChartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp,cParentChartID cParentChartID = Trim(Fields("glcParentGLChartID").Value) If cParentChartID <> "" Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select glcGLCategoryID From GLCharts Where glcGLChartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cParentChartID),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("glcGLCategoryID").Value) <> Trim(rsTemp.Fields("glcGLCategoryID").Value) Then e.Cancel = "The category on the parent chart does not match the category on the current chart." End If End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function glcCashEquivalents_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("glcCashEquivalents").Value) = True Then Fields("glcCashFlowCategory").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function glcGLCategoryID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("glcGLCategoryID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select gltCategoryType from GLCategories where gltGLCategoryID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("glcGLCategoryID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsData.Fields("gltCategoryType").Value) <= 3 Then Fields("glcAccountType").Value = 1 Else Fields("glcAccountType").Value = 2 End If Select Case CInt(rsData.Fields("gltCategoryType").Value) Case 1: 'Assets = A Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 1 'Dr Case 2: 'Liabilities = L Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 2 'Cr Case 3: 'Equity = E Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 2 'Cr Case 4: 'Income = Rev Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 2 'Cr Case 5: 'Cost of Sales = Exp Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 1 'Dr Case 6: 'Expenses = Exp Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 1 'Dr Case 7: 'Other Income = Rev Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 2 'Cr Case 8: 'Other Expense = Exp Fields("glcNormalBalance").Value = 1 'Dr End Select End If rsData.Close End If End Function

Function mrjExistingJob_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("mrjConsolidated").Value) = True Then Fields("mrjGetPartMethod").Value = false Fields("mrjDirectLink").Value = false Fields("mrjIndirectLink").Value = false Fields("mrjSalesOrderID").Value = "" Fields("mrjSalesOrderLineID").Value = 0 Fields("mrjSalesOrderDeliveryID").Value = 0 Fields("mrjCustomerOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("mrjShipOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("mrjShipLocationID").Value = "" ElseIf CBool(Fields("mrjDirectLink").Value) = True then Fields("mrjDirectLink").Value = false Fields("mrjIndirectLink").Value = true End If End Function
Function mrjPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("mrjPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("mrjPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("mrjPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("mrjPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" or cbool(Fields("mrjSessionID").Fields("mrpCompleted")) = True then Exit Function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddWarning "Part ID '" + cPartID + "', Revision '" + cPartRevisionID + "', Warehouse '" + cWarehouse + "', Bin '" + cBin + "' is inactive." + Chr(13) End If End If End Function

Function GLRecurringJournals_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText cText = "" If CLng(Fields("glrEndGLFiscalYearID").Value) > 0 And CLng(Fields("glrStartGLFiscalYearID").Value) > CLng(Fields("glrEndGLFiscalYearID").Value) Then cText = cText + "End year must be greater than the start year" + Chr(13) End If If CLng(Fields("glrEndGLFiscalYearID").Value) = CLng(Fields("glrStartGLFiscalYearID").Value) Then If CLng(Fields("glrEndGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value) > 0 And CLng(Fields("glrStartGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value) > CLng(Fields("glrEndGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value) Then cText = cText + "End period must be greater than the start period" + Chr(13) End If End If If CDbl(Fields("glrTotalDebits").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("glrTotalCredits").Value) Then cText = cText + "Journal is out of balance" + Chr(13) End If e.AddError cText End Function

Function IncomeTaxYears_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("papUSEmployerStateIDNumber").Value) <> Trim(Fields("papUSEmployerStateIDNumber").OriginalValue) Or Trim(Fields("papEmployerState").Value) <> Trim(Fields("papEmployerState").OriginalValue) Then If Trim(Fields("papUSEmployerStateIDNumber").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("papEmployerState").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("papIncomeTaxYearID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "Update IncomeTaxYearTotals Set pahUSEmployerState1IDNumber = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("papUSEmployerStateIDNumber").Value) + " Where pahIncomeTaxYearID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("papIncomeTaxYearID").Value) + " And pahUSState1 = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("papEmployerState").Value) Connection.Execute "Update IncomeTaxYearTotals Set pahUSEmployerState2IDNumber = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("papUSEmployerStateIDNumber").Value) + " Where pahIncomeTaxYearID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("papIncomeTaxYearID").Value) + " And pahUSState2 = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("papEmployerState").Value) End If End If End Function

Function papCAIncomeTaxDeducted_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nAmount nAmount = CDbl(App.Round((Fields("papCAEmployeeCPPContributions").Value + Fields("papCAEmployerCPPContributions").Value + Fields("papCAEmployee2CPPContributions").Value + Fields("papCAEmployer2CPPContributions").Value + Fields("papCAEmployeeEIPremiums").Value + Fields("papCAEmployerEIPremiums").Value + Fields("papCAIncomeTaxDeducted").Value),2)) If CDbl(Fields("papCATotalDeductionReported").Value) <> nAmount Then Fields("papCATotalDeductionReported").Value = nAmount End If End Function

Function papCADifference_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("papCADifference").Value) <> 0 Then If CDbl(Fields("papCADifference").Value) < 0 Then Fields("papCAOverpayment").Value = -Fields("papCADifference").Value Fields("papCABalanceDue").Value = 0 Else Fields("papCABalanceDue").Value = Fields("papCADifference").Value Fields("papCAOverpayment").Value = 0 End If Else Fields("papCAOverpayment").Value = 0 Fields("papCABalanceDue").Value = 0 End If End Function

Function putEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("putEmployeeID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select lmdEmployeeID, lmdTaxFileNumber, lmdEmployeeFirstName, lmdEmployeeMiddleName, lmdEmployeeLastName, lmdAddressLine1, lmdAddressLine2,lmdCity, lmdState, lmdPostCode, lmdCountry From EmployeePersonalData Where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("putEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("putEmployeeSSN").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdTaxFileNumber").Value Fields("putEmployeeFirstName").Value = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeFirstName").Value) + " " + Left(rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeMiddleName").Value, 1) Fields("putEmployeeLastName").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeLastName").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Dim defaultCountedBy, defaultCountedDate
Function imqFinalCount_ValueChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(defaultCountedDate) Then defaultCountedDate = Now End If If IsNull(defaultCountedBy) Then defaultCountedBy = " " End If
If Trim(Fields("imqCountedBy").Value) = "" then Fields("imqCountedBy").Value = defaultCountedBy end if If IsNull(Fields("imqCountedDate").Value) = True then Fields("imqCountedDate").Value = defaultCountedDate end if End Function
Function imqCountedBy_ValueChanged(sender, e) defaultCountedBy = Trim(Fields("imqCountedBy").Value) End Function
Function imqCountedDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) defaultCountedDate = Trim(Fields("imqCountedDate").Value) End Function
Function InventoryCountLines_CurrentChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(defaultCountedDate) = True then defaultCountedDate = Now end if End Function
Function imqCountedDate_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("imqCountedDate").Value > Now then e.AddWarning "Date entered is greater than today's date" end if End Function
Function imqPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("imqFinalCount").Value) - CDbl(Fields("imqQuantityOnHand").Value) > 0 and CInt(Fields("imqInventoryCountID").Fields("imnPostedToInventory").Value) = 0 Then 'Only check for inactive source bin if quantity change will result in additional quantity going into bin cWareHouse = Trim(Fields("imqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("imqPartBinID").Value) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsBinActive(cWareHouse,cBin)) = False Then e.AddWarning "Bin is marked Inactive and will have additional quantity added to it" End If End If End Function
Function imqFinalCount_Valid(sender, e) Dim allowNegativeQtyOnHand, enableWarningWhenNegative allowNegativeQtyOnHand = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand") enableWarningWhenNegative = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMEnableWarningWhenNegative")
If allowNegativeQtyOnHand Then If App.Ax("Part").IsSerialOrLotTracked(Fields("imqPartID").Value, Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction) and CDbl(Fields("imqFinalCount").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError "Negative Final Count is not allowed for Serial/Lot tracked parts" End If If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("imqPartID").Value,Fields("imqPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("imqPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("imqPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = True And Fields("imqFinalCount").Value < 0 Then e.AddError "Final Count cannot be negative when the part bin is inactive" End If Else If CDbl(Fields("imqFinalCount").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError "Negative Inventory is disabled. Negative Final Count is not allowed" End If End If End Function

Function xbbDateExpires_Valid(sender, e) Dim bindingSource, rsDetails, nCount, cText
Set bindingSource = Record.Table.GetParentOrSiblingBindingSource("WorkCenterSkillCompetencies") If bindingSource.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = bindingSource.GetRecordset() rsDetails.MoveFirst nCount = 0 Do While rsDetails.EOF = False If Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xbbDateExpires").Value) = "" Then nCount = nCount + 1 end if rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set bindingSource = Nothing If nCount > 1 then cText = "Only one competency can have the 'Date Expires' field not specified" e.AddError cText end if End Function

Function glzStartDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("glzStartDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("glzEndDate").Value) = True Then Fields("glzEndDate").Value = DateAdd("d",-1,DateAdd("yyyy",1,Fields("glzStartDate").Value)) End If End Function

Function Leads_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "select TOP 1 lmeEmployeeID from Employees where lmeQuoterEmployee = 1 and lmeUserID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(App.UserID) + " and lmeTerminationDate IS NULL order by lmeEmployeeID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Fields("lopQuoterEmployeeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("lmeEmployeeID").Value End If rsLookup.Close
End Function
Function Leads_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "DELETE FormInputValues FROM FormInputValues Inner Join LeadLines On lolUniqueID = xaiSourceUniqueID WHERE lolLeadID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopLeadID").Value) + " And xaiSourceTable = 'LEADLINES'" End Function
Function lopProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("lopProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID,prpLocationID,prpContactID From Projects Where prpProjectID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value Fields("lopLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpLocationID").Value Fields("lopContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpContactID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function lopStatus_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("lopStatus").Value) = "C" Then Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "select TOP 1 lmeEmployeeID from Employees where lmeUserID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(App.UserID) + " and lmeTerminationDate IS NULL and lmeSalesEmployee = 1 order by lmeEmployeeID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Fields("lopClosedByEmployeeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("lmeEmployeeID").Value End If rsLookup.Close Fields("lopClosedDate").Value = Now() Else Fields("lopClosedByEmployeeID").Value = "" Fields("lopClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function lopMilestoneID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("lopMilestoneID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lopMilestoneDate").Value = Date() End If End Function
Function lopCustomRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("lopCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("lopExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("lopCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("lopLeadDate").Value) End If End Function
Function lopShipLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlShipContactID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopShipOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopShipLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("lopShipContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlShipContactID").Value Else Fields("lopShipContactID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 3 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("lopShipOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("lopShipLocationID").Value)) End If End Function
Function lopQuoteLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlQuoteContactID, cmlCurrencyRateID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopQuoteLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then
Fields("lopQuoteContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlQuoteContactID").Value Fields("lopCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value Else Fields("lopQuoteContactID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End Function
Function lopLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlARInvoiceContactID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("lopContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlARInvoiceContactID").Value Else Fields("lopContactID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 2 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("lopLocationID").Value)) End If End Function
Function lopCustomerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oCustRs Dim oShipToRs Fields("lopShipOrganizationID").Value = Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("lopLocationID").Value = "" Fields("lopContactID").Value = "" Fields("lopQuoteLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("lopQuoteContactID").Value = "" Fields("lopShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("lopShipContactID").Value = "" Else Set oCustRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oCustRs.Open "select cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID, cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID, cmoDefaultShipLocationID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oCustRs.EOF = False Then ' If blank, don't need to set it again, as the related fields are blanked out automatically each time the customer is changed. If Trim(Fields("lopLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value) Then Fields("lopLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("lopQuoteLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID").Value) Then Fields("lopQuoteLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultQuoteLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("lopShipLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value) Then Fields("lopShipLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value End If Else Fields("lopLocationID").Value = "" Fields("lopContactID").Value = "" Fields("lopQuoteLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("lopQuoteContactID").Value = "" Fields("lopShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("lopShipContactID").Value = "" End If oCustRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 1 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("lopCustomerOrganizationID").Value), "") End If End Function
Function LeadLinesCount() Dim childBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("LeadLines") If childBs.Count > 0 Then LeadLinesCount = true Else LeadLinesCount = false End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function
Function lopSplitPercentTotal_Valid(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("lopSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 0 And CDbl(Fields("lopSplitPercentTotal").Value) <> 100 Then Call e.AddError("The percentages for the salespeople listed do not total 100%") End If End Function
Function SetSalesPeople(orgID, locationID) Dim childBs, rsSales, row Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("LeadSalesPeople") childBs.SetRowCount(0) Set rsSales = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSales.Open "select cmkSalesEmployeeID,cmkPercent from OrganizationLocSalespeople where cmkOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(orgID) + " And cmkLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(locationID) + " Order By cmkSequenceID", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsSales.EOF = False Then Do While rsSales.EOF = False Set row = childBs.AddNewAsRs() row.Fields("lojSalesEmployeeID").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkSalesEmployeeID").Value row.Fields("lojPercent").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkPercent").Value rsSales.MoveNext Loop End If rsSales.Close End Function

Function stlEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("stlEmployeeID").Value) <> "" then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select lmeCessationType, lmdHomeCountry, lmdEmployeeID, lmdTaxFileNumber, lmdBirthDate, lmeHireDate, lmeTerminationDate, lmdEmployeeFirstName, lmdEmployeeLastName, lmdEmployeeMiddleName, lmdAddressLine1, lmdAddressLine2, lmdCity, lmdState, lmdPostCode, Case When lmeUseEmailPayslips = 2 Then lmdPersonalEmailAddress When lmeUseEmailPayslips = 1 Then lmeWorkEMailAddress When lmeUseEmail = 2 Then lmdPersonalEmailAddress Else lmeWorkEMailAddress End As EmailAddress, lmdPhoneNumber From EmployeePersonalData Inner Join Employees on lmdEmployeeID = lmeEmployeeID Where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("stlEmployeeID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False then Fields("stlTaxFileNumber").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdTaxFileNumber").Value Fields("stlPayeeFamilyName").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeLastName").Value Fields("stlPayeeFirstName").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeFirstName").Value Fields("stlPayeeOtherName").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeMiddleName").Value Fields("stlPayeeBirthDate").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdBirthDate").Value Fields("stlCommencementDate").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmeHireDate").Value Fields("stlCessationDate").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmeTerminationDate").Value Fields("stlAddressLine1").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdAddressLine1").Value Fields("stlAddressLine2").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdAddressLine2").Value Fields("stlSuburb").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdCity").Value Fields("stlState").Value = UCase(rsTemp.Fields("lmdState").Value) Fields("stlPostCode").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdPostCode").Value Fields("stlCountryCode").Value = "AU" Fields("stlEmailAddress").Value = rsTemp.Fields("EmailAddress").Value Fields("stlPhoneNumber").Value = Left(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("lmdPhoneNumber").Value), 16) Fields("stlHomeCountry").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdHomeCountry").Value Fields("stlCessationType").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmeCessationType").Value End If rsTemp.Close end if End Function

Function RecalculateSalesCommissionAmounts() Dim childBs, rsSales, row Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("ARRecurringInvoiceSalespeople") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsSales = childBs.GetRecordset() rsSales.MoveFirst Do While rsSales.EOF = False rsSales.Fields("aroAmount").Value = App.Round((App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arrTotalForSalesCommission").Value) * (CDbl(rsSales.Fields("aroRate").Value) / 100), 2) + CDbl(Fields("arrLineCommissionTotal").Value)) * (CDbl(rsSales.Fields("aroPercent").Value) / 100),2) rsSales.MoveNext Loop End If End Function

Function arrShipLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("arrShipOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("arrShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("arrShippingMethodID").Value = "" Fields("arrShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = "" Fields("arrFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arrSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arrCurrencyRateID").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlShipContactID,cmlCustomerShippingMethodID,cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID,cmlCustomerTaxCodeID,cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID,cmlCurrencyRateID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arrShipOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("arrShipContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlShipContactID").Value If CInt(App.Props("AR").Fields("xafARTaxOnFreight").Value) = True Then Fields("arrFreightTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arrSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID").Value Else Fields("arrFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arrSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" End If Fields("arrShippingMethodID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShippingMethodID").Value If Trim(oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arrShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCustomerShipPaymentTypeID").Value End If Fields("arrCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value
Else Fields("arrShipContactID").Value = "" Fields("arrShippingMethodID").Value = "" Fields("arrShippingPaymentTypeID").Value = "" Fields("arrFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arrSecondFreightTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("arrCurrencyRateID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 3 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("arrShipOrganizationID").Value), Trim(Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value)) End If End Function

Function arrCustomerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oCustRs Dim oShipToRs Fields("arrShipOrganizationID").Value = Fields("arrCustomerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("arrCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("arrARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("arrARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("arrShipContactID").Value = "" Else Set oCustRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oCustRs.Open "select cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID,cmoDefaultShipLocationID,cmoResellerOrganizationID,cmoResellerLocationID,cmoResellerContactID,cmoIncludeFreightInPrice from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arrCustomerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oCustRs.EOF = False Then ' If blank, don't need to set it again, as the related fields are blanked out automatically each time the customer is changed. If Trim(Fields("arrARInvoiceLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value) Then Fields("arrARInvoiceLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value) Then Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value End If Fields("arrResellerOrganizationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerOrganizationID").Value If Trim(Fields("arrResellerOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arrResellerLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerLocationID").Value Fields("arrResellerContactID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoResellerContactID").Value End If Fields("arrIncludeFreightInPrice").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoIncludeFreightInPrice").Value Else Fields("arrARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("arrARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value = "" FIelds("arrShipContactID").Value = "" End If oCustRs.Close End If If CInt(App.Props("CM").Fields("xapCMSalesPersonDefaultLoc").Value) = 1 Then Call SetSalesPeople(Trim(Fields("arrCustomerOrganizationID").Value), "") End If End Function
Function SetSalesPeople(orgID, locationID) Dim childBs, rsSales, row Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("ARRecurringInvoiceSalesPeople") childBs.SetRowCount(0) Set rsSales = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsSales.Open "select cmkSalesEmployeeID,cmkPercent from OrganizationLocSalespeople where cmkOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(orgID) + " And cmkLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(locationID) + " Order By cmkSequenceID", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsSales.EOF = False Then Do While rsSales.EOF = False Set row = childBs.AddNewAsRs() row.Fields("aroSalesEmployeeID").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkSalesEmployeeID").Value row.Fields("aroPercent").Value = rsSales.Fields("cmkPercent").Value rsSales.MoveNext Loop End If rsSales.Close End Function
