Function JobAssemblies_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Dim aValues,oRs If CLng(Fields("jmaParentAssemblyID").Value) = 0 Then Fields("jmaLevel").Value = 2 Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmaJobAssemblyID,jmaLevel,jmaQuantityToMake FROM JobAssemblies WHERE jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaJobID").Value) + " AND jmaJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmaParentAssemblyID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("jmaLevel").Value = CLng(oRs.Fields("jmaLevel").Value) + 1 Fields("jmaOrderQuantity").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value Fields("jmaInventoryQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("jmaScrapQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("jmaProductionQuantity").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value Fields("jmaQuantityToPull").Value = 0 Else MsgBox "Unable to find parent assembly - JOBASSEMBLIES AfterInsert Trigger" End If oRs.Close End If e.FocusField = "jmaPartID" End Function
Function JobAssemblies_UpdateStarted(sender, e) ' First check if the part/rev/wh/bin has changed, if so, direct to change rework qty to 0 first If Trim(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaPartID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaPartBinID").OriginalValue) Then If (CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) > 0 Or CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) > 0) And _ CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) > 0 Then Msgbox "The part/revision/warehouse/bin cannot be changed due to the Rework Quantity." & _ vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Please reduce Rework Quantity from [" & Cstr(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) & "] to 0 for:" & _ vbcrlf & "[Part: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmaPartID").OriginalValue) & "', Revision: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) & "', Warehouse: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").OriginalValue) & "' ,Bin: '" & Cstr(Fields("jmaPartBinID").OriginalValue) & "'].", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXREWORKQTYCHANGEPART", "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit function End If End If
' Check QOH for the part/rev/wh/bin Dim allowNegativeQtyOnHand allowNegativeQtyOnHand = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand") If allowNegativeQtyOnHand = False Then If CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmaReworkDate").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaReworkDate").OriginalValue) Then Dim partBinQtyRs Set partBinQtyRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") partBinQtyRs.Open "select isnull(imbQuantityOnHand,imrQuantityOnHand) As imbQuantityOnHand From PartRevisions " & _ "Left Outer Join PartBins On imbPartID = imrPartID And imbPartRevisionID = imrPartRevisionID " & _ "And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) + " AND imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value) + " " & _ "WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If partBinQtyRs.EOF = False Then Dim nQtyChange nQtyChange = CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) - CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) If Cdbl(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) < nQtyChange Then Msgbox "There is insufficient quantity on hand to save this record due to the rework quantity entered." & _ vbcrlf & vbcrlf & "Rework Quantity [" & Cstr(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is greater than Quantity On Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "].", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXINSUFFICIENTQOH", "Confirm") Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value = Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").OriginalValue e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If partBinQtyRs.Close End If End If Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End Function
Function JobAssemblies_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").OriginalValue) Then App.Ax("Job").ChangeProductionQty e.SqlTransaction,Fields("jmaJobID").Value,Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value,Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value,Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").OriginalValue,False Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If
Dim prodCompleteChanged, qtyCompleteChanged, completeDateChanged prodCompleteChanged = False qtyCompleteChanged = False completeDateChanged = False If CBool(Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value) <> CBool(Fields("jmaProductionComplete").OriginalValue) Then prodCompleteChanged = True End If If CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityCompleted").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityCompleted").OriginalValue) Then qtyCompleteChanged = True End If If IsNull(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").OriginalValue) = False Then If CDate(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value) <> CDate(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").OriginalValue) Then completeDateChanged = True End If Else If IsNull(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").OriginalValue) = True Or IsNull(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value) = True And IsNull(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").OriginalValue) = False Then completeDateChanged = True End If End If If CBool(prodCompleteChanged) = True Or CBool(qtyCompleteChanged) = True Or CBool(completeDateChanged) = True Then App.Ax("Job").CompleteJob Fields("jmaJobID").Value,Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value,False,Fields("jmaQuantityCompleted").Value,Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value,Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value,prodCompleteChanged,qtyCompleteChanged,completeDateChanged, e.SqlTransaction Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If
Dim nOldQty Dim nNewQty
nOldQty = App.Ax("Job").CalcAllocation(CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityToPull").OriginalValue),CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityIssued").OriginalValue),CInt(Fields("jmaIssuedComplete").OriginalValue)) nNewQty = App.Ax("Job").CalcAllocation(CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityToPull").Value),CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityIssued").Value),CInt(Fields("jmaIssuedComplete").Value))
App.Ax("Part").ChangeAllocations e.SqlTransaction, Fields("jmaPartID").OriginalValue,Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").OriginalValue,Fields("jmaPartWarehouseLocationID").OriginalValue,Fields("jmaPartBinID").OriginalValue,nOldQty,Fields("jmaPartID").Value,Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("jmaPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value,nNewQty
If Trim(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaPartID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "Update JobOperations Set jmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) + ", jmoPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value) + " Where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaJobID").Value) + " And jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value) + " And jmoOperationType = 2 And jmoPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartID").OriginalValue) End If
If CBool(prodCompleteChanged) = True Then Call App.Ax("Job").UpdateOperationCompleteFlagsForAsm(Fields("jmaJobID").Value, Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value, e.SqlTransaction) End If
Call RefreshPartAllocations()
End Function
Private Function RefreshPartAllocations() Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction, Fields("jmaPartID").Value, Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartRevisions") Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("PartBins") End Function
Function JobAssemblies_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("Schedule").DeleteAssemblyFromScheduleTables(Fields("jmaJobID").Value, Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value, e.SqlTransaction) Call App.Ax("Job").DeleteJobAssembly(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("jmaJobID").Value,Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End Function
Function JobAssemblies_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobAssemblies SET jmaQuantityCompleted = 0, jmaProductionComplete = 0, jmaCompletedDate = NULL, jmaOrderQuantity = 0, jmaInventoryQuantity = 0, jmaScrapQuantity = 0, jmaReworkQuantity = 0, jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory = 0, jmaQuantityToMake = 0, jmaQuantityToPull = 0, jmaQuantityIssued = 0, jmaProductionQuantity = 0, jmaReceivedComplete = 0, jmaIssuedComplete = 0, jmaScheduledStartDate = NULL, jmaScheduledDueDate = NULL WHERE " + aWhere(0)
Dim rsDest,rsSource Set rsDest = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") Set rsSource = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsDest.Open "SELECT jmaUniqueID FROM JobAssemblies WHERE " + aWhere(0) + " Order By jmaJobID,jmaJobAssemblyID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText rsSource.Open "SELECT jmaUniqueID FROM JobAssemblies WHERE " + aWhere(1) + " Order By jmaJobID,jmaJobAssemblyID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsSource.RecordCount = rsDest.RecordCount And rsSource.EOF = False Then Do While rsSource.EOF = False Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").ConfiguratorSaveAs(rsSource.Fields("jmaUniqueID").Value,rsDest.Fields("jmaUniqueID").Value,"JobAssemblies") rsSource.MoveNext rsDest.MoveNext Loop End If rsSource.Close rsDest.Close End Function
Function jmaPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText,imrAverageLaborCost+imrAverageOverheadCost+imrAverageMaterialCost+imrAverageSubcontractCost As AvgCost,imrLastLaborCost+imrLastOverheadCost+imrLastMaterialCost+imrLastSubcontractCost As LastCost,imrStandardLaborCost+imrStandardOverheadCost+imrStandardMaterialCost+imrStandardSubcontractCost As StdCost, imrDocuments from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("jmaUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("jmaPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value
Select Case CInt(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMCostingMethod").Value) Case 1,4,5: ' Avg Fields("jmaEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("AvgCost").Value Case 2: ' Last Fields("jmaEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("LastCost").Value Case 3: ' Standard Fields("jmaEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("StdCost").Value End Select Fields("jmaDocuments").Value = oRs.Fields("imrDocuments").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function jmaQuantityPerParent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If CLng(Fields("jmaJobAssemblyID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmaJobAssemblyID,jmaLevel,jmaQuantityToMake FROM JobAssemblies WHERE jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaJobID").Value) + " AND jmaJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmaParentAssemblyID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("jmaOrderQuantity").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityPerParent").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("jmaQuantityToMake").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) End If oRs.Close End If End Function

Function jmaProductionQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("Job").RefreshJobAsmQuantities(e.Row) End Function
Function jmaPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) <> "" Then If Trim(Fields("jmaPartShortDescription").Value) <> "" Then e.FocusField = "jmaQuantityPerParent" End If End If End Function
Function jmaProductionComplete_ValueChanged(sender, e) if CInt(Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value) = True And _ CDbl(Fields("jmaQuantityCompleted").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmaProductionQuantity").Value) then If Msgbox("Qty Complete does not match Production Qty. Are you sure?",vbExclamation+vbYesNo,"Confirm") = vbNo Then Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value = False End If end if
If CBool(Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value) <> CBool(Fields("jmaProductionComplete").OriginalValue) Then If CBool(Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value) = False Then If App.Ax("Job").IsJobAssemblyProductionComplete(e.SqlTransaction,Fields("jmaJobID").Value,Fields("jmaParentAssemblyID").Value) = True Then e.Cancel = "Production complete cannot be unticked as the parent assembly is marked as production complete." + chr(13) Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value = True End If End If End If
If CInt(Fields("jmaProductionComplete").Value) = True Then If IsNull(Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value) Then Fields("jmaCompletedDate").Value = Date End If End If End Function
Function jmaOverlapSourceLink_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value Then Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value Else If Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> 0 Then Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function jmaOverlapDestinationLink_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value Then Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value Else If Fields("jmaOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value <> 0 Then Fields("jmaOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function jmaAssemblyOverlap_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmaAssemblyOverlap").Value <> 0 then Fields("jmaOverlapOperationID").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function jmaReworkQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value = 0 Then Fields("jmaReworkDate").Value = Empty Else If IsEmpty(Fields("jmaReworkDate").Value) = True Or IsNull(Fields("jmaReworkDate").Value) = True Then Fields("jmaReworkDate").Value = Now End If End If End Function
Function jmaReworkQuantity_Valid(sender, e) Dim partBinQtyRs Set partBinQtyRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") partBinQtyRs.Open "select isnull(imbQuantityOnHand,imrQuantityOnHand) As imbQuantityOnHand From PartRevisions " & _ "Left Outer Join PartBins On imbPartID = imrPartID And imbPartRevisionID = imrPartRevisionID " & _ "And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) + " AND imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value) + " " & _ "WHERE imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText ' Check QOH for the part/rev/wh/bin If CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("jmaReworkDate").Value) <> Trim(Fields("jmaReworkDate").OriginalValue) Then If partBinQtyRs.EOF = False Then Dim nQtyChange nQtyChange = CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) - CDbl(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").OriginalValue) If Cdbl(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) < nQtyChange Then Dim rsPart, allowNegativeQtyOnHand, enableWarningWhenNegative Set rsPart = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") allowNegativeQtyOnHand = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMAllowNegativeQtyOnHand") enableWarningWhenNegative = App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMEnableWarningWhenNegative") rsPart.Open "Select impNonStockedItem, impPhantomOrKitPart From Parts Where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmaPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If rsPart.EOF = False Then If allowNegativeQtyOnHand And rsPart.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value = False And rsPart.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(Trim(Fields("jmaPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").Value), Trim(Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value), e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddError "This entry CAN NOT be saved because Rework Qty [" & Cstr(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is GREATER THAN Quantity on Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "] and WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand for an INACTIVE bin." Else If enableWarningWhenNegative Then e.AddWarning "Saving this record WILL RESULT in a negative quantity on hand for the Part Revision due to the rework quantity entered. Rework Quantity [" & Cstr(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is greater than Quantity on Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "]." End If End If Else If rsPart.Fields("impNonStockedItem").Value Or rsPart.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value Then e.AddError "Rework Qty cannot be entered for Kit Parts or Non-Stock Parts" Else e.AddError "There is insufficient quantity on hand to save this record due to the rework quantity entered." & _ vbcrlf & "Rework Quantity [" & Cstr(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) & "] is greater than Quantity On Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "]." End If End If End If rsPart.Close End If End If End If If partBinQtyRs.EOF = False And Int(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) > 0 Then e.AddWarning "The Rework Qty [" & Cstr(Fields("jmaReworkQuantity").Value) & "] entered will be automatically reduced from Quantity on Hand [" & Cstr(partBinQtyRs.Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) & "] for Warehouse '" + Trim(Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").Value) + "', Bin '" + Trim(Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value) + "'" end if partBinQtyRs.Close End Function
Function jmaPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Fields("jmaPartID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(Fields("jmaPartID").Value, Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("jmaPartWarehouseLocationID").Value,Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID '"&Fields("jmaPartID").Value&"', Revision '"&Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value&"', Warehouse ID '"&Fields("jmaPartWarehouseLocationID").Value&"', Bin ID '"&Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value&"' is inactive." End If End If End Function

Function qapPosted_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("qapPosted").Value Then Fields("qapPostedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("qapPostedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function Inspections_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("qapPosted").Value) = False Then Exit Function End If Dim parentBs, nInvQtyAccepted, cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cPartIDKey, rsPartRevisions, dTempPartQtyOnHand Dim rsWarehouse, bNonNettable, childBs, rsDetails, rsReceiptLine bNonNettable = False Set dTempPartQtyOnHand = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("InspectionLines") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsDetails = childBs.GetRecordset(e.Row) rsDetails.MoveFirst Do While rsDetails.EOF = False Set rsWarehouse = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWarehouse.Open "Select imwWarehouseID, imwNonNettable, imwNonNettableType From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(rsDetails.Fields("qalPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)) + " And imwNonNettable <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsWarehouse.EOF = False Then bNonNettable = rsWarehouse.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouse.Close nInvQtyAccepted = CDbl(rsDetails.Fields("qalInvQuantityAccepted").Value) cPartID = UCase(Trim(rsDetails.Fields("qalPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(rsDetails.Fields("qalPartRevisionID").Value)) cPartIDKey = cPartID & App.IIf(cPartRevisionID = "", "", "/" & cPartRevisionID) If cPartID <> "" And Trim(rsDetails.Fields("qalJobID").Value) = "" And nInvQtyAccepted <> 0 Then Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' If this revision doesn't exist, check to see if we can find another ' one and use it instead. If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then Dim nTotalCurrentCost, nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand, nInventoryUnitCost, nSetupCharge, nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand, nDutyUnitCost, nFreightUnitCost, nMiscUnitCost, bHasLandedCost nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) If dTempPartQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey) <> "" Then nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(dTempPartQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey)) Else nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) End If ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCost = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If If nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand < 0 And nInvQtyAccepted > 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = nInvQtyAccepted Else nNewQtyOnHand = nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand + nInvQtyAccepted End If If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. Set rsReceiptLine = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsReceiptLine.Open "SELECT rmlInventoryUnitCost, rmlSetupCharge, rmlDutyUnitCost, rmlFreightUnitCost, rmlMiscUnitCost, rmpLandedCost FROM ReceiptLines INNER JOIN Receipts ON rmpReceiptID = rmlReceiptID WHERE rmlUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(rsDetails.Fields("qalSourceTableUniqueID").Value)) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsReceiptLine.EOF = False Then nInventoryUnitCost = rsReceiptLine.Fields("rmlInventoryUnitCost").Value nSetupCharge = rsReceiptLine.Fields("rmlSetupCharge").Value nDutyUnitCost = rsReceiptLine.Fields("rmlDutyUnitCost").Value nFreightUnitCost = rsReceiptLine.Fields("rmlFreightUnitCost").Value nMiscUnitCost = rsReceiptLine.Fields("rmlMiscUnitCost").Value bHasLandedCost = rsReceiptLine.Fields("rmpLandedCost").Value End If rsReceiptLine.Close If nInvQtyAccepted > 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = 0 ' Set Avg matl unit cost nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyAccepted)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) + Cdbl(nSetupCharge)) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(nInventoryUnitCost) + App.Round(Cdbl(nSetupCharge) / nInvQtyAccepted, 5) ' Add a key to the dictionary or replace if no exists If dTempPartQtyOnHand.Exists(cPartIDKey) Then dTempPartQtyOnHand(cPartIDKey) = nNewQtyOnHand Else dTempPartQtyOnHand.Add cPartIDKey, nNewQtyOnHand End If End If ' Landed cost If bHasLandedCost Then ' Update duty cost nTotalCurrentCost = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If nTotalCurrentCost < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(nDutyUnitCost) * Cdbl(nInvQtyAccepted)) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastDutyCost").Value = nDutyUnitCost If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = nDutyUnitCost Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageDutyCost").Value = App.Round(nNewTotalCost / nNewQtyOnHand, 5) End If ' Update freight cost nTotalCurrentCost = (Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value)) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If nTotalCurrentCost < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(nFreightUnitCost) * (Cdbl(nInvQtyAccepted))) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastFreightCost").Value = nFreightUnitCost If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = nFreightUnitCost Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageFreightCost").Value = App.Round(nNewTotalCost / nNewQtyOnHand, 5) End If ' Update misc cost nTotalCurrentCost = (Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value)) * nPartRevisionQuantityOnHand If nTotalCurrentCost < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(nMiscUnitCost) * (Cdbl(nInvQtyAccepted))) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMiscCost").Value = nMiscUnitCost If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = nMiscUnitCost Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMiscCost").Value = App.Round(nNewTotalCost / nNewQtyOnHand, 5) End If End If End If End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End If End If rsDetails.MoveNext Loop Set rsDetails = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End Function

Function mrpCutoffDate_Valid(sender, e) If DateDiff("d",Date(),Fields("mrpCutoffDate").Value) < 0 and CInt(Fields("mrpGenerated").Value) = 0 then e.AddError "The Cutoff Date cannot be before today's date." End If End Function
Function mrpCompleted_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("mrpCompleted").Value Then Fields("mrpCompletedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("mrpCompletedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function mrpPartIDs_Valid(sender, e) Dim mrpSessionID mrpSessionID = cstr(Fields("mrpSessionID").Value) dim displayWarning displayWarning = not (CInt(Fields("mrpCompleted").Value) = False And CInt(Fields("mrpGenerated").Value) = False and Trim(Fields("mrpSessionID").Value) <> "" and Trim(Fields("mrpCutoffDate").Value) <> "") dim getDataClicked getDataClicked = cbool(App.Ax("MRP").GetDataClicked(mrpSessionID)) if displayWarning or getDataClicked then Dim returnMsg returnMsg = App.Ax("MRP").CheckOverlap(mrpSessionID, 0, 1) e.AddWarnings returnMsg, "," end if End Function
Function mrpIncludePartForecasts_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("mrpIncludePartForecasts").Value = False Then Fields("mrpConsolidatePartForecastJobs").Value = False End if End Function

Function iniPosted_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("iniPosted").Value Then Fields("iniPostedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("iniPostedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function MaterialIssues_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("iniPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("iniMaterialIssueID").Value)) = True Then e.Cancel = True Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) Exit Function End If End If
dim issueId,issueLineId If CBool(Fields("iniReversalEntry").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("iniPosted").Value)=False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT injReverseMaterialIssueID, injReverseMaterialIssueLineID FROM MaterialIssueLines WHERE injMaterialIssueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("iniMaterialIssueID").Value) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False issueId=Trim(rsTemp.Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueID").Value) issueLineId=rsTemp.Fields("injReverseMaterialIssueLineID").Value If issueId <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssueLines Set injReversed=0 Where injMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(issueId)+" And injMaterialIssueLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(issueLineId) Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssueComponents Set inkReversed=0 Where inkMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(issueId)+" And inkMaterialIssueLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(issueLineId) Connection.Execute "Update MaterialIssues Set iniReversed=0 Where iniMaterialIssueID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(issueId) End if rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function MaterialIssues_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("iniPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MaterialIssue").MaterialIssuePostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("iniMaterialIssueID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit Function End If End If End Function

Function pahPayrollEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("pahPayrollEmployeeID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select lmdEmployeeID, lmdTaxFileNumber, lmdEmployeeFirstName, lmdEmployeeMiddleName, lmdEmployeeLastName, lmdAddressLine1, lmdAddressLine2,lmdCity, lmdState, lmdPostCode, lmdCountry From EmployeePersonalData Where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pahPayrollEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("pahEmployeeTaxFileNumber").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdTaxFileNumber").Value Fields("pahEmployeeFirstName").Value = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeFirstName").Value) + " " + Left(rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeMiddleName").Value, 1) Fields("pahEmployeeLastName").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdEmployeeLastName").Value Fields("pahEmployeeAddressLine1").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdAddressLine1").Value Fields("pahEmployeeAddressLine2").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdAddressLine2").Value Fields("pahEmployeeCity").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdCity").Value Fields("pahEmployeeState").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdState").Value Fields("pahEmployeePostCode").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdPostCode").Value Fields("pahEmployeeCountry").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmdCountry").Value
Fields("pahCAEmploymentProvince").Value = UCase(Left(Trim(rsTemp.Fields("lmdState").Value) + Space(2), 2)) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function pahUSState1_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("pahUSState1").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select paxExternalTaxID From IncomeTaxes Where paxState = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pahUSState1").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("pahUSEmployerState1IDNumber").Value = rsTemp.Fields("paxExternalTaxID").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
