Function LandedCosts_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) ' Add charge defaults Dim rsDefaults Set rsDefaults = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsDefaults.Open "Select rmaLandedCostCategoryID From LandedCostCategories Where rmaDefault = 1", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If Not rsDefaults.Eof Then Set landedCostCharges = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("LandedCostCharges") If IsNull(LandedCostCharges) = False Then Do While Not rsDefaults.EOF Set row = landedCostCharges.AddNewAsRs() row.fields("rmhLandedCostCategoryID").Value = rsDefaults.fields("rmaLandedCostCategoryID").value rsDefaults.MoveNext Loop End If Set landedCostCharges = Nothing End If rsDefaults.Close End Function
Function LandedCosts_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("LandedCost").RefreshLandedCostChargeDetails(Record.Table.BindingSource, Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction) Call App.Ax("LandedCost").RefreshReceiptLineDetails(Record.Table.BindingSource, Record.Table.BindingSource.Transaction) End Function
Function LandedCosts_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Dim cLandedCostID cLandedCostID = Trim(Fields("rmcLandedCostID").Value) If cLandedCostID <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update PurchaseOrderLines Set pmlLandedCostID = '' Where pmlLandedCostID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cLandedCostID) End If End Function
Function rmcClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("rmcClosed").Value) = True Then Fields("rmcClosedDate").Value = Date Else Fields("rmcClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function rmcLandedCostDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim info If IsNull(Fields("rmcLandedCostDate").Value) = False Then Set info = App.Ax("Financial").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("rmcLandedCostDate").Value,"LC",False) If info.Success Then Fields("rmcGLFiscalYearID").Value = info.Year Fields("rmcGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value = info.Period End If End If End Function
Function InTransitChargeCount() Dim childBs, rsSales, totalCount totalCount = 0 Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("LandedCostCharges") If childBs.Count > 0 Then Set rsCharges = childBs.GetRecordset() rsCharges.MoveFirst Do While rsCharges.EOF = False If CBool(rsCharges.Fields("rmhInTransitJournalsCreated").Value) = True Then totalCount = totalCount + 1 End If rsCharges.MoveNext Loop End If InTransitChargeCount = totalCount end function
Function rmcPostedToGL_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("rmcPostedToGL").Value Then Fields("rmcPostedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("rmcPostedDate").Value = Null End If End Function

Function omoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsParts
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("omoPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("omoPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("omoDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("omoUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End Function
Function omoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("omoPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("omoPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("omoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("omoPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddWarning "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect" + Chr(13) End If End If end function

Dim inChange
Function GetAmount(e) Dim parentBs, nAmount Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) GetAmount = CDbl(App.Round(parentBs.Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value * (Fields("pmxPercent").Value / 100),2)) End Function
Sub CalculateAmount(e) Dim nAmount nAmount = GetAmount(e) If nAmount <> CDbl(Fields("pmxAmount").Value) Then Fields("pmxAmount").Value = nAmount End If End Sub
Function pmxPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(inChange) = False Then inChange = True Call CalculateAmount(e) inChange = False End If End Function
Function GetPercent(e) Dim parentBs Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) If Cdbl(parentBs.Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) <> 0 Then GetPercent = CDbl(App.Round((Fields("pmxAmount").Value / parentBs.Fields("pmlExtendedCostBase").Value) * 100,5)) End If End Function
Sub CalculatePercent(e) Dim nPercent nPercent = GetPercent(e) If nPercent <> CDbl(Fields("pmxPercent").Value) Then Fields("pmxPercent").Value = nPercent End If End Sub
Function pmxAmount_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(inChange) = False Then inChange = True Call CalculatePercent(e) inChange = False End If End Function
Function PurchaseOrderAccounts_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Fields("pmxPurchaseOrderAccountID").Value = Record.Table.BindingSource.Count call ValidatePurchaseOrderAccounts End Function
Function PurchaseOrderAccounts_RemoveStarted(sender, e) call ValidatePurchaseOrderAccounts End Function
sub ValidatePurchaseOrderAccounts() Dim tableRecordSet, percentTotal
Set tableRecordSet = Record.Table.BindingSource.GetRecordset() percentTotal = 0
If tableRecordSet.RecordCount = 1 Then percentTotal = 100 tableRecordSet.Fields("pmxPercent").Value = percentTotal End If
tableRecordSet.Close End sub

Function mwoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value = "" Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value = Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value Fields("mwoDestinationWarehouseID").Value = "" Fields("mwoDestinationWarehouseID").Value = Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlDestinationWarehouseID").Value End Function
Function mwoSourceWarehouseID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value) <> "" Then Dim setWarehouseBinId setWarehouseBinID = "" isFoundBinValid = App.Ax("Part").GetWarehouseBinForWarehouseTransferLine(Record.Table.BindingSource, Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value), setWarehouseBinID, Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlPartID").Value, Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value) If isFoundBinValid Then Fields("mwoSourcePartBinID").Value = setWarehouseBinID End If End If End Function
Function mwoDestinationWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwoDestinationWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddWarning "Destination warehouse does not exist for part " + Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) + " and will be created upon save." End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function mwoSourceWarehouseID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imlPartID from PartWarehouseLocations Where imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value)) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Source warehouse does not exist for part '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) + "' Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value) + "'" Else rsLookup.Open "SELECT imwInactive from Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsLookup.fields("imwInactive").Value) = True and cbool(Fields("mwoPosted").Value) = false And Trim(Fields("mwoReverseWHTransferID").Value) = "" Then rsLookup.Open "SELECT impNonStockedItem, SUM(imbQuantityOnHand + imbQuantityToInspect) AS Quantity from PartBins INNER JOIN Parts ON imbPartID = impPartID Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value)) + " group by impNonStockedItem", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsLookup.fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = False AND cdbl(rsLookup.fields("Quantity").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Warehouse '" + Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value + "' is assigned to this part revision, but is inactive and all bins have no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect. [Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value) + "']" End If End If End If End If End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function mwoSourcePartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") If Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value) <> "" Then rsLookup.Open "select imbPartBinID from PartBins Where imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoSourcePartBinID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then Dim setWarehouseBinId setWarehouseBinID = "" isFoundBinValid = App.Ax("Part").GetWarehouseBinForWarehouseTransferLine(Record.Table.BindingSource, Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value), setWarehouseBinID, Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlPartID").Value, Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlPartRevisionID").Value, e.SqlTransaction) If isFoundBinValid = False Then e.AddError "ALL Bins in the Source Warehouse for Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value) + "' are INACTIVE and have no quantity on hand." Else e.AddError "Source bin does not exist for part '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value) + "'" End If Else If cbool(Fields("mwoPosted").Value) = false And Trim(Fields("mwoReverseWHTransferID").Value) = "" then rsLookup.Open "SELECT impNonStockedItem, imbQuantityOnHand, imbQuantityToInspect FROM PartBins INNER JOIN Parts ON imbPartID = impPartID WHERE imbInactiveBin = 1 AND imbPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value)) + " And imbPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value)) + " And imbWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value) + " And imbPartBinID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("mwoSourcePartBinID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If cbool(rsLookup.fields("impNonStockedItem").Value) = False AND cdbl(rsLookup.fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value) + cdbl(rsLookup.fields("imbQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Bin in the Source Warehouse for Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("mwoPartRevisionID").Value) + "' is INACTIVE and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." End If End If End If End If rsLookup.Close End If End Function
Function WarehouseTransferComponents_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Fields("mwoSourceWarehouseID").Value = Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlSourceWarehouseID").Value Fields("mwoDestinationWarehouseID").Value = Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferLineID").Fields("mwlDestinationWarehouseID").Value End Function
Function mwoShipQuantity_Valid(sender, e) call validateNegativeQuantities(Fields("mwoShipQuantity").Value, Fields("mwoShipQuantity").Caption, e) End Function
Function validateNegativeQuantities(quantity, fieldCaption, e) If cdbl(quantity) < 0 And CBool(Fields("mwoWarehouseTransferID").Fields("mwpReversalEntry").Value) = False Then e.AddError trim(fieldCaption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) end if End Function
Function rmtInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("rmtInactive").Value) = True Then Fields("rmtInactiveDate").Value = Date Else Fields("rmtInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function apaInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("apaInactive").Value) = True Then Fields("apaInactiveDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("apaInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function

Function dmoPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(Trim(Fields("dmoPartID").Value), e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(Trim(Fields("dmoPartID").Value), Trim(Fields("dmoPartRevisionID").Value), Trim(Fields("dmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value), Trim(Fields("dmoPartBinID").Value), e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID '" + Trim(Fields("dmoPartID").Value) + "', Revision '" + Trim(Fields("dmoPartRevisionID").Value) + "', Warehouse '" + Trim(Fields("dmoPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) + "', Bin '" + Trim(Fields("dmoPartBinID").Value) + "' is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect." End If End If End Function

Function ProductCategoryLines_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Dim oRs If CLng(Fields("insParentLineID").Value) = 0 Then Fields("insLevel").Value = 2 Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT insLevel FROM ProductCategoryLines WHERE insProductCategoryID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("insProductCategoryID").Value) + " AND insProductCategoryLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("insParentLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("insLevel").Value = CLng(oRs.Fields("insLevel").Value) + 1 End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function ProductCategoryLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("ProductCategory").DeleteProductCategoryLine(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("insProductCategoryID").Value,Fields("insProductCategoryLineID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End Function
Function insStructureID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "Select * From ProductCategoryLines Where insProductCategoryID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("insProductCategoryID").Value) + " And insProductCategoryLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("insParentLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockREadOnly, adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False then Fields("insStructureCode").Value = Trim(oRs.Fields("insStructureCode").Value) + Trim(Fields("insStructureID").Value) end if oRs.Close End Function

Function ARRecurringInvoiceLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) ' Default Taxable and Non-Tax Reason to the customer specified on the invoice header Dim rsParent Dim rsLookup Set rsParent = Fields("arqARRecurringInvoiceID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("arrProjectID,arrShipOrganizationID,arrShipLocationID") If rsParent.EOF = False Then Fields("arqProjectID").value = rsParent.Fields("arrProjectID").value Set rsLookup = CreateObject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "SELECT cmlCustomerTaxable,cmlCustomerTaxCodeID,cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID,cmlNonTaxReasonID FROM OrganizationLocations WHERE cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsParent.Fields("arrShipOrganizationID").Value) + " AND cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(rsParent.Fields("arrShipLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsLookup.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxable").Value) = True Then Fields("arqTaxCodeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("cmlCustomerTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arqSecondTaxCodeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("cmlCustomerSecondTaxCodeID").Value End If Fields("arqNonTaxReasonID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("cmlNonTaxReasonID").Value End If rsLookup.Close End If Set rsParent = Nothing End Function
Function CalculateDiscountPercent() Dim nPrice nPrice = 0 If CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountForeign").Value) / CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) nPrice = App.Round(nPrice * 100,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If End If CalculateDiscountPercent = nPrice End Function
Sub CheckSellPrice Dim rsInvoice,nPrice,nFullPrice,bForeignAmount If Trim(Fields("arqPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsInvoice = Fields("arqARRecurringInvoiceID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("arrCustomerOrganizationID,arrARInvoiceLocationID,arrCurrencyRateID") If rsInvoice.EOF = False Then Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetSellingPrice(Fields("arqPartID").Value,Fields("arqPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("arqPartGroupID").Value,rsInvoice.Fields("arrCustomerOrganizationID").Value,rsInvoice.Fields("arrARInvoiceLocationID").Value,Fields("arqOrderQuantity").Value,rsInvoice.Fields("arrCurrencyRateID").Value,Nothing) nPrice = 0 nFullPrice = 0 bForeignAmount = False If IsNull(priceObj) = False Then nFullPrice = priceObj.FullPrice nPrice = priceObj.DiscountedPrice bForeignAmount = priceObj.IsForeignCurrency End If Set priceObj = nothing
If Cdbl(nPrice) <> -1 Then If bForeignAmount = True Then Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value = nFullPrice Fields("arqUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice Else Fields("arqFullUnitPriceBase").Value = nFullPrice Fields("arqUnitPriceBase").Value = nPrice End If End If End If Set rsInvoice = Nothing End If End Sub
Function arqFullUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice, nPercent nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("arqUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arqUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("arqDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("arqDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function arqSecondTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("arqSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("arqSecondTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("arqExtendedPriceForeign").Value, Date, Fields("arqTaxAmountForeign").Value, 4) End Function
Function arqUnitPriceBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceBase").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arqUnitPriceBase").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountBase").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arqUnitDiscountBase").Value = nPrice End If Else Fields("arqFullUnitPriceBase").Value = Fields("arqUnitPriceBase").Value End If End Function
Function arqTaxAmountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("arqSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("arqSecondTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("arqExtendedPriceForeign").Value, Date, Fields("arqTaxAmountForeign").Value, 4) End Function
Function arqPartGroupID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Dim nRate nRate = 0 If Trim(Fields("arqPartGroupID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsTemp = Fields("arqPartGroupID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("imuCommissionType,imuCommissionRate") If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsTemp.Fields("imuCommissionType").Value) = 2 Then nRate = CInt(rsTemp.Fields("imuCommissionRate").Value) End If End If End If Fields("arqCommissionRate").Value = nRate End Function
Function arqUnitDiscountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,nPercent nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("arqUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arqUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("arqDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("arqDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function arqTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("arqTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("arqTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("arqExtendedPriceForeign").Value, Date, 0, 4) Fields("arqNonTaxReasonID").Value = "" End Function
Function arqPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("arqPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arqPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arqPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("arqPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("arqUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("arqPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("arqPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value Call CheckSellPrice End If oRs.Close e.FocusField = "arqOrderQuantity" End If End Function
Function arqDiscountPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,nPercent nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If nPercent <> CDbl(Fields("arqDiscountPercent").Value) Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("arqDiscountPercent").Value) / 100),5) If CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arqUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If End If End Function
Function arqOrderQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("arqInvoiceQuantity").Value = Fields("arqOrderQuantity").Value Call CheckSellPrice End Function
Function arqUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arqUnitPriceForeign").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arqUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If Else Fields("arqFullUnitPriceForeign").Value = Fields("arqUnitPriceForeign").Value End If End Function
Function arqUnitDiscountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountBase").Value) If CDbl(Fields("arqUnitPriceBase").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arqUnitPriceBase").Value = nPrice End If End Function
Function arqExtendedPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("arqTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("arqTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("arqExtendedPriceForeign").Value, Date, 0, 4) Fields("arqSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("arqSecondTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("arqExtendedPriceForeign").Value, Date, Fields("arqTaxAmountForeign").Value, 4) End Function
Function arqFullUnitPriceBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("arqFullUnitPriceBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("arqUnitDiscountBase").Value) If CDbl(Fields("arqUnitPriceBase").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("arqUnitPriceBase").Value = nPrice End If End Function
Function arqPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("arqPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select impPartGroupID,impTaxCodeID,impSecondTaxCodeID,impAlwaysNonTaxable,impNonTaxReasonID from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("arqPartID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("arqPartGroupID").Value = oRs.Fields("impPartGroupID").Value If CInt(oRs.Fields("impAlwaysNonTaxable").Value) = True Then Fields("arqTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value Fields("arqSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value Else If Trim(oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arqTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impTaxCodeID").Value End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arqSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("impSecondTaxCodeID").Value End If End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("impNonTaxReasonID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("arqNonTaxReasonID").Value = oRs.Fields("impNonTaxReasonID").Value End If End If oRs.Close If Trim(Fields("arqPartShortDescription").Value) <> "" Then e.FocusField = "arqOrderQuantity" End If End If End Function
Function ARRecurringInvoiceLines_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) e.FocusField = "arqPartID" End Function

Function immUseDefaultWarehouseAndBin_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("immUseDefaultWarehouseAndBin").Value) = True Then Fields("immPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = "" Fields("immPartBinID").Value = "" Else Call SetDefaultValue End If End Function
Function SetDefaultValue() Dim selectedPartID, selectedPartRevisionID, emptyPlantID Dim setWarehouseID, setWarehouseBinID, setMessage setWarehouseID ="" setWarehouseBinID = "" setMessage = "" selectedPartID = Fields("immPartID").Value selectedPartRevisionID = Fields("immPartRevisionID").Value emptyPlantID = "" if selectedPartID = "" then Exit Function End if
dim searchWarehouseAndBin searchWarehouseAndBin = App.Ax("Part").InitializeWarehouseBinForOutboundPart(Record.Table.BindingSource, selectedPartID, selectedPartRevisionID, emptyPlantID, setWarehouseID, setWarehouseBinID, setMessage)
If searchWarehouseAndBin = True then Fields("immPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = setWarehouseID Fields("immPartBinID").Value = setWarehouseBinID End If End Function
Function immPartID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("immPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsParts Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsParts.Open "select impTrackSerialNumbers,impTrackLotNumbers from Parts where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(UCase(Trim(Fields("immPartID").Value))), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then If (CInt(rsParts.Fields("impTrackSerialNumbers").Value) = True And CInt(Fields("immBackflush").Value) = True) Or (CInt(rsParts.Fields("impTrackLotNumbers").Value) = True And CInt(Fields("immBackflush").Value) = True) Then Fields("immBackflush").Value = False End If End If rsParts.Close If Trim(Fields("immPartShortDescription").Value) <> "" Then e.FocusField = "immQuantityPerAssembly" End If End If End Function
Function immRelatedPartOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("immRelatedPartOperationID").Value) = 0 Then Fields("immBackflush").Value = False Else Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If Fields("immRelatedPartOperationID").Value <> 0 Then rsTemp.Open "select imoMethodOperationID from PartOperations where imoMethodID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("immMethodID").Value)) & " and imoMethodRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("immMethodRevisionID").Value)) & " and imoMethodAssemblyID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("immMethodAssemblyID").Value)) & " and imoMethodOperationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("immRelatedPartOperationID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = True Then e.Cancel = "Related Part Operation ID does not exist" Fields("immRelatedPartOperationID").Value = 0 End If End If End If End Function
Function immPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("immPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText,imrSupplierOrganizationID,imrPurchaseLocationID,imrLeadTime,imrAverageLaborCost+imrAverageOverheadCost+imrAverageMaterialCost+imrAverageSubcontractCost+imrAverageDutyCost+imrAverageFreightCost+imrAverageMiscCost As AvgCost,imrLastLaborCost+imrLastOverheadCost+imrLastMaterialCost+imrLastSubcontractCost+imrLastDutyCost+imrLastFreightCost+imrLastMiscCost As LastCost,imrStandardLaborCost+imrStandardOverheadCost+imrStandardMaterialCost+imrStandardSubcontractCost+imrStandardDutyCost+imrStandardFreightCost+imrStandardMiscCost As StdCost from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("immPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("immPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("immPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("immUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("immPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("immPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value ' Set lead time before supplier because it may be changed there. Fields("immLeadTime").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLeadTime").Value Fields("immSupplierOrganizationID").Value = oRs.Fields("imrSupplierOrganizationID").Value Fields("immPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("imrPurchaseLocationID").Value
Select Case CInt(App.Props("IM").Fields("xapIMCostingMethod").Value) Case 1,4,5: ' Avg Fields("immEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("AvgCost").Value Case 2: ' Last Fields("immEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("LastCost").Value Case 3: ' Standard Fields("immEstimatedUnitCost").Value = oRs.Fields("StdCost").Value End Select If CInt(Fields("immUseDefaultWarehouseAndBin").Value) = False Then Call SetDefaultValue End If End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function PartMaterials_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) e.FocusField = "immPartID" End Function
Function immPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("immPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("immPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("immPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("immPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End If If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse,cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = true Then e.AddWarning "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect" + Chr(13) End If End If End Function

Function PartBins_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim rsData If IsNull(Record.Table.ParentBindingSource) Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "SELECT * FROM PartWarehouseLocations WHERE imlPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imbPartID").Value) + " And imlPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imbPartRevisionID").Value) + " And imlPartWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = True Then rsData.AddNew rsData.Fields("imlPartID").Value = Fields("imbPartID").Value rsData.Fields("imlPartRevisionID").Value = Fields("imbPartRevisionID").Value rsData.Fields("imlPartWarehouseID").Value = Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value rsData.UpdateBatch End If rsData.Close End If Call App.Ax("Part").RefreshPartAllocations(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("imbPartID").Value, Fields("imbPartRevisionID").Value) End Function
Function imbDefaultBin_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("imbDefaultBin").Value) = True then Dim currentBs Set currentBs = Record.Table.BindingSource If currentBs.Count > 0 Then Dim rows Set rows = currentBs.GetRecordset() If rows.recordcount > 0 Then rows.MoveFirst do while rows.EOF = False If CBool(rows.Fields("imbDefaultBin").Value) = True And Trim(Fields("imbPartID").Value) = Trim(rows.Fields("imbPartID").Value) And Trim(Fields("imbPartRevisionID").Value) = Trim(rows.Fields("imbPartRevisionID").Value) Then if Trim(Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value) = Trim(rows.Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value) Then if Trim(Fields("imbPartBinID").Value) <> Trim(rows.Fields("imbPartBinID").Value) Then rows.Fields("imbDefaultBin").Value = False end if Else rows.Fields("imbDefaultBin").Value = False End If End If rows.MoveNext loop End If Set rows = Nothing End If Set childBs = Nothing End If End Function
Function PartBins_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE PartBins SET imbQuantityOnHand = 0, imbBinQuantityOnHand = 0, imbQuantityAllocated = 0, imbQuantityToInspect = 0, imbQuantityToReturn = 0, imbQuantityToReturnJob = 0, imbQuantityOnOrderSales = 0, imbQuantityOnOrderPurchases = 0 WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function PartBins_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Dim warehouseLocBs, newRow Set warehouseLocBs = Record.Table.GetParentOrSiblingBindingSource("PartWarehouseLocations") If Not warehouseLocBs.DoesKeyExist(Array(Fields("imbPartID").Value, Fields("imbPartRevisionID").Value, Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value)) Then Set newRow = warehouseLocBs.AddNewAsRs() newRow.Fields("imlPartWarehouseID").Value = Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value End If End Function
Function imbConversionFactor_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("imbConversionFactor").Value) = 0 Then Fields("imbBinQuantityOnHand").Value = Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value Else Fields("imbBinQuantityOnHand").Value = Fields("imbQuantityOnHand").Value / Fields("imbConversionFactor").Value End If End Function
Function imbPartBinID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("imbDescription").Value=Fields("imbPartBinID").Fields("inbDescription").Value End Function
Function PartBins_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Fields("imbDescription").Value=Fields("imbPartBinID").Fields("inbDescription").Value End Function
Function PartBins_RemoveStarted(sender, e) Dim parentBs, partWarehouseLocationsBs, rsPartBins, sWhere
set rsPartBins = Record.Table.BindingSource.Recordset.Select("imbWarehouseID = '" & Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value & "'") sWhere = "Fields(" & chr(34) & "imlPartWarehouseID" & chr(34) & ") = " & chr(34) & Fields("imbWarehouseID").Value & chr(34)
If rsPartBins.RecordCount = 1 then Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) Set partWarehouseLocationsBs = parentBs.PrimaryTable.GetChildBindingSource("PartWarehouseLocations")
call partWarehouseLocationsBs.RemoveWhere(sWhere) End If End Function
Function imbInactiveBin_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("imbInactiveBin").Value) = True Then Fields("imbInactiveBinDate").Value = Date Else Fields("imbInactiveBinDate").Value = null End if End Function

Function TimecardLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim oRs,dTimecardDate dTimecardDate = Null Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select lmpEmployeeID,lmpShiftID,lmpTimecardDate,lmpProjectID from Timecards where lmpTimecardID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmlTimecardID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("lmlEmployeeID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmpEmployeeID").Value Fields("lmlShiftID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmpShiftID").Value Fields("lmlProjectID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmpProjectID").Value dTimecardDate = oRs.Fields("lmpTimecardDate").Value End If oRs.Close
oRs.Open "select top 1 lmlRoundedEndTime From TimecardLines Where lmlTimecardID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmlTimecardID").Value) + " Order By lmlRoundedEndTime Desc",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value = oRs.Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value Else Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value = App.Ax("Shift").GetDayStartTime(Fields("lmlShiftID").Value, dTimecardDate, e.SqlTransaction) ' Added to to fix -rounded end time is earlier than the rounded start time error when changing the labor hours 'Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value=Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value
End If oRs.Close
If Trim(Fields("lmlEmployeeID").Value) <> "" Then oRs.Open "select lmeDirectExpenseID,lmeIndirectExpenseID,lmeDefaultWorkCenterID from Employees where lmeEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 1 Then If Trim(oRs.Fields("lmeDirectExpenseID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlExpenseID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmeDirectExpenseID").Value End If Else If Trim(oRs.Fields("lmeIndirectExpenseID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlExpenseID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmeIndirectExpenseID").Value End If End If If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 2 Then If Trim(oRs.FIelds("lmeDefaultWorkCenterID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value = oRs.FIelds("lmeDefaultWorkCenterID").Value End If End If End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function TimecardLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim oRs,dTimecardDate Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") ' Update labor cost field If CDbl(Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) = 0 Then Fields("lmlLaborCost").Value = 0 Else oRs.Open "select lmdLaborRate from EmployeePersonalData where lmdEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("lmlLaborCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("lmdLaborRate").Value),2) Else Fields("lmlLaborCost").Value = 0 End If oRs.Close End If
' Update burden cost field oRs.Open "select xawOverheadCalculationType,xawOverheadRate from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If CInt(oRs.Fields("xawOverheadCalculationType").Value) = 2 Then ' Calculate burden on machine hours If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 1 Then ' Direct timecard Fields("lmlOverheadCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lmlMachineHours").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xawOverheadRate").Value),2) Else ' Indirect timecard ' If indirect and calculate burden on machine hours is true, don't update the ' burden cost because the user wasn't using a machine. Fields("lmlOverheadCost").Value = 0 End If Else ' Calculate burden on labour hours Fields("lmlOverheadCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xawOverheadRate").Value),2) End If Else Fields("lmlOverheadCost").Value = 0 End If oRs.Close
' Need to check timecard created date against upgrading to V9.2 ' If less than this date, material issues will need to be manually reveresed and re-issued dTimecardDate = GetTimecardDate(Fields) Dim createdDate If IsNull(Fields("lmlCreatedDate").Value) = True then createdDate = Now Else createdDate = Fields("lmlCreatedDate").Value End If If Cdate(dTimecardDate) < Cdate(App.Props("DS").Fields("xadVersion92UpgradeDate").Value) And cDate(createdDate) < Cdate(App.Props("DS").Fields("xadVersion92UpgradeDate").Value) Then ' Check to see if operation has any linked backflushed materials Dim rsBackflushCheck set rsBackflushCheck = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsBackflushCheck.open "Select jmmBackflush from JobMaterials where jmmJobID= " & _ App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("lmlJobID").Value) & " and jmmJobAssemblyID=" & _ App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").Value) & _ " and jmmRelatedJobOperationID=" & _ App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").Value) & _ " and jmmBackflush = 1" ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsBackflushCheck.RecordCount > 0 Then Call msgbox("Materials linked to this job operation will need to be manually reversed and re-issued.",VbExclamation+VbOkOnly,"Confirm Validation Message") End If rsBackflushCheck.Close Else If Trim(Fields("lmlJobID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("lmlJobID").OriginalValue) Or _ CLng(Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").Value) <> CLng(Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").OriginalValue) Or _ CLng(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").Value) <> CLng(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").OriginalValue) Or _ CLng(Fields("lmlCompletionType").Value) <> CLng(Fields("lmlCompletionType").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlGoodQuantity").Value) + CDbl(Fields("lmlScrapQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlGoodQuantity").OriginalValue) + CDbl(Fields("lmlScrapQuantity").OriginalValue) Then
' Need to create reversal material issues for all associated timecards Dim oMaterialIssues, returnMsg, oReversalItem Set oMaterialIssues = createobject("adodb.recordset") Set oReversalItem = createobject("adodb.recordset") oMaterialIssues.Open "Select iniMaterialIssueID from MaterialIssues Where iniPosted = 1 and iniReversalEntry = 0 and iniReversed = 0 and iniSourceTableUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("lmlUniqueID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText Do While oMaterialIssues.eof = false ' If any return msg, then there was an error, display and stop save returnMsg = "" returnMsg = Trim(App.RunTransferProcess("M1.Ax.Erp.MaterialIssueReversalProcess", e.Database, Array(oMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value))) If returnMsg <> "" Then msgbox returnMsg TimecardLines_UpdateStarted = False Exit Function End if ' Need to find new reversal material issue, and post oReversalItem.Open "Select Distinct injMaterialIssueID From MaterialIssueLines Where injReverseMaterialIssueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(oMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value), connection, 3, 1 if oReversalItem.eof = false then ' not using a transaction here, as per not using one in the runtransferprocess (enhance later) Call App.Ax("MaterialIssue").PostMaterialIssueScript(nothing, oReversalItem.fields("injMaterialIssueID").value) end if oReversalItem.close
oMaterialIssues.movenext Loop oMaterialIssues.Close
' Then re-issue all backflushed material If CInt(Fields("lmlCompletionType").Value) = 1 Or CInt(Fields("lmlCompletionType").Value) = 3 Then bComplete = False Else bComplete = True End If If App.Ax("JobFunctions").Backflush(Fields("lmlJobID").Value,Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").Value,Fields("lmlJobOperationID").Value,CDbl(Fields("lmlGoodQuantity").Value),CDbl(Fields("lmlScrapQuantity").Value),bComplete,dTimecardDate,"",Fields("lmlUniqueID").Value) = False Then TimecardLines_UpdateStarted = False Exit Function End If End If End If
If Trim(Fields("lmlJobID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("lmlJobID").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").OriginalValue) Or _ CInt(Fields("lmlWorkType").Value) <> CInt(Fields("lmlWorkType").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlMachineHours").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlMachineHours").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlGoodQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlGoodQuantity").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlScrapQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlScrapQuantity").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlSetupPercentCompleted").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlSetupPercentCompleted").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("lmlCompletionType").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("lmlCompletionType").OriginalValue) Then ' Need to change related job operation record Call App.Ax("TimecardLine").BackOutJobOperation(e.Row, e.SqlTransaction) Call App.Ax("TimecardLine").AddToJobOperation(e.Row, e.SqlTransaction) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("JobOperations") End If
End Function
Function TimecardLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) ' Check if there is a un-posted material issue associated to the a job that belongs to the ' Timecard line to be deleted Dim oPostedMaterialIssues Set oPostedMaterialIssues = createobject("adodb.recordset") oPostedMaterialIssues.Open "Select iniPosted, iniMaterialIssueID From MaterialIssues " & _ " Join TimecardLines On iniSourceTableUniqueID = lmlUniqueID " & _ " Where lmlTimecardID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmlTimecardID").Value) & _ " And lmlTimecardLineID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("lmlTimecardLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText_ Dim unpostedList Set unpostedList = CreateObject("System.Collections.ArrayList") Do While oPostedMaterialIssues.eof = false If CBool(oPostedMaterialIssues.fields("iniPosted").value) = False And Not unpostedList.Contains(oPostedMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value) Then unpostedList.Add oPostedMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value End If oPostedMaterialIssues.MoveNext() Loop oPostedMaterialIssues.Close If unpostedList.Count <> 0 Then TimecardLines_DeleteStarted = False Msgbox "This timecard line cannot be deleted because it is linked to the following unposted material issues:" & _ vbCrLf & join(unpostedList.ToArray(), vbCrLf), vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, App.GetLanguageText("MISCMESSAGEBOXCONFIRMUPDATE", "Confirm") e.Cancel = true Exit Function End If ' Need to check timecard created date against upgrading to V9.2 ' If less than this date, material issues will need to be manually reveresed and re-issued Dim createdDate, dTimecardDate dTimecardDate = GetTimecardDate(Fields) If IsNull(Fields("lmlCreatedDate").Value) = True then createdDate = Now Else createdDate = Fields("lmlCreatedDate").Value End If If Cdate(dTimecardDate) < Cdate(App.Props("DS").Fields("xadVersion92UpgradeDate").Value) And cDate(createdDate) < Cdate(App.Props("DS").Fields("xadVersion92UpgradeDate").Value) Then ' Check to see if operation has any linked backflushed materials Dim rsBackflushCheck set rsBackflushCheck = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsBackflushCheck.open "Select jmmBackflush from JobMaterials where jmmJobID= " & _ App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("lmlJobID").Value) & " and jmmJobAssemblyID=" & _ App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").Value) & _ " and jmmRelatedJobOperationID=" & _ App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").Value) & _ " and jmmBackflush = 1" ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsBackflushCheck.RecordCount > 0 Then Call msgbox("Materials linked to this job operation will need to be manually reversed and re-issued.",VbExclamation+VbOkOnly,"Confirm Validation Message") End If rsBackflushCheck.Close Else Dim oMaterialIssues, returnMsg, oReversalItem Set oMaterialIssues = createobject("adodb.recordset") Set oReversalItem = createobject("adodb.recordset") oMaterialIssues.Open "Select iniMaterialIssueID from MaterialIssues Where iniPosted = 1 and iniReversalEntry = 0 and iniReversed = 0 and iniSourceTableUniqueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("lmlUniqueID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText Do While oMaterialIssues.eof = false ' If any return msg, then there was an error, display and stop save returnMsg = "" returnMsg = Trim(App.RunTransferProcess("M1.Ax.Erp.MaterialIssueReversalProcess", e.Database, Array(oMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value))) If returnMsg <> "" Then MsgBox returnMsg e.Cancel = true Exit Function End if ' Need to find new reversal material issue, and post oReversalItem.Open "Select Distinct injMaterialIssueID From MaterialIssueLines Where injReverseMaterialIssueID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(oMaterialIssues.fields("iniMaterialIssueID").value), connection, 3, 1 if oReversalItem.eof = false then Call App.Ax("MaterialIssue").PostMaterialIssueScript(nothing, oReversalItem.fields("injMaterialIssueID").value) end if oReversalItem.close
oMaterialIssues.movenext Loop oMaterialIssues.Close End If
Call App.Ax("TimecardLine").BackOutJobOperation(e.Row, e.SqlTransaction) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnTableChanged("JobOperations") End Function
Function TimecardLines_DeleteCompleted(sender, e) Call TimecardLines_UpdateCompleted(sender ,e) End Function
Function TimecardLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Dim aValues,nTimecard aValues = ParentInfo.ParentKeyValues nTimecard = aValues(0)
Connection.Execute "UPDATE Timecards SET lmpMachineHours = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(lmlMachineHours) FROM TimecardLines WHERE lmlTimecardID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nTimecard) + "),0) WHERE lmpTimecardID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(nTimecard) If CInt(Fields("lmlSource").Value) <> 2 Then Call App.Ax("Timecard").RecalculateHeaderTimes(nTimecard, e.SqlTransaction) End If End Function
Function GetTimecardDate(rsData) Dim dTimecardDate,rsTemp dTimecardDate = Null If IsNull(rsData("lmlActualStartTime").Value) = False Then dTimecardDate = rsData("lmlActualStartTime").Value Else Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select lmpTimecardDate from Timecards Where lmpTimecardID = " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(rsData("lmlTimecardID").Value)),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then dTimecardDate = rsTemp.FIelds("lmpTimecardDate").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If If IsNull(dTimecardDate) = True Then dTimecardDate = Date() End If GetTimecardDate = dTimecardDate End Function
Function lmlActualEndTime_Valid(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("lmlActualStartTime").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("lmlActualEndTime").Value) = False And IsEmpty(Fields("lmlActualStartTime").Value) = False And IsEmpty(Fields("lmlActualEndTime").Value) = False Then If Fields("lmlActualEndTime").Value < Fields("lmlActualStartTime").Value Then e.AddError "The Actual End Time is less than the Actual Start Time" End If End If End Function
Function lmlRoundedEndTime_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim bPrev If App.InUserChangeEvent = True Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value = App.Ax("Shift").CalculateHours(Fields("lmlShiftID").Value, Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value, Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value, e.SqlTransaction) App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End If If IsNull(Fields("lmlActualEndTime").Value) = True Or CBool(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapLMUpdateActualWithRounded").Value) = True Then Fields("lmlActualEndTime").Value = Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value End If End Function
Function lmlRoundedEndTime_Valid(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value) = False And IsEmpty(Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value) = False And IsEmpty(Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value) = False Then If Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value < Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value Then e.AddError "The Rounded End Time is less than the Rounded Start Time" End If End If End Function
Function lmlRoundedStartTime_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nShift,bPrev nShift = CLng(Fields("lmlShiftID").Value) If nShift > 0 Then If IsNull(Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) > 0 Then Select Case CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapLMCalculateEndTime").Value) Case 2, 3: Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value = App.Ax("Shift").CalculateEndTime(nShift,Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value,Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value,e.SqlTransaction) End Select End If bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value = App.Ax("Shift").CalculateHours(Fields("lmlShiftID").Value, Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value, Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value, e.SqlTransaction) App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End If End If If IsNull(Fields("lmlActualStartTime").Value) = True Or CBool(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapLMUpdateActualWithRounded").Value) = True Then Fields("lmlActualStartTime").Value = Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value End If End Function
Function lmlJobID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,bPrev If CStr(Trim(Fields("lmlJobID").Value)) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT jmpProjectID,jmpProjectAreaID FROM Jobs WHERE jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("lmlJobID").Value)),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("lmlProjectID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmpProjectID").Value Fields("lmlProjectAreaID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmpProjectAreaID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End If oRs.Close Else Fields("lmlProjectID").Value = "" Fields("lmlProjectAreaID").Value = "" End If End Function
Function lmlLaborHours_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If CDbl(Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 1 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawSetMachineToLaborHours from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If CInt(oRs.Fields("xawSetMachineToLaborHours").Value) = True Then Fields("lmlMachineHours").Value = Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value End If End If oRs.Close End If
Dim nShift,bPrev If App.InUserChangeEvent = True Then nShift = CLng(Fields("lmlShiftID").Value) If nShift > 0 Then If IsNull(Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) > 0 Then Select Case CInt(App.Props("PN").Fields("xapLMCalculateEndTime").Value) Case 1, 3: bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("lmlRoundedEndTime").Value = App.Ax("Shift").CalculateEndTime(nShift, Fields("lmlRoundedStartTime").Value, Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value,e.SqlTransaction) App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev End Select End If End If End If End If End Function
Function lmlJobOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If CLng(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select jmoWorkCenterID,jmoProcessID from JobOperations where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlJobID").Value) + " and jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmlJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmlJobOperationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Trim(oRs.Fields("jmoWorkCenterID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoWorkCenterID").Value End If If Trim(oRs.Fields("jmoProcessID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlProcessID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoProcessID").Value End If End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function lmlTimecardType_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("lmlEmployeeID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select lmeDirectExpenseID,lmeIndirectExpenseID,lmeDefaultWorkCenterID from Employees where lmeEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlEmployeeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 1 Then If Trim(oRs.Fields("lmeDirectExpenseID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlExpenseID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmeDirectExpenseID").Value End If Else If Trim(oRs.Fields("lmeIndirectExpenseID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlExpenseID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmeIndirectExpenseID").Value End If End If If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 2 Then If Trim(oRs.FIelds("lmeDefaultWorkCenterID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value = oRs.FIelds("lmeDefaultWorkCenterID").Value End If End If End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 2 Or CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 3 Then Fields("lmlJobID").Value = "" Fields("lmlWorkType").Value = 0 Fields("lmlCompletionType").Value = 0
Fields("lmlGoodQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("lmlScrapQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("lmlSetupPercentCompleted").Value = 0
Fields("lmlScrapReasonID").Value = "" Fields("lmlReworkReasonID").Value = "" Fields("lmlProcessID").Value = ""
Fields("lmlMachineHours").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 3 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select lmsIdleTimeWorkCenterID,lmsIdleTimeIndirectLaborID from Shifts Inner Join Timecards On lmsShiftID = lmpShiftID Where lmpTimecardID = " & App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("lmlTimecardID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Trim(Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value) = "" Then Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmsIdleTimeWorkCenterID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("lmlIndirectLaborID").Value) = "" Then Fields("lmlIndirectLaborID").Value = oRs.Fields("lmsIdleTimeIndirectLaborID").Value End If End If oRs.Close End If If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("lmlIndirectLaborID").Value = "" End IF End Function
Function lmlWorkType_ValueChanged(sender, e) Select Case CInt(Fields("lmlWorkType").Value) Case 1: ' Setup Fields("lmlGoodQuantity").Value = 0 Fields("lmlScrapQuantity").Value = 0 Case 2: ' Production Fields("lmlSetupPercentCompleted").Value = 0 End Select End Function
Function lmlWorkCenterID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 1 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawWorkCenterID,xawProcessID from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If Trim(oRs.Fields("xawProcessID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("lmlProcessID").Value = oRs.Fields("xawProcessID").Value End If End If oRs.Close End If
If CDbl(Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("lmlTimecardType").Value) = 1 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawSetMachineToLaborHours from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmlWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If CInt(oRs.Fields("xawSetMachineToLaborHours").Value) = True Then Fields("lmlMachineHours").Value = Fields("lmlLaborHours").Value End If End If oRs.Close End If End Function

Function EmployeeSalesBudgets_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) Dim childBs Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("EmployeeSalesBudgetLines") If childBs.SetRowCount(12) > 0 Then childBs.ResequenceKeys() End If End Function
Function lnsStartDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("lnsStartDate").Value) = False And IsNull(Fields("lnsEndDate").Value) = True Then Fields("lnsEndDate").Value = DateAdd("d",-1,DateAdd("yyyy",1,Fields("lnsStartDate").Value)) End If End Function

Function Followups_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "select TOP 1 lmeEmployeeID from Employees where lmeUserID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(App.UserID) + " and lmeTerminationDate IS NULL order by lmeEmployeeID",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then Fields("cmfAssignedToEmployeeID").Value = rsLookup.Fields("lmeEmployeeID").Value End If rsLookup.Close End Function

Function QuoteQuantities_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim partGroupID, markups Fields("qmqCommissionPercent").Value = App.Ax("QuoteQuantity").GetQuoteCommissionRate(sender.BindingSource) partGroupID = Fields("qmqQuoteLineID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("qmlPartGroupID").Fields("qmlPartGroupID").Value Set markups = App.Ax("Part").GetPartGroupMarkups(partGroupID) Fields("qmqMaterialMarkupPercent").Value = markups.MaterialMarkup Fields("qmqSubcontractMarkupPercent").Value = markups.SubcontractMarkup Fields("qmqLaborMarkupPercent").Value = markups.LaborMarkup Fields("qmqOverheadMarkupPercent").Value = markups.OverheadMarkup Fields("qmqQuotingMarkupPercent").Value = markups.QuoteMarkup Fields("qmqPurToOrderMarkupPercent").Value = markups.PurchaseToOrderMarkup End Function
Sub RefreshDiscountPercent() Dim nPrice, bPrev If CDbl(Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("qmqUnitDiscountBase").Value) / CDbl(Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) nPrice = nPrice * 100 nPrice = App.Round(nPrice,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If If CDbl(Fields("qmqDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPrice Then bInUserChange = True Fields("qmqDiscountPercent").Value = nPrice bInUserChange = False End If End If End Sub
Function qmqDiscountPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If CBool(bInUserChange) = False Then nPrice = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("qmqDiscountPercent").Value) / 100)),5) If CDbl(Fields("qmqUnitDiscountBase").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("qmqUnitDiscountBase").Value = nPrice End If End If End Function
Function qmqUnitDiscountBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,bPrev nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("qmqUnitDiscountBase").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value = nPrice End If Call RefreshDiscountPercent End Function
Function qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("qmqUnitDiscountBase").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value = nPrice End If Call RefreshDiscountPercent End Function
Function qmqAdditionalCostAmount_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CDbl(Fields("qmqAdditionalCostAmount").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("qmqAdditionalCostDescription").Value) = "" Then Fields("qmqAdditionalCostDescription").Value = "Additional Cost" End If End Function
Function qmqAdditionalChargeBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cText If CDbl(Fields("qmqAdditionalChargeBase").Value) <> 0 And Trim(Fields("qmqAdditionalChargeDescription").Value) = "" Then cText = App.Props("QM").Fields("xapQMAdditionalChargeText").Value If Trim(cText) = "" Then cText = "Additional Charge" End If Fields("qmqAdditionalChargeDescription").Value = cText End If End Function
Function qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nDiscount If App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMEnableDiscountFields").Value Then nDiscount = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("qmqUnitDiscountBase").Value) <> nDiscount Then Fields("qmqUnitDiscountBase").Value = nDiscount End If Else If CDbl(Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value) Then Fields("qmqFullRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value = Fields("qmqRevisedUnitPriceBase").Value End If End If Call RefreshDiscountPercent If App.Ax("Financial").AvalaraActivated = true then Connection.Execute "Update Quotes Set qmpAvalaraTaxCalculated = 0 Where qmpQuoteID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qmqQuoteID").Value) end if End Function
Function qmqTotalRunQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("QuoteQuantity").CalculateUsingCurrentQty(e.Row, e.SqlTransaction) End Function
Function qmqQuoteQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) ' MBW 20150709 - Added to populate price on subsequent quote quantities that are entered manually If CDbl(Fields("qmqTotalUnitCost").Value) = 0 Then 'No cost to markup - get the selling price Call App.Ax("QuoteQuantity").SetPriceForQuantity(sender.BindingSource, e.Row) End If End Function
Function qmqScrapPercent_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("qmqScrapPercent").Value >= 100 Then e.AddError "Scrap Percent must be less than 100." Else If Fields("qmqScrapPercent").Value <= -100 then e.AddError "Scrap Percent must be greater than -100." End If End If End Function
Function qmqCommissionPercent_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("qmqCommissionPercent").Value >= 100 Then e.AddError "Commission Percent must be less than 100." Else If Fields("qmqCommissionPercent").Value <= -100 then e.AddError "Commission Percent must be greater than -100." End If End If End Function
Function CalculateCommission(nCommissionPercent, nTotalUnitPrice) If nCommissionPercent < 0 Then CalculateCommission = App.Round(nTotalUnitPrice + ((nCommissionPercent / 100.0) * nTotalUnitPrice), 5) Else If nCommissionPercent >= 100 Then CalculateCommission = nTotalUnitPrice Else CalculateCommission = App.Round(nTotalUnitPrice / (1 - (nCommissionPercent / 100.0)), 5) End If End If End Function
Function CalculateRunQuantity(nScrapPercent, nQuoteQuantity) If nScrapPercent >= 100 Then CalculateRunQuantity = nQuoteQuantity * 2 Else CalculateRunQuantity = App.Round(nQuoteQuantity / (1 - (nScrapPercent / 100.0)), App.Props("DatasetProperties").Fields("xadSellQuantityDecimals").Value) End If End Function
Function CalculateMarkup(markupType, cost, markupPercent, roundTo) If markupType = 2 Then ' Margin If (1 - (markupPercent / 100.0)) <> 0 Then CalculateMarkup = App.Round(cost / (1 - (markupPercent / 100.0)), roundTo) Else CalculateMarkup = 0 End If Else ' Markup CalculateMarkup = App.Round(cost * (1 + (markupPercent / 100.0)), roundTo) End If End Function
Function CalculateUnitAmount(nQuoteQuantity, nTotal) If nQuoteQuantity = 0 Then CalculateUnitAmount = 0 Else CalculateUnitAmount = App.Round(nTotal / nQuoteQuantity, 5) End If End Function
Function CalculateTotalMarkup(markupType, totalUnitCost, totalUnitPrice) If markupType = 2 Then If totalUnitPrice = 0 Then CalculateTotalMarkup = 0 Else CalculateTotalMarkup = App.Round((1 - (totalUnitCost / totalUnitPrice)) * 100.0, 2) End If Else If totalUnitCost = 0 Then CalculateTotalMarkup = 0 Else CalculateTotalMarkup = App.Round(((totalUnitPrice / totalUnitCost) - 1) * 100.0, 2) End If End If End Function

If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then ' Only updatebatch if not a reversal If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False Then
Dim nTotalCurrentCost, nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCost = (Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value) + Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value) + Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) + Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value)) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If
If Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) < 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value) Else nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value) End If
If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. If Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value) > 0 Then ' Set avg/last labor/burden to zero. rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = 0
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastSubcontractCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = 0
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = GetMaxDate(Fields("rmmReceiptDate").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value)
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value) ' Set Avg matl unit cost nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value) * Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
End If End If
rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End if
' Still want this code to run regardless of reversal status If Trim(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE PurchaseOrderLines SET pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived = pmlPurchaseQuantityReceived + " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmmPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value) + " ,pmlInventoryQuantityReceived = pmlInventoryQuantityReceived + " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value) + ",pmlReceivedComplete = " + App.IIf(Cbool(Fields("rmmPOLineReceivedComplete").Value) = True, "1", "0") + " WHERE pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " AND pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) End If End If ' Mfg Receipts ElseIf CInt(Fields("rmmReceiptType").Value) = 3 then Set rsJobAssembly = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsJobAssembly.Open "select jmaJobID,jmaJobAssemblyID,jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory,jmaPartID,jmaPartRevisionID,jmaPartShortDescription,jmaPartRevisionID,jmaUnitOfMeasure,jmaPartLongDescriptionRTF,jmaPartLongDescriptionText,jmaScrapQuantityCompleted from JobAssemblies where jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("rmmJobID").Value) + " And jmaJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmmJobAssemblyID").Value) ,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsJobAssembly.EOF = True then Msgbox "Unable to retrieve job information.", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly Exit Function End If
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmmPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmmPartRevisionID").Value))
' Only run if not a reversal If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If Cbool(App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("AB")) = False Then Set rsParts = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsParts.Open "select imrPartRevisionID From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then If cPartRevisionID <> UCase(Trim(rsParts.Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value)) Then If Cbool(App.Ax("PartFunctions").ChangeRevisionOnPart(cPartID, rsParts.Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value, cPartRevisionID)) = False Then Call Msgbox("Unable to replace revision.", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly) Exit Function End If End If End If rsParts.Close End If End if
Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText ' Only run if not a reversal If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' Add new Parts record If Msgbox("Part/Revision " + Trim(cPartID) + "/" + Trim(cPartRevisionID) + " does not exist in inventory. If you continue, it will be created for you.", vbExclamation + vbOKCancel, "Confirm Create Part") = vbOK Then Set rsParts = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsParts.Open "select * from Parts Where impPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = True Then rsParts.AddNew rsParts.Fields("impPartID").Value = cPartID rsParts.Fields("impShortDescription").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaPartShortDescription").Value rsParts.Fields("impLongDescriptionRTF").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value rsParts.Fields("impLongDescriptionText").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionText").Value rsParts.Fields("impPartType").Value = 2 rsParts.UpdateBatch End If rsParts.Close
rsPartRevisions.AddNew Call App.BlankRecord(rsPartRevisions) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrPartID").Value = cPartID rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value = cPartRevisionID rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaPartShortDescription").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrEffectiveStartDate").Value = Date rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaUnitOfMeasure").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaUnitOfMeasure").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitLaborCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitOverheadCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitLaborCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitOverheadCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastSubcontractCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrStandardLaborCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitLaborCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrStandardOverheadCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitOverheadCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrStandardMaterialCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrStandardSubcontractCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value = rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaPartLongDescriptionText").Value
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = Fields("rmmReceiptDate").Value Else Exit Function End If Else ' Update existing Parts record nOldQOH = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) nNewQOH = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmQuantityToInspect").Value) nNewInspectionQOH = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityToInspect").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmQuantityToInspect").Value) nReceiptQty = Cdbl(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmQuantityToInspect").Value) ' Update average unit costs If Cdbl(nOldQOH) <= 0 Or Cdbl(nReceiptQty) = 0 Or (Cdbl(nNewInspectionQOH) <= 0 And Cdbl(nNewQOH) <= 0) Then ' If old qty on hand or new qty on hand is <= 0 then ' set average unit costs to screen values rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitLaborCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitOverheadCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = App.Round(((nOldQOH * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value)) + (nReceiptQty * Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitLaborCost").Value))) / nNewQOH, 5) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = App.Round(((nOldQOH * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value)) + (nReceiptQty * Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitOverheadCost").Value))) / nNewQOH, 5) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(((nOldQOH * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value)) + (nReceiptQty * Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value))) / nNewQOH, 5) rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = App.Round(((nOldQOH * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value)) + (nReceiptQty * Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value))) / nNewQOH, 5) End If ' Update last unit costs rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitLaborCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitOverheadCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastSubcontractCost").Value = Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = GetMaxDate(Fields("rmmReceiptDate").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value) End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End If
If Cdbl(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) <> 0 Or Cdbl(Fields("rmmScrapQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then Call App.Ax("Part").NewPartRevCheck(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrPartID").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrPartRevisionID").Value, App.Ax("Production").PlantID, e.SqlTransaction) If Cdbl(rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 Then rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory").Value = 0 Else rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory").Value = Cdbl(rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) End If ' Code to update job assembly scrap amount If Cdbl(rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaScrapQuantityCompleted").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmScrapQuantity").Value) < 0 Then rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaScrapQuantityCompleted").Value = 0 Else rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaScrapQuantityCompleted").Value = Cdbl(rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaScrapQuantityCompleted").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmScrapQuantity").Value) End If If CInt(Fields("rmmJobAssemblyID").Value) = 0 Then Connection.Execute "Update Jobs Set jmpQuantityReceivedToInventory = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaQuantityReceivedToInventory").Value) + ",jmpScrapQuantityCompleted = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaScrapQuantityCompleted").Value) + " Where jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(rsJobAssembly.Fields("jmaJobID").Value) End If End If rsJobAssembly.UpdateBatch
end if End Function
Private Function GetMaxDate(dDate1, dDate2) Dim dReturn dReturn = Null If IsNull(dDate1) Then dReturn = dDate2 ElseIf IsNull(dDate2) Then dReturn = dDate1 Else If dDate1 > dDate2 Then dReturn = dDate1 Else dReturn = dDate2 End If End If GetMaxDate = dReturn End Function
Function rmmInventoryQuantityReceived_Valid(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False and CInt(Fields("rmmReceiptType").Value) = 3 then If Cdbl(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) = 0 And Cdbl(Fields("rmmScrapQuantity").Value) = 0 And Cdbl(Fields("rmmQuantityToInspect").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "Please enter a quantity in either Inv Qty Rec'd, Scrap Qty or Qty To Inspect" + Chr(13) End If End If
If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False and cdbl(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 Then e.AddError Trim(Fields("rmmInventoryQuantityReceived").Caption) + " cannot be less than zero. If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function
