Function rmmJobType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("rmmJobType").Value) <> 1 Then Fields("rmmJobMaterialID").Value = 0 Fields("rmmJobMatQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("rmmJobType").Value) <> 2 Then Fields("rmmJobOperationID").Value = 0 Fields("rmmJobOprQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("rmmJobType").Value) <> 3 Then Fields("rmmJobAsmQuantityReceived").Value = 0 End If If CInt(Fields("rmmJobType").Value) = 3 Then Fields("rmmJobAssemblyID").Value = 0 End If
Fields("rmmCreateJobSeq").Value = False End Function
Function rmmPurchaseOrderID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False then If Trim(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select pmpSupplierOrganizationID,pmpPurchaseLocationID from PurchaseOrders where pmpPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("rmmSupplierOrganizationID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value Fields("rmmPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value End If oRs.Close Else Fields("rmmPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value = 0 Fields("rmmPurchaseUnitCost").Value = 0 Fields("rmmSetupCharge").Value = 0 Fields("rmmPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = "" End If End if End Function
Function rmmPurchaseUnitCost_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False then If CDbl(Fields("rmmPurchaseUnitCost").Value) <> 0 And CInt(Fields("rmmReceiptType").Value) = 1 Then Dim nConversionFactor nConversionFactor = 1 If Trim(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim oPurchaseOrderLines Set oPurchaseOrderLines = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oPurchaseOrderLines.Open "select pmlInventoryQuantity,pmlPurchaseQuantity from PurchaseOrderLines where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oPurchaseOrderLines.EOF = False Then If CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConversion = App.Round(CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) / CDbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value),8) End If End If oPurchaseOrderLines.Close If nConversion <> 0 Then If CInt(Fields("rmmJobType").Value) = 2 Then Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("rmmPurchaseUnitCost").Value) * nConversion,5) Else Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("rmmPurchaseUnitCost").Value) * nConversion,5) End If End If End If End If End if End Function
Function rmmRequiresInspection_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False then If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CBool(Fields("rmmRequiresInspection").Value) = False Then Dim rsInspection Set rsInspection = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsInspection.Open "Select qalInspectionID, qalInspectionLineID From InspectionLines Where qalSourceTableUniqueID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("rmmUniqueID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsInspection.EOF = False Then e.Cancel = "This Mfg Receipt is currently in inspection on Inspection ID " & rsInspection.Fields("qalInspectionID").Value & " - " & rsInspection.Fields("qalInspectionLineID").Value & chr(13) bInUpdate = True Fields("rmmRequiresInspection").Value = True bInUpdate = False Else Fields("rmmQuantityToInspect").Value = 0 End If Set rsInspection = nothing end if End If End if End Function
Function rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False then If CInt(Fields("rmmReceiptType").Value) = 2 then If Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value) <> 0 Then Dim nConversionFactor nConversionFactor = 1 If Trim(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" And CInt(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim oPurchaseOrderLines Set oPurchaseOrderLines = createobject("adodb.recordset") oPurchaseOrderLines.Open "select pmlInventoryQuantity,pmlPurchaseQuantity,pmlInventoryQuantityReceived from PurchaseOrderLines where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("rmmPurchaseOrderLineID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If oPurchaseOrderLines.EOF = False Then If Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value) < 0 Then If Abs(Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value)) > cdbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value) Then Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value = -oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantityReceived").Value End If End If If Cdbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nConversionFactor = App.Round(Cdbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value) / Cdbl(oPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value), 8) End If End If oPurchaseOrderLines.Close If Cdbl(nConversionFactor) <> 0 Then Fields("rmmPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("rmmMiscInvQuantityReceived").Value) * Cdbl(nConversionFactor), App.Ax("Production").BuyQuantityDecimals) End If End If End If end if End if End Function

Function rmmPosted_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("rmmPosted").Value Then Fields("rmmPostedDate").Value = Date() Else Fields("rmmPostedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function rmmKitPart_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("rmmKitPart").RunFormatter e.Database, e.Row End Function
Function rmmJobAssemblyID_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("rmmReceiptType").Value) = 1 And CInt(Fields("rmmJobType").Value) = 3 And CInt(Fields("rmmJobAssemblyID").Value) = 0 then e.AddError "Job Assembly ID is required" + Chr(13) End If End Function
Function rmmQuantityToInspect_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If Cdbl(Fields("rmmQuantityToInspect").Value) <> 0 and cstr(Trim(Fields("rmmJobID").Value)) <> "" Then If Cbool(Fields("rmmRequiresInspection").Value) = False Then bInUpdate = True Fields("rmmRequiresInspection").Value = True bInUpdate = False End If End If If cbool(Fields("rmmProductionComplete").Value) = False and cstr(Trim(Fields("rmmJobID").Value)) <> "" and Cdbl(Fields("rmmQuantityToInspect").Value) >= 0 Then Call App.Ax("MfgReceipt").CompareQtyWithJob(e.Row) End If End If End Function
Function rmmTotalUnitCost_Valid(sender, e) If Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitLaborCost").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitOverheadCost").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitSubcontractCost").Value) <= 0 Then Dim objPartCosts Set objPartCosts = App.Ax("Part").GetPartCosts(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("rmmPartID").Value, Fields("rmmPartRevisionID").Value) if IsNull(objPartCosts) = false Then If Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) <> 0 Then e.AddWarning "Total unit cost in inventory is not 0 while the mfg/misc receipt total unit cost is 0." + Chr(13) End If End If Set objPartCosts = nothing End If End Function
Function rmmExtendedCostBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) bInExtCostUpdate = True End Function
Function rmmTotalComponentCosts_ValueChanged(sender, e) bInExtCostUpdate = True End Function
Function rmmUnitMaterialCost_Valid(sender, e) dim errorText If Cdbl(Fields("rmmUnitMaterialCost").Value) <> 0 then If CBool(bInExtCostUpdate) = True And CBool(Fields("rmmKitPart").Value) = True And Cdbl(Fields("rmmExtendedCostBase").Value) <> 0 then If App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("rmmExtendedCostBase").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) <> App.Round(Cdbl(Fields("rmmTotalComponentCosts").Value),App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) then errorText = "The total kit component costs do not equal the kit part extended cost. To make them equal, change the unit cost on the kit or on the components." bInExtCostUpdate = false If CInt(App.Props("GL").Fields("xafGLCreateStockJournals")) = True Then e.AddError errorText Else e.AddWarning errorText End if End if End if End if End Function
Function MfgReceipts_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("rmmReverseMfgReceiptID").Value) <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update MfgReceipts Set rmmReversed=1 Where rmmMfgReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmmReverseMfgReceiptID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update MfgReceiptComponents SET rmnReversed=1 Where rmnMfgReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmmReverseMfgReceiptID").Value) End If
If Cbool(Fields("rmmProductionComplete").Value) = False And CStr(Trim(Fields("rmmJobID").Value)) <> "" And Cbool(Fields("rmmPosted").Value) = false And Cbool(Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = false Then Dim updateJob, updateMfgReceiptCost
updateJob = true updateMfgReceiptCost = false
Call App.Ax("MfgReceipt").CompareQtyWithJob(e.Row, e.SqlTransaction, updateJob, updateMfgReceiptCost) End If End Function
Function MfgReceipts_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmmPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MfgReceipt").MfgReceiptPostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("rmmMfgReceiptID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True Exit function End If End If

Function lmnInactive_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim dLastEndDate Dim rsLookup Dim cText If Fields("lmnInactive").Value = True Then dLastEndDate = DateSerial(1899, 12, 31) cText = "" Set rsLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select Top 1 pasPayrollEndDate From PayrollSessions Inner Join PayrollHeaders On pasPayrollSessionID=patPayrollSessionId Where pasPostedToGL = 1 And patPayrollEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmnEmployeeID").Value) + " Order By pasPayrollEndDate DESC", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsLookup.Fields("pasPayrollEndDate").Value) = False Then dLastEndDate = rsLookup.Fields("pasPayrollEndDate").Value End If End If rsLookup.Close ' Get Leave Timecard not transferred where Timecard Paid date after last posted payroll end date rsLookup.Open "Select IsNull(Sum(lmpPayrollHours),0) As lmpPayrollHours From Timecards Where lmpEmployeeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmnEmployeeID").Value) + " And lmpLeaveAccrualID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("lmnLeaveAccrualID").Value) + " And lmpTransferredToPayroll = 0 And lmpPaidDate > " + App.Convert.DateToSQL(dLastEndDate), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If CDbl(rsLookup.Fields("lmpPayrollHours").Value) <> 0 Then cText = cText & " - there are untransferred leave timecards in the future." & Chr(13) End If End If rsLookup.Close
' Check if amounts are zero If (CDbl(Fields("lmnCurrentUnawardedAmount").Value) + CDbl(Fields("lmnCurrentAccruedAmount").Value)) <> 0 Then cText = cText & " - the balance is non-zero." & Chr(13) End If
If Trim(cText) <> "" Then e.Cancel = "You cannot set a leave accrual to inactive when: " & Chr(13) & cText Else Fields("lmnInactiveDate").Value = Date() End If Else Fields("lmnInactiveDate").Value = Null End If End Function

Function PayrollSessions_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("pasCompleted").Value) <> CInt(Fields("pasCompleted").OriginalValue) And CInt(Fields("pasCompleted").Value) = False Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE PayrollHeaders SET patCompleted = 0 WHERE patPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE PayrollLines SET panCompleted = 0 WHERE panPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If
If CInt(Fields("pasPostedToGL").Value) <> CInt(Fields("pasPostedToGL").OriginalValue) Then Connection.Execute "Update PayrollLines Set panPostedToGL = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(CInt(Fields("pasPostedToGL").Value)) + " Where panPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) Connection.Execute "Update PayrollHeaders Set patPostedToGL = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(CInt(Fields("pasPostedToGL").Value)) + " Where patPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If End Function
Function PayrollSessions_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE Timecards SET lmpTransferredToPayroll = 0, lmpTransferredDate = Null FROM Timecards Inner Join PayrollHeaderTotalLines On lmpTimecardID = paiTimecardID Inner Join PayrollHeaders On paiPayrollSessionID = patPayrollSessionID And paiPayrollHeaderID = patPayrollHeaderID WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) + " And patVoidedPayment = 0"
Connection.Execute "UPDATE TimecardLines SET lmlTransferredToPayroll = 0 FROM TimecardLines Inner Join PayrollHeaderTotalLines On lmlTimecardID = paiTimecardID Inner Join PayrollHeaders On paiPayrollSessionID = patPayrollSessionID And paiPayrollHeaderID = patPayrollHeaderID WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) + " And patVoidedPayment = 0"
Connection.Execute "UPDATE PayrollHeaders SET patVoidedPayment = 0 FROM PayrollHeaders Inner Join (Select patVoidedPayrollSessionID, patVoidedPayrollHeaderID From PayrollHeaders Where patPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) + " And patVoidedPayment <> 0) As Test On test.patVoidedPayrollSessioniD = PayrollHeaders.patPayrollSessionID And test.patVoidedPayrollHeaderID = PayrollHeaders.patPayrollHeaderID WHERE patVoidedPayment <> 0"
Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM Timecards WHERE lmpCreatedFromPayrollSession = 1 AND lmpTimecardID IN (SELECT paiTimecardID FROM PayrollHeaderTotalLines WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) + ")"
Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM TimecardLines WHERE lmlCreatedFromPayrollSession = 1 AND lmlTimecardID IN (SELECT paiTimecardID FROM PayrollHeaderTotalLines WHERE paiPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) + ")"
Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM PayrollHeaderLeaveAccruals WHERE lmfPayrollSessionID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("pasPayrollSessionID").Value) End Function

Function pasBankAccountID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("pasBankAccountID").Value) = "" Then Fields("pasCashGLAccountID").Value = "" Else Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select glnCashGLAccountID,glnEFTPayrollDescription From BankAccounts Where glnBankAccountID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pasBankAccountID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("pasCashGLAccountID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("glnCashGLAccountID").Value Fields("pasEFTDescription").Value = rsTemp.Fields("glnEFTPayrollDescription").Value End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function pasPayrollEndDate_Valid(sender, e) Dim nPayFrequency Dim dStartDate Dim dEndDate Dim dLastDOM Dim nDay Dim nEOMDay
nPayFrequency = CInt(Fields("pasPayFrequency").Value) If nPayFrequency <> 0 Then If IsNull(Fields("pasPayrollEndDate").Value) = False Then dEndDate = Fields("pasPayrollEndDate").Value Select Case nPayFrequency Case 4 'Semi-Monthly nDay = DatePart("d", dEndDate) nEOMDay = DatePart("d", App.EOM(dEndDate, 0)) If UCase(Trim(App.DSRegion)) <> "CAN" Then If (nDay = 15) Or (nDay = nEOMDay) Then Else Call e.AddError("Payroll End Date must be the 15th or End of Month when Pay Frequency is set to Semi-Monthly") End If End If End Select End If End If End Function
Function CalculateStartDate(nPayFrequency, dEndDate) Dim dStartDate Dim dLastDOM Dim nDay Dim nEOMDay
dStartDate = Null nPayFrequency = CInt(nPayFrequency) If nPayFrequency <> 0 Then If IsNull(dEndDate) = False Then Select Case nPayFrequency Case 0: Case 2 'Weekly dStartDate = DateAdd("d", -6, dEndDate) Case 3 'Bi-Weekly dStartDate = DateAdd("d", -13, dEndDate) Case 4 'Semi-Monthly nDay = DatePart("d", dEndDate) nEOMDay = DatePart("d", App.EOM(dEndDate, 0)) If UCase(Trim(App.DSRegion)) = "CAN" Then If DatePart("d", dEndDate) <= 7 Or DatePart("d", dEndDate) >= 21 Then If DatePart("d", dEndDate) >= 1 And DatePart("d", dEndDate) <= 7 Then dStartDate = DateSerial(DatePart("yyyy", dEndDate), DatePart("m", dEndDate) - 1, 16) ElseIf DatePart("d", dEndDate) >= 21 Then dStartDate = DateSerial(DatePart("yyyy", dEndDate), DatePart("m", dEndDate), 16) End If Else dStartDate = DateAdd("d", -(Day(dEndDate) - 1), dEndDate) End If Else If (nDay = 15) Or (nDay = nEOMDay) Then If DatePart("d", dEndDate) <= 7 Or DatePart("d", dEndDate) >= 21 Then If DatePart("d", dEndDate) >= 1 And DatePart("d", dEndDate) <= 7 Then dStartDate = DateSerial(DatePart("yyyy", dEndDate), DatePart("m", dEndDate) - 1, 16) ElseIf DatePart("d", dEndDate) >= 21 Then dStartDate = DateSerial(DatePart("yyyy", dEndDate), DatePart("m", dEndDate), 16) End If Else dStartDate = DateAdd("d", -(Day(dEndDate) - 1), dEndDate) End If Else dStartDate = DateSerial(DatePart("yyyy", dEndDate), DatePart("m", dEndDate), 1) End If End If Case 5 'Monthly dLastDOM = App.EOM(dEndDate, 0) If DateDiff("d", dLastDOM, dEndDate) = 0 Then dStartDate = DateAdd("d", -(Day(dEndDate) - 1), dEndDate) Else dStartDate = DateAdd("d", 1, DateAdd("m", -1, dEndDate)) End If Case Else 'Daily, Yearly dStartDate = dEndDate End Select End If End If CalculateStartDate = dStartDate End Function

Function GetAmount(e) Dim parentBs, nAmount Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) nAmount = App.Round(parentBs.Fields("arrTotalForSalesCommission").Value * (Fields("aroRate").Value / 100),2) + parentBs.Fields("arrLineCommissionTotal").Value GetAmount = CDbl(App.Round(nAmount * (Fields("aroPercent").Value / 100),2)) End Function
Sub CalculateAmount(e) Dim nAmount nAmount = GetAmount(e) If nAmount <> CDbl(Fields("aroAmount").Value) Then Fields("aroAmount").Value = nAmount End If End Sub
Function aroRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call CalculateAmount(e) End Function
Function aroSalesEmployeeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = Fields("aroSalesEmployeeID").RelatedTableGetAdoRecord("lmeCommissionRate") If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("aroRate").Value = rsTemp.Fields("lmeCommissionRate").Value Else Fields("aroRate").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function aroAmount_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim parentBs, nLineAmount, nEnteredAmount, nAmountForSales, nNewRate If GetAmount(e) <> CDbl(Fields("aroAmount").Value) then Set parentBs = Record.Table.GetParentBindingSource(e.Row) nLineAmount = CDbl(App.Round(parentBs.Fields("arrLineCommissionTotal").Value * (Fields("aroPercent").Value / 100),2)) nEnteredAmount = CDbl(Fields("aroAmount").Value) - nLineAmount nAmountForSales = App.Round(parentBs.Fields("arrTotalForSalesCommission").Value * (Fields("aroPercent").Value / 100),2) nNewRate = App.Round((nEnteredAmount / nAmountForSales) * 100,2) If nNewRate <> CDbl(Fields("aroRate").Value) Then Fields("aroRate").Value = nNewRate End If End If End Function
Function aroPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call CalculateAmount(e) End Function

Function AssetAdjustments_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText cText = "" If Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value) = "E" Then If CDbl(Fields("faaValue").Value) > CDbl(Fields("faaNetAssetValue").Value) Then cText = cText + "The depreciate amount cannot be greater than the net asset value" + Chr(13) End If End If If Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value) = "R" Then If CDbl(Fields("faaValue").Value) < CDbl(Fields("faaOpeningAssetValue").Value) Then cText = cText + "The revalue amount cannot be less than the asset cost" + Chr(13) End If End If If Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value) = "D" Or Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value) = "S" Then If Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select fapQuantity From Assets Where fapAssetID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("faaAssetID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If CDbl(Fields("faaQuantity").Value) > CDbl(rsData.Fields("fapQuantity").Value) Then cText = cText + "The quantity may not be greater than the quantity on the asset" + Chr(13) End If End If rsData.Close End If End If e.AddError cText End Function
Function faaCustomerOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oCustRs If Trim(Fields("faaCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("faaARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("faaARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Else Set oCustRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oCustRs.Open "select cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("faaCustomerOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oCustRs.EOF = False Then Fields("faaARInvoiceLocationID").Value = oCustRs.Fields("cmoDefaultARInvoiceLocationID").Value Else Fields("faaARInvoiceLocationID").Value = "" Fields("faaARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" End If oCustRs.Close End If End Function
Function faaCurrencyRateID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value) = "" Then Fields("faaCustomRate").Value = False Fields("faaExchangeRate").Value = 1 Else Fields("faaCustomRate").Value = False Fields("faaExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) End If End Function
Function faaCustomRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("faaCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("faaExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) End If End Function
Function faaARInvoiceLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("faaCustomerOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("faaARInvoiceLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("faaARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value = App.HomeCurrencyID Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlARInvoiceContactID,cmlCurrencyRateID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("faaCustomerOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("faaARInvoiceLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("faaARInvoiceContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlARInvoiceContactID").Value Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value Else Fields("faaARInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value = App.HomeCurrencyID End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function faaAdjustmentType_ValueChanged(sender, e) Select Case Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value) Case "D","T": Fields("faaValue").Value = 0 Case "P": If Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" then If Fields("faaAssetID").Fields("fapLowCostAsset").Value = True Or Fields("faaAssetID").Fields("fapLowValueAssetInPool").Value = True Then e.Cancel = "Asset " + Fields("faaAssetID").Value + " is already in Low Value Asset Pool." Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value = "" e.FocusField = "faaAdjustmentType" end if end if End Select Fields("faaCustomerOrganizationID").Value = "" Call App.Ax("FixedAssets").SetAssetValues(Record.Table.BindingSource) End Function
Function faaAdjustmentDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nYear,nPeriod If IsNull(Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) = False Then Set info = App.Ax("Financial").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value,"GL",False) If info.Success Then Fields("faaGLFiscalYearID").Value = info.Year Fields("faaGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value = info.Period End If End If
If Trim(Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "" Then If CInt(Fields("faaCustomRate").Value) = False Then Fields("faaExchangeRate").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetExchangeRate(Fields("faaCurrencyRateID").Value,Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) End If End If Call App.Ax("FixedAssets").SetAssetValues(Record.Table.BindingSource) End Function
Function faaAssetID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData If Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select fapPlantID From Assets Where fapAssetID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) ),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("faaSourcePlantID").Value = rsData.Fields("fapPlantID").Value End If rsData.Close End If Call App.Ax("FixedAssets").SetAssetValues(Record.Table.BindingSource) End Function
Function RecalculateProfit(assetValue, accDep, depThisYear, openingAssetVal, adjType) Select Case adjType Case "T", "R", "P": RecalculateProfit = 0 Case Else RecalculateProfit = assetValue + (accDep + depThisYear) - openingAssetVal End Select End Function
Function faaAdjustmentDate_Valid(sender, e) 'Check for Future Adjustments If Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" And IsNull(Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) = False Then Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select faaAssetAdjustmentID, faaAdjustmentDate, faaAdjustmentType From AssetAdjustments Where faaAssetID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) + " And faaAdjustmentDate >= " + App.Convert.DateToSQL(Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) + " And faaAssetAdjustmentID <> " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("faaAssetAdjustmentID").Value) + " Order By faaAdjustmentDate ASC", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then e.AddError "You may not enter an adjustment at this date because Adjustment " + cstr(rsLookup.Fields("faaAssetAdjustmentID").Value) + " had already been entered on a later date for Asset " + Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) + "." End If rsLookup.Close Set rsLookup = nothing End If
'If type is set to Low Value Asset Pool Transfer, then need to check Transfer Date to make sure it is first day of year If UCase(Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value)) = "P" And Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) = False Then Dim rsFiscalPeriod Set rsFiscalPeriod = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsFiscalPeriod.Open "Select glfStartDate From GLFiscalYearPeriods Where glfGLFiscalYearID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Fields("faaGLFiscalYearID").Value) + " And glfGLFiscalYearPeriodID = 1", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsFiscalPeriod.EOF = False Then If Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value <> rsFiscalPeriod.Fields("glfStartDate").Value Then e.AddError "Transfer to Low Value Asset Pool must be performed at the start of a fiscal year." End If End If rsFiscalPeriod.Close End If End If
Dim info If Fields("faaPostedToGL").Value = False Then If IsNull(Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value) = False Then Set info = App.Ax("Financial").GetYearAndPeriod(Fields("faaAdjustmentDate").Value,"GL",False) If info.Success = False Then Call e.AddError(info.Message) End If End If End If End Function
Function faaGLFiscalYearID_Valid(sender, e) If UCase(Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value)) = "E" And _ Fields("faaGLFiscalYearID").Value <> 0 And _ Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" Then
Dim cAssetID, nYear, rsTemp cAssetID = Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) nYear = Trim(Fields("faaGLFiscalYearID").Value)
set rsTemp = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsTemp.Open "select fasGLFiscalYearID " + _ "from AssetSchedules " + _ "where fasAssetID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cAssetID) + " And fasType = 'BOOK' " + _ "Order By fasGLFiscalYearID,fasGLFiscalYearPeriodID " _ , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If cint(nYear) <> cint(rsTemp.Fields("fasGLFiscalYearID").Value) Then e.AddError "You may only depreciate an asset in the same fiscal year as it was purchased." End If End If rsTemp.Close set rsTemp = nothing End If End Function
Function faaAdjustmentType_Valid(sender, e) ' Need to check if current depreciation method is diminishing value ' as only Low value asset depreciated using the diminishing value method can be added to low value asset pool If UCase(Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value)) = "P" And Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsAssetDepMethod Set rsAssetDepMethod = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsAssetDepMethod.Open "Select famTaxDepreciationMethod From Assets Inner Join AssetTypeMethods On fapAssetTypeID = famAssetTypeID and famCurrentMethod = 1 Where fapAssetID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsAssetDepMethod.EOF = False Then If UCase(Trim(rsAssetDepMethod.Fields("famTaxDepreciationMethod").Value)) <> "RB" Then e.AddError "Only assets using the Reducing Balance method for Tax Depreciation can be transferred to Low Value Asset Pool." End If End If rsAssetDepMethod.Close set rsAssetDepMethod = nothing End If End Function
Function faaAssetID_Valid(sender, e) If UCase(Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value)) = "P" And Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select fapLowCostAsset, fapLowValueAssetInPool From Assets Where fapAssetID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = False Then If rsLookup.Fields("fapLowCostAsset").Value = True Or rsLookup.Fields("fapLowValueAssetInPool").Value = True Then e.AddError "Asset " + Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) + " is already in Low Value Asset Pool." End If End If rsLookup.Close set rsLookup = nothing End If End Function
Function faaDestinationPlantID_Valid(sender, e) If App.SecurityInfo.IsModulePurchased("MP") = True Then If Trim(Fields("faaDestinationPlantID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsLookup Set rsLookup = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsLookup.Open "Select fayAssetTypeID From Assets Inner Join AssetTypePlants On fapAssetTypeID = fayAssetTypeID Where fapAssetID = " + Trim(App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("faaAssetID").Value)) + " And fayAssetTypePlantID = " + Trim(App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("faaDestinationPlantID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsLookup.EOF = True Then e.AddError "Asset Type Plant had not been set up for Asset Type linked to Asset " + Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) + " And Plant " + Trim(Fields("faaDestinationPlantID").Value) End If rsLookup.Close set rsLookup = nothing End If End If End Function
Function faaOpeningAssetValue_Valid(sender, e) ' Need to check if opening adjustable value is less than 1000 ' Must be less than 1000 to be classifiy as Low Value Asset If UCase(Trim(Fields("faaAdjustmentType").Value)) = "P" And Trim(Fields("faaAssetID").Value) <> "" Then If App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("faaOpeningAssetValue").Value) - Cdbl(Fields("faaAccumulatedDepreciation").Value)),2) >= 1000 then e.AddError "Only assets with an opening adjustable value below $1,000 are allowed to be allocated to the Low Value Asset Pool." end if end if End Function
Function faaGLFiscalYearPeriodID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call App.Ax("FixedAssets").SetAssetValues(Record.Table.BindingSource) End Function

Function BankStatements_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("glsBankStatementID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "DELETE FROM BankEntries WHERE gleBankStatementID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("glsBankStatementID").Value) + " And gleEntryType = 3" Connection.Execute "UPDATE BankEntries SET gleCleared = 0 WHERE (gleBankStatementID = 0 Or gleBankStatementID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("glsBankStatementID").Value) + ") And gleCleared = 1 And glePostedToGL = 0" Connection.Execute "UPDATE BankEntries SET gleTransactionDate = null WHERE gleBankStatementID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("glsBankStatementID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE BankEntries SET gleBankStatementID = 0 WHERE gleBankStatementID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("glsBankStatementID").Value) End If End Function
Function glsBankAccountID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("glsBankAccountID").Value) = "" Then Fields("glsCashGLAccountID").Value = "" Else Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select glnCashGLAccountID, glnCurrencyRateID From BankAccounts Where glnBankAccountID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("glsBankAccountID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("glsCashGLAccountID").Value = rsData.Fields("glnCashGLAccountID").Value Fields("glsCurrencyRateID").Value = rsData.Fields("glnCurrencyRateID").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function

Function glsOpeningBalanceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("glsOpeningBalanceForeign").Value),"BankStatements",Fields("glsBankStatementID").Value,"FOREIGN",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("glsOpeningBalance").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("glsOpeningBalance").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If End Function
Function glsEndingBalanceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("glsEndingBalanceForeign").Value),"BankStatements",Fields("glsBankStatementID").Value,"FOREIGN",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("glsEndingBalance").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("glsEndingBalance").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If End Function
Function glsEndingDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("glsOpeningDate").Value) = False Then If IsNull(Fields("glsEndingDate").Value) = False Then If Fields("glsEndingDate").Value < Fields("glsOpeningDate").Value Then e.Cancel = "Ending date must be greater than the opening date" Else Fields("glsGLFiscalYearID").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetYear(Fields("glsEndingDate").Value,"GL") End If End If End If

Function glsOpeningDate_ValueChanged(sender, e) If IsNull(Fields("glsOpeningDate").Value) = False Then If IsNull(Fields("glsEndingDate").Value) = False Then If Fields("glsEndingDate").Value < Fields("glsOpeningDate").Value Then e.Cancel = "Opening date must be less than the ending date" Else Fields("glsGLFiscalYearID").Value = App.Ax("Financial").GetYear(Fields("glsEndingDate").Value,"GL") End If End If End If End Function

'Dim fso 'Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") 'If fso.FileExists(cLocation) = False And fso.FolderExists(cLocation) = False Then ' e.Cancel = "File " + cLocation + " does not exist." 'End If End If End Function

Function JobOperations_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select jmpPlantID From Jobs Where jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoJobID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("jmoPlantID").Value = rsData.Fields("jmpPlantID").Value End If rsData.Close End Function
Function JobOperations_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobOperations SET jmoAddedOperation = 0, jmoPrototypeOperation = 0, jmoOperationQuantity = 0, jmoEstimatedProductionHours = 0, jmoQuantityComplete = 0, jmoSetupPercentComplete = 0, jmoSetupComplete = 0, jmoProductionComplete = 0, jmoActualSetupHours = 0, jmoActualProductionHours = 0, jmoCompletedSetupHours = 0, jmoCompletedProductionHours = 0, jmoStartDate = NULL, jmoDueDate = NULL, jmoStartHour = 0, jmoDueHour = 0, jmoPurchaseOrderID = '', jmoRFQID = '', jmoQuantityToInspect = 0, jmoScrapQuantityReceived = 0, jmoQuantityToReturn = 0, jmoInspectionComplete = 0, jmoInspectionStatus = 0 WHERE " + aWhere(0)
Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select jmoJobID,Avg(jmpProductionQuantity) As jmpProductionQuantity From JobOperations Inner Join Jobs On jmoJobID = jmpJobID Where " + aWhere(0) + " Group By jmoJobID", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText Do While rsData.EOF = False Call App.Ax("Job").ChangeProductionQty(Null, rsData.Fields("jmoJobID").Value, 0, rsData.Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value, rsData.Fields("jmpProductionQuantity").Value, False) rsData.MoveNext Loop rsData.Close
End Function

Function jmoPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("jmoPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("jmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function jmoWorkCenterID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawWorkCenterID,xawProcessID,xawOverheadRate,xawSetupHours,xawStandardFactor,xawProductionStandard,xawQueueTime,xawMoveTime from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("jmoOverheadRate").Value = oRs.Fields("xawOverheadRate").Value Fields("jmoQueueTime").Value = oRs.Fields("xawQueueTime").Value Fields("jmoMoveTime").Value = oRs.Fields("xawMoveTime").Value
Call SetFields(true, true, true, oRs)
If Trim(oRs.Fields("xawProcessID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("jmoProcessID").Value = oRs.Fields("xawProcessID").Value End If End If oRs.Close End Function
Function jmoProcessID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,rsTemp,cPrev,bCopyDesc Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xacProcessID,xacShortDescription,xacLongDescriptionRTF,xacLongDescriptionText,xacProjectedSetupRate,xacProjectedProductionRate,xacSetupHours,xacStandardFactor,xacProductionStandard from Processes where xacProcessID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoProcessID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then cPrev = e.PreviousValue Fields("jmoProcessShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("xacShortDescription").Value bCopyDesc = False Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "select xacLongDescriptionRTF from Processes where xacProcessID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPrev),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If App.TrimNull(Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value) = App.TrimNull(rsTemp.Fields("xacLongDescriptionRTF").Value) Then bCopyDesc = True Else If App.TrimNull(Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value) = "" Then bCopyDesc = True Else replaceTxt = MsgBox("Do you want to replace the current Long Description with the Long Description from your new selection?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Replace Text?") If replaceTxt = vbYes Then bCopyDesc = True Else bCopyDesc = False End If End If End If Else If App.TrimNull(Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value) = "" Then bCopyDesc = True Else bCopyDesc = False End If End If rsTemp.Close If bCopyDesc = True Then ' Only refresh the extended description info if it doesn't match the previous operations extended description or it hasn't been entered yet. Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("xacLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("xacLongDescriptionText").Value End If Fields("jmoSetupRate").Value = oRs.Fields("xacProjectedSetupRate").Value Fields("jmoProductionRate").Value = oRs.Fields("xacProjectedProductionRate").Value
Dim bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard
bUpdateSetupHours = false bUpdateStandardFactor = false bUpdateProductionStandard = false
If CDbl(oRs.Fields("xacSetupHours").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("jmoSetupHours").Value = oRs.Fields("xacSetupHours").Value Else bUpdateSetupHours = true End If
If Trim(oRs.Fields("xacStandardFactor").Value) <> "" Then Fields("jmoStandardFactor").Value = oRs.Fields("xacStandardFactor").Value Else bUpdateStandardFactor = true End If
If CDbl(oRs.Fields("xacProductionStandard").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("jmoProductionStandard").Value = oRs.Fields("xacProductionStandard").Value Else bUpdateProductionStandard = true End If
Call SetWorkCenterInformation(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard)
End If oRs.Close End Function
Function jmoOperationType_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cReturn cReturn = "" If Record.EditMode <> adEditAdd Then Dim oLookup Set oLookup = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") If CInt(Fields("jmoOperationType").Value) = 1 Then ' Was a subcontract, now is in-house
' Check to see if this operation is in the PartTransactions table. oLookup.Open "select imtJobOperationID from PartTransactions where imtJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoJobID").Value) + " and imtJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and imtJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value) + " and imtJobType = 2",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oLookup.EOF = False Then If cReturn = "" Then cReturn = "PartTransactions" Else cReturn = cReturn + " and PartTransactions" End If End If oLookup.Close Else ' Was in-house, now is subcontract
' Check to see if this operation is in the TimecardLines table. oLookup.Open "select lmlJobOperationID from TimecardLines where lmlJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoJobID").Value) + " and lmlJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and lmlJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oLookup.EOF = False Then cReturn = "TimecardLines" End If oLookup.Close End If If cReturn <> "" Then cReturn = "You cannot change the type of this operation because it is referenced in the " + Trim(cReturn) + " table(s)." End If End If ' Only continue if no error messages If cReturn = "" Then If CInt(Fields("jmoOperationType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("jmoPartID").Value = "" Fields("jmoPartRevisionID").Value = "" Fields("jmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = "" Fields("jmoStandardFactor").Value = App.Props("JM").Fields("xapJMStandardFactor").Value Fields("jmoSupplierOrganizationID").Value = "" Fields("jmoPurchaseOrderID").Value = "" Fields("jmoEstimatedUnitCost").Value = 0 Fields("jmoMinimumCharge").Value = 0 Fields("jmoSetupCharge").Value = 0 Else Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select jmaPartID,jmaPartRevisionID,jmaPartWareHouseLocationID,jmaPartBinID from JobAssemblies where jmaJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoJobID").Value) + " And jmaJobAssemblyID = " + Trim(App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value)),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText if oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("jmoPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartID").Value Fields("jmoPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartRevisionID").Value Fields("jmoPartWareHouseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartWareHouseLocationID").Value Fields("jmoPartBinID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmaPartBinID").Value End If oRs.Close Fields("jmoUnitOfMeasure").Value = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("jmoStandardFactor").Value = "TD" End If End If e.Cancel = cReturn End Function
Function jmoOverlapSourceLink_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value Then Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value = Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value Else If Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> 0 Then Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function jmoOverlapDestinationLink_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value Then Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value = Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value Else If Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 And Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value <> 0 Then Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 End If End If End Function
Function jmoOverlapOperationID_Valid(sender, e) Dim hasLinksAssigned, hasLinksRemoved
If Fields("jmoOverlapOperationID").Value <> 0 And Fields("jmoOverlapOperationID").Value = Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value Then Call e.AddError("Overlap Sequence cannot be the current sequence") End If
hasLinksRemoved = Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapOperationID").Value <> 0 hasLinksAssigned = Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value <> 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapOperationID").Value = 0
If hasLinksRemoved OR hasLinksAssigned Then Call e.AddError("Overlap Sequence and Overlap Links must both be entered or both be removed") End If
hasLinksRemoved = Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value = 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapOperationID").Value <> 0 hasLinksAssigned = Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value <> 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapOperationID").Value = 0
If hasLinksRemoved OR hasLinksAssigned Then Call e.AddError("Overlap Sequence and Overlap Links must both be entered or both be removed") End If End Function

Function jmoStartDate_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("jmoJobID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("jmoStartdate").Value) AND IsJobOperationScheduled() then Call e.AddError("The job operation is scheduled, the start date must not be empty") End if End If End Function
Function jmoDueDate_Valid(sender, e) If Fields("jmoJobID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value <> "" Then If IsNull(Fields("jmoDuedate").Value) AND IsJobOperationScheduled() then Call e.AddError("The job operation is scheduled, the due date must not be empty") End if End If End Function
Function jmoOverlapOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Fields("jmoJobID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value <> "" Then If Fields("jmoOverlapDestinationLink").Value <> 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value <> 0 AND Fields("jmoOverlapOperationID").Value = 0 Then Fields("jmoOverlapSourceLink").Value = 0 End if End if End Function
Function IsInsertButtonEnabled() If Fields("jmoJobID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value <> "" Then If IsJobAssemblyScheduled AND IsJobOperationScheduled() = false then IsInsertButtonEnabled = true Else IsInsertButtonEnabled = false End if End if End function
Function IsUpdateButtonEnabled() If Fields("jmoJobID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value <> "" Then If IsJobAssemblyScheduled AND IsJobOperationScheduled() then IsUpdateButtonEnabled = true Else IsUpdateButtonEnabled = false End if End if End Function
Function IsSetupConfigurationInvalid(isSetupComplete) If Fields("jmoJobID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value <> "" AND Fields("jmoJobOperationID").Value <> "" Then If Fields("jmoSetupHours").Value <> 0 AND Fields("jmoProductionStandard").Value = 0 then IsSetupConfigurationInvalid = isSetupComplete End if End if End function
Private Function IsJobAssemblyScheduled() Dim recordSet, isAssemblyScheduled, assemblyQuery
isAssemblyScheduled = false assemblyQuery = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS quantity FROM ScheduleTasks INNER JOIN ScheduleTrees ON sxkScheduleTreeID = sxtScheduleTreeID INNER JOIN Jobs ON sxtGroupUniqueID = jmpUniqueID WHERE jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoJobID").Value) + " AND sxkScheduleBranchID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value) + " AND sxkStartDate IS NOT NULL AND sxkEndDate IS NOT NULL AND sxtType = 1"
Set recordSet = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") recordSet.Open assemblyQuery,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If recordSet.EOF = False Then isAssemblyScheduled = Cbool(recordSet.Fields("quantity").Value) End If
recordSet.Close IsJobAssemblyScheduled = isAssemblyScheduled End Function
Private Function IsJobOperationScheduled() Dim recordSet, isOperationScheduled, jobOperationQuery
isOperationScheduled = false jobOperationQuery = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS quantity FROM ScheduleTasks INNER JOIN ScheduleTrees ON sxkScheduleTreeID = sxtScheduleTreeID INNER JOIN Jobs ON sxtGroupUniqueID = jmpUniqueID WHERE jmpJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoJobID").Value) + " AND sxkScheduleBranchID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJobAssemblyID").Value) + " AND sxkScheduleTaskID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("jmoJoboperationID").Value) + " AND sxkStartDate IS NOT NULL AND sxkEndDate IS NOT NULL"
Set recordSet = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") recordSet.Open jobOperationQuery,Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If recordSet.EOF = False Then isOperationScheduled = Cbool(recordSet.Fields("quantity").Value) End If
recordSet.Close IsJobOperationScheduled = isOperationScheduled End function
Private Function SetWorkCenterInformation(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select xawSetupHours,xawStandardFactor,xawProductionStandard from WorkCenters where xawWorkCenterID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("jmoWorkCenterID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText
If oRs.EOF = False Then Call SetFields(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard, oRs) End If oRs.Close End Function
Private Function SetFields(bUpdateSetupHours, bUpdateStandardFactor, bUpdateProductionStandard, oRecordSet) If bUpdateSetupHours Then If CDbl(oRecordSet.Fields("xawSetupHours").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("jmoSetupHours").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawSetupHours").Value Else Fields("jmoSetupHours").Value = 0 End If End If
If bUpdateStandardFactor Then If oRecordSet.Fields("xawStandardFactor").Value <> "" Then Fields("jmoStandardFactor").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawStandardFactor").Value Else Fields("jmoStandardFactor").Value = App.Props("JM").Fields("xapjmstandardfactor").Value End If End If
If bUpdateProductionStandard Then If CDbl(oRecordSet.Fields("xawProductionStandard").Value) <> 0 Then Fields("jmoProductionStandard").Value = oRecordSet.Fields("xawProductionStandard").Value Else Fields("jmoProductionStandard").Value = 0 End If End If End Function

Function Receipts_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText,rsTemp cText = "" If CBool(Fields("rmpPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select rmpPostedToGL From Receipts Where rmpReceiptID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmpReceiptID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsTemp.Fields("rmpPostedToGL").Value) = True Then cText = cText + "Record cannot be saved because the receipt has been posted while editing the data" + Chr(13) End If End If rsTemp.Close End If e.AddError cText End Function

Function Receipts_DeleteStarted(sender, e) dim receiptId,receiptLineId If CBool(Fields("rmpReversalEntry").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("rmpPostedToGL").Value)=False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT rmlReverseReceiptID, rmlReverseReceiptLineID FROM ReceiptLines WHERE rmlReceiptID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmpReceiptID").Value) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False receiptId=Trim(rsTemp.Fields("rmlReverseReceiptID").Value) receiptLineId=rsTemp.Fields("rmlReverseReceiptLineID").Value If receiptId <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update ReceiptLines Set rmlReversed=0 Where rmlReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId)+" And rmlReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update ReceiptComponents Set rmoReversed=0 Where rmoReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId)+" And rmoReceiptLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(receiptLineId) Connection.Execute "Update Receipts Set rmpReversed=0 Where rmpReceiptID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(receiptId) End If rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function

If you want to reverse this transaction, please perform a reversal." + Chr(13) End If End Function
Function MfgReceiptComponents_DeleteStarted(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("rmnPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MfgReceipt").MfgReceiptPostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("rmnMfgReceiptID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True End If Exit Function End If End Function
Function MfgReceiptComponents_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsPartRevisions
If CBool(Fields("rmnMfgReceiptID").Fields("rmmReversalEntry").Value) = False Then If CBool(Fields("rmnPosted").Value) = False Then If CBool(App.Ax("MfgReceipt").MfgReceiptPostedCheck(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("rmnMfgReceiptID").Value)) = True Then Call MsgBox("This record cannot be saved or posted as it is already marked as being posted in the database.", vbExclamation + vbOkOnly, "Confirm") e.Cancel = True End If Exit Function Else If (Cbool(Fields("rmnPosted").Value) = Cbool(Fields("rmnPosted").OriginalValue)) then Exit Function End If End If
Dim rsWarehouse, bNonNettable bNonNettable = False Set rsWarehouse = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsWarehouse.Open "Select imwWarehouseID, imwNonNettable, imwNonNettableType From Warehouses Where imwWarehouseID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(Trim(Fields("rmnPartWarehouseLocationID").Value)) + " And imwNonNettable <> 0", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsWarehouse.EOF = False Then bNonNettable = rsWarehouse.Fields("imwNonNettable").Value End If rsWarehouse.Close
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmnPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("rmnPartRevisionID").Value))
Set rsPartRevisions = createobject("adodb.recordset") rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText If rsPartRevisions.EOF = True Then ' If this revision doesn't exist, check to see if we can find another ' one and use it instead. If App.Ax("Part").GetLatestPartRevision(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, e.SqlTransaction) = True Then rsPartRevisions.Close rsPartRevisions.Open "select * from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSQL(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockBatchOptimistic, adCmdText End If End If If rsPartRevisions.EOF = False Then Dim nTotalCurrentCost, nNewTotalCost, nNewQtyOnHand ' Calculate current costs using current quantity on hand. nTotalCurrentCost = (Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value) + Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value) + Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value) + Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value)) * Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) If Cdbl(nTotalCurrentCost) < 0 Then nTotalCurrentCost = 0 End If
If Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) < 0 Then nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(Fields("rmnInvReceiptQuantity").Value) Else nNewQtyOnHand = Cdbl(rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrQuantityOnHand").Value) + Cdbl(Fields("rmnInvReceiptQuantity").Value) End If
If CBool(bNonNettable) = False Then ' Only update costs if receipt qty is not negative. If Cdbl(Fields("rmnInvReceiptQuantity").Value) > 0 Then ' Set avg/last labor/burden to zero. rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastOverheadCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageLaborCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageOverheadCost").Value = 0
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageSubcontractCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastSubcontractCost").Value = 0 rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = 0
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value = GetMaxDate(Fields("rmnMfgReceiptID").Fields("rmmReceiptDate").Value, rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastReceiptDate").Value)
rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmnUnitCost").Value) ' Set Avg matl unit cost nNewTotalCost = nTotalCurrentCost + (Cdbl(Fields("rmnUnitCost").Value) * Cdbl(Fields("rmnInvReceiptQuantity").Value)) If nNewQtyOnHand <= 0 Then rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = Cdbl(Fields("rmnUnitCost").Value) Else rsPartRevisions.Fields("imrAverageMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(Cdbl(nNewTotalCost) / Cdbl(nNewQtyOnHand), 5) End If
End If End If End If rsPartRevisions.UpdateBatch End If End Function
Private Function GetMaxDate(dDate1, dDate2) Dim dReturn dReturn = Null If IsNull(dDate1) Then dReturn = dDate2 ElseIf IsNull(dDate2) Then dReturn = dDate1 Else If dDate1 > dDate2 Then dReturn = dDate1 Else dReturn = dDate2 End If End If GetMaxDate = dReturn End Function
Function rmnPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("rmnMfgReceiptID").Fields("rmmReceiptType").Value) <> 1 Then If CBool(Fields("rmnPosted").Value) = false Then If Cstr(Fields("rmnReverseMfgReceiptID").Value) = "" Then Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("rmnPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("rmnPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("rmnPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("rmnPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddError "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive" + Chr(13) End If End If End If End If End If End Function

Function smpARInvoiceLocationID_Valid(sender, e) Dim offsetTotal offsetTotal = 0 If Fields("smpCustomerOrganizationID").Value = Fields("smpCustomerOrganizationID").OriginalValue And Fields("smpARInvoiceLocationID").Value <> Fields("smpARInvoiceLocationID").OriginalValue Then If CBool(Fields("smpARInvoiceLocationID").Fields("cmlCreditCheckForLocation").Value) = True Then offsetTotal = Fields("smpShipmentSubtotal").Value Else offsetTotal = Fields("smpShipmentSubtotal").Value - Fields("smpShipmentSubtotal").OriginalValue End if ElseIf Fields("smpCustomerOrganizationID").Value <> Fields("smpCustomerOrganizationID").OriginalValue Then offsetTotal = Fields("smpShipmentSubtotal").Value Else offsetTotal = Fields("smpShipmentSubtotal").Value - Fields("smpShipmentSubtotal").OriginalValue End If Call App.Ax("Organizations").CustomerCreditCheck(Fields("smpCustomerOrganizationID").Value,Fields("smpARInvoiceLocationID").Value, App.Props("PN").Fields("xapCMShipmentCreditMessage").Value, App.Props("PN").Fields("xapCMShipmentHoldMessage").Value, 0, offsetTotal, 0, e.ValidationInfo, true) End Function

Function Shipments_DeleteStarted(sender, e) dim shipmentId,shipmentLineId If CBool(Fields("smpReversalEntry").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("smpPostedToGL").Value)=False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT smlReverseShipmentID,smlReverseShipmentLineID FROM ShipmentLines WHERE smlShipmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("smpShipmentID").Value) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False shipmentId=Trim(rsTemp.Fields("smlReverseShipmentID").Value) shipmentLineId=rsTemp.Fields("smlReverseShipmentLineID").Value If shipmentId <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update ShipmentLines Set smlReversed=0 Where smlShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(shipmentId)+" And smlShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(shipmentLineId) Connection.Execute "Update ShipmentComponents Set smoReversed=0 Where smoShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(shipmentId)+" And smoShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(shipmentLineId) Connection.Execute "Update Shipments Set smpReversed=0 Where smpShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(shipmentId) End if rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function Shipments_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim shipmentID, shipmentLineID, sWhere, cDeleteShipmentLines Dim rsShipmentLines, childBs Dim strArrayShipmentLines
If Cbool(App.Props("ProductionProperties").Fields("xapSMDeleteZeroShipmentLines").Value) then Set strArrayShipmentLines = CreateObject("System.Collections.ArrayList") Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("ShipmentLines") if childBs.Count > 0 then Set rsShipmentLines = childBs.GetRecordset() if rsShipmentLines.Recordcount > 0 then rsShipmentLines.MoveFirst Do While Not rsShipmentLines.EOF if Cdbl(rsShipmentLines.Fields("smlQuantityShipped").Value) = 0 and Cdbl(rsShipmentLines.Fields("smlJobQuantityShipped").Value) = 0 then shipmentID = Trim(rsShipmentLines.Fields("smlShipmentID").Value) shipmentLineID = Cint(rsShipmentLines.Fields("smlShipmentLineID").Value) sWhere = "(Fields(" & chr(34) & "smlShipmentID" & chr(34) & ") = " & chr(34) & Trim(shipmentID) & chr(34) sWhere = sWhere & " AND Fields(" & chr(34) & "smlShipmentLineID" & chr(34) & ") = " & Cint(shipmentLineID) & ")" strArrayShipmentLines.Add sWhere end if rsShipmentlines.MoveNext() loop end if rsShipmentLines.Close If strArrayShipmentLines.Count > 0 Then cDeleteShipmentLines = join(strArrayShipmentLines.ToArray(), " Or ") Call childBs.RemoveWhere(cDeleteShipmentLines) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) end if end if Set rsShipmentLines = nothing Set childBs = nothing end if End Function

Function APInvoiceLines_SaveAs(aWhere) Connection.Execute "UPDATE APInvoiceLines SET aplPurchaseOrderID = '', aplPurchaseOrderLineID = 0, aplReceiptID = '', aplReceiptLineID = 0, aplInvoicedComplete = 0, aplPostedToGL = 0 WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function APInvoiceLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select appProjectID,cmoSupplierTaxCodeID,cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID,cmoForm1099Box from Organizations inner join APInvoices on appSupplierOrganizationID=cmoOrganizationID where appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("aplTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoSupplierTaxCodeID").Value Fields("aplSecondTaxCodeID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID").Value Fields("aplProjectID").value = oRs.Fields("appProjectID").value Fields("aplForm1099Box").value = oRs.Fields("cmoForm1099Box").value End If oRs.Close End Function
Function APInvoiceLines_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim nConversionFactor If CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("aplPartID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("aplPartID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("aplPartRevisionID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("aplPartRevisionID").OriginalValue) Or _ CInt(Fields("aplJobType").Value) <> CInt(Fields("aplJobType").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("aplConversionFactor").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("aplConversionFactor").OriginalValue) Or _ CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").OriginalValue) Then
If CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) >= 0 Then If CInt(App.Props("FN").Fields("xafAPUpdateJobCosts").Value) = True Then nConversionFactor = CDbl(Fields("aplConversionFactor").Value) If nConversionFactor = 0 Then nConversionFactor = 1 End If Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select * From PartRevisions Where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("aplPartID").Value)) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("aplPartRevisionID").Value)),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockBatchOptimistic,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CInt(Fields("aplJobType").Value) = 2 Then 'rsTemp.Fields("imrLastSubcontractCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) * nConversionFactor,5) Else rsTemp.Fields("imrLastMaterialCost").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) * nConversionFactor,5) End If 'Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").PartSaveTrigger(rsTemp.Fields,"APINVOICE " + Trim(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value)) rsTemp.UpdateBatch End If rsTemp.Close End If End If End If
Dim cValue If CInt(Fields("aplInvoicedComplete").Value) <> CInt(Fields("aplInvoicedComplete").OriginalValue) Then If CInt(Fields("aplInvoicedComplete").Value) = True Then cValue = "1" Else cValue = "0" End If If Trim(Fields("aplReceiptID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("aplReceiptLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE ReceiptLines SET rmlInvoicedComplete = " + cValue + " WHERE rmlReceiptID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplReceiptID").Value) + " AND rmlReceiptLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplReceiptLineID").Value) End If If Trim(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE PurchaseOrderLines SET pmlInvoicedComplete = " + cValue + " WHERE pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " AND pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) End If If Trim(Fields("aplRMAClaimID").Value) <> "" And CLng(Fields("aplRMAClaimLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Connection.Execute "UPDATE RMAClaimLines SET ralInvoicedComplete = " + cValue + " WHERE ralRMAClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplRMAClaimID").Value) + " AND ralRMAClaimLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplRMAClaimLineID").Value) End If End If If CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").OriginalValue) Then If Record.EntryMode = "GRID" Then Call App.Ax("APFunctions").RefreshExpensesForLine(Fields) End If End If End Function
Function APInvoiceLines_UpdateCompleted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("APFunctions").RefreshInvoiceTotals(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value) End Function
Function APInvoiceLines_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Call App.Ax("APFunctions").DeleteAPInvoiceLineEvent(Fields) End Function
Function APInvoiceLines_DeleteCompleted(sender, e) Dim aValues aValues = ParentInfo.ParentKeyValues Call App.Ax("APFunctions").RefreshInvoiceTotals(aValues(0)) End Function
Function APInvoiceLines_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText,rsTemp cText = "" If CInt(Fields("aplPostedToGL").Value) = False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select appPostedToGL From APInvoices Where appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsTemp.Fields("appPostedToGL").Value) = True Then cText = cText + "Record cannot be saved because the invoice has been posted while editing the data" + Chr(13) End If End If rsTemp.Close End If e.AddError cText End Function
Function aplPurchaseOrderID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cPO,cSupplierID,rsData cPO = Trim(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value) If cPO <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select appSupplierOrganizationID, pmpSupplierOrganizationID from APInvoices Inner Join PurchaseOrders On pmpPurchaseOrderID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPO) & " Where appAPInvoiceID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If Trim(rsData.Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) <> Trim(rsData.Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) Then If msgbox("Purchase order " & Trim(cPO) & " is for supplier " & Trim(rsData.Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) & ", which is different than " & Trim(rsData.Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) & ", which is the supplier for this invoice. Do you still want to use this po?",vbYesNo + vbExclamation,"Add PO") = vbNo Then Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value = "" End If End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function aplConversionFactor_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nConv nConv = CDbl(Fields("aplConversionFactor").Value) If nConv <> 0 Then Fields("aplReceivedQuantity").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) / nConv,App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Else Fields("aplReceivedQuantity").Value = 0 End If End Function
Function aplPurchaseOrderLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) = 0 Then Fields("aplInvoicedComplete").Value = False Else Dim rsPurchaseOrderLines,rsPartTransactions,rsOrg,bPrev Set rsPurchaseOrderLines = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsPurchaseOrderLines.Open "select pmlJobID,pmlJobAssemblyID,pmlJobType,pmlJobMaterialID,pmlJobOperationID,pmlPartID,pmlPartRevisionID,pmlPartShortDescription,pmlPartLongDescriptionRTF,pmlPartLongDescriptionText,pmlTaxable,pmlPurchaseQuantity,pmlConversionFactor,pmlInventoryQuantity,pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase,pmlSetupChargeBase,pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure,pmlInvoicedComplete,pmlRMAClaimID,pmlRMAClaimLineID,pmlAssetTypeID,pmlAssetID from PurchaseOrderLines where pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsPurchaseOrderLines.EOF = False Then Fields("aplInvoicedComplete").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInvoicedComplete").Value Fields("aplRMAClaimID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlRMAClaimID").Value Fields("aplRMAClaimLineID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlRMAClaimLineID").Value Fields("aplAssetID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlAssetID").Value Fields("aplAssetTypeID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlAssetTypeID").Value Fields("aplJobID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlJobID").Value If Trim(Fields("aplJobID").Value) <> "" Then ' This will be empty if the job is invalid. Fields("aplJobAssemblyID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlJobAssemblyID").Value Fields("aplJobType").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.FIelds("pmlJobType").Value If CInt(rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlJobType").Value) = 1 Then Fields("aplJobMaterialID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlJobMaterialID").Value Else Fields("aplJobOperationID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlJobOperationID").Value End If End If bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("aplPartID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPartID").Value Fields("aplPartRevisionID").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPartRevisionID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev
Fields("aplPartDescription").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPartShortDescription").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionText").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPartLongDescriptionText").Value If CInt(rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlTaxable").Value) = True Then Set rsOrg = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsOrg.Open "select cmoSupplierTaxCodeID,cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID from Organizations inner join PurchaseOrders on pmpSupplierOrganizationID=cmoOrganizationID where pmpPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsOrg.EOF = False Then Fields("aplTaxCodeID").Value = rsOrg.Fields("cmoSupplierTaxCodeID").Value Fields("aplSecondTaxCodeID").Value = rsOrg.Fields("cmoSupplierSecondTaxCodeID").Value End If rsOrg.Close Else Fields("aplTaxCodeID").Value = "" Fields("aplSecondTaxCodeID").Value = "" End If Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlSetupChargeBase").Value
' Get the purchase qty and unit of measures from PartTransactions Set rsPartTransactions = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsPartTransactions.Open "select top 1 imtPartTransactionID,imtInventoryQuantityReceived,imtPurchaseQuantityReceived,imtPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imtInventoryUnitOfMeasure from PartTransactions where imtPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value) + " and imtPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) + " order by imtPartTransactionID desc",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsPartTransactions.EOF = False Then Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value = rsPartTransactions.Fields("imtPurchaseQuantityReceived").Value Fields("aplReceivedQuantity").Value = rsPartTransactions.Fields("imtInventoryQuantityReceived").Value Fields("aplPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsPartTransactions.Fields("imtPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("aplReceivedUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsPartTransactions.Fields("imtInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Else Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseQuantity").Value Fields("aplConversionFactor").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlConversionFactor").Value Fields("aplReceivedQuantity").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryQuantity").Value Fields("aplPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("aplReceivedUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsPartTransactions.Close ' Set unit cost last so it will override values set when extended cost changes. Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = rsPurchaseOrderLines.Fields("pmlPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value
End If rsPurchaseOrderLines.Close End If End Function
Function aplReceiptLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CLng(Fields("aplReceiptLineID").Value) <> 0 Then Dim rsTemp Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "Select pmlAssetID,pmlAssetTypeID,pmlPurchaseOrderID,pmlPurchaseOrderLineID From ReceiptLines Inner Join PurchaseOrderLines On rmlPurchaseOrderID = pmlPurchaseOrderID And rmlPurchaseOrderLineID = pmlPurchaseOrderLineID Where rmlReceiptID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplReceiptID").Value) + " And rmlReceiptLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplReceiptLineID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Fields("aplAssetID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("pmlAssetID").Value Fields("aplAssetTypeID").Value = rsTemp.Fields("pmlAssetTypeID").Value If Trim(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> Trim(rsTemp.Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) Then Fields("aplPurchaseOrderID").Value = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) End If If CLng(Fields("aplPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) <> CLng(rsTemp.Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) Then Fields("aplPurchaseOrderLineID").Value = Trim(rsTemp.Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value) End If End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function

Function aplJobMaterialID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,bPrev If CDbl(Fields("aplJobMaterialID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select jmmPartID,jmmPartRevisionID,jmmPartShortDescription,jmmPartLongDescriptionRTF,jmmPartLongDescriptionText,jmmUnitOfMeasure from JobMaterials where jmmJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplJobID").Value) + " and jmmJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and jmmJobMaterialID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplJobMaterialID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("aplPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartID").Value Fields("aplPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartRevisionID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev
Fields("aplPartDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartShortDescription").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmPartLongDescriptionText").Value Fields("aplReceivedUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmmUnitOfMeasure").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function aplJobOperationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If CDbl(Fields("aplJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select jmoPartID,jmoPartRevisionID,jmoProcessShortDescription,jmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF,jmoProcessLongDescriptionText,jmoUnitOfMeasure,jmoSetupCharge from JobOperations where jmoJobID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplJobID").Value) + " and jmoJobAssemblyID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplJobAssemblyID").Value) + " and jmoJobOperationID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSql(Fields("aplJobOperationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoSetupCharge").Value bPrev = App.InUserChangeEvent App.InUserChangeEvent = False Fields("aplPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartID").Value Fields("aplPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoPartRevisionID").Value App.InUserChangeEvent = bPrev
If Trim(Fields("aplPartDescription").Value) = "" Then Fields("aplPartDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoProcessShortDescription").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoProcessLongDescriptionText").Value End If Fields("aplReceivedUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("jmoUnitOfMeasure").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
