Function aplPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,rsRef,cPurUM,nConv,cSupplierID,nValue,cType,cCurrencyID,bForeignAmount,cLocID If Trim(Fields("aplPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrPartID,imrShortDescription,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText,imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrConversionFactor from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("aplPartDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("aplPartLongDescriptionText").Value = oRs.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value cPurUM = oRs.Fields("imrPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("aplReceivedUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value nConv = CDbl(oRs.Fields("imrConversionFactor").Value) Set rsRef = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsRef.Open "select imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure,imxConversionFactor from PartCrossReferences where imxPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplPartID").Value) + " and imxOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(cSupplierID) + " And imxLocationID = ''",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsRef.EOF = False Then cPurUM = rsRef.Fields("imxPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value nConv = CDbl(rsRef.Fields("imxConversionFactor").Value) End If rsRef.Close
If nConv = 0 And Trim(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value) = Trim(Fields("aplReceivedUnitOfMeasure").Value) Then nConv = 1 End If Fields("aplConversionFactor").Value = nConv Fields("aplPurchaseUnitOfMeasure").Value = cPurUM End If oRs.Close
bForeignAmount = False cCurrencyID = "" cSupplierID = "" cLocID = "" oRs.Open "select appSupplierOrganizationID,appAPInvoiceLocationID,appCurrencyRateID from APInvoices where appAPInvoiceID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then cSupplierID = Trim(oRs.Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) cCurrencyID = Trim(oRs.Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value) cLocID = Trim(oRs.Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) End If oRs.Close

End If End Function

Function aplPurchaseQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs,nConv,cSupplierID,nValue,cType,cCurrencyID,bForeignAmount,cLocID nConv = CDbl(Fields("aplConversionFactor").Value) If nConv <> 0 Then Fields("aplReceivedQuantity").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) / nConv,App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) Else Fields("aplReceivedQuantity").Value = 0 End If

bForeignAmount = False cCurrencyID = "" cSupplierID = "" cLocID = "" oRs.Open "select appSupplierOrganizationID,appAPInvoiceLocationID,appCurrencyRateID from APInvoices where appAPInvoiceID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then cSupplierID = Trim(oRs.Fields("appSupplierOrganizationID").Value) cCurrencyID = Trim(oRs.Fields("appCurrencyRateID").Value) cLocID = Trim(oRs.Fields("appAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) End If oRs.Close
'Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").PartReferenceCheck(Fields, "aplPartID", "aplPartRevisionID", "aplOrgPartID", "aplPartDescription","aplOrgPartShortDescription", cSupplierID,"", "HOME") Call App.Ax("PartFunctions").PartReferenceCheck(Fields, "aplPartID", "aplPartRevisionID", "aplOrgPartID", "aplPartDescription","aplOrgPartShortDescription", cSupplierID,cLocID, "HOME")
If CLng(Fields("aplJobOperationID").Value) <> 0 Then cType = "SUBCONTRACT" Else cType = "MATERIAL" End If nValue = App.Ax("PartFunctions").GetPurchasePrice(Fields("aplPartID").Value,Fields("aplPartRevisionID").Value,cSupplierID,cLocID,Fields("aplReceivedQuantity").Value,cType,cCurrencyID,bForeignAmount) If nValue > 0 Then If bForeignAmount = True Then If CDbl(nValue) <> CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value) Then Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value = nValue End If Else If CDbl(nValue) <> CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) Then Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = nValue End If End If End If
End If
nValue = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) * CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value),2) + CDbl(Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value) If CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) <> nValue Then Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value = nValue End If End Function
Function aplPurchaseUnitCostBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value),"APInvoiceLines",Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value,"BASE",5) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostForeign").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If
If App.UpdatingUnitCost = False Then Dim nValue If CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) <> 0 Then nValue = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) * CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value),2) Else nValue = 0 End If nValue = nValue + CDbl(Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value)
Dim nCost,nAnswer If CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) <> nValue Then
If CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nCost = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value)) / CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value),5) Else If CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) = 0 Then nCost = CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) Else nCost = CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value) End If End If nAnswer = vbYes ' If the current extended cost calculates out to the current unit cost, then there must be a rounding ' issue that would cause a difference here. If CDbl(nCost) = CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) Then nAnswer = msgbox("The unit cost of " + CStr(CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value)) + " calculates an extended cost of " + CStr(nValue) + ", but the current extended cost of " + CStr(CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value)) + " also calculates the current unit cost. Which extended cost would you like to use? Click yes to use " + CStr(nValue) + ", and click no to use " + CStr(CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value)) + ".",vbExclamation + vbYesNo,"Confirm") End If If nAnswer = vbYes Then Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value = nValue End If End If End If End Function

Function aplTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("aplTaxCodeID").Value) = "" Or CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) = 0 Then Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value = 0 Fields("aplTaxAmountForeign").Value = 0 Else Dim oRs,bPrev, rsAP, dDate Set rsAP = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsAP.Open "Select appInvoiceDate, appCreditDate, appInvoiceType From APInvoices Where appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsAP.EOF = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceDate").value If CInt(rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If End If
If IsNull(dDate) = True Then dDate = Date End If
Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select Top 1 IsNull(xabTaxRate,0) As xabTaxRate from TaxCodes Left Outer Join TaxCodeLines on xaxTaxCodeID = xabTaxCodeID where xaxTaxCodeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplTaxCodeID").Value) + " And IsNull(xabEffectiveDate,'19000101') <= " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dDate) + " Order By xabEffectiveDate DESC",Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then bPrev = App.UpdatingCost App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xabTaxRate").Value) / 100,4) Fields("aplTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostForeign").Value) * CDbl(oRs.Fields("xabTaxRate").Value) / 100,4) App.UpdatingCost = bPrev Fields("aplNonTaxReasonID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function aplSecondTaxCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim bPrev, rsAP, dDate
Set rsAP = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsAP.Open "Select appInvoiceDate, appCreditDate, appInvoiceType From APInvoices Where appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsAP.EOF = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value If CInt(rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If End If rsAP.Close If IsNull(dDate) = True Then dDate = Date End If
bPrev = App.UpdatingCost App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("aplSecondTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("aplSecondTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value, dDate, Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value, 4) Fields("aplSecondTaxAmountForeign").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("aplSecondTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("aplExtendedCostForeign").Value, dDate, Fields("aplTaxAmountForeign").Value, 4) App.UpdatingCost = bPrev End Function
Function aplExtendedCostBase_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value),"APInvoiceLines",Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value,"BASE",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostForeign").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("aplExtendedCostForeign").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If
If App.UpdatingUnitCost = True Then Dim nValue If CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value) <> 0 Then nValue = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value)) / CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseQuantity").Value),5) Else If CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) = 0 Then nValue = CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) Else nValue = CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("aplSetupChargeBase").Value) End If End If If CDbl(Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value) <> nValue Then Fields("aplPurchaseUnitCostBase").Value = nValue End If End If
Dim nExCost, rsAP, dDate Set rsAP = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsAP.Open "Select appInvoiceDate, appCreditDate, appInvoiceType From APInvoices Where appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsAP.EOF = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceDate").Value If CInt(rsAP.Fields("appInvoiceType").Value) = 2 Then If IsNull(rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value) = False Then dDate = rsAP.Fields("appCreditDate").Value End If End If End If rsAP.Close If IsNull(dDate) = True Then dDate = Date End If
nExCost = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("aplTotalExtendedCostBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value) - CDbl(Fields("aplSecondTaxAmountBase").Value)),2) If Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value <> nExCost Then Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("aplTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value, dDate, 0, 4)
Fields("aplSecondTaxAmountBase").Value = App.Ax("Financial").CalculateTaxOnSubTotal(Fields("aplSecondTaxCodeID").Value, Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value, dDate, Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value, 4)
Fields("aplTotalExtendedCostBase").Value = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("aplSecondTaxAmountBase").Value)), 2) End If
Dim nRetention, rsOrg If CInt(App.InUserChangeEvent) = True Then Set rsOrg = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsOrg.Open "Select cmoAPIncludeTaxInRetention From APInvoices Inner Join Organizations on appSupplierOrganizationID = cmoOrganizationID Where appAPInvoiceID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("aplAPInvoiceID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsOrg.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsOrg.Fields("cmoAPIncludeTaxInRetention").Value) = False Then nRetention = CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("aplRetentionPercent").Value) / 100) Else nRetention = (CDbl(Fields("aplExtendedCostBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("aplTaxAmountBase").Value) + CDbl(Fields("aplSecondTaxAmountBase").Value)) * (CDbl(Fields("aplRetentionPercent").Value) / 100) End If End If rsOrg.Close
If CDbl(Fields("aplRetentionAmountBase").Value) <> nRetention Then Fields("aplRetentionAmountBase").Value = nRetention End If End If End Function

Function xasCarrier_ValueChanged(sender, e) Select Case UCase(Trim(Fields("xasCarrier").Value)) Case "FEDEX", "FDXE", "FDXG": Fields("xasTrackingLink").Value = "http://www.fedex.com/tracking?action=track&language=english&cntry_code=us&initial=x&tracknumbers=<TrackingNumber>" Fields("xasReferenceTrackingLink").Value = "" Case "UPS": Fields("xasTrackingLink").Value = "http://wwwapps.ups.com/etracking/tracking.cgi?tracknums_displayed=1&TypeOfInquiryNumber=T&HTMLVersion=4.0&InquiryNumber1=<TrackingNumber>"
Fields("xasReferenceTrackingLink").Value = "http://wwwapps.ups.com/WebTracking/OnlineTool?TypeOfInquiryNumber=R&InquiryNumber=<ReferenceID>&FromPickupMonth=<DateRangeFromMonth>&FromPickupDay=<DateRangeFromDay>&FromPickupYear=<DateRangeFromYear>&ToPickupMonth=<DateRangeToMonth>&ToPickupDay=<DateRangeToDay>&ToPickupYear=<DateRangeToYear>&SenderShipperNumber=<AccountNumber>&DestinationPostalCode=&DestinationCountry="
Case "YELL": Fields("xasTrackingLink").Value = "http://www.myyellow.com/dynamic/services/servlet?CONTROLLER=com.yell.ec.inter.yfsgentracking.http.controller.TrackPro&PRONumber=<TrackingNumber>" Fields("xasReferenceTrackingLink").Value = "" Case "TNT": Fields("xasTrackingLink").Value = "http://www.tntexpress.com.au/InterAction/ASPs/CnmHxAS.asp?<TrackingNumber>" Fields("xasReferenceTrackingLink").Value = "" End Select
If Trim(Fields("xasCarrier").Value) <> "FDXE" And Trim(Fields("xasCarrier").Value) <> "FDXG" Then Fields("xasFdxReturnShipIndicator").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxDropOffType").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxService").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxRateRequestType").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxHomeDeliveryType").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxSignatureOption").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxCODCollectionType").Value = "" Fields("xasfdxAccessibility").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxSaturdayDelivery").Value = False Fields("xasFdxCod").Value = False Fields("xasFdxNonStandardContainer").Value = False Fields("xasFdxSaturdayPickup").Value = False Fields("xasFdxInsideDelivery").Value = False Fields("xasFdxInsidePickup").Value = False Fields("xasFdxHoldAtLocation").Value = False Fields("xasFdxVHCLevel").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxVHCType").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxVHCAmountOrPercentage").Value = 0 Fields("xasFdxRateTypeBasis").Value= "" Fields("xasFdxRateElementBasis").Value= "" Else If Trim(Fields("xasCarrier").Value) = "FDXG" Then Fields("xasFdxDropOffType").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxHoldAtLocation").Value = False Fields("xasfdxAccessibility").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxInsidePickup").Value = False Fields("xasFdxInsideDelivery").Value = False Fields("xasFdxSaturdayPickup").Value = False Fields("xasFdxSaturdayDelivery").Value = False call SetFedExDefaultValuesFromDbOptions() End If If Trim(Fields("xasCarrier").Value) = "FDXE" Then Fields("xasFdxCODCollectionType").Value = "" Fields("xasFdxNonStandardContainer").Value = False Fields("xasFdxHomeDeliveryType").Value = "" call SetFedExDefaultValuesFromDbOptions() End If End If End Function
Function xasFdxHoldAtLocation_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Record.EntryMode = ".NET" Then If CBool(Fields("xasFdxHoldAtLocation").Value) = True Or Trim(Fields("xasfdxAccessibility").Value) = "ACCESSIBLE" Or Trim(Fields("xasfdxAccessibility").Value) = "INACCESSIBLE" Then Fields("xasFdxSignatureOption").Value = "" End If End If End Function
Function xasFdxAccessibility_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Record.EntryMode = ".NET" Then If CBool(Fields("xasFdxHoldAtLocation").Value) = True Or Trim(Fields("xasfdxAccessibility").Value) = "ACCESSIBLE" Or Trim(Fields("xasfdxAccessibility").Value) = "INACCESSIBLE" Then Fields("xasFdxSignatureOption").Value = "" End If End If End Function
function SetFedExDefaultValuesFromDbOptions() Dim rsDetails set rsDetails = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsDetails.Open "SELECT xsmFdxReturnShipIndicator, xsmFdxDropOffType, xsmFdxWebRateRequestType, xsmFdxRateTypeBasis, xsmFdxRateElementBasis, xsmFdxRateRequestType,xsmFdxPackaging, xsmFdxVHCLevel, xsmFdxVHCType, xsmFdxVHCAmountOrPercentage,xsmFdxHomeDeliveryType FROM ShippingProperties", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsDetails.EOF = False Then Fields("xasFdxReturnShipIndicator").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxReturnShipIndicator").Value) Fields("xasFdxDropOffType").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxDropOffType").Value) Fields("xasFdxWebRateRequestType").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxWebRateRequestType").Value) Fields("xasFdxRateRequestType").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxRateRequestType").Value) Fields("xasFdxRateTypeBasis").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxRateTypeBasis").Value) Fields("xasFdxRateElementBasis").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxRateElementBasis").Value) Fields("xasFdxVHCLevel").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxVHCLevel").Value) Fields("xasFdxVHCType").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxVHCType").Value) Fields("xasFdxVHCAmountOrPercentage").Value= rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxVHCAmountOrPercentage").Value Fields("xasFdxHomeDeliveryType").Value= Trim(rsDetails.Fields("xsmFdxHomeDeliveryType").Value) End If rsDetails.Close end function

Function glfStartDate_Valid(sender, e) Dim detailsRs If Not IsEmpty(Fields("glfStartDate").Value) And Not IsEmpty(Fields("glfEndDate").Value) And CInt(Fields("glfGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value) <= 12 Then Set detailsRs = Record.Table.BindingSource.GetRecordset() Set tempRs = detailsRs.Select("glfStartDate <= " + detailsRs.FormatDateForSelect(Fields("glfStartDate").Value) + " and glfEndDate >= " + detailsRs.FormatDateForSelect(Fields("glfStartDate").Value) + " and glfGLFiscalYearID = " + CStr(Fields("glfGLFiscalYearID").Value) + " and glfGLFiscalYearPeriodID <> " + CStr(Fields("glfGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value) + " and glfGLFiscalYearPeriodID <> 13") If tempRs.RecordCount > 0 Then Call e.AddWarning("The From Date for period " + CStr(Fields("glfGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value) + " overlaps the dates for period " + CStr(tempRs.Fields("glfGLFiscalYearPeriodID").Value)) End If End If End Function

Function jmtPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, rsParts
cPartID = UCase(Trim(Fields("jmtPartID").Value)) cPartRevisionID = UCase(Trim(Fields("jmtPartRevisionID").Value)) Set rsParts = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
If cPartID <> "" Then rsParts.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrWeight from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartID) & " And imrPartRevisionID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(cPartRevisionID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsParts.EOF = False Then Fields("jmtDescription").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("jmtUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsParts.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If rsParts.Close End If End Function
Function jmtPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("jmtPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("jmtPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("jmtPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("jmtPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactiveAndEmpty(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddWarning "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive and has no quantity on hand or quantity to inspect" + Chr(13) End If End If end function

Function uxLandedCostPOInTransitRemoveButton_Click(sender, e) Dim cWhere If Trim(controls("m1datacontrol").recordset.fields("rmcLandedCostID").Value) <> "" Then If controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostPOs").recordset.EOF = False Then If CBool(controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostPOs").recordset.Fields("pmlInTransitJournalsCreated").Value) = False Then If Trim(controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostPOs").recordset.Fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value) <> "" Then cWhere = "pmlPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostPOs").recordset.fields("pmlPurchaseOrderID").Value)) + " And pmlPurchaseOrderLineID = " + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(Trim(controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostPOs").recordset.fields("pmlPurchaseOrderLineID").Value))
Connection.Execute "Update PurchaseOrderLines Set pmlLandedCostID = '' Where pmlLandedCostID <> '' And " & cWhere this.SaveView Call LoadPOGrid End If Else Call Msgbox("The selected purchase order line could not be removed as in-transit journals have been created", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly) End If End If End If End Function

Function uxLandedCostDetailRemoveButton_Click(sender, e) Dim cWhere If Trim(controls("m1datacontrol").recordset.fields("rmcLandedCostID").Value) <> "" Then If controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostReceipts").recordset.EOF = False Then If CBool(controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostReceipts").recordset.Fields("rmlPostedToGL").Value) = False Then If Trim(controls("m1BindingSourceLandedCostReceipts").recordset.Fields("rmlReceiptID").Value) <> "" Then cWhere = "rmpLandedCostID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(controls("m1datacontrol").recordset.fields("rmcLandedCostID").Value)) Connection.Execute "UPDATE ReceiptLines SET rmlDutyUnitCost = 0, rmlFreightUnitCost = 0, rmlMiscUnitCost = 0 FROM ReceiptLines Inner Join Receipts on rmpReceiptID=rmlReceiptID WHERE " + cWhere Connection.Execute "Update Receipts Set rmpLandedCostID = '' Where rmpLandedCostID <> '' And " & cWhere this.SaveView this.OnTableChanged("Receipts") Call LoadReceiptGrid End If Else Call Msgbox("The selected receipt could not be removed as it has been posted", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly) End If End If End If End Function

Function PurchaseOrders_UpdateStarted(sender, e) If App.Ax("FollowUps").TransferPurchaseOrderToFollowup(Fields) Then Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(2) End If
' Check to see if the suppler/loc has changed on the current record and update if it has If Trim(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").OriginalValue) Or _ Trim(Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) <> Trim(Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").OriginalValue) Then
' Update the supplier/location on linked job operations Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobOperations SET jmoSupplierOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + ", jmoPurchaseLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) + _ "FROM JobOperations " + _ "Inner Join PurchaseOrderLines on jmoJobID = pmlJobID and jmoJobAssemblyID = pmlJobAssemblyID and jmoJobOperationID = pmlJobOperationID and pmlPurchaseOrderID = jmoPurchaseOrderID " + _ "Inner Join PurchaseOrders on pmlPurchaseOrderID = pmpPurchaseOrderID " + _ "WHERE pmpPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpPurchaseOrderID").Value) + _ "And pmlPurchaseType = 1 and pmlJobType = 2"
' Update the supplier/location on linked job materials Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobMaterials SET jmmSupplierOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + ", jmmPurchaseLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) + _ "FROM JobMaterials " + _ "Inner Join PurchaseOrderLines on jmmJobID = pmlJobID and jmmJobAssemblyID = pmlJobAssemblyID and jmmJobMaterialID = pmlJobMaterialID and pmlPurchaseOrderID = jmmPurchaseOrderID " + _ "Inner Join PurchaseOrders on pmlPurchaseOrderID = pmpPurchaseOrderID " + _ "WHERE pmpPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpPurchaseOrderID").Value) + _ "And pmlPurchaseType = 1 and pmlJobType = 1" End If End Function
Function PurchaseOrders_DeleteStarted(sender, e) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobMaterials SET jmmPurchaseOrderID = '' WHERE jmmPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpPurchaseOrderID").Value) Connection.Execute "UPDATE JobOperations SET jmoPurchaseOrderID = '' WHERE jmoPurchaseOrderID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpPurchaseOrderID").Value) End Function
Function PurchaseOrders_SaveAs(aWhere) Dim rsTemp,dNewDate,nDiff,rsTemp2 dNewDate = Null Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT pmpOrderDate,pmpDueDate FROM PurchaseOrders WHERE " + aWhere(0),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value) = False And IsNull(rsTemp.Fields("pmpDueDate").Value) = False Then ' Get the number of days difference and apply that amount to the dates on the new order. nDiff = DateDiff("d",rsTemp.Fields("pmpOrderDate").Value,rsTemp.Fields("pmpDueDate").Value) dNewDate = DateAdd("d",nDiff,Date()) End If End If Connection.Execute "UPDATE PurchaseOrders SET pmpOrderDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSQL(Date) + ",pmpDueDate = " + App.Convert.DateToSql(dNewDate) + " WHERE " + aWhere(0) End Function
Function pmpDropShipOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("pmpDropShipOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmoDefaultShipLocationID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpDropShipOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("pmpDropShipLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoDefaultShipLocationID").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function pmpClosed_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("pmpClosed").Value) = True Then Fields("pmpClosedDate").Value = Date Else Fields("pmpClosedDate").Value = Null End If End Function
Function pmpAPInvoiceLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) = "" And Trim(Fields("pmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) = "" Then Fields("pmpAPInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("pmpPaymentTermID").Value = "" Else Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlAPInvoiceContactID,cmlSupplierPaymentTermID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("pmpAPInvoiceContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlAPInvoiceContactID").Value Fields("pmpPaymentTermID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlSupplierPaymentTermID").Value Else Fields("pmpAPInvoiceContactID").Value = "" Fields("pmpPaymentTermID").Value = "" End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function pmpPurchaseLocationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmlPurchaseContactID,cmlSupplierShippingMethodID from OrganizationLocations where cmlOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) + " and cmlLocationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("pmpPurchaseContactID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlPurchaseContactID").Value Fields("pmpShippingMethodID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmlSupplierShippingMethodID").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function pmpProjectID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("pmpProjectID").Value) <> "" And Trim(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) = "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select prpOrganizationID,prpLocationID,prpContactID,cmoSupplierStatus From Projects Inner Join Organizations On prpOrganizationID = cmoOrganizationID Where prpProjectID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpProjectID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then If CInt(rsData.Fields("cmoSupplierStatus").Value) = 2 Then Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpOrganizationID").Value Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpLocationID").Value Fields("pmpPurchaseContactID").Value = rsData.Fields("prpContactID").Value End If End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function pmpSupplierOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs If Trim(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID,cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID,cmoSupplierShippingMethodID,cmoCurrencyRateID,cmoDropShipOrganizationID,cmoDropShipLocationID from Organizations where cmoOrganizationID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("pmpShippingMethodID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoSupplierShippingMethodID").Value Fields("pmpCurrencyRateID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoCurrencyRateID").Value ' If blank, don't need to set it again, as the related fields are blanked out automatically each time the customer is changed. If Trim(Fields("pmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oRs.Fields("cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID").Value) Then Fields("pmpAPInvoiceLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoDefaultAPInvoiceLocationID").Value End If If Trim(Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value) <> Trim(oRs.Fields("cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID").Value) Then Fields("pmpPurchaseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoDefaultPurchaseLocationID").Value End If
Fields("pmpDropShipOrganizationID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoDropShipOrganizationID").Value Fields("pmpDropShipLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("cmoDropShipLocationID").Value End If oRs.Close if cbool(App.Props("DS").Fields("xadAllowIntraCompanyTrans").Value) = True Then If Trim(Fields("pmpSupplierOrganizationID").Fields("cmoIntraCompanyDatasetID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("pmpIntraCompany").Value = true Else Fields("pmpIntraCompany").Value = false End if Else Fields("pmpIntraCompany").Value = false End if End If End Function

Dim bInUpdate
Function RMAClaimLines_AddNewCompleted(sender, e) e.FocusField = "ralPartID" End Function
Function ralSupplierOrganizationID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nValue If Trim(Fields("ralPartID").Value) <> "" Then Dim objPartCosts Set objPartCosts = App.Ax("Part").GetPartCosts(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("ralPartID").Value, Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value) if IsNull(objPartCosts) = False Then nValue = Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) + _ Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) End If Set objPartCosts = nothing
If Cdbl(nValue) > 0 Then If CDbl(nValue) <> CDbl(Fields("ralUnitCost").Value) Then Fields("ralUnitCost").Value = nValue End If End If End If End Function
Function ralActionType_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("ralActionType").Value) <> "3" Then Fields("ralReturnToSupplier").Value = False End If End Function
Function ralPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData,rsClaim,nPrice,nValue,bForeign,bKitPart bKitPart = False If Trim(Fields("ralPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure,imrLongDescriptionRTF,imrLongDescriptionText,impPhantomOrKitPart from PartRevisions Inner Join Parts on imrPartID=impPartID where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ralPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("ralPartShortDescription").Value = rsData.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("ralUnitOfMeasure").Value = rsData.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("ralPartLongDescriptionRTF").Value = rsData.Fields("imrLongDescriptionRTF").Value Fields("ralPartLongDescriptionText").Value = rsData.Fields("imrLongDescriptionText").Value bKitPart = rsData.Fields("impPhantomOrKitPart").Value
Set rsClaim = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsClaim.Open "SELECT rapCustomerOrganizationID,rapARInvoiceLocationID,rapCurrencyRateID,rapClaimDate FROM RMAClaims WHERE rapRMAClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ralRMAClaimID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsClaim.EOF = False Then Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetSellingPrice(Fields("ralPartID").Value,Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("ralPartGroupID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapCustomerOrganizationID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapARInvoiceLocationID").Value,Fields("ralQuantity").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapCurrencyRateID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapClaimDate").Value) nPrice = 0 nFullPrice = 0 bForeign = False If IsNull(priceObj) = False Then nFullPrice = priceObj.FullPrice nPrice = priceObj.DiscountedPrice bForeign = priceObj.IsForeignCurrency End If Set priceObj = nothing
If Cdbl(nPrice) <> -1 Then If bForeign = True Then If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value) Then Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").value = nPrice End If Else If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("ralUnitPrice").Value) Then Fields("ralUnitPrice").Value = nPrice End If End IF End If
Dim objPartCosts Set objPartCosts = App.Ax("Part").GetPartCosts(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("ralPartID").Value, Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value) if IsNull(objPartCosts) = False Then nValue = Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) + _ Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) End If Set objPartCosts = nothing
If Cdbl(nValue) > 0 Then If CDbl(nValue) <> CDbl(Fields("ralUnitCost").Value) Then Fields("ralUnitCost").Value = nValue End if End If End If rsClaim.Close End If rsData.Close End If Fields("ralKitPart").Value = bKitPart End Function
Function ralQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim rsData,rsClaim,nPrice,nValue,bForeign,nFullPrice
If Trim(Fields("ralPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set rsClaim = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsClaim.Open "SELECT rapCustomerOrganizationID,rapARInvoiceLocationID,rapCurrencyRateID,rapClaimDate FROM RMAClaims WHERE rapRMAClaimID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("ralRMAClaimID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsClaim.EOF = False Then Dim priceObj Set priceObj = App.Ax("Part").GetSellingPrice(Fields("ralPartID").Value,Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value,Fields("ralPartGroupID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapCustomerOrganizationID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapARInvoiceLocationID").Value,Fields("ralQuantity").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapCurrencyRateID").Value,rsClaim.Fields("rapClaimDate").Value) nPrice = 0 nFullPrice = 0 bForeign = False If IsNull(priceObj) = False Then nFullPrice = priceObj.FullPrice nPrice = priceObj.DiscountedPrice bForeign = priceObj.IsForeignCurrency End If Set priceObj = nothing
If Cdbl(nPrice) = -1 Then Else If bForeign = True Then Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").value = nFullPrice Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice Else Fields("ralFullUnitPriceBase").Value = nFullPrice Fields("ralUnitPrice").Value = nPrice End If End If
Dim objPartCosts Set objPartCosts = App.Ax("Part").GetPartCosts(e.SqlTransaction, Fields("ralPartID").Value, Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value) if IsNull(objPartCosts) = False Then nValue = Cdbl(objPartCosts.LaborCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.OverheadCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MaterialCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.SubcontractCost) + _ Cdbl(objPartCosts.DutyCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.FreightCost) + Cdbl(objPartCosts.MiscCost) End If Set objPartCosts = nothing
If Cdbl(nValue) > 0 Then If CDbl(nValue) <> CDbl(Fields("ralUnitCost").Value) Then Fields("ralUnitCost").Value = nValue End if End If End If rsClaim.Close End If
If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("ralConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then nValue = App.Round((CDbl(Fields("ralQuantity").Value)) * CDbl(Fields("ralConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").SellQuantityDecimals) If nValue <> CDbl(Fields("ralSalesQuantity").Value) Then Fields("ralSalesQuantity").Value = nValue End If End If End If
End Function
Function ralSalesQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(bInUpdate) = False Then If CDbl(Fields("ralConversionFactor").Value) <> 0 Then bInUpdate = True Fields("ralQuantity").Value = App.Round((Cdbl(Fields("ralSalesQuantity").Value)) / Cdbl(Fields("ralConversionFactor").Value), App.Ax("Production").InventoryQuantityDecimals) bInUpdate = False End If End If End Function
Function ralConversionFactor_ValueChanged(sender, e) Call ralSalesQuantity_ValueChanged(sender, e) End Function
Function CalculateDiscountPercent() Dim nPrice nPrice = 0 If CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = CDbl(Fields("ralUnitDiscountForeign").Value) / CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) nPrice = App.Round(nPrice * 100,2) If nPrice > 999.99 Then nPrice = 999.99 ElseIf nPrice < -999.99 Then nPrice = -999.99 End If End If CalculateDiscountPercent = nPrice End Function
Function ralUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice If CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value),5) If CDbl(Fields("ralUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("ralUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If Else If CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> CDbl(Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value) Then Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value = Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value End If End If End Function
Function ralFullUnitPriceForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("ralUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("ralDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("ralDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function ralDiscountPercent_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice,nPercent nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If nPercent <> CDbl(Fields("ralDiscountPercent").Value) Then nPrice = App.Round(CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) * (CDbl(Fields("ralDiscountPercent").Value) / 100),5) If CDbl(Fields("ralUnitDiscountForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("ralUnitDiscountForeign").Value = nPrice End If End If End Function
Function ralUnitDiscountForeign_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim nPrice nPrice = CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) - CDbl(Fields("ralUnitDiscountForeign").Value) If CDbl(Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> nPrice Then Fields("ralUnitPriceForeign").Value = nPrice End If If CDbl(Fields("ralFullUnitPriceForeign").Value) <> 0 Then nPercent = CalculateDiscountPercent() If CDbl(Fields("ralDiscountPercent").Value) <> nPercent Then Fields("ralDiscountPercent").Value = nPercent End If End If End Function
Function RMAClaimLines_SetDefaultValues(sender, e) Fields("ralProjectID").Value = Fields("ralRMAClaimID").Fields("rapProjectID").Value Fields("ralSalesUnitOfMeasure").Value = App.Props("OM").Fields("xapOMUnitOfMeasure").Value Fields("ralRequiresInspection").Value = App.Props("ProductionProperties").Fields("xapQARMARequiresInspection").Value End Function
Function ralSalesOrderID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("ralSalesOrderID").Value) <> "" Then Fields("ralCustomerPO").Value = Fields("ralSalesOrderID").Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value else Fields("ralCustomerPO").Value="" end if End Function
Function ralPartBinID_Valid(sender, e) Dim cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin cPartID = Trim(Fields("ralPartID").Value) cPartRevisionID = Trim(Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value) cWarehouse = Trim(Fields("ralPartWarehouseLocationID").Value) cBin = Trim(Fields("ralPartBinID").Value) If cPartID = "" or cWarehouse = "" or cBin = "" then Exit function End if If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartNonStockedOrKit(cPartID, e.SqlTransaction)) = false Then If CBool(App.Ax("Part").IsPartBinInactive(cPartID, cPartRevisionID, cWarehouse, cBin, e.SqlTransaction)) = True Then e.AddWarning "Part ID ‘" + cPartID + "’, Revision ‘" + cPartRevisionID + "’, Warehouse ‘" + cWarehouse + "’, Bin ‘" + cBin + "’ is inactive" + Chr(13) End If End If End Function

Function spaPackageDimensionsUOM_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("spaPackageDimensionsUOM").Value) = "CM" And Trim(Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value) <> "KGS" Then If Trim(Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value) = "" Then Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value = "KGS" Else If Msgbox("Centimeters cannot be used when weight UOM is set to pounds. Do you want to change weight UOM to kilograms?", vbYesNo, "Confirm") = vbYes Then Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value = "KGS" Else Fields("spaPackageDimensionsUOM").Value = "IN" End If End If End If If Trim(Fields("spaPackageDimensionsUOM").Value) = "IN" And Trim(Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value) <> "LBS" Then If Trim(Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value) = "" Then Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value = "LBS" Else If Msgbox("Inches cannot be used when weight UOM is set to kilograms. Do you want to change weight UOM to pounds?", vbYesNo, "Confirm") = vbYes Then Fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value = "LBS" Else Fields("spaPackageDimensionsUOM").Value = "CM" End If End If End If End Function

Function spaPackageWeight_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("SPACarrier").Value) = "UPS" Then if Trim(fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value) = "LBS" then if fields("spaUPSPackageTypes").value = "25" then if cdbl(fields("spaPackageWeight").value) < 0 or cdbl(fields("spaPackageWeight").value) > 22 then msgbox "Weight must be greater than zero and less than or equal to 22 " & Trim(fields("spaPackageWeightUOM").Value) & ".", 0,"Invalid Weight Specified" e.FocusField = "spaPackageWeight" fields("spaPackageWeight").value=cdbl(0) end if elseif fields("spaUPSPackageTypes").value = "24" then if cdbl(fields("spaPackageWeight").value) < 0 or cdbl(fields("spaPackageWeight").value) > 55 then msgbox "Weight must be greater than zero and less than Function GetCustomerPOForPackage(ByVal nPackageID) Dim cCustomerPO Dim bFound Dim rsCustomerPO Dim rsDetails Dim cLines
Set rsCustomerPO = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") set rsDetails = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
rsCustomerPO.Open "Select Distinct ompCustomerPO From ShipmentLines Inner Join SalesOrders on smlSalesOrderID = ompSalesOrderID Where ompCustomerPO <> '' And smlShipmentID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("spaShipmentID").Value)), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsCustomerPO.RecordCount = 1 Then If IsNull(rsCustomerPO.Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value) = False Then cCustomerPO = Trim(rsCustomerPO.Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value) End If bFound = True End If rsCustomerPO.Close
If bFound = False And nPackageID <> 0 Then ' Need to check details in box rsDetails.open "Select distinct spdShipmentLineID From ShipmentPackageDetails Where spdShipmentID =" & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("spaShipmentID").Value)) & " And spdShipmentPackageID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(nPackageID), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText Do While rsDetails.EOF = False cLines = cLines & "," & cstr(rsDetails.Fields("spdShipmentLineID").Value) rsDetails.MoveNext Loop
If cLines <> "" Then cLines = Mid(cLines, 2) End If If Trim(cLines) <> "" Then rsCustomerPO.Open "Select distinct ompCustomerPO from ShipmentLines Inner Join SalesOrders On smlSalesOrderID = ompSalesOrderID Where smlShipmentID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Trim(Fields("spaShipmentID").Value)) & " And smlShipmentLineID In (" & Trim(cLines) & ") And ompCustomerPO <> '' Order By ompCustomerPO", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsCustomerPO.EOF = False Then If IsNull(rsCustomerPO.Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value) = False Then cCustomerPO = Trim(rsCustomerPO.Fields("ompCustomerPO").Value) End If End If rsCustomerPO.Close End If
End If
GetCustomerPOForPackage = cCustomerPO
end function

Function rmhExchangeRate_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim bFixForeign, oRs, nPrice bFixForeign = False Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
oRs.Open "Select cmlCurrencyRateID From OrganizationLocations Where cmlOrganizationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmhSupplierOrganizationID").Value) & " And cmlLocationID = " & App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("rmhSupplierLocationID").Value), Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then If (Trim(oRs.Fields("cmlCurrencyRateID").Value) = Trim(Fields("rmhCurrencyRateID").Value)) And ((Trim(Fields("rmhCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "") And (Trim(Fields("rmhCurrencyRateID").Value) <> Trim(App.HomeCurrencyID))) Then bFixForeign = True End If End If oRs.Close
' Need to keep this as automatic currency exchange cannot occur due to needing to check if any in-transit journals were created first If bFixForeign = False Then If CInt(Fields("rmhInTransitJournalsCreated").Value) = 0 Then If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("rmhEstTotalCost").Value),"LANDEDCOSTCHARGES",Fields,"BASE",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("rmhEstTotalCostForeign").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("rmhEstTotalCostForeign").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If End If Else If CInt(Fields("rmhInTransitJournalsCreated").Value) = 0 Then If App.UpdatingCost = False Then nPrice = App.Ax("LegacyFunctions").ExchangeCurrency(CDbl(Fields("rmhEstTotalCostForeign").Value),"LANDEDCOSTCHARGES",Fields,"FOREIGN",2) If CDbl(nPrice) <> CDbl(Fields("rmhEstTotalCost").Value) Then App.UpdatingCost = True Fields("rmhEstTotalCost").Value = nPrice App.UpdatingCost = False End If End If End If End If
If CInt(Fields("rmhInTransitJournalsCreated").Value) = 0 Then Fields("rmhEstExchangeRate").Value = Fields("rmhExchangeRate").Value End If End Function

Function DMRShipments_DeleteStarted(sender, e) dim shipmentId,shipmentLineId If CBool(Fields("dspReversalEntry").Value) = True And CBool(Fields("dspPosted").Value)=False Then Set rsTemp = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsTemp.Open "SELECT dslReverseDMRShipmentID,dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID FROM DMRShipmentLines WHERE dslDMRShipmentID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("dspDMRShipmentID").Value) , Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If rsTemp.EOF = False Then Do While rsTemp.EOF = False shipmentId=Trim(rsTemp.Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentID").Value) shipmentLineId=rsTemp.Fields("dslReverseDMRShipmentLineID").Value If shipmentId <> "" Then Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipmentLines Set dslReversed=0 Where dslDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(shipmentId)+" And dslDMRShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(shipmentLineId) Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipmentComponents Set dsoReversed=0 Where dsoDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(shipmentId)+" And dsoDMRShipmentLineID=" + App.Convert.NumberToSQL(shipmentLineId) Connection.Execute "Update DMRShipments Set dspReversed=0 Where dspDMRShipmentID=" + App.Convert.StringToSql(shipmentId) End If rsTemp.MoveNext Loop Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) End If rsTemp.Close End If End Function
Function DMRShipments_UpdateStarted(sender, e) Dim shipmentID, shipmentLineID, sWhere, cDeleteShipmentLines Dim rsDMRShipmentLines, childBs Dim strArrayShipmentLines
If Cbool(App.Props("ProductionProperties").Fields("xapSMDeleteZeroShipmentLines").Value) then Set strArrayShipmentLines = CreateObject("System.Collections.ArrayList") Set childBs = Record.Table.GetChildBindingSource("DMRShipmentLines") if childBs.count > 0 then Set rsDMRShipmentLines = childBs.GetRecordset() if rsDMRShipmentLines.Recordcount > 0 then rsDMRShipmentLines.MoveFirst Do While Not rsDMRShipmentLines.EOF if Cdbl(rsDMRShipmentLines.Fields("dslQuantityShipped").Value) = 0 then shipmentID = Trim(rsDMRShipmentLines.Fields("dslDMRShipmentID").Value) shipmentLineID = Cint(rsDMRShipmentLines.Fields("dslDMRShipmentLineID").Value) sWhere = "" sWhere = "(Fields(" & chr(34) & "dslDMRShipmentID" & chr(34) & ") = " & chr(34) & Trim(shipmentID) & chr(34) sWhere = sWhere & " AND Fields(" & chr(34) & "dslDMRShipmentLineID" & chr(34) & ") = " & Cint(shipmentLineID) & ")" strArrayShipmentLines.Add sWhere end if rsDMRShipmentLines.MoveNext() loop end if rsDMRShipmentLines.Close If strArrayShipmentLines.Count > 0 Then cDeleteShipmentLines = join(strArrayShipmentLines.ToArray(), " Or ") Call childBs.RemoveWhere(cDeleteShipmentLines) Call Record.Table.BindingSource.OnDataChanged(3) end if end if Set rsDMRShipmentLines = nothing Set childBs = nothing end if End Function

Function DatasetProperties_Valid(sender, e) Dim cText cText = "" If CInt(Fields("xadInventoryQuantityDecimals").Value) < CInt(Fields("xadSellQuantityDecimals").Value) Or _ CInt(Fields("xadInventoryQuantityDecimals").Value) < CInt(Fields("xadBuyQuantityDecimals").Value) Then cText = cText + "Inventory decimals cannot be less than the buy and sell decimals" + Chr(13) End If ' Check to see if non-nettable has been unchecked If CInt(Fields("xadEnableNonNettable").Value) <> CInt(Fields("xadEnableNonNettable").OriginalValue) And _ CInt(Fields("xadEnableNonNettable").Value) = 0 Then Dim oRs Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") 'oRs.Open "Select imbpartid From PartBins b where (select sum(imbQuantityOnHand) from partbins a inner join PartWarehouselocations on b.imbWarehouseID = imlPartWareHouseID and b.imbPartID = imlPartID and 'b.imbPartRevisionID = imlPartRevisionID where a.imbPartID = b.imbPartID and a.imbPartRevisionID = b.imbPartRevisionID and a.imbWareHouseID = b.imbWareHouseID) > 0 group by 'imbPartID,imbPartRevisionID,imbWarehouseid", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText oRs.Open "SELECT imwWarehouseID FROM Warehouses WHERE imwNonNettable = 1", Connection, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText If oRs.RecordCount > 0 Then cText = cText + "Warehouses marked as non-nettable must be unmarked before disabling this option" + Chr(13) End If End If e.AddError cText If CDbl(Fields("xadHoursMon").Value) = 0 And CDbl(Fields("xadHoursTue").Value) = 0 And CDbl(Fields("xadHoursWed").Value) = 0 And CDbl(Fields("xadHoursThu").Value) = 0 And CDbl(Fields("xadHoursFri").Value) = 0 And CDbl(Fields("xadHoursSat").Value) = 0 And CDbl(Fields("xadHoursSun").Value) = 0 Then e.AddError "At least one day of the week in Company Details must have hours" End If End Function
Function xadCurrencyRateID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("xadCurrencyRateID").Value) <> "" Then App.HomeCurrencyID = Trim(Fields("xadCurrencyRateID").Value) Else App.HomeCurrencyID = "" End If End Function
Function xadAllowIntraCompanyTrans_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CBool(Fields("xadAllowIntraCompanyTrans").Value) = False then Fields("xadIntraCompanyOrganizationID").Value = "" end if End Function

Function qarCorrectiveActionComplete_ValueChanged(sender, e) If CInt(Fields("qarCorrectiveActionComplete").Value) = True and IsNull(Fields("qarCorrectiveActionDate").Value) Then Fields("qarCorrectiveActionDate").Value = Date End If End Function
Function qarCorrectiveActionCategoryID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Fields("qarCorrectiveActionCodeID").Value = "" End Function
Function qarCorrectiveActionCodeID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("qarCorrectiveActionCodeID").Value) <> "" Then Dim rsData Set rsData = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") rsData.Open "Select qaoHoursAllowed From CorrectiveActionCodes Where qaoCorrectiveActionCodeID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qarCorrectiveActionCodeID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If rsData.EOF = False Then Fields("qarHoursAllowed").Value = rsData.Fields("qaoHoursAllowed").Value End If rsData.Close End If End Function
Function qarPartRevisionID_ValueChanged(sender, e) If Trim(Fields("qarPartID").Value) <> "" Then Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "select imrShortDescription,imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure from PartRevisions where imrPartID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qarPartID").Value) + " And imrPartRevisionID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(Fields("qarPartRevisionID").Value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qarPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("imrShortDescription").Value Fields("qarUnitOfMeasure").Value = oRs.Fields("imrInventoryUnitOfMeasure").Value End If oRs.Close End If End Function
Function qarInspectionLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Dim rsLookup Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT qalPartid,qalPartRevisionID,qalPartWarehouseLocationID,qalPartBinID,qalPartShortDescription,qalJobID,qalJobAssemblyID,qalJobOperationID,qalJobMaterialID FROM inspectionLines where qalInspectionid = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(fields("qarInspectionID").value) + " and qalInspectionLineID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(fields("qarInspectionLineID").value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qarPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("qalPartid").Value Fields("qarPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("qalPartRevisionID").Value Fields("qarPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("qalPartWarehouseLocationid").Value Fields("qarPartBinID").Value = oRs.Fields("qalPartBinID").Value Fields("qarPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("qalPartShortDescription").Value If IsNull(oRs.Fields("qalJobID").value) = False Then Fields("qarJobID").value = oRs.Fields("qalJobID").value Fields("qarJobAssemblyID").Value = oRs.Fields("qalJobAssemblyID").value Fields("qarJobOperationID").Value = oRs.Fields("qalJobOperationID").value Fields("qarJobMaterialID").Value = oRs.Fields("qalJobMaterialID").value End If End If oRs.Close End Function
Function qarRMAClaimLineID_ValueChanged(sender, e) Dim oRs Dim rsLookup Set oRs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset") oRs.Open "SELECT ralPartid,ralPartRevisionID,ralPartWarehouseLocationID,ralPartBinID,ralPartShortDescription FROM RMAClaimLines where ralRMAClaimID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(fields("qarRMAClaimID").value) + " and ralRMAClaimLineID = " + App.Convert.StringToSql(fields("qarRMAClaimLineID").value),Connection,adOpenStatic,adLockReadOnly,adCmdText If oRs.EOF = False Then Fields("qarPartID").Value = oRs.Fields("ralPartid").Value Fields("qarPartRevisionID").Value = oRs.Fields("ralPartRevisionID").Value Fields("qarPartWarehouseLocationID").Value = oRs.Fields("ralPartWarehouseLocationid").Value Fields("qarPartBinID").Value = oRs.Fields("ralPartBinID").Value Fields("qarPartShortDescription").Value = oRs.Fields("ralPartShortDescription").Value End If oRs.Close End Function
